title: Mechanical or Rotating Equipment Engineer / Inspector
description:
Job Purpose

To perform independent verification, inspection, and technical integrity assessments of offshore mechanical and rotating equipment, structures, and safety-critical elements, ensuring compliance with applicable standards, regulatory requirements, and asset integrity management systems.

Key Responsibilities

Rotating Equipment Verification

  • Conduct verification and inspection of rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, turbines, generators, motors, and associated systems.
  • Assess equipment condition, maintenance effectiveness, and operational integrity.
  • Identify equipment deficiencies and recommend corrective actions.

Structural Integrity Verification

  • Perform verification of offshore structures, topside structures, and helidecks.
  • Conduct annual surveys of offshore facilities and verify structural integrity compliance.
  • Assess corrosion, degradation, fatigue, and structural protection systems.

Safety Critical Element (SCE) Verification

  • Conduct verification of Safety and Environmental Critical Elements (SECEs/HSECES), including:
    • Fire and Gas Detection Systems
    • Emergency Shutdown and Isolation Systems
    • Surface Safety Isolation Valves (SSIV)
    • Subsurface Safety Valves (SSSV)
    • High Integrity Pressure Protection Systems (HIPPS)
    • Emergency Depressurization Systems
    • Reservoir Isolation and Containment Systems
    • Toxic Gas and Oxygen Depletion Detection Systems
    • Drainage and Containment Systems
    • Drilling Well Control Systems

Fire and Safety Systems Verification

  • Verify effectiveness and operational readiness of:
    • Fire Water Pumps and Fire Water Systems
    • Foam Systems
    • Portable and Fixed Fire Extinguishing Systems
    • Gaseous and Liquid Fire Suppression Systems
    • Blast Resistant Structures
    • Fire Mitigation and Collision Protection Systems
    • Dropped Object Prevention and Protection Systems

Emergency Systems Assessment

  • Verify emergency preparedness systems including:
    • Public Address (PA) and Alarm Systems
    • Emergency Lighting Systems
    • Emergency Power Supplies and Generators
    • Lifeboats and Life Rafts
    • Escape, Rescue and Recovery Facilities
    • Means of Escape and Access Routes
    • Crane Safety Certifications and Test Records

Technical Integrity Verification

  • Conduct physical inspections and surveys of offshore facilities.
  • Review maintenance management documentation, inspection reports, and asset integrity records.
  • Verify process containment integrity, relief systems, pipeline and riser integrity, and well containment systems.
  • Assess HVAC systems, ignition prevention systems, ballast systems, stability management systems, and anchoring/mooring systems.
  • Evaluate collision avoidance measures and other operational risk controls.

Inspection and Reporting

  • Independently select equipment and systems for verification activities based on risk and integrity requirements.
  • Perform inspections at elevated locations and offshore work areas.
  • Prepare technical reports, observations, Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), findings, and recommendations.
  • Track closure of corrective actions and follow-up activities.
  • Ensure compliance with company standards, industry regulations, and statutory requirements.

Educational Qualification

  • Diploma / Bachelor's Degree (B.E./B.Tech) / Master's Degree (M.E./M.Tech) in Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent engineering discipline.
  • Additional certifications in Asset Integrity Management, Rotating Equipment, Inspection Engineering, Offshore Safety, Reliability Engineering, or Risk-Based Inspection (RBI) will be an advantage.
  • Offshore safety certifications such as BOSIET, H2S, HUET, or equivalent offshore training are preferred.
  • Membership or certification from recognized professional bodies (e.g., ASME, API, IMechE, or equivalent) is desirable.
  • Minimum 18+ years of experience in Offshore Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Refinery, or Process Industries.
  • At least one offshore operations/maintenance assignment is mandatory.
  • Proven experience in Technical Integrity Verification, Independent Verification Body (IVB) Services, and Safety Critical Element (SCE/HSECES) Verification.
  • Must be capable of independently selecting equipment and systems for verification based on risk and criticality.
  • Physically fit and competent to conduct inspections at heights and offshore installations.

title: Trainee Cardiac Physiologist
description:
• Salary from $72,100 per annum, plus 12% superannuation and access to salary packaging benefits.

  • Location: Macquarie University, Wallumattagal Campus, North Ryde

Drive innovation in healthcare, transform patient outcomes, and advance your career today.


Macquarie University Health is seeking a science graduate with an interest in Cardiac Anatomy and Physiology to join the Cardiology and Interventional Services team, working across ECG, non-invasive cardiac diagnostics and the cardiac catheterisation laboratory. You will perform, analyse and report on a broad range of cardiac investigations, and provide specialist physiological support during diagnostic and interventional procedures, including complex structural heart cases and coronary physiology studies. It is a role with genuine clinical breadth, situated in an environment where diagnostic expertise, teaching and research work side by side to improve care for patients.


About the Role


The Cardiac Physiologist is central to the safe, timely and accurate delivery of cardiac diagnostics and procedural support at Macquarie University Health. Working alongside cardiologists, nursing staff, allied health professionals and students, you will apply sound clinical reasoning and technical expertise within your scope of practice, escalating findings that require immediate clinical attention and contributing to a coordinated, patient-centred approach to care.

Key areas of responsibility include:


• Providing specialist cardiac physiological support during diagnostic and interventional cardiac catheterisation, right heart catheterisation and cardiac device procedures, including haemodynamic monitoring, ECG interpretation and operation of imaging and recording systems
• Preparing accurate patient reports for referring and treating clinicians, and maintaining complete records in the electronic medical record and related systems
• Communicating findings respectfully and clearly with patients, families and carers, and promptly escalating results requiring urgent clinical review
• Maintaining cardiac equipment in safe working order, arranging servicing and repairs, and supporting continuous quality improvement, audit and research activities
• Contributing to education and professional development, including weekly cardiac diagnostic meetings, in-house education sessions, and supervision of less experienced staff and students in routine tasks


About You


• A degree in science, preferably health science, or an equivalent qualification, with membership of Professionals in Cardiac Sciences Australia (PICSA) and/or ACCP viewed favourably
• Sound knowledge of cardiac anatomy, physiology and pathology, and the ability to work independently within the scope of practice for Cardiac Physiologists
• Demonstrated some basic knowledge in performing and interpreting cardiac investigations such as ECG and Holters

• Experience in working within healthcare is preferred
• Experience in, or genuine interest in developing, Cath lab skills across diagnostic and interventional procedures;

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with patients and work effectively within a multidisciplinary team
• Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office and clinical databases, effective workload prioritisation, availability for rotational on-call duties, and a clear commitment to continuing professional development

How To Apply


To be considered, please apply online with your CV and a cover letter outlining how your experience aligns with the selection criteria (above).

For enquiries, or a confidential conversation about the role, please contact Mina Banoub, Team Lead, Junior Cardiac Physiologists at mina.banoub@mq.edu.au or Rebecca Wood, Talent Acquisition Consultant, Health at R.wood@mq.edu.au

description:

Cloud Infrastructure & Virtualization

Identity & Systems Administration

  • Manage Active Directory (AD) accounts, including user and security group lifecycle provisioning, privilege allocation, and directory maintenance.
  • Administer and maintain Group Policy Objects (GPOs) to enforce system configurations, access controls, and security baselines.
  • Support enterprise systems management, baseline configuration, and server administration across Windows and Linux environments.

Cybersecurity & Compliance

  • Implement DoD security hardening guidelines (e.g., DISA STIGs) and ensure adherence to defense cybersecurity directives.
  • Partner with security teams to conduct routine vulnerability assessments, analyze scan findings, and execute timely remediation.

Required Qualifications

  • Education & Professional Experience:
    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent work experience).

  • Certifications:
    • Current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE, CCNA Security, SSCP, or higher).

    • Strong systems administration background in mixed enterprise operating environments (both Linux and Windows Server).
    • Identity & Access Management: Hands-on experience with Active Directory (AD) account management, user and group provisioning, access control, and Group Policy (GPO) administration.
    • Enterprise Systems Management: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Red Hat Satellite, or Microsoft SQL Server.
    • Working knowledge of core networking concepts essential for systems administration (e.g., DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, basic subnets, and host/local firewall configurations).

Desired Qualifications


  • Scripting & Task Orchestration: Proficient scripting skills for automation and systems management (e.g., Bash, PowerShell, or Python).
  • Zero Trust Architecture: Familiarity with Zero Trust principles, architectures, and implementation frameworks within DoD or federal enterprise environments (e.g., NIST SP 800-207, DoD Zero Trust Strategy).
  • Hypervisor Platforms: Experience configuring and operating Nutanix Enterprise Cloud / AHV, VMware ESXi/vSphere, or similar hypervisor environments.
  • Multi-Cloud Exposure: Broad familiarity across alternate platforms such as Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or IBM Cloud.
  • Cloud Certifications: Relevant vendor credentials, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect / SysOps Administrator, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator / Solutions Architect, or CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator).

This position manages the project team, tasks, budget, and schedule for all phases of design and construction. title: Software Engineer III - Flight Software
description:

We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

About the Role

The Software Engineer III role involves designing, developing, and testing software applications for space systems and technologies. This advanced position requires expertise in at least one programming language, an advanced understanding of software development principles, and the ability to design and architect complex software systems. The role includes writing clean, maintainable code, collaborating with team members to understand project requirements, and contributing to the development of innovative software solutions. Additionally, this position involves mentoring and guiding other engineers, providing technical leadership and support.

In this role, you will design, develop, and test software applications for space systems and technologies while writing clean, maintainable code that adheres to best practices and coding standards. You will architect and implement complex software systems to meet project requirements and collaborate with team members to understand project needs, contributing to the development of effective software solutions. Utilizing version control systems such as Git, you will manage code changes and work collaboratively with team members. You will participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to development standards, troubleshoot and resolve software-related issues in a timely manner, and document software configurations, processes, and procedures for future reference. Staying current with industry trends and advancements in software development and space technologies will be essential, and you will mentor and guide other engineers, providing technical leadership and support to foster growth and collaboration within the team.

About You

Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission.

We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Requires bachelor's degree in a related field (or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree or master's +3 yrs experience).

  • Expertise in one to multiple programming languages and advanced understanding of software development principles.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to mentor and guide other engineers.
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with kernel-level programming.
  • Proficiency in programming languages (Python, C++, Java) and their ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages (Bash, PowerShell) and automation tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef).
  • Experience with Agile or Scrum/Kanban methodologies and tools (JIRA, Confluence, Jenkins).
  • Strong analytical skills, performance profiling, and debugging complex systems.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, and efficient with collaborative tools (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) and development ceremonies (daily standup, backlog grooming, work planning, task estimation, retrospectives, etc.).
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker).
  • Understanding of network protocols, security principles, and secure coding practices.
  • Ability to write and maintain technical documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
  • Experience with continuous integration and automated test.
  • Experience utilizing and setting up static analysis tools.

Compensation:

Pay Range:

$129,776.00 - $178,441.25

Your actual base compensation will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge and skills, education, experience, internal equity and market competitiveness.

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance. U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment. Non-U.S. citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance. The Department of Defense Consolidated Adjudications Facility (DoD CAF), a federal government agency, handles the adjudicative aspects of the security clearance eligibility process for industry applicants. title: Vice President, Corporate Actions
description:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.

Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

Position Description

Corporate Actions is a key operational function responsible for managing complex asset-servicing events on behalf of clients and portfolios. The team supports mandatory and voluntary corporate actions, bank loan amendments and restructurings, proxy voting, defaulted securities, and securities class actions. The function serves as an important link among Portfolio Management, Credit Research, Legal and Compliance, Account Management, Technology, custodians, vendors, and investment management operations teams.

The Vice President, Corporate Actions is a senior operational leader responsible for team management, risk and control oversight, service delivery, process governance, and the continued modernization of the Corporate Actions operating model. The role requires broad investment operations expertise, sound judgment, strong people leadership, and the ability to manage high-risk, deadline-driven workflows across multiple asset classes and regions.

The successful candidate will lead through a combination of operational discipline, stakeholder partnership, data-driven decision-making, and technology enablement. The Vice President will identify control gaps, oversee issue resolution and remediation, develop scalable workflows, and promote the effective use of automation, analytics, APIs, and AI. The position provides substantial exposure to senior stakeholders and an opportunity to shape the future state of a critical investment operations function.


Location

Newport Beach, CA.


About You

  • An experienced investment operations leader with strong knowledge of corporate actions, asset servicing, and the associated financial, operational, regulatory, and client risks.
  • Demonstrated management experience and can set priorities, develop talent, establish accountability, and maintain high standards across a demanding operational environment.
  • Comfortable making decisions, challenging existing practices, and navigating complex or unstructured issues involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Able to communicate clearly and credibly with senior leaders, investment professionals, control functions, technology teams, vendors, and service providers.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and can identify process gaps, data inconsistencies, control weaknesses, and emerging risks before they result in material issues.
  • A proactive, analytical, and solutions-oriented leader who balances risk management, client service, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Ability to demonstrate integrity, sound judgment, resilience, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of corporate actions and related workflows, including mandatory and voluntary events, bank loan amendments and restructurings, proxy voting, defaulted securities, and securities class actions.
  • Manage and develop team members, establish priorities and service standards, allocate resources, provide coaching, and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Own the risk and control environment for the function, including process governance, procedures, reconciliations, escalation protocols, issue management, root-cause analysis, remediation tracking, and management reporting.
  • Provide senior oversight for complex, time-sensitive, or high-risk events and serve as an escalation point for operational, accounting, data, vendor, regulatory, and client-impacting matters.
  • Partner with Portfolio Management, Credit Research, Legal and Compliance, Account Management, Technology, custodians, administrators, and other operations teams to ensure timely decisions and effective execution.
  • Lead the design and enhancement of scalable workflows, data controls, reporting, and operating models, with appropriate documentation, ownership, and auditability.
  • Drive strategic initiatives involving automation, APIs, data integration, analytics, workflow platforms, and AI to reduce manual risk, improve transparency, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Oversee third-party service providers and data vendors, including service quality, issue escalation, control expectations, and opportunities to improve connectivity and data integrity.
  • Develop and present operational metrics, risk indicators, trend analysis, project updates, and recommendations to senior management and governance forums.
  • Support audits, regulatory reviews, client inquiries, policy updates, business continuity planning, and other governance or control activities relevant to the function.
  • Lead industry engagement to identify emerging market, regulatory, and operational developments, assess their impact on Corporate Actions and related workflows, and translate insights into actionable process, control, and operating-model enhancements
  • Contribute to broader Investment Operations and enterprise initiatives by sharing best practices, advancing technology adoption, and promoting consistent risk and control standards

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree or relevant professional designation is preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in financial services or investment management, with significant experience in investment operations, corporate actions, asset servicing, trade support, or a related control function.
  • Minimum of 7 years of direct experience with corporate actions and the broader asset-servicing lifecycle for global assets, including the impact of events across financial instruments, asset classes, accounting, cash, positions, and client reporting.
  • Demonstrated people-management or team-leadership experience, including prioritization, performance management, talent development, and oversight of complex operational deliverables.
  • Strong knowledge of fixed income and multiple asset classes, with the ability to assess the operational and control implications of complex or nonstandard events.
  • Proven experience designing or enhancing workflows, controls, governance frameworks, escalation models, metrics, and management reporting.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders across investments, operations, technology, legal, compliance, and external service providers.
  • Experience with data feeds, API integrations, workflow tools, automation, analytics, and the practical use of AI or other technologies to improve speed, accuracy, transparency, and risk management.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with Bloomberg and financial-services data providers required. Experience with tools such as SQL, VBA, Python, Power BI, or workflow platforms is preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment.

title: Director, Product Management - CDA & AI
description:
Lineage is the largest and most dynamic temperature-controlled warehousing & logistics company in the world, reimagining the global food supply chain to eliminate waste and help feed the world. We are a trusted, innovative partner to our customers, connecting them to communities worldwide with efficient supply chain solutions that preserve and protect food.

Our Product Management team drives this vision by leading Lineage’s technology transformation — changing how customers and partners engage, how warehouses operate, how energy is used, and how food is processed and transported. We define, design, develop, and deliver transformative technology products that modernize the food supply chain through data-driven insights, intuitive digital experiences, and resilient solutions deployed at scale.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Director of Product Management to lead our Data Solutions portfolio — the central data repositories that serve as Lineage’s source of truth and the business tools built on top of them, including metricsOne, our proprietary KPI and performance management platform, and our enterprise reporting and analytics products. These products power decision-making and business management across every function and region of the company, from warehouse floor operations to the executive team, and form the data foundation for Lineage’s analytics and AI ambitions.

In this role, you will take ownership of an established team of product managers and an existing product portfolio in active use worldwide, and you will be accountable for its next chapter: sharpening the strategy, raising the bar on product quality and adoption, evolving the platform to support advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities, and ensuring that the business trusts — and acts on — the data these products deliver. You will operate at the intersection of product, data engineering, data science, and every business function that runs on our data.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for Lineage’s Data Solutions portfolio, spanning central data repositories, enterprise reporting, KPI and performance management tools, and analytics products.
  • Lead, coach, and develop an existing team of product managers and business analysts; set clear priorities, raise the standard of product craft, and build a healthy pipeline of talent.
  • Treat the data platform as a product: define and prioritize the capabilities, data domains, and quality standards required to serve both today’s reporting needs and emerging analytics and AI use cases.
  • Partner with data engineering, data science, and enterprise architecture to align platform investment with product strategy, balancing new capability delivery against reliability, scalability, and technical debt.
  • Champion data trust across the enterprise — partner with data governance, finance, and operations stakeholders to ensure consistent definitions, certified metrics, and a single source of truth for business-critical reporting.
  • Drive adoption and measurable business impact: establish success metrics for the portfolio, instrument usage, retire low-value assets, and hold the team accountable for outcomes rather than output.
  • Engage stakeholders from frontline warehouse leaders to the C-suite to understand decision-making needs, translate them into product requirements, and communicate the “why” behind roadmap choices.
  • Coordinate with product leaders across the technology organization to align roadmaps, share data capabilities, and ensure cohesive execution across interconnected products.
  • Facilitate annual and quarterly planning for the portfolio, making transparent trade-offs across value, scope, budget, resources, dependencies, and timelines.
  • Manage relationships with third-party development teams and technology vendors that contribute to the portfolio, ensuring quality and value for investment.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years directly managing and developing product managers.
  • Demonstrated success owning data, analytics, or business intelligence products — e.g., data platforms, enterprise reporting, KPI/dashboarding tools, or data-as-a-product initiatives — at enterprise scale.
  • Strong technical acumen with modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake or equivalent), BI and visualization tools, and the fundamentals of data modeling, pipelines, and governance; able to engage credibly with engineers and data scientists.
  • Proven ability to inherit an existing product portfolio and team, quickly build credibility, and drive a step-change in strategy, execution, and outcomes.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to convey complex data concepts to non-technical audiences and to influence stakeholders at every level, including the C-suite.
  • Proven ability to lead change in large, complex, global organizations, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, highly visible environment.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering AI/ML-enabled product capabilities or preparing data platforms to support machine learning and generative AI use cases.
  • Experience in logistics, supply chain, or other operationally intensive industries; warehouse operations exposure is a plus.
  • Experience with enterprise information management domains such as financial, operational, HR, or ESG reporting.
  • Familiarity with Atlassian tools (JIRA, Confluence) and analytical tools (SQL, Excel).
  • Experience working with geographically distributed teams and third-party development partners.

Why Join Us?

At Lineage, you’ll have the opportunity to make a global impact by transforming the food supply chain. Data is the lifeblood of our business, and this role sits at its center — you’ll shape how one of the world’s largest warehousing companies measures, manages, and improves its operations, while building the data foundation for the next generation of analytics and AI at Lineage.

Why Lineage?

This is an excellent position to begin your career path within Lineage! Success in this role enables greater responsibilities and promotions! A career at Lineage starts with learning about our business and how each team member plays a part each and every day to satisfy our customers’ requirements. Beyond that, you’ll help us grow and learn on our journey to be the very best employer in our industry. We’ll ask you for your opinion and ensure we do our part to keep you developing and engaged as we grow our business. Working at Lineage is energizing and enjoyable. We value respect and care about our team members.

Lineage is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and is committed to compliance with all federal, state, and local laws that prohibit workplace discrimination and unlawful harassment and retaliation. Lineage will not discriminate against any applicant on the basis of race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical or mental disability or any other protected status under federal, state and local law.

Benefits


Lineage provides safe, stable, reliable work environments, medical, dental, and basic life and disability insurance benefits, 401k retirement plan, paid time off, annual bonus eligibility, and a minimum of 7 holidays throughout the calendar year.

description:
This is a full-time onsite role based in the location(s) posted and is performed from the designated work location five days per week. No relocation is offered.


Overall Purpose: The Director of Technology Strategy leads the development and execution of Supply Chain’s technology strategy, translating business priorities and product roadmaps into an integrated, multi-year technology portfolio. The role directs strategic planning, technology investment prioritization, portfolio governance, and delivery planning across complex initiatives, ensuring technology decisions and investments are aligned with business objectives, technical capacity, dependencies, risk, and expected value.


The Director provides strategic leadership across Product, Engineering, Data & AI, Finance, and business organizations to align technology priorities, resolve portfolio-level tradeoffs, and drive execution of the technology roadmap. The role establishes measures for technology investment performance and value realization and provides executive leadership with an integrated view of strategic priorities, investments, delivery commitments, dependencies, risks, and business outcomes.


Directs and leads a large team of professionals who strategically align current and future technologies and technology investments with business goals, establish integrated technology portfolio plans and priorities, and guide complex, multi-year initiatives to maximize business value, delivery effectiveness, and operational excellence.

  • Strategic Alignment and Technology Planning: Develop and execute technology strategies and multi-year plans aligned with business objectives; integrate product roadmaps, technology capabilities, strategic initiatives, and emerging technology considerations to establish priorities and guide investment decisions.
  • Technology Portfolio and Investment Strategy: Lead portfolio planning and prioritization across technology investments, using business value, technical capacity, dependencies, risk, and expected outcomes to inform funding and resource tradeoffs and ensure investments remain aligned with strategic priorities.
  • Integrated Planning and Strategic Execution: Establish integrated planning and governance across product and technology organizations, coordinating complex initiatives, sequencing priorities, identifying cross-team dependencies and risks, and helping resolve portfolio-level constraints that impact technology strategy and execution.
  • Research, Analysis and Value Measurement: Define and develop tools, models, and frameworks to evaluate technology alternatives, investment performance, industry and technology trends, and expected versus realized business value; use quantitative and qualitative analysis to inform strategic recommendations and future portfolio decisions.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration and Executive Communication: Collaborate with business leaders, Product, Engineering, Data & AI, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to align technology strategy and investment priorities. Develop and deliver executive-level communications that provide visibility into technology strategy, portfolio priorities, investments, dependencies, risks, performance, and business outcomes.

Oversees departmental programs and is often hands-on with the design and implementation of applicable strategies. Typically leads large teams, supervising supervisors as well as career-level staff within the organization. As a Frontier employee, your work connects to more than a single role. Whether you’re supporting flights, helping customers, maintaining aircraft, leading teams or working behind the scenes, you help create a travel experience that is safe, reliable and built around value.

Our work is guided by our core values: customer first, safety always, operational excellence and one team. These values shape how we make decisions, support each other and deliver for the people who count on us.

Support for work, life and travel

Frontier offers benefits, programs and travel privileges designed to support eligible employees at work and beyond. Availability may vary by role, employment status, eligibility, location, schedule, applicable policies and current plan details.

Depending on role and eligibility, available benefits and programs may include:

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement savings options
  • Paid holidays, vacation time and sick time
  • Travel privileges on Frontier Airlines and participating partner airlines, based on current program rules and availability
  • Buddy passes, based on eligibility and program rules
  • Travel-related discounts and employee discounts on select products, services and vendors
  • A hybrid schedule for eligible headquarters roles based in Denver, Colorado
  • Business casual dress options for eligible corporate and support roles
  • Employee support programs and resources, including the HOPE League, Frontier Airlines’ nonprofit organization

About Frontier Airlines

Frontier Airlines is a Denver-based airline serving destinations across the United States and select international markets. Our people support every part of the travel journey, from airport operations and flight crews to aircraft maintenance, customer support, corporate teams and more.

We’re focused on delivering meaningful value by making travel more accessible, practical and easy to personalize for our customers. Across the airline, our teams help support a safe, reliable and efficient operation while continuing to strengthen the experience for the people who choose Frontier.

What Will You Be Doing?

The Airport Commercial Contracts team is an important and impactful department within the airline that is a key enabler of the airline’s reliable daily operation and customer experience at over 100 airports throughout North America, Central America and the Caribbean. This team is the commercial relationship and contract owner for all the airline’s ground handling and airport services business partners such as Menzies, Swissport and Unifi. The team is charged with managing and adapting the airline’s ground handling footprint as the network grows and evolves, leading negotiations with and managing performance of all airport services business partners.

This Manager position is within the Airport Commercial Contracts vertical within the broader Strategic Sourcing – Fleet and Operations organization. You will join a team of managers and analysts with responsibility over all airport services disciplines and contracts to evaluate long-range business needs against the current setup, propose, model and negotiate contract modifications, lead or contribute to RFPs, track supplier performance, maintain and validate staffing models and standards, and resolve commercial / contract issues. This position builds and maintains relationships with internal stakeholders as part of a matrixed organization and represents the airline externally in interactions and negotiations with some of the airline’s largest and most critical suppliers.

This role is considered a subject matter expert on the airline’s airport operations contracts. This position combines commercial negotiation, long-range planning and strategy, financial analysis, and relationship and contract management activities. This position will also have exposure to real-time operational events and take a leading role in mitigation and problem solving.

As a member of the team, the position will interact frequently with senior Frontier executives including departmental VPs/SVPs and the CFO. It will also be responsible for managing and developing junior team members.

Essential Functions:

Supplier leadership

  • Serve as the commercial owner and focal point for an airport services and ground handling business partner portfolio
  • Lead negotiations, contract amendments and resolve performance matters and other issues driving a high performance supplier base
  • Serve as a subject matter expert maintaining in-depth knowledge of major airport ops agreements including economics, rights and responsibilities of the parties and service levels
  • Proactively analyze and manage “what if” scenario impacts on these major agreements (e.g. changes to the airline’s fleet or operating footprint), in close cooperation with operating teams and FP&A
  • Build and maintain relationships with supplier personnel
  • Build and maintain relationships with key internal stakeholders

Financial analysis

  • Own and direct the financial analysis supporting contracting decisions, either during RFP processes or to support ongoing management of or amendments to existing relationships
  • Partner with FP&A to align transaction economics to the long-range business forecast and financial planning objectives
  • Validate station staffing across the network and monitor adherence to the airline’s standards and performance guidelines
  • Provide clear recommendations to the Director and the internal operating teams

Oher functions

  • Frequent reporting and presentations to senior management; responsible for producing Board-level presentations and communications with little oversight
  • Attend industry-related conferences
  • Ad-hoc financial analysis and corporate-finance related projects
  • Participate in and contribute to budget process

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, mathematics, statistics or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience performing contracts, finance or airport services functions, OR experience in other roles with transferrable skills such as management consulting or finance
  • At least 2 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial capacity leading cross-functional teams in a corporate environment

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel including advanced modelling capabilities
  • Ability to build trust with internal and external counterparties
  • Strong influence and negotiating skills
  • Experience evaluating, executing, and managing contracts with outside parties
  • Understanding of airline operations and supplier ecosystem (Tech Ops, Ground Ops, Maintenance etc.) strongly preferred
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills including exposure to senior executives and external audiences
  • Proactive, able to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment and adapt to evolving business needs
  • Demonstrates organizational values of integrity, respect for people, diversity, appreciation, innovation, adherence to ethical standards, challenging the status quo, excellence in performance, commitment to shareholder value, teamwork, and continuous improvement
  • Proven leadership skills with the ability to train, develop and manage in an efficient, productive, and respectful manner
  • Airport staff planning methodologies and modeling in industry standard software preferred (i.e. StaffPlan, Inform)

Equipment Operated

Standard office equipment, including PC, copier, printer

Work Environment

Typical office environment, adequately heated and cooled

Physical Effort

Generally, not required.

Supervision Received

General Direction: The incumbent normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work and receives general instructions on new assignments.

Positions Supervised

Analyst, potential future team members

title: Assistant Foreman
description:
Join Our Team!

Sunbelt Rentals strives to be the customer's first choice in the equipment rental industry. From pumps to scaffolding to general construction tools, we aim to be the only call needed to outfit a job site with the proper equipment. Not only do we offer a vast fleet that ranks among the best in the industry, we pair it all with a friendly and knowledgeable staff. Our employees are our greatest asset, and although we present a comprehensive equipment offering, our expertise and service are what truly distinguish us from the competition.

We pride ourselves on investing in our workforce and offer competitive benefits, as well as extensive on-the-job training for all eligible employees.

As a highly successful national company, we are constantly looking for talented individuals to support our growth. If you are interested in pursuing a rewarding career, we invite you to review our opportunities!

Job Description Summary


Assistant Foreman – Pump Solutions

Build Your Tomorrow, Starting Today

Teamwork. Heart. Drive. Passion. This is what defines the team at Sunbelt Rentals. As an industry leader in tool and equipment rentals, we help build the world around us. More importantly, we build careers that last.

We are seeking an Assistant Foreman to lead field operations, specialize in large-scale fluid handling, and manage temporary utility infrastructure. If you have strong mechanical expertise in bypass pumping, thrive on solving complex hydraulic challenges, and want to lead crews safely on active job sites, let's get after it.

Beyond Your Pay: What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation: Base pay range of $21.38 - $29.39 / hour (starting rate varies based on location, experience, and training).
  • Market-Leading Benefits: Comprehensive packages that allow you to bring your best on the clock and recharge when you're off.
  • Career Advancement: Clear pathways to supercharge your fluid-handling skills and map out your leadership career.
  • On-the-Job Training: Continuous technical training with a heavy focus on safety.
  • A Vibe That Can’t Be Beat: A welcoming, diverse, and inclusive environment where your team feels more like friends than coworkers.

What You’ll Do

As an Assistant Foreman, you will balance hands-on technical pump execution with field leadership. Your core responsibilities include:

💧 Pump Mobilization & Fluid Dynamics

  • Lead setup and teardown of high-volume industrial pumping configurations and bypass systems.
  • Manage fluid-handling infrastructure, including heavy-duty pumps, hoses, pipes, fittings, and associated power distribution systems.
  • Deploy rapidly to manage equipment, fluid logistics, and resources during critical emergency bypass and water restoration response efforts.
  • Ensure peak efficiency of all deployed rental fleet assets to guarantee client satisfaction and profitable project delivery.

🛡️ Safety & Compliance Leadership

  • Promote a zero-harm workplace by strictly enforcing company safety policies, procedures, and job-site best practices.
  • Conduct fluid-hazard assessments (such as managing containment and pressure risks) and implement immediate controls to protect your crew.
  • Support Project Leads by monitoring project timelines, tracking resource allocation, and troubleshooting equipment issues on site.

What You’ll Bring

  • Pump Expertise: Prior hands-on experience in a mechanical or construction equipment role, with a strong focus on bypass pumping, water restoration, hydraulics, or fluid management systems.
  • Technical Chops: Deep understanding of mechanical systems, hydraulics, fluid flow, and electrical/electronic pump interfaces.
  • Blueprint Literacy: Ability to confidently read and interpret technical manuals, pump curves, fluid-system schematics, and site blueprints.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Sharp analytical skills to troubleshoot complex mechanical failure or flow restrictions on active job sites.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written skills to effectively coordinate with clients, dispatchers, and internal project teams.
  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent required; technical certifications or degrees in mechanics, hydraulics, or engineering are a major plus.

Base Pay Range: $21.38 - 29.39

Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. Please visit https://www.sunbeltrentals.com/careers/ for more information on our benefits and to join our Talent Network.

Sunbelt also provides a comprehensive benefits package to its full-time employees. This package includes:

  • Health, Dental and Vision plans

  • 401(k) Match

  • Volunteer time off

  • Short-term and long-term disability

  • Accident, Life and Travel insurance, as well as flexible spending

  • Tuition Reimbursement Options

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Length of Service Awards

You will become eligible for benefits on the first of the month following 30 days from your start date. Sunbelt offers team members the following paid time off from work, subject to Sunbelt’s policies (unless specified in a collective bargaining agreement):

  • 12-25 vacation days depending on years of service

  • 5 sick days

  • 6 holidays

  • 2 half day holidays

  • 2 floating holidays

  • 1 inclusion day

  • 1 volunteer day


Gear up for an exciting career!

Sunbelt Rentals supports service members. Veterans encouraged to apply.

title: VPII, Data Engineering Manager
description:
At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience - shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win: clients, LPL, and, most importantly, our employees.

If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what's possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today.


Job Overview

The VPII, Data Engineering Manager will lead a team and provide the day-to-day technical and delivery leadership needed to move complex programs forward. The leader will oversee LPL's enterprise data orchestration capability, data observability, and modernization of legacy batch workloads onto the Data Foundations Platform. Success requires deep data engineering experience, strong AWS and orchestration expertise, the ability to navigate legacy environments, and a track record of building teams that can operate with increasing autonomy.


Responsibilities

  • Set and execute the engineering roadmap for enterprise data orchestration, data observability, batch modernization, and migration of legacy workloads to the Data Foundations Platform.
  • Direct the end-to-end design, delivery, testing, deployment, reliability, and production support of large-scale data pipelines, databases, platforms, and event-driven workflows.
  • Provide sufficient technical depth to challenge designs, guide architecture decisions, review engineering trade-offs, unblock teams, and ensure solutions are secure, reliable, scalable, and supportable.
  • Modernize inconsistent and legacy patterns across Informatica, SQL Server and stored procedures, .NET, and proprietary technologies while reducing dependency on legacy capabilities, including DIS and LPL SQL.
  • Establish engineering standards for data quality, lineage, observability, infrastructure as code, testing, deployment, resiliency, and operational support.
  • Partner across Product, Architecture, SRE, Quality Engineering, Scrum, and business teams to sequence work, manage dependencies, communicate trade-offs, and deliver roadmap commitments.
  • Build team capability through hiring, coaching, succession planning, vendor management, and development of junior engineering talent; create an operating model in which teams increasingly self-organize.
  • Evaluate emerging data technologies and recommend adoption based on business value, architectural fit, operational risk, and total cost of ownership

What are we looking for?

We're looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity and continuous improvement, and who contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive data engineering or data-platform experience, including at least 5 years leading technical teams and delivery in complex enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and modernizing large-scale data pipelines, databases, and data platforms that process high-volume, business-critical workloads.
  • Production experience delivering end-to-end workflows in AWS, including infrastructure as code with Terraform and orchestration using Airflow or comparable technologies.
  • Experience leading through both modern and legacy data environments, including SQL, relational and NoSQL databases, ETL and batch processing, event-driven architectures, data modeling, lineage, and production support.

Core Competencies

  • Deep data engineering and platform architecture expertise
  • Technical leadership, sound judgment, and decisive execution
  • Large-scale team leadership, coaching, and talent development
  • Roadmap ownership, prioritization, and executive communication
  • Production reliability, observability, and operational accountability

Preferences

  • Experience with AWS services such as Glue, Lambda, EC2, RDS, DynamoDB, S3, and API Gateway, as well as Confluent Kafka and Snowflake.
  • Proficiency in Python, Java, SQL, or .NET, with the ability to participate credibly in architecture discussions, technical designs, and code reviews.
  • Experience applying domain-driven design and delivering capabilities across backend, middleware, and front-end technologies.
  • Financial-services or other highly regulated industry experience with complex data, control, resiliency, and audit requirements.
  • Experience modernizing environments with approximately large ETLs and workloads ranging from hundreds of thousands to tens of millions of records per job.


Pay Range:

$169,126.00 - $281,808.00


Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer!


Company Overview:

LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor-mediated marketplace(6) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com.


At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients.


For further information about LPL, please visit .


Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. EOE.


Information on Interviews:

LPL will only communicate with a job applicant directly from an @lplfinancial.com email address and will never conduct an interview online or in a chatroom forum. During an interview, LPL will not request any form of payment from the applicant, or information regarding an applicant’s bank or credit card. Should you have any questions regarding the application process, please contact LPL’s Human Resources Solutions Center at (855) 575-6947.

title: Accts Receivable Rep, Zoro Tools
description:
Company Summary

Zoro.com is a leading eCommerce platform offering nearly 12 million tools, parts and supplies for our business customers. Launched in 2011, we brought a B2C-like experience to the B2B industry, and continue to be at the forefront of digital innovation at the intersection of technology and distribution. We have rapidly grown to over $1 billion in annual revenue and we’re just getting started!

Job Summary

The Accounts Receivable Cash Applications Specialist applies customer payments, reconciles cash receipts, and maintains accurate accounts receivable records. Working under general supervision, this role follows established procedures to resolve payment discrepancies, coordinate with customers and internal partners, and escalate exceptions as needed. The specialist also supports month-end close and process improvement work.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Apply customer payments—including ACH, wire, credit card, lockbox, and check payments—to the correct invoices in the ERP system.
  • Reconcile bank activity, lockbox files, and payment platform records against daily cash receipts; investigate discrepancies using source documents.
  • Research and resolve unapplied cash, short payments, overpayments, duplicate payments, and remittance discrepancies; escalate exceptions outside assigned authority.
  • Prepare and post approved write-offs, discounts, deductions, and other adjustments within assigned authority; route items requiring approval to the appropriate owner.
  • Maintain complete records of cash applications, adjustments, and account activity, following internal controls and segregation-of-duties requirements.
  • Respond to customer and internal questions about payment status, account balances, and remittance application by phone and email.
  • Partner with Collections and Customer Service to resolve account questions.
  • Support month-end cash reconciliation, reporting, accounts receivable journal-entry documentation, process documentation, and assigned testing or data validation.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Two or more years of experience in a combination of Accounting, Credit, Collections, Customer Service, or Finance required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Experience processing or reconciling financial transactions in an ERP system or similar business application.
  • Ability to research and resolve payment discrepancies using source documents and established procedures.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with customers and internal partners.
  • Ability to use spreadsheet, email, and document applications to record and communicate account information.
  • Strong organization and follow-through; able to prioritize daily work and meet deadlines.
  • Accuracy, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills in a high-volume environment.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, follow documented controls, and escalate exceptions appropriately.
  • Experience with high-volume cash application, lockbox processing, or multiple payment methods.
  • Working ability in NetSuite and Microsoft or comparable Google Workspace applications.

Total Rewards

Zoro’s total compensation plan includes our Zoro Incentive Plan (ZIP) that is designed to foster and reward our team members for strong performance. Total compensation will be highly competitive.

In addition to competitive compensation, Zoro offers comprehensive benefits and perks including:

  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans with coverage starting on day one of employment
  • Maternity support programs, nursing benefits, and up to 14 weeks paid leave for birth parents and up to 4 weeks paid leave for non-birth parents. We also support growing your family through access to adoption assistance program
  • 6 free sessions each year with a licensed therapist and Wellhub portal membership to support your mental and emotional wellbeing
  • At least 18 paid time off days annually for full-time employees and 6 company holidays per year
  • 6% company contribution to a 401K Retirement Savings Plan each pay period, no employee contribution required
  • Tuition reimbursement, student loan refinancing and access to financial counseling, education, and tools
  • Charitable Gift Program - match gift to an eligible educational, cultural, community health, and human service organizations
  • Employee discounts and admission to various civic and cultural institutions around Chicago

Our Culture

Zoro was founded in 2011 with a simple idea: make it easy for businesses to get the tools, parts, and supplies they need to keep things running. We've grown by staying curious, moving quickly, and solving everyday challenges in smart, practical ways. Backed by W.W. Grainger and inspired by our endless assortment business model, we’re on a clear path toward our next big milestone: $2 billion in revenue—and beyond.

At Zoro, we don’t just follow a playbook—we help build it. You’ll get to work on real problems with a supportive team that shares ideas freely, learns from each other, and celebrates wins together. Our culture is grounded in values that guide how we show up every day: Winning & Learning Together, Being Customer Obsessed, Being Transparent, and Taking Ownership. We don’t have all the answers, but we’re always asking good questions.

Zoro’s culture has been recognized by Fortune, Best Places to Work, and Built In Chicago—but the recognition we care about most comes from our team members, who make this place what it is.

We also know that flexibility matters. Our hybrid work model gives you space to focus and the flexibility to live your life — asking team members to be onsite at least two days a week. Our Chicago HQ (right above Ogilvie Transportation Center in the Accenture Tower) is always open and ready for connection, collaboration, or just a good cup of coffee.

title: Document Technician - Utilities
description:
NOTICE TO APPLICANT

Applications must be submitted by 11:59 PM MST the day before the posted End Date.

You must ensure your application reflects the correct and current information for your work experience, hours worked per week per position, education, personal information, etc.

Only the information provided on this application is evaluated when determining compensation.

Job Description

PURPOSE SUMMARY. Provides administrative, cashiering, and customer service support for the Utilities Department. Assists the public and county staff with utility account services, payment processing, account maintenance, purchasing support, records management, mail processing, and related departmental administrative functions. Maintains accurate financial and customer records while ensuring efficient front-counter operations and support of departmental activities.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES.

1. Provide front-counter customer service to the public and county employees

  • Greet customers, receive phones calls, and either provide needed information or direct customers to other individuals or departments.

  • Search customer accounts and provide information.

  • Accept utility payments and sell solid waste coupons.

  • Post payments to customer accounts in a computer-based accounting system.

  • May participate in off-site community outreach meetings.

2. Receive and distribute department mail

  • Open envelopes and record check/money order numbers on attached stubs.

  • Post mailed payments to customer accounts in a computer-based accounting system.

  • Reconcile checks and stubs to prepare for daily balance and deposit.

  • Return checks with incomplete or wrong information along with a letter explaining why payment was returned.

3. Prepare requisitions and purchase order

  • Input requisitions into a computer-based accounting system.

  • Input the department’s open purchase orders at the beginning of fiscal year.

  • Input and track change-orders.

  • Receipt mailed invoices.

  • Serve as back-up for receiving items on the receiving report.

4. Open and close utility accounts

  • Place work order for new and existing customers.

  • Take applications for new customers and provide information on grants that may be available.

  • Fill out name change forms.

  • Make payment arrangements on past-due accounts.

  • Gather information to close accounts and notify customers of final bill.

5. Create and maintain files

  • Create and file new applications, grant forms, name change forms and payment-arrangement forms.

  • File all invoices, requisitions, and purchase orders.

  • File any letters sent out to customers regarding their accounts.

  • File any paperwork involved with applications (permits, warranty deeds, letters of credit).

ADDITIONAL DUTIES. Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS.

A. Education. High School diploma or equivalent.

B. Experience. Two (2) years of experience in cash handling, payment processing, customer service, or general administrative support including one (1) year of experience in high-volume cash receipting, balancing and reconciliation. Bilingual (English/Spanish) required.

C. Education/Experience substitution. In accordance with county policy.

D. Licenses/Certifications. N/A

E. Other (e.g., post-offer medical exam, polygraph, background check, driver’s license record, etc.). Must pass pre-employment background check. Must pass pre-employment credit check.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED BY THE POSITION:

Knowledge of:

  • Telephone etiquette and customer service techniques.

  • Basic arithmetic; alpha-numeric filing methods.

  • Record management procedures.

  • Word processing, databases, spreadsheet, and email programs.

  • Functional aspects of computer operating systems.

Skill in:

  • Communication and interpersonal relations to provide effective customer service.

  • Processing payments and balancing financial transactions accurately.

  • Maintaining organized files and records.

  • Entering and retrieving data from computerized systems.

  • Communicating effectively verbally and in writing.

Ability to:

  • Interact professionally with the public and county staff.

  • Explain procedures, policies, and account information clearly.

  • Maintain accurate financial and customer records.

  • Prepare and process documents with attention to detail.

title: Network Planner
description:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

The Network Planner is responsible for balancing and optimizing supply planning to meet demand. This position provides input to define and implement supply planning process, determining priorities, including supporting the creation of MRP for sourcing of materials, DRP, MPS, supporting process improvements, and supply reviews.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Supports the generation of the replenishment requirements using the demand signal, on-hand inventory and inventory targets that deliver a comprehensive network supply plan across the supply chain organization, to meet all financial requirements, operational capabilities, and wholesalers service objectives for assigned Business Unit.
  • Undertaking analytics and identifying process improvements managing a defined product portfolio.
  • The Network Planner recommends changes to the network supply plan when deemed necessary over the planning horizon. Changes are to be governed through sales and operations execution (S&OE) and planning (S&OP) process.
  • Communicates and interacts with demand planners, customer management, network supply planning supervisor, sales, and finance to provide replenishment plans and exception-based reporting for assigned BU. Makes recommendations on actions needed to meet actual and forecasted demand.
  • Supports the Supply Planning team with new product introductions and product conversions.
  • Reports Key Performance Indicators for their given Business Unit complete with process improvement initiatives and prioritizes tasks and deliverables in a timeline driven environment.
  • Supports the Sr. Network Supply Planner to drive continuous improvement efforts to improve performance on all key metrics, including service targets and network inventory levels.

What You'll Bring

  • B.A./B.S. Supply Chain, Operations or a business-related field.
  • Experience in an end-to-end supply chain role and experience in production planning, supply chain planning, or logistics.
  • Minimum of 3+ years’ experience in supply chain planning.
  • Adavance level of English.
  • Strong mathematical and analytical skills including experience with statistical analysis and data modeling.
  • Must be proficient in data gathering and quantitative and qualitative data analysis, including business process metrics and measures linking to business KPIs.
  • Experience with planning tools, business intelligence tools & business analytics software Accustomed to using a variety of technology tools and applications to support daily work including Rapid Response.
  • Advanced experience with Microsoft Office applications, Excel and PowerPoint a must.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively with co-workers, related internal functions, external partners, and on project teams.
  • Process improvement & proven results turn-around a plus. Customer management skills and experience a plus.
  • Solid, straightforward, and professional oral and written communication skills, including presenting data and analysis clearly to management.
  • Self-directed and possess a sense of urgency.

title: 2027 Summer Internship - Strategy Analytics Project
description:
When you’re the best, we’re the best. We instill an environment where employees feel engaged, satisfied and able to contribute their unique skills and talents while living and working as their authentic selves. We provide extensive opportunities for personal and professional development, building both employee competence and organizational capability to fuel exceptional performance through an inclusive environment both now and in the future.

Vizient Intern Program Overview:


This program is designed to foster a beneficial relationship and provide growth opportunities for Vizient, our employees, and collegiate students. Since 2000, our summer intern program has provided college undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral students with practical experience that exposes them to multiple aspects of a career field and the healthcare industry. This full-time, paid intern program offers an opportunity to accelerate academic learning, apply classroom knowledge, and introduce students to a professional setting. Interns are assigned a supervisor to mentor/develop their business skills, as well as monitor their work experiences. Interns are integral members of the company’s team, setting goals, working toward deadlines, and actively participating in community service projects.


The program requires the intern to commit to 10 weeks of participation in all formal training, mentoring, on-the-job learning, and opportunities to interact with senior leaders.

  • Program starts June 1, 2027, and ends August 6, 2027
  • Pay rate: $25 per hour.

About the team and role

The Strategy Managed Services team partners with clients to support enterprise, service line, and network-level planning. The team combines healthcare market intelligence, quantitative analysis, and strategic thinking to help clients better understand growth opportunities, access needs, competitive dynamics, and care delivery priorities.

As an intern, you will support active client and internal initiatives by conducting focused research and analysis, organizing findings, and contributing to clear, client-ready deliverables. Your primary work will center on evaluating healthcare markets and translating data into practical insights that help project teams answer strategic questions.


What You’ll Do

  • Support a defined healthcare strategy project, such as a market assessment, service line growth analysis, or ambulatory network evaluation.
  • Gather, organize, and validate data to support project analyses.
  • Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses related to market demand, competitive positioning, access, utilization, and growth opportunities.
  • Partner with team members to advance project objectives and meet agreed-upon timelines.
  • Develop clear charts, summaries, and presentation materials that communicate key findings and the “so what” for project teams and stakeholders.
  • Document analytic approaches, assumptions, data sources, and open questions to support high-quality, reproducible work.
  • Support the team’s growth and scalability by helping develop reusable templates, standardized analyses, documentation, and efficient reporting processes.

What You’ll Learn

  • How healthcare organizations use market, utilization, claims, and strategic planning information to make enterprise and service line decisions.
  • How to structure market assessments using Excel, Tableau, Power BI, PowerPoint, and Vizient/Sg2 data and planning methodologies.
  • How strategy, analytics, and client delivery teams work together to move from a business question to an evidence-based insight.
  • How to strengthen executive communication, data storytelling, project management, and stakeholder presentation skills.

Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, analytics, economics, public health, healthcare administration, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with Tableau, Power BI, or a similar data visualization tool, including organizing data and creating clear charts or dashboards.
  • Relevant coursework or project experience in data analysis, statistics, market research, strategy, finance, or healthcare.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative information into clear takeaways.
  • Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and interest in healthcare strategy and analytics.
  • Must be based in Chicago and available to work from the Chicago office for the full 10-week internship program (3x a week in the office).

title: Sr. Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Company Summary

Zoro.com is a leading eCommerce platform offering nearly 12 million tools, parts and supplies for our business customers. Launched in 2011, we brought a B2C-like experience to the B2B industry, and continue to be at the forefront of digital innovation at the intersection of technology and distribution. We have rapidly grown to over $1 billion in annual revenue and we’re just getting started!

Position Description

The Sr Business Intelligence Analyst drives data-informed decisions by building scalable solutions, leading end-to-end projects, and mentoring analysts while setting a high standard for quality, consistency, and collaboration. This role combines strong technical expertise with business understanding to deliver insights that enable stakeholders in Category Management, Technology, Revenue, Digital Experience, Customer Fulfillment, and Finance to make better decisions.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of data models, reports, and dashboards in tools, such as Looker.
  • Partner directly with stakeholders to translate business needs into effective data solutions that drive actionable insights.
  • Develop and optimize models and queries to ensure scalability, performance, and data accuracy.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to implement and maintain reliable data pipelines and metrics definitions.
  • Drive process optimization and automation throughout analytics and reporting workflows by leveraging generative AI and cutting-edge tools.
  • Ensure documentation, validation, and testing processes are consistently applied across all deliverables.
  • Proactively surface trends and insights that highlight business risks or opportunities.
  • Mentor junior analysts by promoting best practices, and sharing feedback.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or a related data role.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience developing data models in BI Tools.
  • Proven ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable business insights.
  • Experience leveraging generative AI tools to improve workflow efficiency and decision-making.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience managing multiple projects with varying levels of complexity and visibility.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced SQL and LookML experience.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (BigQuery preferred).
  • Experience using Python or other scripting languages for analysis or automation.
  • Comfort working in agile environments and managing work via JIRA or similar tools.

Total Rewards

Zoro’s total compensation plan includes our Zoro Incentive Plan (ZIP) that is designed to foster and reward our team members for strong performance. Total compensation will be highly competitive.

In addition to competitive compensation, Zoro offers comprehensive benefits and perks including:

  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans with coverage starting on day one of employment
  • Maternity support programs, nursing benefits, and up to 14 weeks paid leave for birth parents and up to 4 weeks paid leave for non-birth parents. We also support growing your family through access to adoption assistance program
  • 6 free sessions each year with a licensed therapist and Wellhub portal membership to support your mental and emotional wellbeing
  • At least 18 paid time off days annually for full-time employees and 6 company holidays per year
  • 6% company contribution to a 401K Retirement Savings Plan each pay period, no employee contribution required
  • Tuition reimbursement, student loan refinancing and access to financial counseling, education, and tools
  • Charitable Gift Program - match gift to an eligible educational, cultural, community health, and human service organizations
  • Employee discounts and admission to various civic and cultural institutions around Chicago
  • Zoro office perks including coffee bar, beer on tap, unlimited snacks, access to the onsite gym, and incredible city skyline views

For additional information and details regarding our benefits and our parent company, W. W. Grainger, please click on the link here.

Our Culture

Zoro was founded in 2011 with a simple idea: make it easy for businesses to get the tools, parts, and supplies they need to keep things running. We've grown by staying curious, moving quickly, and solving everyday challenges in smart, practical ways. Backed by W.W. Grainger and inspired by our endless assortment business model, we’re on a clear path toward our next big milestone: $2 billion in revenue—and beyond.

At Zoro, we don’t just follow a playbook—we help build it. You’ll get to work on real problems with a supportive team that shares ideas freely, learns from each other, and celebrates wins together.
