title: Scientist II
description:
This Scientist II will support the development and commercialization of next-generation ultrafiltration and microfiltration membrane technologies for bioprocessing applications. The position will contribute to projects from concept development through commercialization, including membrane design, process development, scale-up, verification and validation, technology transfer, and lifecycle support, with a focus on delivering high-quality solutions that meet customer and business needs.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on scientist or engineer with strong expertise in membrane science and process development. This individual will work closely with cross-functional teams including Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Commercial, bringing a collaborative and accountable approach to developing innovative products and manufacturing processes. The ideal candidate will take ownership of technical challenges, contribute ideas and perspectives, and work effectively across teams to drive results while maintaining a strong commitment to quality, integrity, and compliance.

This role is expected to model our Leadership Behaviors—Integrity & Compliance, Customer Focus, Collaboration, Courage, Team Empowerment, and Accountability & Results—in all aspects of work.


Responsibilities

  • Develop ultrafiltration and microfiltration membranes and membrane manufacturing processes from concept through commercialization, with a focus on product performance, manufacturability, and customer needs.
  • Execute new product development activities including process development, design verification, validation, scale-up, and technology transfer, taking ownership of deliverables and project outcomes.
  • Evaluate membrane formulations, process improvements, and emerging technologies to enhance product performance and manufacturability, bringing forward new ideas and approaches to technical challenges.
  • Design, execute, and analyze laboratory and pilot-scale experiments to address technical challenges, make informed decisions, and support project objectives.
  • Support validation activities using quality and manufacturing tools including DFMEA, PFMEA, IQ/OQ/PQ, control plans, and process verification methodologies, maintaining a strong commitment to quality, integrity, and compliance.
  • Prepare clear and accurate technical documentation, including development reports, characterization studies, validation reports, technology transfer packages, and SOPs.
  • Maintain a highly hands-on approach, spending significant time in the laboratory and pilot-scale environment developing processes, operating equipment, and troubleshooting complex technical issues with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, sharing knowledge and perspectives and working toward common goals to advance development projects and commercialization efforts.

Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Materials Science, Chemistry, or related discipline with 2+ years of relevant industrial experience, or M.S. with 5+ years, or B.S. with 8+ years of relevant experience.
  • Experience in polymeric membrane development, membrane formation processes, and membrane separation technologies.
  • Experience supporting new product development projects, including process scale-up and technology transfer to manufacturing.
  • Familiarity with Stage-Gate product development processes, design verification and validation, and process validation activities.
  • Working knowledge of quality and manufacturing tools such as DFMEA, PFMEA, IQ/OQ/PQ, process characterization, and statistical analysis.
  • Strong experimental and troubleshooting skills with the ability to independently design and execute technical studies, make sound technical decisions, and take ownership of results.
  • Highly hands-on scientist/engineer who enjoys working in laboratory and pilot-scale environments.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, organizational, and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively, share ideas, and contribute to team success.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize effectively, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of quality and accountability.

What Repligen Offers

Our mission is to inspire advances in bioprocessing as a trusted partner in the production of biologic drugs that improve human health worldwide. Focused on cost and process efficiencies, we deliver innovative technologies and solutions that help set new standards in bioprocessing. The estimated base salary range for this role, based in the United States of America is $113,000-$163,000. Compensation decisions are dependent on several factors including, but not limited to an individual's ,qualifications, location, internal equity, and alignment with market data. Additionally, employees are eligible to participate in one of our variable cash programs (bonus or commission) and eligible roles may receive equity as part of the compensation package. We offer a wide range of benefits such as paid time off, health/dental/vision, retirement benefits and flexible spending accounts. All compensation and benefits information will be confirmed in writing at the time of offer.

Position Overview

Bureau Veritas is seeking an experienced QA/QC Inspector to provide quality assurance oversight during the fabrication and construction of precision cooling equipment modules.

This role will support the manufacturer's QA inspection team by monitoring quality throughout the fabrication process, performing inspections, reviewing documentation, and verifying compliance with project requirements while helping maintain construction progress and schedule.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide quality assurance oversight for precision cooling equipment modules throughout the fabrication and construction process.
  • Audit the Level I (L1) checklist process and verify consistent application of approved quality procedures.
  • Perform inspections of structural enclosures and equipment without unnecessarily impacting construction progress.
  • Conduct routine inspections of ongoing work to verify quality installation and execution in accordance with contract documents, specifications, and approved requirements.
  • Oversee required testing and final follow-up inspections to verify identified deficiencies have been properly corrected.
  • Monitor non-conforming work and help ensure it is corrected before subsequent work is completed or concealed.
  • Support inspection and cleaning of equipment prior to energization.
  • Participate in the review of MEP submittals, specifications, contract documents, and owner/customer standards.
  • Perform onsite spot checks of materials and product data to verify compliance with project requirements.
  • Work with project and inspection teams to confirm approved quality processes and procedures are being followed.
  • Maintain accurate and complete inspection and quality documentation.

Level I Documentation Review

Review Level I documentation for completeness, accuracy, proper approval, and retention, including:

  • FWT test reports and checklists
  • BAS documentation and Sequence of Operations
  • Coordination Study implementation and documentation
  • NETA testing logs and reports
  • Tracking and correction of testing discrepancies
  • Verification of completed data sheets
  • Verification of NETA testing stickers on tested equipment
  • Sign-off against the latest approved SCCS documentation
  • Equipment Insulation Resistance (Megger) logs and reports
  • Phase Rotation and Energization logs and reports
  • Equipment Torquing logs and reports
  • Mechanical Pipe Pressure reports

Qualifications

  • Experience in QA/QC inspection of MEP systems, mechanical/electrical systems, or precision cooling equipment.
  • Experience performing construction or fabrication quality inspections.
  • Familiarity with NETA testing, Level I documentation, commissioning activities, and equipment energization procedures.
  • Ability to read and interpret contract documents, technical specifications, drawings, and submittals.
  • Understanding of construction quality control practices and non-conformance management.
  • Strong documentation, reporting, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with QA/QC, construction, contractor, and project teams.
  • Ability to train, support, and mentor inspection personnel as required.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for local site travel.

What You'll Bring

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, safety-conscious, and comfortable working in an active fabrication or construction environment. You should be able to identify quality concerns, clearly document findings, coordinate corrective actions, and work collaboratively with project teams without unnecessarily disrupting construction progress.

The coach works with athletes of varying ages and skill levels while fostering sportsmanship, accountability, healthy lifestyle habits, and lifelong fitness skills.

DMOS Orthopaedic Center is actively improving the lives of our patients by providing the highest quality of care and we are seeking a professional medical professional to help us achieve more!

title: Scientist – Measurement Science
description:
Job Location

JAKARTA GENERAL OFFICE

Job Description

Overview of Role

Personal Health Care (PHC) is an exciting and fast paced business that contributes to a significant component of P&G’s global profits and sales in Health care sector. This role provide hands-on Measurement Sciences leadership and analytical execution for the regional Personal Healthcare business. The role converts business and technical questions into fit-for-purpose measurement plans, generates reliable and compliant data, and turns results into clear recommendations that enable innovation, product qualification, claims support, business continuity, and lifecycle stewardship. The role combines strong procedural execution with growing application capability: rigorous experimentation, method development and validation, technical problem-solving, data interpretation, and collaboration across R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Product Supply, Procurement, external laboratories, and contract manufacturers.


Your team

This role will be located at Jakarta PHC Plant. The role will be part of the Measurement sciences team supporting Health Care organization and reports to Director, AMA PHC Measurement Science. You will have the opportunity work in multi-functional teams (local, regional and global), engage with both internal and external partners.

How success looks like

  • You will ensure a reliable, decision-ready analytical evidence is delivered at the speed and rigor needed by the business.
  • You will ensure methods are fit for purpose, reproducible, transferable, compliant, and supported by complete technical documentation.
  • You will ensure technical risks, unexpected results, and quality signals are identified early, investigated scientifically, and translated into actionable recommendations.
  • You will ensure regional project teams receive strong Measurement Sciences partnership across innovation and base-business priorities.
  • You will ensure External capability and digital workflows are leveraged responsibly to improve learning speed, capacity, and data integrity
  • You will be responsible for deploying measurement strategies to internal and external partners

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with MFT project teams to frame clear technical problem statements, hypotheses, critical measures, acceptance criteria, and learning plans.
  • Select appropriate analytical approaches from the existing toolbox and recommend new or modified methods when an outage exists.
  • Connect measurement outputs to product performance, stability, quality, mechanism of action, claims, and business decisions.
  • Independently execute established chemical and physical methods and progressively develop or adapt methods for tablets, capsules, liquids, semi-solids, and other relevant dosage forms.
  • Apply appropriate techniques such as HPLC, GC, UV/Vis, AAS, ICP, dissolution, physical characterization, and other fit-for-purpose methods relevant to the personal healthcare portfolio.
  • Plan and execute method development, validation or qualification, robustness, equivalence, transfer, and troubleshooting activities with coaching where required.
  • Own instrument readiness, calibration, maintenance, repair coordination, and qualification activities within assigned scope, ensure safe sample handling, precise preparation, reliable measurement, complete traceability, and data integrity.
  • Recognize anomalous, out-of-trend, or unexpected results; investigate root causes and propose scientifically sound next steps, apply foundational statistics and effective visualization to interpret results and distinguish signal from variability.
  • Summarize conclusions, risks, and recommendations in concise technical reports and project updates.
  • Execute and coordinate stability, quality monitoring, qualification, troubleshooting, and business-continuity testing.
  • Contribute to investigations, change controls, method or specification updates, and lifecycle documentation within assigned scope.
  • Maintain inspection-ready records, protocols, reports, SOPs, and controlled analytical documentation.
  • Work effectively with Product Development, Product Research, Process, Packaging, QA, Regulatory, GPS, Product Supply, Procurement, external laboratories, suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
  • Collaborates with Quality Control team to deploy methods, build capabilities and synergies across processes to enable smooth transition from R&D to QC.
  • Coordinate external testing and capability, including clear briefs, technical oversight, data review, and timely delivery, while protecting confidential information and intellectual property.
  • Build an internal and external technical network, seek the right expertise for complex problems, and share learning across projects.
  • Use approved digital systems for experiment documentation, data capture, analysis, visualization, collaboration, and knowledge reuse.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify methods, automate repeatable steps, improve throughput, and strengthen touchless data flow without compromising quality.
  • Recommend and implement practical improvements to laboratory methods, test designs, supplies, and work processes.

Job Qualifications

Role Requirements

  • Advanced degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, or a closely related discipline. A PhD with relevant analytical experience, or a Master’s degree with substantial hands-on analytical experience, is preferred.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in analytical method development, validation or qualification, transfer, stability testing, and laboratory troubleshooting.
  • Working knowledge of chromatographic and spectroscopic techniques, with the ability to connect analytical results to product or material behavior.
  • Experience working under regulated laboratory practices and quality systems, with strong understanding of data integrity and good documentation.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly in English. Bahasa Indonesia capability is strongly preferred for local stakeholder and partner engagement.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, collaborate across functions, and work with increasing independence.

Preferred experience

  • Experience in consumer health, pharmaceutical, OTC, medical-device, food-supplement, or other regulated product environments.
  • Experience with Indonesian or regional product requirements, pharmacopeial methods, local external laboratories, contract manufacturers, or technology transfer.
  • Exposure to claims support, product qualification, stability strategy, OOS/OOT investigations, CAPA, change control, and audit readiness
  • Practical use of statistical tools and digital data systems such as LIMS, Excel, Power BI, chromatography data systems.
  • Evidence of technical curiosity, external focus, continuous improvement, and responsible handling of confidential information and intellectual property.

About us

We produce globally recognized brands and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide. Visit to know more.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor

title: Glue & Pad Operator - UV Department
description:
The Glue and Pad Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of glue application and padding equipment used in SPC flooring production. Reporting to the UV Shift Supervisor, this position ensures proper equipment setup, consistent adhesive application and pad placement, product quality, and continuous production flow while following safety and operating standards. The pad operator is expected to also help in any other area of the line as needed.

JOB DUTIES

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate, monitor, start up, and shut down glue application and padding equipment according to approved procedures and production schedules.
  • Verify the correct adhesive, pad material, and product specifications before production; load and feed materials correctly.
  • Perform routine setup, changeovers, and minor adjustments within approved process specifications and training.
  • Monitor adhesive application and pad alignment, coverage, and adhesion to ensure finished flooring meets quality requirements.
  • Inspect materials and finished products at required intervals; identify, segregate, and report nonconforming material.
  • Monitor material supply and coordinate replenishment to maintain continuous production and minimize waste.
  • Record production output, downtime, material usage, and quality checks accurately
  • Troubleshoot basic process issues and work with the Production Tech, Supervisor, Maintenance, and Quality teams to resolve equipment or product concerns.
  • Follow safety policies, required PPE, chemical handling instructions, and lockout/tagout procedures; never bypass guards or safety controls.
  • Perform approved routine cleaning and operator maintenance; promptly report unsafe conditions and equipment problems.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work area and communicate equipment status, quality concerns, and material needs during shift handoff.
  • Support continuous improvement, learn additional tasks as needed, and perform other duties assigned by the Supervisor or management.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • 1-3 years of experience operating machinery in a manufacturing or production environment; flooring experience preferred.
  • Ability to work assigned shifts, including nights, weekends, and overtime as needed.

Skills and Competencies

  • Ability to read and follow safety rules, operating procedures, work instructions, and product specifications.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude, troubleshooting ability, and math and measurement skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to product quality and waste reduction.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, communicate clearly, and learn new skills.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Prolonged periods of standing, walking, bending, and repetitive movement; occasional climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, or crawling.
  • Ability to wear required PPE, including a respirator when required for assigned tasks.
  • Vision sufficient for close and distance inspection, color identification, peripheral awareness, depth perception, and adjustment of focus.

Work Environment

This position operates in an industrial manufacturing environment with exposure to moving mechanical parts, vibration, airborne particles, adhesive materials, chemicals and elevated noise levels. Conditions may include wet areas and warm, humid, or cold temperatures. Employees must follow all safety, chemical handling, and housekeeping requirements.

Organization Alignment

Reports directly to the Production Supervisor.

title: Inventory Supervisor - Day Shift
description:

title: Senior OneStream Project Manager
description:
Andrew Morgan is a fast-growing Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) that helps organizations, including federal agencies with critical missions, turn complex financial processes into clear, data-driven decisions. We’re looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead OneStream implementations from kickoff to go-live.

This isn’t a role where you just track tasks and send status reports. You’ll be the person clients trust to turn an ambitious CPM vision into a working solution. You’ll lead talented teams of analysts and technical consultants, solve problems before they become fires, and leave every engagement better than you found it. If you love the mix of strategy, technology, and people that makes a complex implementation succeed, we’d like to talk.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Core responsibilities apply across all levels. Scope, ownership, and independence will vary based on your experience:

  • Own the delivery. Lead end-to-end OneStream implementations and deliver on time, in scope, and on budget.
  • Build the roadmap. Create and manage detailed project plans covering timelines, milestones, resources, and deliverables.
  • Keep the engine running. Allocate resources wisely, clear bottlenecks, and keep the team moving efficiently.
  • Be the trusted voice. Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and stakeholders, building strong relationships and keeping everyone aligned on goals and progress.
  • Lead great teams. Guide cross-functional teams of business analysts, technical consultants, and specialists, and build a culture of collaboration and high performance.
  • Raise the bar on quality. Make sure every deliverable meets client requirements, quality standards, and industry best practices.
  • Communicate with clarity. Run regular status meetings that give transparent updates on progress, risks, and challenges.
  • Stay ahead of risk. Spot issues early, put mitigation strategies in place, and escalate when needed to keep projects on track.
  • Manage the numbers. Track actual spending against the forecast for each project, and keep labor costs in line with contract funding.
  • Make the next one better. Refine project management processes, run post-project reviews, and capture lessons learned that improve future implementations.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field. An MBA or other advanced degree is a plus.
  • 7+ years of project management experience, including 3+ years implementing OneStream or a similar CPM solution such as Oracle Hyperion, SAP BPC, or Anaplan.
  • PMP or an equivalent certification.
  • A proven track record of leading large, complex software implementations from start to finish.
  • Strong understanding of CPM processes, including financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Experience with federal financial management, including budget formulation and execution, appropriations, and the Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) process.
  • Hands-on experience with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, JIRA, or Asana.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • The leadership presence to build, motivate, and guide high-performing teams.
  • Composure under pressure. You can balance competing priorities and deliver on tight deadlines.
  • Sharp problem-solving and decision-making skills for complex project challenges.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • OneStream OCA or OCP certification.
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM).
  • Experience integrating CPM tools with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Dynamics.

SALARY:

Salary is commensurate with both location and experience.

THE AM EMPLOYEE WILL DISPLAY…

  • Attention to Detail: Produce high-quality deliverables and outputs that align with contract outcomes.
  • Self-Sufficiency: Execute tasks independently, seeking client assistance only after internal resources are exhausted, ensuring requests align with contract goals.
  • Teamwork: Collaborate effectively with team members, including AMC resources, subcontractors, and government stakeholders.
  • Communication/Engagement: Maintain professional conduct in meetings and written communication, participating actively with cameras on.
  • Responsiveness: Stay engaged, communicate promptly, and ensure deadlines are consistently met.

ABOUT ANDREW MORGAN…

Andrew Morgan LLC, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Alexandria, VA, is a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) and a certified HUBZone Small Business. We specialize in delivering high-quality consulting services to both federal and commercial clients, offering expertise in Strategy and Management Consulting, Technology & Architecture Services, and Industry & Mission Analytics Solutions. Our distinguished clientele includes the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), the Department of Defense (DoD), and the United Stated Army Corps of Engineers (USACE). title: Platform Engineer II-Event Streaming & Messaging
location: GCC Office – ITC Green Center, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.


Summary of the role:


The primary responsibility of this role is to engineer, operate, and continuously improve LS&Co.’s enterprise messaging and event-streaming platforms. As a member of the Event Stream squad within the APIs and Enablement organization, you will help deliver IBM MQ and Apache Kafka platform services supporting applications and workloads across Azure, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, and on-premises environments. These platforms are foundational components of LS&Co.’s broader integration architecture. They support enterprise APIs currently delivered through MuleSoft and play a central role in LS&Co.’s event-driven agentic runtime built using Temporal. This role will partner closely with teams across the organization working on the agent runtime, enterprise APIs, and application services to enable reliable event-driven communication, workflow orchestration, and system integration.

This role combines platform engineering, infrastructure enablement, and production operations. Rather than developing individual application connections, the team focuses on delivering secure, reliable, scalable, and reusable platform capabilities that allow application teams to onboard and manage their integrations successfully. This opportunity provides meaningful autonomy and responsibility within a critical enterprise platform domain. You will work closely with enterprise architects, developers and engineers from domain-aligned teams, business analysts, product managers, and other platform teams to shape technical direction, establish reusable patterns, and move platform capabilities from design through production. The team works collaboratively while giving individual engineers the space to make technical decisions and take responsibility for the reliability, evolution, and impact of the capabilities they lead.

About the role:

  • Engineer, operate, and continuously improve highly available IBM MQ and Confluent Kafka platform services across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Build secure, scalable, reusable, and increasingly self-service platform capabilities that reduce the need for one-off integration development.
  • Support the complete platform lifecycle, including deployment, upgrades, monitoring, incident response, problem management, disaster recovery, and capacity planning.
  • Partner with teams working on the Temporal-based agentic runtime, enterprise APIs, MuleSoft services, and domain applications to enable reliable event-driven integration.
  • Define reusable patterns for messaging, event streaming, connectors, schemas, routing, retries, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and recovery.
  • Apply Domain-Driven Design principles—including bounded contexts, domain events, and explicit integration contracts—to platform and solution designs.
  • Develop platform automation, observability, alerting, operational tooling, and technical documentation.
  • Facilitate platform onboarding through standards, documentation, consultation, and troubleshooting.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and improvements to platform reliability, security, performance, scalability, and developer experience.
  • Take ownership of assigned platform capabilities while collaborating closely with architects, engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders.

About you:

  • 6+ years of experience in software, integration, infrastructure, or platform engineering.
  • 4+ years of recent experience designing, implementing, administering, or operating IBM MQ in production environments.
  • 1+ years of experience implementing or operating Apache Kafka, preferably Confluent Kafka.
  • Experience supporting highly available, business-critical platforms as part of a platform, middleware, infrastructure, or site-reliability team.
  • Experience with Linux or Unix and cloud infrastructure in Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or AWS; multi-cloud experience is strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of event-driven architecture, distributed systems, enterprise messaging, resiliency, networking, security, and performance management.
  • Experience with automation, infrastructure as code, configuration management, or CI/CD is preferred.
  • Experience applying Domain-Driven Design principles to events, integrations, or service boundaries is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Temporal, MuleSoft, enterprise API platforms, or workflow orchestration is preferred.
  • Strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis experience, with the ability to make sound technical decisions within an area of ownership.
  • Must be able to collaborate effectively with North American and India-based teams.
  • Production responsibilities may include scheduled maintenance, incident response, or participation in an on-call rotation.
  • The position requires working at a computer or video-display terminal for more than 75% of the working day.

We put a lot of thought into our programs to provide you with a benefits package that matters. Whether it is for medical care, taking time off, improving your health or planning for retirement, we've got you covered.

· Complimentary preventive health check-up for you & your spouse

title: Leader of Manufacturing - Avionics & Environmental Test - Millennium Space Systems
description:
Leader of Manufacturing - Avionics & Environmental Test - Millennium Space Systems

Company:

Millennium Space Systems

Millennium Space Systems, a part of Boeing Defense, Space and Security (BDS), is a fast, agile small satellite company focused on national security space. Our missions have direct impact to global security, like missile warning and Earth observation.


Our team is curious, bold and innovative. We take risks, innovate and explore new techniques and technologies. We influence change because we challenge the status quo. And when we watch our satellites launch, we know each one of us made it happen.


The Leader of Manufacturing - Avionics (internally, the Millennium title will be Director of Manufacturing), oversees aspects of satellite component product assembly, test, and delivery to satellite integration. This role will manage and provide technical leadership to Avionics and Electro Mechanical manufacturing engineers and technicians to produce complex satellite electronic assemblies and support full-system integration.


Millennium delivers high-quality small satellite prototypes and constellations across all orbits for National Security Space and related missions to keep our nation safe and secure. We are a curious, bold, and innovative workforce that is part of something bigger than any one of us to make a difference in the space industry. We strive for a world-class work environment that provides an exciting, inspiring, and rewarding experience for our employees. Be the one who takes us to the next level.


Specifically, this position will report to the VP of Manufacturing and partner with the rest of the Manufacturing leadership team in support of the company’s mission success.


This position's internal job code is Engineering Multi-Skill Leader. Our Team is currently hiring for a level L.


Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide leadership to manufacturing personnel. Responsible for ensuring that product is manufactured safely to the highest quality standards and service levels while achieving cost improvement goals
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of the health of Manufacturing and Production with respect to capacity, work force, throughput, and bottle necks
  • Assist with Millennium factory build efforts with respect to: staffing, planning of satellite production lines, and flight program builds (both classified and unclassified)
  • Define and execute continuous improvement strategies and initiatives to achieve business objectives
  • With the assistance of team leads, may manage manufacturing engineers and all technicians (avionics and harness, electro-mechanical, mechanical, and environmental test) to produce satellite components and support integration
  • Lead and execute tasks required to transition hardware build from low-rate initial production to higher rate production
  • Lead and execute tasks required to transition hardware build to different manufacturing locations
  • Support proposals for future contracts and coordinate throughout the proposal gate review process
  • Support and implement AS9100 Quality practices
  • Partner with Boeing Space Mission Systems Operations counterparts as a Boeing non-fully integrated subsidiary leader
  • Manage Millennium Space Systems’ Manufacturing OH and Process Improvement budgets, and capital budgets
  • Communicate state of the company to manufacturing and production personnel

Avionics:

  • Electro-Mechanical Integration: Oversee the seamless integration of avionics suites into the satellite chassis, ensuring all electro-mechanical interfaces meet strict flight requirements and tolerances
  • Technical Quality Standards: Implement and enforce industry-standard electronics manufacturing practices (e.g., IPC standards) alongside AS9100 Quality practices to ensure the reliability of avionics hardware
  • Avionics Production Scaling: Lead the transition of avionics and electro-mechanical hardware builds from low-rate initial production (LRIP) to high-rate production to meet constellation delivery timelines
  • Complex Assembly Management: Develop and maintain throughput and capacity models specifically for avionics assembly, identifying bottlenecks in the electro-mechanical build process
  • Test & Verification: Coordinate with test engineering to ensure avionics components are manufactured for testability and that functional verification is integrated into the production flow

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 15+ years’ experience in manufacturing, mechanical, electrical, test engineering materials and process engineering, or similar field in Aerospace, Automotive, or Commercial industries
  • Bring a level of subject matter expertise to one of the following areas: harnessing, printed circuit board assemblies, structural assembly,
  • Experience to one of the following: structural bonding, mechanisms, or composite honeycomb machining.
  • High level of proficiency in MRP/ERP systems
  • Knowledge of satellite manufacturing engineering principles and concepts
  • This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active TS/SCI clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering or related field
  • Experience working with a union represented workforce
  • Scaling Avionics Production
  • Box-Level Assembly, Integration, System Test
  • Must have technical problem-solving skills
  • 10+ years of industry experience working in satellite manufacturing
  • Demonstrated ability to scale manufacturing rate capability

Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process

Millennium Space Systems, a Boeing Company, is a Drug Free Workplace (DFW) where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies.


Total Rewards:

At Millennium Space Systems, a Boeing Company, we strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage and retain the top talent. Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities.


Millennium Space Systems also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Millennium is DDTC-registered, ITAR-compliant Company. This position is located at a facility that requires special access. Applicants MUST be U.S. citizens and eligible for a security clearance. description:
Location: Nashville, TN (Music City Center) | Full-Time | Pay range: $20.23 - $23.80/HR (Based off experience)

Why This Role Matters

Great events depend on the people behind the technology. As an AV Technician, you'll help deliver seamless experiences for clients, attendees, and venue partners while building the technical expertise that drives unforgettable productions. Your work directly impacts the success of every event you support.

About LMG

For over 40 years, we have powered unforgettable experiences across conventions, international concert tours, Fortune 500 events, and nationally televised productions. As part of the Entertainment Technology Partners (ETP) family, we are a team united by innovation, collaboration, and a passion to go Beyond Technology. We take pride in our work, our values, and most importantly, our people.

Deliver Exceptional Event Experiences

  • Set up, operate, support, maintain, and strike audio, video, lighting, and LED equipment for a variety of live events.

  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.

Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, flexible spending account, 401(k) with company contribution, paid time off, and company holidays.

Bring your technical skills, curiosity, and passion for live events to a team that delivers extraordinary experiences every day. Apply today and discover what it means to go Beyond Technology.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:

We’re hiring a Sr. Quality Engineer at our Vancouver, WA location!

Join a stable, long-term opportunity where your work matters. We’re hiring a Sr. Quality Engineer to support production and ensure high-quality output in a fast-paced manufacturing setting.

Pay Range - $87,000 - $112,000 annually (Actual base pay based on factors such as relevant experience, education, market, qualifications, and skills.)

With nearly 80,000 employees globally, Kyocera is a leading manufacturer of high-tech ceramics in various industries, including aerospace, automotive, Medical applications, and semiconductor processing. Our innovative materials are found in everything from smartphones to space shuttles! Check out our profile video!

Look at these PERKS!

  • Competitive pay, benefits, and hours
  • 120 hours of vacation accrued per year to start (that's 3 weeks/year for regular 8-hour shifts!)
  • 10 Paid Holidays per year
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Pension
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

We have a long-tenured staff (many with over 30 years of service!), a vital company mission, and an excellent benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, paid time off to volunteer, paid leave options, tuition reimbursement, an employer-paid Pension and a 401(k) with both Roth and a healthy company match. Our larger locations also feature onsite gyms, walking tracks, exercise rooms, and employee gardens!

We strive to have a diverse workforce from all backgrounds, including minorities, women, and veterans, who bring their experience to support the innovation and quality that Kyocera is known for.

Kyocera International, Inc. also has a robust corporate culture and philosophy based on the experiences and writings of our founder, Dr. Kazuo Inamori, which you can learn more about here: . Our company motto is “Do the right thing as a human being,” and we try to use that motto constantly in our decision-making.

GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF POSITION

In conjunction with Senior Quality Manager, this position helps drive culture change towards a Quality-infused organization. The Senior Quality Engineer contributes to the development of project requirements based on corporate policies and strategies and uses independent judgment to influence decisions and timelines. Directs and coordinates activities to meet the technical, labor, and administrative requirements of multiple projects. Receives assignments and determines how to use resources to meet schedules and goals. May personally assist with project implementation.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Prevent repeat issues:

• Lead investigations, drive Root Cause analysis

• Deep dive into internal audit findings and Internal Corrective Action Reports to identify recurring themes

2. Special Projects: Drive implementation of new software and equipment (including training and documentation as needed).

• Collect project-related information from various internal resources.

• Coordinate with key stakeholders.

• Establish project objectives, budget requirements, timelines, labor requirements, and resource planning.

• Establish “hand-off” criteria (i.e. clearly define what conditions must be in place to close the project)

• Maintain schedules, budgets, requirements, minutes, risk analysis, and mitigation plans.

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously

• May recommend, evaluate, and test new software, hardware, and problem-solving methods. Use ability to independently assess and articulate options, risks, and trade-offs.

3. Training resource for

• control plans

• FMEAs

• 8D

• 5 Whys

4. Perform as an individual contributor to monitor, document, and report project status regularly to plant management and affected parties.

5. Perform any other related duties as required or assigned.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate the following:

• Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with key stakeholders

• Ability to prioritize workload, and meet deadlines

• Ability to work effectively as part of a team, while also successfully executing independent assignments

• Analytical and creative problem-solving skills

• Ability to identify and evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of internal control processes

• Ability to identify areas for improvement and recommend solutions

• Ability to assess risks

• Ability to formalize audit observations and draft reports

REQUIREMENTS

• Four-year technical degree (e.g. Bachelor's in Engineering or other technical field)

• 5 years minimum experience in manufacturing and/or training in the form of an advanced degree.

• Must have a thorough understanding of company processes and appropriate technical knowledge, or experience in a related industry.

• Working knowledge of project management principles is required.

• Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Microsoft Office especially Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint.

• Ability to positively influence various resources without direct line management responsibility.

• Frequently interacts with supervisors and/or functional peer group managers, normally involving matters between functional areas or other company divisions or units.

• Eligible to work in an ITAR Environment.

SUPERVISION RECEIVED

Under general supervision where standard practice enables the employee to proceed alone on routine work, referring questionable cases to the supervisor.

USE OF MACHINES, EQUIPMENT, AND/OR COMPUTERS

Regular use of complex machines and equipment (desktop/laptop computer and software, production equipment, etc.)

EMPLOYEE CONTACT

Contacts of considerable importance within the department or office, such as those required in coordination of effort, or frequent contacts with other departments or offices, in the normal course of performing duties. Requires tact in discussing problems and presenting data and making recommendations, but responsibility for action and decision reverts to others.

SOFTWARE SKILLS REQUIRED

Basic: Enterprise Resource Planning, Presentation/PowerPoint, Spreadsheet

encounters while performing essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

From asset creation and loan management to renovations and real estate brokerage services, The Fay Group offers end-to-end capabilities under one platform. This role develops, executes and manages the growth and retention strategy for the assigned clients, actively leads client engagement, and coordinates issue resolution to ensure client satisfaction and procurement of new revenue.

This elevated role requires a strategic mindset, strong planning skills, ability to lead by influence, effective communication skills, and strong ownership mentality.   • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word and Power Point)

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to develop and maintain effective relationships across the organization

  • Professional maturity, integrity, ability to maintain confidential data and information
  • Strong business acumen; strong fiscal and technical aptitude

title: Sosiaalityöntekijä Lastensuojelu, Hamina
description:
Haemme sosiaalityöntekijää Kymenlaakson hyvinvointialueen lastensuojelun Haminan toimipisteeseen 1.1.2027 alkaen toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan virkaan.

Meillä lapsen asioista vastaava sosiaalityöntekijä työskentelee alaikäisten lasten kanssa, jotka ovat avo-, sijais- tai jälkihuollon asiakkaana. Sosiaalityöntekijänä sinulla on tiimikavereina viisi sosiaalityöntekijää, kolme sosiaaliohjaajaa ja kaksi tehostetun perhetyön perheohjaajaa. Toimipisteessä työskentelee tiimien lisäksi johtava sosiaalityöntekijä, perheterapeutti ja palvelusihteeri.

Lastensuojelun sosiaalityö on monipuolista ja monella tapaa haastavaa. Samalla työ, sen tuomat ihmissuhteet, oppimisen ja onnistumisen kokemukset palkitsevat tekijäänsä. Lapsen ja perheen oikeasti aito kohtaaminen ovat työmme lähtökohta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että työyhteisönä jaamme vahvan eettisen arvopohjan.

Työsi on itsenäistä, mutta työparin, tiimin jäsenten ja lähiesihenkilön tukea on saatavilla. Työtäsi tukee säännölliset tiimikohtaiset tapaamiset, työnohjaukset, yhdessä suunniteltu täydennyskoulutus sekä kehittämis- ja työhyvinvointipäivät. Työyhteisössämme korostuvat aito lapsen huomioiminen, hyvä huumori ja yhdessä tekemisen meininki. Tällä hetkellä kehitämme meille jo juurtunutta systeemistä työotetta ja toimintamallia sekä pilotoimme palautetietoista työotetta (FIT-mittari). Meillä on liukuva työaika ja mahdollisuus etätyöpäiviin.

Olet kelpoinen tähän tehtävään, kun sinulla on sosiaalityöntekijän tutkinto sekä ammattihenkilölaillistus sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöiden keskusrekisterissä.. Kelpoisuusehdot täyttävien hakijoiden puuttuessa huomioimme haussa sijaiskelpoisuuden ehdot täyttävät hakijat. Sosiaalityöntekijän tehtävissä voi toimia tilapäisesti enintään vuoden ajan henkilö, joka opiskelee sosiaalityöntekijän ammattiin ja on suorittanut hyväksytysti sosiaalityön perus- ja aineopinnot sekä käytännön harjoittelun. Sosiaalityöntekijän tehtävissä voi toimia tilapäisesti myös henkilö, joka on suorittanut seuraavat:

1. Soveltuvan yhteiskuntatieteellisen alan yliopistotutkinnon tai sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattikorkeakoulututkinnon,
2. Sosiaalityön perus- ja aineopinnot sekä
3. Käytännön harjoittelun tai hänellä on riittävä käytännön kokemus ja ammattitaito

Eduksi katsomme aiemman kokemuksesi lastensuojelun sosiaalityöstä ja verkostotyöstä lapsiasioissa sekä systeemisen työotteen omaksumisen. Työ edellyttää liikkumista, joten sinulla olisi hyvä olla ajokortti. Parkkipaikalta löytyy työnantajan auto, joten oma auto ei ole välttämätön. Haittaa ei ole siitäkään, että saamme työyhteisöömme yhden hyvän tyypin lisää!

Haluamme tehdä työnhakuprosessista sinulle mahdollisimman sujuvan. Kaikki työnhakua ja työskentelyä koskevat käytännön tiedot löydät keskitetysti täältä: https://kymenhva.fi/urapolulla-kymenlaakson-hyvinvointialueella/tervetuloa-toihin-kymenlaakson-hyvinvointialueelle/ (https://kymenhva.fi/urapolulla-kymenlaakson-hyvinvointialueella/tervetuloa-toihin-kymenlaakson-hyvinvointialueelle/)

Meillä on kattava koulutuskalenteri, jolla voimme tukea urapolkuasi. Meille on tärkeää edistää työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa, hyvinvointisi tueksi tarjoamme sinulle E-passiedun.

Tämä rekrytointi toteutetaan anonyyminä, joten ethän ilmoita hakemustekstissäsi tunnistettavia tietoja, kuten ikää, sukupuolta, nimeä tai muita henkilökohtaisia tietoja. Järjestelmä lukitsee automaattisesti myös CV:n tiedot. Anonyymisyys päättyy, kun päätös haastatteluun kutsuttavista on tehty ja tarvitsemme hakijoiden yhteystiedot yhteydenottoa varten

Olemme kiinnostuneita hakemuksestasi ja pyrimme tutustumaan siihen jo hakuaikana. Rekrytoinnin etenemisestä, aikatauluista ja valinnoista viestimme pääosin sähköpostilla. Järjestelmästä lähetetyt viestit saattavat ohjautua roskapostikansioon.

Me omien polkujemme kulkijat teemme yhdessä Kymenlaakson - tervetuloa joukkoomme!

title: Senior Engineer - Automation
description:

Senior Engineer - Automation

Job Description:

Job Description – Senior QA Automation Engineer

Experience: 7–8 Years
Location: Bangalore
Work Mode: 5 Days Work From Office
Role: Senior QA Automation Engineer – iOS, Web, API & Database Testing

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Senior QA Automation Engineer with 7–8 years of experience in software testing and strong expertise in iOS, Web, API, and Database automation.

The candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks and driving end-to-end test automation across mobile applications, web platforms, backend APIs, and databases.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for iOS applications using Appium, XCUITest, TestSigma, or equivalent tools.

Full time

description:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

The role:

As the Therapy Specialist you will work as part of a Team to provide clinical, educational and technical support to Healthcare Professionals with Baxter’s range of products within the low mid and high acuity setting – Med/Surg wards and ICU. The primary focus of this role is to coordinate and provide clinical & educational support alongside product knowledge supporting our beds, surfaces, safe patient handling equipment and low acuity vitals. You will be the key clinical contact in nominated accounts to support Baxter in achieving its commercial and sales objectives as well as being part of the Therapy Specialist Team building and executing UK wide educational support and strategies.


You will have a sound understanding of assigned therapies and protocols – pressure injury prevention, Falls and Early Mobility supporting medical professionals through education with Baxter solutions to improve patient outcomes.

This role is field based covering the Manchester/Leeds region and there may be a requirement for extensive travel. You will work closely in your Regional Teams supporting prioritised clinical product evaluations and organisation wide system installations, as well as ongoing clinical training and support to maintain and grow Baxter’s existing customer base and portfolio.


Key responsibilities:

  • Acting as primary clinical resource for the account managers you will identify and nurture relationships with key clinicians and potential product advocates in particular Tissue Viability Nurses, falls leads, Mobilisation/Moving and Handling teams.
  • Identify and develop key opinion leaders and rising stars to create a network for development and involvement of evidence generation and quality improvement programmes, opportunities for case studies, endorsements and/or clinical papers.
  • As a subject matter expert, you will provide in field and remote clinical & technical support to multi-disciplinary teams to ensure the correct use and application of Baxter’s products and solutions to improve patient safety, efficiency and outcomes.
  • Attend pre-planned training days to provide full in-service training on Baxter products and solutions pre- and post-sale.

You will have experience working within the Healthcare environment, ideally a post graduate qualification in Tissue Viability or wound care, as well as knowledge and understanding of the current NHS and Private sector.

A deep understanding of the NHS – workflows, stakeholder groups, buying processes.

Clinical experience within speciality – Tissue viability, safe mobility and falls prevention.

title: Business Analyst
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
The Business Analyst – Application Design, Redesign & Modernization will be integral to large projects for EOHHS applications that support operations, investigation and incident management, quality management, and legal business units for DDS as well as business processes related to these core functions. Under the direction of a Project Manager/Business Analyst (PM/BA), the Business Analyst will be involved in the modernization of EOHHS applications including Home and Community Services Information System (HCSIS) and Quality Enhancement License and Certification (QE5).

HCSIS is the primary application for DDS to monitor Center for Medicaid Services (CMS) services. These services include the individuals served under the four Acquired Brain Injury / Moving Forward Plan (ABI/MFP) residential and nonresidential waiver programs administered by MassHealth/CMS. QE5 is the application DDS uses to monitor CMS provider qualification assurances.

The successful candidate must have substantial hands-on experience leading the functional design or redesign of complex enterprise applications. The candidate will assess existing applications and workflows, identify functional gaps and system dependencies, define future-state application behavior, and translate business policies, regulations, operational needs, and user requirements into detailed, implementable functional designs.

This position requires more than requirements documentation or meeting facilitation experience. The Business Analyst – Application Design, Redesign & Modernization will actively shape application solutions and independently own business analysis and functional design deliverables. Experience with case management, healthcare, human services, public-sector, or other highly regulated applications is strongly preferred.

The primary work location for this role will be at 40 Broad St., Boston, Massachusetts 02109. The work schedule for this position is Monday through Friday, 9:00AM to 5:00PM. The individual is expected to occasionally travel to the DDS area and regional Massachusetts offices. This position is expected to follow a hybrid model of reporting to work that combines in-office workdays and work from home days as needed.


DETAILED LIST OF JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
•     Lead discovery, current state assessment, requirements elicitation, workflow redesign, and functional solution design activities involving business users, provider representatives, technical teams, and project leadership.
•     Analyze and, when necessary, reverse engineer existing application functionality, workflows, business rules, user roles, data flows, integrations, reports, controls, exceptions, workarounds, and system dependencies.
•     Identify functional gaps, conflicting requirements, redundant processes, usability issues, manual workarounds, regulatory constraints, and opportunities to simplify or improve application behavior.
•     Design future state application workflows and functional behavior, including user roles and permissions, task routing, approvals, reassignment, validations, notifications, escalations, exception handling, auditability, reporting, and operational controls.
•     Develop detailed business and functional analysis artifacts such as current state and future state process models, use cases, user stories, functional specifications, business rule catalogs, role and permission matrices, screen and field requirements, data definitions, interface requirements, reporting requirements, acceptance criteria, and requirements traceability matrices.
•     Evaluate functional design alternatives and clearly document recommendations, tradeoffs, dependencies, assumptions, constraints, and impacts on users, operations, data, integrations, reporting, etc.
•     Lead functional design reviews and walkthroughs, resolve requirements and design gaps, obtain stakeholder decisions and approvals, and maintain traceability from business need through design, development, testing, and implementation.
•     Proactively identify scope changes, design conflicts, delivery risks, unresolved decisions, dependencies, and potential impacts, and escalate them to project leadership with recommended actions.
•     Communicate complex business, functional, and technical concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.

Requirements

Preferred Qualifications:
•     Minimum five (5) years of progressively responsible Business Analyst experience on complex application-development, redesign, or modernization projects, including at least three (3) years directly responsible for functional application design or redesign.
•     Demonstrated recent experience independently owning major business analysis and functional design deliverables.
•     Demonstrated experience assessing an existing or legacy application, defining future-state functionality, evaluating design alternatives, and supporting the selected design through development, testing, and implementation.
•     Experience participating in at least two substantial application implementations, redesigns, replacements, or modernization efforts across multiple phases of the software-development life cycle.
•     Experience translating complex policies, regulations, operational procedures, and business rules into implementable application behavior and testable requirements.
•     Experience leading discovery, requirements, workflow design, and solution design sessions with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, and multidisciplinary technical teams.
•     Demonstrated ability to create high-quality functional-design artifacts such as process models, use cases, user stories, functional specifications, business rules, screen and field requirements, acceptance criteria, and requirements traceability matrices.
•     Strong understanding of the full software-development life cycle and practical experience working in Agile, hybrid, or iterative delivery environments.
•     Ability to identify conflicting requirements, challenge assumptions constructively, evaluate functional alternatives, recommend solutions, and drive issues to resolution.
•     Ability to work independently, manage multiple analysis and design priorities, and deliver complete, internally consistent work products with limited supervision.

title: Associate Transportation Manager
description:
Earlier this year, Unilever announced an agreement to combine its Foods business with McCormick & Company, creating a scaled global flavor powerhouse. The proposed combination would bring together iconic Foods brands, including Hellmann’s and Knorr, with McCormick’s portfolio to create a global leader across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by strong retail and foodservice platforms. McCormick brings more than 135 years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions, with completion estimated for mid-2027.



Job Title: Associate Transportation Manager, Ambient

JOB PURPOSE

Support reliable, cost-effective, and sustainable transportation of ambient Foods products across the assigned logistics network. Partner with carriers, 3PLs, customer operations, planning, warehousing, procurement, and finance to help ensure service commitments are met while improving transportation performance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Associate Transportation Manager, Ambient supports day-to-day transportation execution and continuous improvement across the ambient network. This role helps ensure products move safely, on time, at the right cost, and in alignment with customer needs and business priorities. The role also provides analytical, operational, and cross-functional support to improve carrier performance, service reliability, cost management, and sustainability outcomes.

  • Monitor daily transportation execution for ambient shipments, partnering with carriers, 3PLs, warehouses, planning, customer service, and customer operations to resolve service risks and delivery exceptions.
  • Track and report transportation KPIs including on-time performance, failed-to-arrive incidents, load fill, cost performance, cost per pallet or ton, and service-related escalations.
  • Support carrier and 3PL governance routines by preparing performance insights, identifying root causes, documenting actions, and following through on improvement plans.
  • Partner with procurement, finance, and logistics stakeholders to support cost-to-serve initiatives, freight savings opportunities, tender preparation, and network optimization efforts.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to improve transportation processes, data accuracy, pallet management, returns, stock-in-transit visibility, and issue resolution.
  • Contribute to safety, compliance, and sustainability objectives by supporting carrier adherence to operating standards and identifying opportunities to reduce waste, miles, and carbon impact.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Operations, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain operations, customer operations, warehousing, or a closely related operational environment.
  • Working knowledge of end-to-end supply chain processes, transportation execution, carrier performance, and service/cost trade-offs.
  • Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, communicate insights, and support fact-based decision-making.
  • Strong communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across internal teams and external partners.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience working with transportation management systems, warehouse management systems, ERP tools, Power BI, Excel, or other reporting/analytics platforms.
  • Experience supporting carrier management, 3PL governance, freight procurement, continuous improvement, or cost savings initiatives.
  • Familiarity with consumer goods, food, ambient product distribution, customer service logistics, or sustainability-focused transportation initiatives.
