title: Manager, Corporate Communications
description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

Manager, Corporate Communications


If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

At IDEX, our businesses manufacture mission-critical technologies used in everyday life – from helping firefighters and rescue teams save lives, to advancing scientific research, to supporting some of the world's most innovative industrial applications.

With more than 50 businesses around the world, our operating structure is purposefully designed to offer the stability of a large corporation, while enabling our businesses to be agile and entrepreneurial, and our teams to retain their passion, energy and autonomy. We believe great communication plays a critical role in connecting employees to our purpose, strategy and culture.


Why Join IDEX?

This role offers the opportunity to shape communications for a high-growth, global, publicly traded company. You'll work closely with leaders, gain exposure to diverse businesses and industries, and deliver communication that connects employees to our purpose while advancing the company's strategic priorities.


Position Summary

The Manager, Corporate Communications, is a high-visibility role responsible for designing and executing communication plans and channels across the company while maintaining close partnerships with corporate partners in HR, IT, Finance and Legal. The role will support both enterprise communication initiatives and functional priorities that impact the overall company. This ideal candidate will need strong attention to detail, writing skills and project management abilities. This individual must possess curiosity to learn the business, problem solving skills and experience working with a wide array of stakeholders, internal and external.

IDEX communications team operates in a lean, collaborative environment. This position offers significant exposure to senior leaders and opportunities to make an immediate impact. Ideal candidates should have experience prioritizing the most critical enterprise-level work, while providing standard tools and guideposts that can be leveraged for local or business-specific needs.

The position is hybrid, with remote working on Mondays and Fridays and office working Tuesday through Thursday at IDEX’s corporate headquarters in Northbrook, Illinois, to foster better collaboration, connection, and innovation. This position will require occasional travel to IDEX business units.


Responsibilities

  • Oversee enterprise communication channels including company intranet, town halls, email platforms, social media, company website and newsroom.
  • Analyze ongoing metrics for all communication channels and campaigns, highlighting insights and opportunities to improve.
  • Explore new communication channels that support IDEX communication strategy
  • Leverage emerging communication technologies, including AI-enabled tools, to improve content development, efficiency and audience reach while maintaining high standards of quality and accuracy.
  • Curate and facilitate content sharing across businesses and teams, ensuring milestones and wins are widely known and celebrated across the company.
  • Design and execute communication plans supporting enterprise initiatives, including M&A, sustainability, transformation and culture changes.
  • Serve as an expert in communications across the enterprise, implementing best practices and designing self-serve solutions that improve communication across the company.
  • Partner with business units and corporate functions to translate complex business topics into clear, compelling communications for internal and external stakeholders (e.g., earnings communications, narratives for annual reports and investor presentations, and content for town halls and other employee-facing communications (e.g., intranet).
  • Support executive and leadership communications, including presentations, talking points, videos, speeches and employee messages.
  • Coordinate enterprise-wide announcements with careful attention to timing, audience needs and organizational priorities.
  • Support planning and execution of global town halls, employee broadcasts, leadership meetings and other major communication events.
  • Help strengthen employee engagement by promoting company values, culture, community involvement, sustainability efforts and business performance through meaningful storytelling.

Essential Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Business or a related field.
  • 5-7 years of experience in corporate communications, public relations, marketing communications or a related discipline.
  • Excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills with demonstrated ability to adapt content for different audiences and channels, both internal and external.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships and influence across a global, matrixed organization.
  • Excellent organizational, project management and analytical skills with strong attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Sound judgment and demonstrated ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

Preferred

  • Experience creating digital, multimedia and video content. Familiarity with Microsoft 365 tools, including SharePoint, Teams and Viva Engage.
  • Experience using communication measurement and analytics tools.
  • Basic graphic design, presentation development and visual storytelling skills.
  • Experience using AI-enabled productivity and content development tools.
  • Experience supporting executive communications and employee engagement initiatives.

What Will Help You Succeed

  • You are naturally curious and enjoy learning about people, technologies and businesses.
  • You are a proactive self-starter who looks for opportunities to improve communications and generate fresh ideas in an environment where change can be decided and implemented quickly.
  • You balance creativity with attention to detail.
  • You are comfortable collaborating with leaders at all levels of the organization.
  • You understand that great communication starts with listening.
  • You embrace continuous learning and view improvement as a lifelong journey.

Are you ready to join a different kind of company where our people, our culture, and our commitments are centered around providing trusted solutions that improve lives around the world?

Total Rewards

The compensation range for this position is $99,800.00 - $149,600.00, depending on experience. This position may be eligible for performance based bonus plan.

Benefits Package

Our comprehensive U.S. benefit offerings include: Health benefits, 401(k) retirement savings program with company match, PTO, and more. More information on our benefits and rewards can be found on our career page:

title: Data Scientist
description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit .

In 2024, Yext acquired Hearsay Systems, bringing together two industry leaders to form one unified organization. By combining Yext’s brand visibility expertise with Hearsay’s best-in-class compliant engagement solutions, we’re delivering even greater value to our customers. Our integrated approach unlocks a deeper set of data, insights, and recommendations — empowering brands to convert prospects into customers faster and more effectively.

As an AI-first organization using modern AI and agentic workflows, we seek a Data Scientist to transform data assets into measurable business value and product capabilities by designing reliable data products, methodologies, and cross-functional features from concept to production.

What You'll Do

  • Identify product and business opportunities by analyzing the structure, quality, and capabilities of Yext's data sources.
  • Design data models and metrics to power innovative customer-facing features and decision-making.
  • Lead high-impact data science and ML research from problem framing through prototyping to engineering handoff.
  • Leverage AI-first tools and agentic workflows (e.g., Codex, Claude, Coco) for efficient research, coding, and testing.
  • Develop and evaluate statistical, ML, and GenAI/LLM solutions across structured and unstructured data.
  • Build reproducible prototypes and validate model quality, coverage, and business impact prior to production deployment.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous opportunities into production solutions.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to enhance data pipelines, data quality, and overall data stack architecture.
  • Clearly communicate findings, trade-offs, and promote evidence-based, responsible AI adoption.
  • Mentor teammates and continuously explore emerging AI methods to boost team capabilities.

What You Have

  • 3+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or data analytics.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, modeling, and experimentation.
  • Solid understanding of statistics, supervised/unsupervised learning, and model validation techniques.
  • Experience with data modeling, data warehousing, and preparing datasets for analytical and product use.
  • Familiarity with generative AI/LLM applications (e.g., RAG, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, evaluation).
  • AI-first mindset utilizing AI coding assistants (e.g., Codex, Claude) while ensuring quality and security.
  • Hands-on experience in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Strong problem-solving ability and comfort working independently through ambiguity.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Features Production Coordinator
description:
700 Club – Virginia Beach, VA

Keep Stories Moving. Support Production. Make an Impact Behind the Scenes!

The Christian Broadcasting Network (CBN) is looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Features Production Coordinator to join the Features Department supporting The 700 Club television program in Virginia Beach. In this role, you’ll play an important behind the scenes part in bringing compelling feature stories to the screen by coordinating production workflows, maintaining story records, tracking assignments and deadlines, and ensuring producers and production staff have the information and resources they need throughout the production process. Working closely with producers, line producers, and other departments, you’ll help keep stories moving from initial assignment through broadcast and archiving while supporting the daily operations of a dynamic television production team.

If you’re someone who enjoys keeping things organized, anticipating needs, solving problems, and helping a team work efficiently, this is an opportunity to put those strengths to work in a meaningful ministry environment. Serving in this position facilitates ministry activities and contributes to CBN’s Biblical mission to advance the Gospel of Jesus Christ worldwide.

The salary range for this position is $47,000 - $50,000 annually. Final compensation within this range will be determined based on a combination of education, relevant experience, and demonstrated skills aligned with the role requirements.

What You’ll Do

You'll maintain and manage the Features Department's master story database, tracking stories throughout the production process from assignment through broadcast and archiving. You'll prepare daily production reports, organize and upload story materials for production meetings, coordinate media resources and documentation, and help ensure information and files remain accurate and accessible. You'll work closely with producers, line producers, and production staff to monitor story progress, follow up on assignments and deadlines, identify potential workflow issues, and communicate updates as needed. You'll also serve as a liaison with CBN International, Operation Blessing, and Marketing to facilitate video access and production information requests, while providing scheduling, assignment tracking, and general coordination support to the Features Director.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Understanding of television production processes, story development, research, and the workflow involved in taking a feature story from assignment through broadcast and archiving.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally and effectively with producers, production staff, and internal departments.
  • Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word, and experience maintaining information in databases or other digital platforms.
  • Ability to learn, adapt to, and effectively utilize emerging technologies, including online database/CRM platforms, AI tools, and digital media management systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to recognize workflow issues, assess competing priorities, and recommend practical solutions in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, take initiative, and follow through on responsibilities.
  • Ability to maintain effective working relationships and collaborate with individuals across multiple departments and levels of the organization.
  • Ability to provide backup support to the Features Director with scheduling, story assignments, and other departmental coordination responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated life application of Biblical principles and practices in alignment with CBN's non-profit Christian mission.

Why Work at CBN

At CBN, your work supports a global ministry and contributes to the mission of advancing the Gospel of Jesus Christ. We also believe in investing in the people who make that mission possible. CBN offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes paid vacation and sick time, paid parental leave, paid holidays, health and life insurance, department and ministry-wide chapel time, substantial tuition reduction for employees and dependent through our partnership with Regent University, and more. Employees have the opportunity to be part of a workplace where faith, purpose, and service are woven into the workday.

CBN is a global nonprofit ministry demonstrating the love of God by sharing the Gospel through digital content, traditional media, and humanitarian aid. CBN offers a professional and rewarding work environment, competitive salary, and benefits package to include healthcare for full time positions. If you meet the listed qualifications and are in agreement with CBN’s mission and purpose, please click apply or visit our CBN Job Board at for application and benefit information.

More than 2,400 professionals across 14 global offices deliver the expertise, responsiveness, and consistency that have made HSFT a trusted partner to alternative asset managers worldwide.


At HSFT, we are committed to helping employees build meaningful, long-term careers through structured development programs, leadership opportunities, and clear paths for growth. Guided by our core values of Relationships, Support, Innovation, and Expertise, we foster a collaborative environment where people are empowered to learn, contribute, and succeed.

The AML Team is responsible for the oversight and support of the Investor Services Financial Crime prevention activities, in particular Anti-Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing and Financial Sanctions compliance (AML-CTF and FS).

As a member of the AML team with a focus on the Name Screening process, a Senior Administrator will conduct daily name screening against Financial Sanctions, Adverse Media and Politically Exposed Persons lists.   • Ad hoc assistance in AML project work or remediation work on transitioned clients.
  • Rotating with other team members to provide coverage for US based Investor Services team.

Technical knowledge

  • University degree and/or professional/post-graduate qualification required.
  • Experience within a compliance/AML role in the financial services industry, ideally within fund administration or fund management.
  • Experience of Financial Sanctions, Adverse Media and Politically Exposed Persons name screening.
  • Experience of Cayman and US AML regulations would be of benefit.
  • Familiarity with a broad spectrum of investor types and legal structures

The successful candidate should:

  • Have the ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.
  • Have strong investigative skills.
  • Have the ability to show initiative and react quickly to changes in priorities.
  • Be able to work independently as well as in a team.
  • Have excellent attention to detail and accuracy when completing time sensitive tasks.
  • Have excellent organisational skills.

Cheers to creating an incredible tomorrow!

Here’s to crafting careers and creating new legacies.

  • You are comfortable with the physical requirements of this position including sitting, standing, climbing, or balancing, stooping, kneeling, pushing, pulling, crouching or crawling. Frequently lifting and/or moving items over 60 pounds.

title: Founding Brand Design Intern
description:

title: First Line Project Management Manager
description:
First Line Project Management Manager

Company:

The Boeing Company

Acoustic Programs (AP) is a dynamic business within BDS Space, Intelligence, and Weapon Systems (SI&WS) focused on delivering complex solutions in some of the most challenging environments on Earth. We are seeking a First-Line Multi-Skill Engineering Manager with acoustics domain experience to join our team in California, MD.


The Acoustic Programs portfolio defines, designs, and delivers multiple products primarily targeted at the underwater and Anti-Submarine Warfare (ASW) domain.


In this role, you will support the Acoustic Programs team with day-to-day operations, site management, forward business planning, and program-level cost account management. You will provide status updates to upper management, manage functional personnel, and oversee key program areas.


The Acoustic Programs portfolio includes four main elements: Development, Production, Training Systems, and Advanced Programs. Development Programs cover the full software and system engineering lifecycle—from development and integration with targeted hardware to deployment and maintenance—focused on detecting and tracking underwater targets. Production Programs define, develop, manage suppliers, and maintain hardware supporting the ASW mission on the P-8A platform. Training Systems develop acoustic training components for various mission-level trainers and associated hardware. Advanced Programs support a range of advanced acoustic initiatives, including IR&D, international efforts, new hardware design and development, and new business and cross-Boeing collaborations.


If you are motivated, interested in a management position within an exciting domain, enjoy a dynamic work environment with a broad range of engineering skills, and aspire to further develop your program leadership abilities, we want to hear from you.


Position Responsibilities:


  • Manage employees’ day-to-day efforts as well as long-term career goals and performance
  • Understand and refine long-term future business strategies
  • Lead across various Boeing business units, external suppliers, and domestic/international customers
  • Support Cost Account Management (CAM) activities with Program Management of Acoustic Programs
  • Provide input on program-level business and technical strategies, goals, and objectives
  • Support and help direct Acoustic Programs’ Long Range Business Plan, IR&D, and new business activities
  • Acquire resources for department activities, provide technical management of suppliers, and lead process improvements. Develop and maintain relationships and partnerships with customers, stakeholders, peers, partners, and direct reports
  • Maintain, tailor, and improve Program Management Best Practices (PMBP) focused on program goals
  • Manage site operations of a small Boeing facility in California, MD
  • Interface cross-functionally with internal stakeholders to define and evaluate forward business planning, IRAD, capital, and program priorities
  • Oversee and be accountable for the quality and safety of the products and facility

title: Maintenence Manager
description:
Lineage is the global leader in temperature-controlled logistics, with a clear mission: to transform the food supply chain to eliminate waste and help feed the world. Through cutting-edge technology, a vast logistics network, and a commitment to sustainability, we serve a broad customer base, from Fortune 500 corporations to local, family-owned businesses.


We're looking for a Maintenance Manager to lead and develop our engineering function at our Heywood facility, ensuring the reliability, safety, and performance of critical site equipment and infrastructure.


At Lineage, we believe in empowering our people to make a difference. You'll have the opportunity to lead a skilled engineering team, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and play a key role in supporting the operational success of one of the world's leading cold storage and logistics businesses.


Shift Available: Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 4:00pm


Salary: Competitive + Benefits


About the Role

As a Maintenance Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing all maintenance activities across the site, ensuring the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of equipment, facilities, and engineering systems.

You'll lead a team of engineers and contractors, managing both planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive maintenance activities while driving a proactive maintenance culture focused on continuous improvement, compliance, and operational excellence.


Working closely with Operations and Site Leadership teams, you'll ensure engineering activities support business objectives and minimise downtime across the facility.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Leading, coaching, and developing the site maintenance team to deliver high levels of performance, engagement, and technical capability.
  • Managing planned preventative maintenance programmes to maximise equipment reliability and reduce operational downtime.
  • Ensuring the effective delivery of reactive maintenance activities and supporting root cause analysis of equipment failures.
  • Managing maintenance budgets, engineering contractors, and supplier relationships.
  • Overseeing the maintenance of conveyors, refrigeration systems, cranes, mobile racking, plant utilities, and other site infrastructure.
  • Driving continuous improvement initiatives to improve equipment performance, efficiency, and reliability.
  • Ensuring full compliance with health and safety, food safety, environmental, and engineering standards.
  • Leading engineering projects, including equipment installations, upgrades, and site improvement activities.
  • Monitoring maintenance KPIs and producing reports to support operational and strategic decision-making.
  • Working collaboratively with Operations, Quality, and Site Leadership teams to support customer and business requirements.
  • Ensuring maintenance records, permits, risk assessments, and engineering documentation are accurately maintained.

You'll spend some time working within our temperature-controlled environment at approximately -18°C, but we'll provide all the specialist PPE needed to keep you comfortable and safe.


There will also be occasions where you'll be required to work at height or oversee work involving access equipment and specialist contractors.


Who We're Looking For

We're looking for an experienced engineering professional with strong leadership skills, a continuous improvement mindset, and a passion for building high-performing maintenance teams.


Essential

  • A recognised Electrical or Mechanical Engineering qualification (HNC, HND, Degree, NVQ Level 3, or equivalent).
  • Previous experience managing maintenance operations within a warehouse, logistics, manufacturing, FMCG, food production, cold storage, or automated environment.
  • Proven experience leading and developing engineering teams.
  • Strong knowledge of planned preventative maintenance (PPM) systems and asset management.
  • Excellent fault-finding, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
  • Strong understanding of health and safety legislation and engineering compliance requirements.
  • Experience managing contractors, suppliers, and engineering budgets.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • A proactive and organised approach with the ability to prioritise workloads effectively.

Desirable (But Not Essential)

  • Experience working within a temperature-controlled or cold storage environment.
  • Knowledge of refrigeration systems and industrial cooling equipment.
  • Experience with automated material handling equipment, conveyors, cranes, and mobile racking systems.
  • IOSH Managing Safely, NEBOSH, or equivalent health and safety qualification.
  • Experience leading engineering improvement or capital project activities.
  • Familiarity with CMMS (Computerised Maintenance Management Systems).
  • Continuous improvement experience using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies.

What's in it for me?

  • The opportunity to earn an additional day of annual leave each year, up to the maximum of one extra week for length of service.
  • Free onsite car park
  • Social environment with a team who like to support each other to achieve goals, with recognition schemes and shared spaces to enjoy lunch and rest breaks together
  • Support your emotional well-being with access to a 24/7 employee assistance phone line offering confidential free counselling and advice
  • Preferential rates for loans and savings offered through exclusive access to a credit union

Job Reference: INDUK

Why Lineage?

We are a global company with more than 22,000 employees spanning 20 countries and more than 400 locations across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and South America.

At Lineage Logistics, we have a shared purpose; we are transforming the food supply chain to eliminate waste and help feed the world. This means working at Lineage is not just a job – it’s an opportunity to innovate and put your mark on how food moves from the farm to dinner tables around the world. As a member of our team, you will be a critical link in the food supply chain.

Our shared purpose drives everything we do in all parts of our organisation, from the warehouse floor to the office. Our team members are passionate about the impact they make every single day.

We are an equal opportunities employer and positively encourage applications from persons regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity. At Lineage we also recognise that Ex-Military, veterans, and military families have great experience with transferable skills and core values that can add significant value to our organisation.

Benefits

As a Lineage team member, we aim to provide everything you and your family need to thrive. That’s why we offer competitive rates of pay, paid time off, skills training, and development opportunities to grow a long and fulfilling career with us. This is enhanced by recognition schemes (so that your hard work won’t go unnoticed), plus the chance to make your salary go even further with our cycle-to-work scheme and preferential rates for loans and savings courtesy of a leading credit union.

Your everyday wellbeing is also important to us, so we will provide you with all the protective equipment you need to be safe and comfortable at work, and you will have access to a free 24/7 employee assistance phone line, which offers confidential counselling and advice. With all of this offered against the backdrop of a fun and social environment in which you will be supported by a team who enjoy helping each other in achieving their goals, we are confident you will excel with us.

Location Flexible Across the Anglian Water Region - Hybrid

Make every drop of your potential count!


We're looking for an experienced and collaborative Head of Asset Management to help us make great decisions about our assets, investment and long-term priorities.

This is an influential leadership role with the opportunity to work across the organisation, bringing together strategy, risk, performance and insight to help us make informed, sustainable decisions.

  • is comfortable working with complexity and uncertainty
  • builds trusted relationships and works collaboratively

We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong. We are proud signatories of the Social Mobility Pledge, Race at Work Charter and Armed Forces Covenant, and we're a Disability Confident employer.

Job Summary:

Bureau Veritas Cyber Physical Security is seeking an experienced Oil & Gas Cybersecurity Assessment & Audit Lead to support and grow our Assessment & Audit service pillar.

The role will primarily lead cybersecurity assessments and audits across Oil & Gas environments, including upstream, midstream, downstream, offshore, and associated industrial operations. The individual will bring a strong understanding of Oil & Gas operations, safety culture, operational technology (OT), industrial control systems (ICS), cybersecurity, and risk.

While Oil & Gas will be the primary sector focus, the Lead will operate as part of the broader Assessment & Audit service pillar and may support comparable engagements across critical infrastructure and industrial sectors, including energy, utilities, manufacturing, data centers, transportation, and other operationally or safety-critical environments.

This role sits at the intersection of operations, safety, OT/ICS cybersecurity, technical assurance, and governance, risk and compliance (GRC). It requires an individual who can translate cybersecurity and control requirements into practical assessment activities appropriate for live industrial environments.

The Lead will be responsible for planning and executing assessments, leading field activities, evaluating evidence, developing defensible findings, managing client interactions, and producing high-quality deliverables while maintaining a strong safety and operational-risk mindset.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Oil & Gas Cybersecurity Assessments & Audits

  • Lead cybersecurity assessments and audits across Oil & Gas facilities, including offshore assets, production environments, pipelines, processing facilities, terminals, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Plan and execute onsite and remote assessment activities including document review, stakeholder interviews, technical walkthroughs, control verification, and evidence collection.
  • Evaluate the implementation and effectiveness of cybersecurity controls within operational environments.
  • Assess cybersecurity risk in the context of asset criticality, safety, environmental impact, operational availability, reliability, and production requirements.
  • Develop clear, evidence-based findings, observations, recommendations, and executive-level reporting.
  • Lead client kickoff meetings, field activities, daily readouts, debriefs, and final report discussions.

OT / ICS and Control Systems

  • Assess cybersecurity controls associated with OT and industrial control environments, including DCS, PLC, SIS, SCADA, HMI, engineering workstations, historians, industrial networks, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Understand the relationships between process control, safety systems, enterprise infrastructure, remote access, vendors, third-party connectivity, and supporting networks.
  • Evaluate technical and procedural controls associated with asset management, identity and access, network segmentation, remote access, system hardening, backup and recovery, change management, vulnerability management, logging and monitoring, and incident preparedness.
  • Understand the operational and safety implications of interacting with live industrial control environments.
  • Adapt technical assessment methods to the criticality, operating state, safety constraints, and risk profile of the systems being assessed.

Safety and Operational Assurance

  • Maintain a strong safety-first mindset for all field and assessment activities.
  • Understand the relationship between cybersecurity, process safety, functional safety, operational reliability, and safety-critical systems.
  • Work effectively within client HSE requirements, site-access requirements, permit-to-work processes, and offshore or industrial operating procedures.
  • Recognize when cybersecurity assessment or testing activities could introduce operational or safety risk and adapt the assessment approach accordingly.
  • Engage effectively with Operations, HSE, Engineering, Maintenance, Automation/Controls, IT, OT, and cybersecurity stakeholders.

Cybersecurity Risk, Governance and Compliance

  • Lead cybersecurity maturity, risk, gap, control-effectiveness, and compliance assessments.
  • Assess client environments against recognized cybersecurity standards, frameworks, regulatory requirements, and client-specific policies and control frameworks.
  • Translate policies and control requirements into practical technical and operational verification activities.
  • Evaluate both design and implementation of controls, using appropriate documentation, interviews, technical evidence, and field observations.
  • Develop defensible findings supported by objective evidence and clearly articulate associated operational and cybersecurity risk.
  • Support development and review of cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, risk registers, remediation plans, and control frameworks, where included within engagement scope.

Cross-Sector Critical Infrastructure Assessments

While Oil & Gas will be the Lead's primary sector responsibility, the individual will also:

  • Support OT cybersecurity assessments and audits across other critical infrastructure and industrial environments, such as energy, utilities, manufacturing, data centers, transportation, and other cyber-physical environments.
  • Apply common OT/ICS cybersecurity assessment principles across sectors while recognizing differences in operating processes, technologies, safety requirements, regulatory obligations, and business risk.
  • Work alongside sector-specific subject matter experts where specialized operational knowledge is required.
  • Transfer relevant lessons learned, methodologies, and assessment practices between industrial sectors without applying a one-size-fits-all approach.
  • Contribute to building a scalable, cross-sector Assessment & Audit methodology while maintaining sector-specific assessment requirements.

Delivery Leadership

  • Serve as the technical and delivery lead for assigned cybersecurity assessment and audit engagements.
  • Develop assessment plans, evidence requirements, interview plans, fieldwork schedules, and assessment procedures based on the engagement scope.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams involving cybersecurity specialists, auditors, control-system engineers, HSE personnel, operations personnel, and other subject matter experts.
  • Manage assessment activities from kickoff through fieldwork, reporting, client review, and closeout.
  • Review assessment evidence and ensure findings are technically sound, clearly supported, and appropriate for the environment being assessed.
  • Perform technical and quality reviews of reports before client delivery.
  • Mentor junior auditors, consultants, and technical specialists.
  • Help develop repeatable methodologies, checklists, evidence requirements, templates, and field procedures for the Assessment & Audit practice.

Client and Practice Development

  • Act as a trusted advisor to Oil & Gas and critical infrastructure clients.
  • Participate in client discussions, technical workshops, proposal development, scoping, and assessment planning.
  • Help determine appropriate assessment approaches based on client objectives, asset characteristics, operational constraints, and risk.
  • Identify opportunities for broader services based on client needs while maintaining appropriate boundaries between independent assessment and other services.
  • Contribute Oil & Gas and operational cybersecurity expertise to the continued development of Bureau Veritas' cyber-physical assurance capabilities.
  • Support development of new assessment offerings and methodologies that can scale across multiple critical infrastructure sectors.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No supervisory responsibilities

Skills

The requirements listed below are representative of acquired skills required.

  • Operational Technology (OT) Cybersecurity:
  • In-depth knowledge of OT systems, including DCS, PLC, SIS, SCADA, HMI, engineering workstations, and industrial networks.
  • Understanding of OT cybersecurity standards and frameworks such as ISA/IEC 62443, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-82, API 1164, and ISA84.00.09 v3.
  • Experience with cybersecurity maturity, risk, compliance, gap, or control-effectiveness assessments.
  • Industrial Control Systems (ICS):
  • Hands-on experience with industrial control systems and automation environments.
  • Familiarity with asset management, identity and access, network segmentation, remote access, system hardening, backup and recovery, change management, vulnerability management, logging and monitoring, and incident preparedness.
  • Cybersecurity Risk Management:
  • Ability to assess and evaluate cybersecurity risk in the context of asset criticality, safety, environmental impact, operational availability, reliability, and production requirements.
  • Experience with governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) in cybersecurity.
  • Industry-Specific Knowledge:
  • Oil & Gas Operations:
  • Comprehensive understanding of Oil & Gas operations, including upstream, midstream, downstream, offshore, and associated industrial operations.
  • Knowledge of the operational constraints associated with production environments.
  • Safety and Operational Assurance:
  • Strong safety mindset and understanding of safe working practices in industrial facilities.
  • Familiarity with process safety, functional safety, and operational reliability.
  • Soft Skills:
  • Communication:
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to develop professional technical reports, findings, recommendations, and executive summaries.
  • Client Interaction:
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Oil & Gas and critical infrastructure clients.
  • Participate in client discussions, technical workshops, proposal development, scoping, and assessment planning.
  • Team Leadership:
  • Ability to lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams involving cybersecurity specialists, auditors, control-system engineers, HSE personnel, operations personnel, and other subject matter experts.
  • Mentor junior auditors, consultants, and technical specialists.

Competency

The requirements listed below are competencies required to perform the job successfully.

  • Project Management:
  • Develop assessment plans, evidence requirements, interview plans, fieldwork schedules, and assessment procedures based on the engagement scope.
  • Manage assessment activities from kickoff through fieldwork, reporting, client review, and closeout.
  • Adaptability:
  • Ability to adapt technical assessment methods to the criticality, operating state, safety constraints, and risk profile of the systems being assessed.
  • Capability to apply common OT/ICS cybersecurity assessment principles across different sectors while recognizing sector-specific differences.
  • Professional Certifications:
  • Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, or equivalent.
  • Relevant Oil & Gas, control systems, functional safety, HSE, or offshore safety qualifications.
  • These skills and competencies will enable the candidate to effectively perform the duties and responsibilities outlined

Education, Certifications, and Experience (required)

  • 10+ years of professional experience within the Oil & Gas industry, with meaningful experience in operational, engineering, technical assurance, cybersecurity, controls, safety, or industrial environments.
  • Demonstrated cybersecurity experience involving OT, ICS, industrial, or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Strong understanding of Oil & Gas operations and the operational constraints associated with production environments.
  • Working knowledge of industrial control and automation environments.
  • Understanding industrial network and control system architectures.
  • Strong safety mindset and understanding of the importance of safe working practices in operating industrial facilities.
  • Ability to assess technical, procedural, and governance of cybersecurity controls.
  • Ability to engage effectively with operational personnel, engineers, HSE teams, cybersecurity teams, IT teams, management, and executives.
  • Experience developing professional technical reports, findings, recommendations, and executive summaries.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability and willingness to travel to client facilities, including offshore or remote locations where required.
  • Preferred Qualifications
  • Previous cybersecurity audit, assurance, inspection, risk assessment, or compliance assessment experience.
  • Offshore Oil & Gas experience.
  • Safety, HSE, process safety, or operational assurance experience.
  • Control System engineering or automation experience.
  • Hands-on experience with DCS, SIS, PLC, SCADA, industrial networks, or associated OT systems.
  • OT cybersecurity architecture or engineering experience.
  • Cybersecurity GRC experience within regulated or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Experience with recognized OT/ICS cybersecurity standards and frameworks such as ISA/IEC 62443, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-82, API 1164, ISA84.00.09 v3 (2024) or comparable requirements.
  • Experience performing cybersecurity maturity, risk, compliance, gap, or control-effectiveness assessments.
  • Experience working in another critical infrastructure sector in addition to Oil & Gas.
  • Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, or equivalent.
  • Relevant Oil & Gas, control systems, functional safety, HSE, or offshore safety qualifications.

Working closely with the Manager, Employee Engagement, this individual coordinates and executes a portfolio of employee volunteer programs, giving campaigns, and engagement initiatives, and serves as a key day to day point of contact for internal leaders who want to engage with them.



Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, purpose driven analyst to join our Global Social Impact team. This role brings our employee engagement strategy to life, connecting employees with meaningful volunteer and giving opportunities that strengthen the communities where we live and work. Working closely with the Manager, Employee Engagement, this individual coordinates and executes a portfolio of employee volunteer programs, giving campaigns, and engagement initiatives, and serves as a key day to day point of contact for internal leaders who want to engage with them.


This role is primarily dedicated to Insulet for Good and employee volunteer engagement, with a portion of capacity allocated to supporting broader Global Sustainability and Social Impact programs as business needs arise, including Health Tech for All community health programming.


Key Responsibilities


Program Delivery

  • Coordinate the planning, logistics, and execution of employee volunteer programs, giving campaigns, and engagement initiatives across global locations.
  • Maintain project plans, timelines, and communication schedules, managing multiple programs simultaneously against defined milestones and deadlines.
  • Run the end to end project cycle for assigned initiatives, from scoping and kickoff through cross functional coordination, status tracking, issue resolution, and post event debriefs, capturing lessons learned and applying them to future programming
  • Maintain project documentation, standard operating procedures, and implementation resources.
  • Support the development and execution of a diverse portfolio of volunteer opportunities that encourage employee participation and strengthen local communities.
  • Partner with regional leaders, Employee Resource Groups, nonprofit organizations, and internal stakeholders to successfully deliver volunteer experiences, coordinating inputs, approvals, and deliverables across multiple parties and time zones to keep on schedule.

Communications & Storytelling

  • Capture and share stories, photos, and testimonials that demonstrate the impact of employee volunteerism and giving.
  • Develop presentations, newsletters, intranet content, and emails that increase awareness and participation.
  • Partner with Corporate Communications to amplify employee engagement initiatives internally and externally.

Measurement & Operations

Education and/or Experience

Three to six months related experience and/or training; One year certificate from college or technical school; or equivalent combination of experience and education.

Cache Creek Casino Resort Tribal Gaming License. California Driver's License may be required for specific job assignments.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodations.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to climb or balance. The employee is occasionally required to sit and taste or smell. The employee must regularly lift and /or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. The employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places and toxic or caustic chemicals. The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; outside weather conditions; risk of electrical shock and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. This position requires the position holder to spend a great deal of time indoors and around slot machines. This is a smoke filled environment.

Job Title: Deployment Team Lead

Country Location and Worksite Details: United States of America | Hoboken US HQ


JOB PURPOSE

Lead reliable deployment of inventory across the logistics network, ensuring products are available where and when customers need them. The Deployment Team Lead coordinates deployment planning execution, stock allocation, exception resolution, and cross-functional follow-up across Planning, Customer Operations, Warehousing, Transportation, Manufacturing, and Logistics Finance. This role serves as a key operational lead for deployment performance, helping balance service, cost, inventory, and customer priorities while developing team capability and driving continuous improvement.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Leads day-to-day deployment execution and operational discipline across the Customer Operations Logistics network. The Team Lead uses data, systems, cross-functional coordination, and people leadership to protect service, resolve stock risks, and improve deployment performance.

  • Lead deployment execution to support product availability, inventory flow, customer service targets, and cost-effective logistics performance.
  • Coordinate the deployment planning process, including stock allocation, deployment exceptions, inventory positioning, invalid shipments and receipts, and service risk mitigation.
  • Serve as a key point of contact across Planning, Customer Operations, Warehousing, Transportation, Manufacturing, Capabilities, and Logistics Finance for deployment-related issue resolution.
  • Monitor deployment plans, order constraints, stock risks, service impacts, and escalation items to ensure timely corrective action.
  • Develop and distribute analysis, reporting, KPIs, and insights that help improve deployment execution, service performance, inventory flow, and cost outcomes.
  • Lead root cause analysis and structured problem solving to address recurring stock, service, and execution issues.
  • Support holiday scheduling, batch job analysis, and other time-sensitive deployment activities that impact service continuity.
  • Coach, develop, and support Deployment Specialists or analysts to strengthen team capability, ways of working, and operational consistency.
  • Drive continuous improvement opportunities that simplify work, improve reliability, and strengthen cross-functional execution.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in supply chain, logistics, deployment planning, customer operations, inventory management, replenishment, or a related operational role.
  • Strong understanding of deployment planning, customer service, transportation, warehousing, and supply chain execution.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify root causes, develop insights, and recommend action.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills across internal teams and external partners.
  • Ability to manage priorities, deadlines, escalations, and exceptions in a fast-paced operating environment.
  • Experience leading, coaching, training, or coordinating others in an operational setting.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel; ability to learn and use supply chain systems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience with SAP, transportation management, warehouse management, planning tools, Power BI, or related supply chain systems.
  • Experience in FMCG, consumer products, food, retail, logistics, manufacturing, or third-party logistics environments.
  • Continuous improvement, structured problem-solving, or process improvement experience.

title: Project Manager Energy
description:
At Bureau Veritas, we believe in shaping a world of trust. As a global leader in Testing, Inspection and Certification (TIC), we help our clients manage quality, safety, environmental performance and asset integrity throughout the entire lifecycle of industrial and energy projects.

To strengthen our Industry & Facilities division, we are looking for an experienced Project Manager Energy. In this role, you will manage multidisciplinary verification, validation, inspection and certification projects within the energy and industrial sectors. Projects may involve hydrogen, natural gas, LNG, offshore wind, conventional energy, process installations, pipelines, pressure equipment, machinery and other critical infrastructure.

You will play a key role in helping clients deliver safe, compliant and future-proof projects while working alongside Bureau Veritas specialists across Europe and beyond.



Your role

As Project Manager, you are responsible for the successful delivery of complex technical projects and programs. From the proposal stage through execution and completion, you ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on time and within budget.

You act as the primary point of contact for clients, coordinate multidisciplinary teams and oversee both the technical and commercial performance of your projects.



What will you do?

  • Lead verification, validation, inspection and certification projects within the energy and industrial sectors.
  • Analyse client requirements and develop project execution strategies and proposals.
  • Manage project scope, planning, resources, risks and budgets.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams of technical specialists, inspectors and surveyors.
  • Act as the key interface between clients, Bureau Veritas experts and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with international standards, regulations and Bureau Veritas quality requirements.
  • Monitor project progress and report on milestones, performance and deliverables.
  • Negotiate scope changes, variation orders and commercial agreements where necessary.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and best practices across the organisation.
  • Identify opportunities for additional services and long-term client partnerships.



What kind of projects can you expect?

Our project portfolio includes activities such as:

  • Verification and certification of energy infrastructure and industrial assets.
  • Pipeline integrity, re-certification and new-build projects.
  • Hydrogen, gas and LNG infrastructure developments.
  • Offshore and onshore renewable energy projects.
  • Pressure Equipment Directive (PED), ATEX and Machinery Directive compliance assessments.
  • Asset integrity and lifecycle management programs.
  • Inspection and certification programs for major industrial investments.
  • Large multidisciplinary projects involving international teams and stakeholders.


A recent example is a large-scale hydrogen transmission project involving pipeline re-certification, new-build infrastructure and substation verification. However, your role will span a broad range of projects across the evolving energy landscape.



What do you bring?

You combine strong project management skills with technical curiosity and commercial awareness. You feel comfortable managing multiple stakeholders and bringing specialists together to achieve common goals.

You have:

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 5 years of project management experience within energy, industrial, infrastructure or process industries.
  • Experience managing complex technical projects involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Affinity with inspection, certification, validation or engineering services.
  • Knowledge of energy infrastructure, industrial installations, pipelines, pressure equipment or related assets.
  • Strong commercial and financial project management capabilities.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Professional proficiency in English. Danish is considered a plus.
  • A proactive, analytical and solution-oriented mindset.



What we offer

At Bureau Veritas, you'll join a global organisation where expertise, innovation and collaboration come together.

We offer:

  • The opportunity to work on technically challenging and high-impact energy projects.
  • Exposure to major developments in hydrogen, renewables, industrial decarbonisation and critical infrastructure.
  • Collaboration with leading experts across our international network.
  • Extensive opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • Competitive employment conditions and attractive benefits.
  • Flexibility and autonomy in an international working environment.
  • A chance to contribute directly to the energy transition and a more sustainable future.


Why work at Bureau Veritas
Every year, we welcome and train more than 13,000 dedicated, talented, and highly skilled engineers, technicians, inspectors, auditors, and support staff around the world. Our inclusive, collaborative, mission-driven environment ensures that your unique talents contribute to our mission to shape a better world. Being part of the BV family means that you can make your mark on shaping a world of trust!

Do you want to be part of Bureau Veritas? Join our team!


Committed to an inclusive workplace

Bureau Veritas is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that is as diverse as the society in which we operate. We do not discriminate on the basis of ethnicity, religion, gender, background, socioeconomic status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, disability, political affiliation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.

We strive to foster an inclusive culture where people can be themselves, experience a sense of belonging at Bureau Veritas, and thrive because "everyone can be a talent" based on performance and behaviors that align with our values.

title: Processing Clerk
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Processing Clerk plays a vital role in supporting the judicial system by ensuring accurate case processing, proper records management, and compliance with applicable laws, statutes, and administrative orders. This position requires a high level of attention to detail and confidentiality while interacting with judges, attorneys, law enforcement, court staff, and the public.

Processing Clerks are responsible for preparing and maintaining official court records, maintaining case files, processing legal documents, and responding to inquiries regarding cases. Duties include docketing and processing of court records for all civil and criminal cases. Docketing, filing the court record into the appropriate case and assigning the correct code for labeling in the court file and workflow purposes, is a critical duty of processing clerks. Processing court records includes but is not limited to issuing court records, creating court records, servicing court records, and entering or updating data in the case maintenance system.

This role demands strong organizational and time management skills to handle multiple priorities in an often high volume and fast-paced environment. Processing clerks must demonstrate proficiency in compliance with Florida statutes and rules, administrative orders, and Clerk’s Office standards, processes and procedures. Processing clerks must maintain confidentiality of sensitive information related to court records and events and juror information. Accuracy and efficiency are essential to the processing clerk position to uphold the integrity of the judicial system.

As representatives of the Clerk and Comptroller’s Office, Processing Clerks are expected to maintain the highest standards of professionalism and customer service. They must demonstrate superior communication skills and attention to detail when assisting both internal and external stakeholders.

The Processing Clerk also plays a key role in continuity of operations planning (COOP), ensuring essential court services remain operational during emergencies by following departmental protocols and assisting with critical functions as required.

In all interactions, the position exemplifies the Clerk and Comptroller’s core values of integrity, making a difference, and proficiency, while promoting a culture of accountability, commitment, and trustworthiness. By setting high standards for professionalism in appearance and demeanor, leaders promote respectful work and service environments that emphasize individual commitment to excellence and integrity across all functions.

The Clerk and Comptroller retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position to align with the mission, core values, and goals of the organization.

Required: High School Diploma or GED

Preferred: Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Criminal Justice, Public Administration, or a related field.

Relevant Field: Business, Business Management, Business Administration, Public

Administration, Communications, Criminal Justice, English or a related discipline

Relevant Experience:

Proven experience working in a legal or judicial setting, records management, customer service, or a related administrative role preferably in a highly regulated industry.

title: AI Transformation Engineer
description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit .

The AI Transformation Office partners with departments across Yext to improve business outcomes through 30 to 60 day transformation sprints. As an AI Transformation Engineer, you build the production systems that make that real: retrieval, answer drafting, routing and evaluation on live data, plus the APIs, automations and pipelines around them. Each sprint ends with a handoff to the team that owns the outcome.

This is not a product-roadmap engineering role. You embed with department teams, learn how work actually gets done, and build with whatever fits. That is usually a workflow platform such as n8n first, and code only where the platform runs out. You care as much about whether someone else can run your work as whether it runs in production. You build and you teach, as one motion.

What You'll Do

Production LLM systems (40%)

  • Build and run production LLM workflows in n8n and similar platforms: retrieval over ticket and documentation data, answer drafting and routing.
  • Build APIs, integrations and data pipelines that connect CRM, support and operational systems.
  • Build and calibrate confidence scoring so teams know when to trust an answer, and design the review steps and approval gates where a person decides.
  • Protect the data you work with: scope what each workflow can read, handle PII and sensitive fields, and keep access logs.
  • Ship every solution monitored, error-handled and version-controlled, not just functional.

Evals and quality (15%)

  • Define evals before each build: test sets, groundedness and accuracy checks, and the thresholds that decide whether output ships or needs review.
  • Report quality results to partner teams in plain terms.
  • Track LLM spend and usage by team, manage API keys, and report run rate.

Knowledge transfer and enablement (20%)

  • Pair-build with embedded team members so they learn by doing, not by watching.
  • Write documentation that scales: runbooks, admin guides, architecture diagrams and decision logs.
  • Train department champions at the right altitude: enough to maintain and extend, not enough to overwhelm.
  • Build with handoff in mind from day one. The owning team should run each system day to day within 30 days of launch. They own workflow configuration, prompts, review queues and reports. You keep the retrieval, eval and scoring code until a second engineer can take it.

System design and architecture (15%)

  • Design integration patterns that connect CRM, support and operational systems.
  • Architect data flows that enable automation and AI-powered decisions.
  • Evaluate new models and tools, and make build-vs-buy recommendations grounded in the team's real maintenance capacity.

Opportunity identification (10%)

  • Spot automation and integration opportunities others miss by understanding how work actually gets done.
  • Translate technical possibilities into language department stakeholders can evaluate.
  • Estimate effort honestly and scope tightly: cut work that does not change the outcome, and say so early.

What You Have

  • 5 to 8 years in software engineering, integration development or automation engineering.
  • Production experience with a workflow platform such as n8n, Zapier or Tray.io, building automations that other teams rely on.
  • Experience designing reliable autonomous agents: agent frameworks and patterns such as tool calling, orchestration, guardrails and human escalation, with eval feedback loops that keep output high quality and consistent.
  • Python or TypeScript for the work a platform cannot do, with API design skills and an understanding of how software is operated: monitoring, error handling, version control and deployment discipline.
  • Hands-on production use of LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI or Google), including prompt design and structured outputs.
  • Retrieval experience: vector databases such as Qdrant or pgvector, chunking and grounding.
  • Experience measuring LLM output quality with test sets, graded review or evals.
  • Experience handling sensitive data in production systems: PII, permissions and audit logging.
  • A teaching instinct. You explain what you build and why, and you notice when someone is lost before they say so.
  • Documentation discipline, and the ability to explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders without jargon.

Bonus Points

  • MCP servers, agent frameworks or tool-calling design.
  • Experience governing a shared LLM cost budget or API keys.
  • CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot), data engineering or ETL, and warehouse analytics such as Snowflake.
  • Familiarity with support, customer success or professional services operations.
  • Experience building internal tools where the users are colleagues, not customers.
  • Training, facilitation or mentoring experience, formal or informal.
  • Comfort in ambiguous environments where requirements evolve as understanding deepens.

Flex Capabilities

You bring enough business context to understand why a process exists, not only how to automate it. You can contribute to prioritization, challenge assumptions about what is worth building, and sharpen your business instincts over time. We are a small team, and everyone stretches beyond their primary role.

What Success Looks Like

Each engagement agrees on key metrics before work starts, such as deflection rate, handle time or hours saved, and measures it against a baseline taken before launch.

30 days: You understand the systems landscape across the partner department and have identified three or more high-impact automation or integration opportunities. The first sprint has an agreed metric, baseline and eval set. Embedded team members see you as approachable and are already learning from working alongside you.

60 days: The first automation is live, meets the agreed quality threshold, and moves the agreed metric. At least one embedded team member can explain how it works and make minor changes without you. Documentation is current, not aspirational.

90 days: The first system is owned by the partner team day to day, and a second is live and stable. Embedded champions can maintain and extend them, and LLM spend is tracked by team. Handoff documentation is complete enough that a new engineer could onboard from it. The department refers to your work as "ours," not "the AI team's."

Thank you for your interest in employment with Torch Technologies. Our team provides superior research, development, and engineering services to the Federal Government and Department of War. As one of the nation’s top 100 defense companies, the services we provide directly support the men and women who serve our country. Our corporate mission sums up the pride our employee-owners take in the work we do: “Lighting the Pathway of Freedom”. And, as a Certified Evergreen ESOP, we have made the commitment to grow and sustain our company for the next 100 years! Come grow with us!

Torch Technologies is seeking a highly skilled AMSC Test Analyst to support the 718th Test Squadron (718 TS) at the Arnold Engineering Development Complex (AEDC). The 718 TS operates world-class aerodynamic and propulsion test facilities, and this role is critical to advancing the nation's hypersonic weapon and flight systems. This position is located onsite at Arnold AFB, TN.


As a Test Analyst, your duties will include the following, but are not limited to:


Test Planning & Execution:

  • Lead the complete test inquiry, planning, and execution process for hypersonic ground tests in arcjet test facilities, ensuring alignment with government and customer requirements.
  • Advise and assist government and customers in assessing test conditions and addressing test cell/test article interactions.
  • Develop requirements, test objectives, measures of performance, and success criteria to support the evaluation of hypersonic weapon systems.
  • Lead Technical, Safety, and Readiness Review Boards.

Data Analysis & Reporting:

  • Perform in-depth analysis of test data to meet analysis objectives.
  • Prepare quick-look reports and detailed technical reports to document test planning, data processing, analysis, conclusions, and recommendations.

Modeling & Simulation:

  • Utilize commercial and in-house simulation codes and analysis tools to support testing activities.

Technical Support & Expertise:

  • ​Provide senior aerothermal test engineering and/or analysis expertise in areas such as aerothermal testing and analysis, Thermal Protection System (TPS) ablation, Fluid-thermal-structural interaction (FTSI) modeling and simulation, computational heat transfer, optical diagnostic techniques, and statistical methods.

Collaboration & Communication:

  • Work in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing work to balance multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Collaborate effectively with senior staff and peers, communicating clearly and concisely in both oral and written formats.

Required Qualifications:

  • U.S. Citizenship
  • Education - Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university.
  • Must be able to obtain/maintain a Top Secret DoW security clearance. Active clearance must be maintained throughout employment tenure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or Aerospace Engineering.
  • At least 5 years' of direct experience in testing.
  • Proficiency with Scientific Python (primary code) and Matlab (secondary).
  • Experience with statistical analysis techniques and data-driven decision making.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience fostering cooperation and teamwork with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong adherence to safety and security protocols in a test environment.
