title: Senior MES Engineer
description:
About Us:

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food & beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology.


Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.


Job Description:

MES Engineer – Ignition / Sepasoft / OEE

Design Group | A Barry-Wehmiller Company

Who We Are

At Design Group, we're engineering the future of manufacturing and industrial technology.

With more than 45 offices across the United States and India and nearly 1,500 engineering and technical professionals, we deliver innovative engineering, consulting, and technology solutions for some of the world's most recognized companies.

Our expertise spans industrial automation, control systems integration, manufacturing execution systems (MES), facility and process engineering, enterprise technology, and more. We partner with industry leaders across the Food & Beverage, Life Sciences, Advanced Technology, and Industrial sectors to solve complex challenges and deliver meaningful results.

As part of Barry-Wehmiller, a $3 billion global organization with nearly 12,000 team members, we share a people-first philosophy and a commitment to using the power of business to build a better world.

The Opportunity

Are you passionate about industrial automation, manufacturing software, and solving complex technical challenges?

We're looking for an experienced MES Engineer to join our growing Systems Integration team. In this role, you'll help leading manufacturers modernize their operations by designing and implementing innovative software solutions that improve visibility, efficiency, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).

You'll work with cutting-edge technologies, including Ignition Perspective, Sepasoft MES, Python, SQL, and REST APIs, delivering solutions that make a measurable impact on manufacturing performance.

Our engineers work on everything from standalone software applications to large-scale manufacturing projects, including new greenfield facilities. Many of our projects involve developing first-of-their-kind solutions to solve real-world operational challenges.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, collaborate with talented engineering professionals, and make a direct impact on how some of the world's leading companies manufacture their products.

What You'll Do

As an MES Engineer, you'll play a key role in designing, developing, and implementing manufacturing software solutions throughout the entire project lifecycle.

MES & Software Development

  • Design, develop, and deploy applications using Ignition Perspective and Sepasoft MES, with a primary focus on OEE solutions.
  • Develop software integrations involving SQL databases, data collection, reporting, Python scripting, and REST APIs.
  • Create applications that provide actionable insights into manufacturing performance, equipment utilization, downtime, and production efficiency.
  • Translate manufacturing requirements into scalable, reliable, and user-friendly software solutions.

Project Execution & Implementation

  • Participate in all phases of project delivery, including requirements gathering, system architecture, development, testing, commissioning, and startup.
  • Support the implementation of new manufacturing systems and the modernization of existing production facilities.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize applications to ensure reliable performance in industrial environments.
  • Manage multiple projects and technical responsibilities while maintaining quality and meeting project deadlines.

Collaboration & Client Engagement

  • Partner directly with clients to understand operational challenges, define project requirements, and develop effective technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams on complex automation and manufacturing projects.
  • Communicate technical concepts and project progress to engineering teams, clients, and stakeholders.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to developing engineers.
  • Travel to client facilities as needed to support implementation, commissioning, and system startup.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for a technically strong, solutions-oriented engineer who enjoys combining software development with real-world manufacturing applications.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in systems integration, SCADA, MES, or industrial software development.
  • Hands-on experience developing applications using Ignition Perspective.
  • Strong understanding of industrial automation and manufacturing software environments.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience managing multiple technical responsibilities and projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work directly with clients, vendors, and engineering teams.
  • Ability to mentor and support less experienced engineers.
  • Willingness to travel as required for project execution, commissioning, and startup activities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing and implementing Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) applications.
  • Hands-on experience with the Sepasoft MES platform.
  • Proficiency in Python scripting, SQL databases, reporting tools, and REST API integrations.
  • Understanding of manufacturing IT/OT infrastructure, including networking, virtualization, operating systems, servers, and databases.
  • Experience integrating manufacturing software with industrial control systems and production equipment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

Why Join Design Group?

Work on Projects That Matter

You'll help leading manufacturers solve complex challenges through innovative automation and software solutions. Your work will have a direct impact on manufacturing productivity, operational efficiency, and digital transformation.

Build Your Career, Not Just Your Resume

We believe professional growth should be intentional and supported. Our engineers have access to mentorship, technical development, individualized career planning, and opportunities to expand their expertise and leadership capabilities.

Development resources include:

  • First Year Experience Program
  • Individual Development Plans
  • Career Path Resources and Tools
  • Mentorship from experienced engineers and technical leaders
  • Opportunities to work across multiple industries and emerging technologies

A People-First Culture

At Design Group, our people are our greatest strength. We foster a collaborative environment built on trust, integrity, mutual respect, and a genuine commitment to each individual's professional and personal success.

Opportunity to Make an Impact

Our entrepreneurial culture encourages engineers to take ownership, bring forward new ideas, and help shape the solutions we deliver. You'll have the opportunity to contribute beyond your immediate responsibilities while building a rewarding, long-term career.

Let's Build Something Great Together

If you're an MES Engineer who enjoys solving challenging problems, developing innovative manufacturing solutions, and seeing your work come to life on the plant floor, we'd love to connect with you.

Join Design Group and help shape the future of industrial automation and smart manufacturing.

The role requires strong operational management, stakeholder engagement, systems management, and project management skills to improve program outcomes

Location

Hybrid – Lexington, KY

This position is based in the Lexington, Kentucky office and requires onsite presence at the Lexington warehouse office a minimum of three days per week.

What You’ll Be Doing (Essential Duties)

*not inclusive of all role responsibilities. May be subject to change

GIK Strategy, Planning & Allocation (40%)

Review, evaluate, and approve book title selections and donated products from Corporate and select non-profit partners, ensuring timely turnaround from offer to approval. Assess Gifts-In-Kind opportunities against organizational priorities, program needs, operational capacity, and donor objectives.
  • Develop receiving, inventory management, and distribution plans for approved donations.
  • Maintain and update the annual Gifts-In-Kind Strategy and Needs List based on evolving program requirements and stakeholder feedback.

Corporate Partnerships & Donor Operations (30%)

  • Collaborate with Lead Advisor, GIK, Corporate Partnerships to align on strategy, goals, pipeline status, and ad hoc projects as needed.
  • Evaluate incoming Gifts-In-Kind opportunities and provide timely recommendations regarding acceptance, feasibility, allocation, and implementation.
  • In concert with Corporate Partnerships account manager, liaise directly with companies to facilitate all logistics for in-kind donations
  • Manage and maintain the Gifts-In-Kind opportunity pipeline, ensuring accurate documentation and timely updates.
  • Perform regular reconciliations between BBEC, TrackVia, Agresso, and related databases to ensure data integrity and reporting accuracy.
  • Participate in donor meetings and provide operational expertise regarding product sourcing, inventory management, and program alignment.
  • Present Gifts-In-Kind strategy, inventory trends, and program priorities during Corporate Partnerships planning and review meetings.
  • Develop and deliver quantitative and qualitative donor reports combining inventory, distribution, utilization, and impact data, including beneficiary feedback, stories, testimonials, and program outcomes.

Systems, Reporting & Knowledge Management (20%)

  • Manage and continuously improve SharePoint sites, Microsoft Teams channels, allocation trackers, receiving plans, and knowledge management resources.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance reporting tools, process documentation, and standard operating procedures.
  • Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and accessibility of operational data and resources across all GIK platforms.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation, workflow improvements, and enhanced reporting capabilities.
  • Support organizational knowledge sharing by maintaining centralized resources and documentation.

Organizational Engagement & Special Projects (10%)

  • Lead semi-annual planning sessions with State Leads to review program needs, product priorities, and Gifts-In-Kind strategy.
  • Facilitate quarterly coordination meetings with State Operations Administrators and other key stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain a centralized content management process to collect and organize impact stories, photos, testimonials, quotes, and other program outcomes.
  • Contribute to special projects and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen the effectiveness and efficiency of the Gifts-In-Kind program.

Required qualifications for the role

  • Minimum of a bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, plus at least 5 years of relevant experience in operations, project management, inventory management, donor services, philanthropy operations, or related fields.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Microsoft Excel, including reporting, analysis, and data management.
  • Experience working with CRM systems such as Blackbaud CRM, Salesforce, or similar platforms.
  • Experience managing information systems and workflow tools such as TrackVia or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple deliverables and competing priorities simultaneously.
  • Professional proficiency in MS Office suite
  • Professional proficiency in spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing Gifts-In-Kind programs, product donation programs, inventory allocation, or nonprofit operations.
  • Experience using TrackVia or similar no-code/low-code platforms, including Airtable, Smartsheet, ServiceNow, or AppSheet.
  • Experience designing and maintaining dashboards, custom reports, workflows, and performance tracking tools used for decision-making.
  • Knowledge of nonprofit accounting practices, inventory valuation, financial reconciliation, and operational reporting.
  • Experience supporting donor engagement, philanthropic strategy, or corporate partnership initiatives.
  • Experience administering SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and enterprise collaboration platforms.
  • Certification or professional training in project management, business process improvement, operations management, or data analytics is a plus.

title: Manager, Software Quality & Integration Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary:

In 2009, The Coca-Cola Company introduced the revolutionary Freestyle dispenser. Open its door and you’ll find embedded software directing an orchestra of motors, sensors and precision pumps to pour a virtually unlimited selection of beverages. Today, Freestyle is part of a growing portfolio of connected beverage equipment: multiple embedded operating systems, digitally enabled dispensers and devices, and the cloud, web and IoT services that tie them together.


As Manager, Software Quality & Integration Engineer, you’ll be central to the software quality, integration and release readiness of new software and hardware across that portfolio. Working closely with software and hardware development teams, product owners and Coca-Cola customers, you’ll drive software quality from test strategy through release: defining test coverage, validating new software on real equipment, triaging and resolving issues in the field, spotting defect patterns before they spread, and making sure every release is ready for the equipment and customers that depend on it. Every release you validate ends up running on real hardware in front of real customers, so the role calls for someone who is solutions-oriented and can balance competing priorities across teams. If you’re excited by REST endpoints that open doors, run compressors and pump fluids, and by the tools that keep a fleet of connected machines healthy, this may be the job for you.

What You’ll Do for Us:

  • Function as a subject matter expert (SME) for the Coca-Cola Freestyle fleet and other connected equipment, providing software quality assurance expertise across embedded systems, software platforms, connected devices, and hardware integrations.
  • Coordinate end-to-end integration efforts across software release cycles, ensuring system stability, functionality, and operational readiness through comprehensive testing and validation processes.
  • Define test coverage, develop test plans, create and maintain test cases, and execute both manual and automated functional and performance tests that identify issues and mitigate risk to the fleet.
  • Bridge technical and business requirements during software release cycles and innovation projects by collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to align system functionality, user needs, operational goals, and deployment expectations.
  • Analyze dispenser logs to assist development resources in defect debugging and leverage and enhance existing test tools to automate testing of physical dispensers.
  • Partner with development and engineering management to understand dispenser and equipment requirements and ensure the testability of those designs.
  • Collaborate with software, hardware, and other engineering teams to help deliver new technologies, embedded software solutions, and innovative system improvements across Freestyle platforms and connected equipment.
  • Investigate and resolve escalated field issues through advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and data-driven problem solving to improve system reliability and minimize operational disruptions.
  • Review and validate new hardware and software prototypes, identifying integration improvements and ensuring compatibility, performance, and readiness for deployment in production environments.
  • Provide fluency in AI-driven tools to support integration and troubleshooting efforts, enabling efficient analysis of large datasets and accelerating issue resolution for field and engineering teams.


Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, or Food Engineering).
  • 3+ years of industry experience, ideally in a fast-moving consumer goods company, with the ability to leverage technical knowledge to provide competitive advantage.
  • Strong knowledge of testing IoT and embedded devices, including Linux, at least one programming language (Java preferred), and backend protocols communicating to hardware.
  • Excellent knowledge of both the embedded and full-stack software development lifecycle, testing methodologies, and testing tools.
  • Ability to help refine solutions and manage internal and external partners’ expectations against technical and business success criteria
  • Strong working knowledge of shell scripting and Unix command-line tools.
  • Ability to use backend communication protocols such as APIs and web services.
  • Knowledge of test automation tools (Selenium, JUnit, JavaScript, Java, Groovy).
  • Knowledge of version control systems such as Git or similar tools.
  • Experience developing test plans, assessing risk, detailing defects, and providing relevant data for test reporting.
  • Fluent in software QA metrics, operations, and statistics.
  • Ability to triage problems, prioritize accordingly, and propose resolutions.
  • Ability to work independently, raise issues, and take corrective action.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

The Coca-Cola Company will not offer sponsorship for employment status (including, but not limited to, H1-B visa status and other employment-based nonimmigrant visas) for this position. Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require The Coca-Cola Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.

title: Microbiology Technologist II
description:

We're not just a workplace. We're a Great Place to Work certified employer!

At Clinical Pathology Laboratories, a division of Sonic Healthcare USA, we cultivate a supportive, science-driven environment that encourages innovation and collaboration. Our mission is to advance the health and well-being of our communities through excellence in clinical laboratory solutions. Quality is in our DNA. Is it in yours?

This full-time opportunity is in the Microbiology Department of Clinical Pathology Laboratories (CPL) in Austin, Texas. We are seeking a Microbiology Technologist to work with the Bacteriology team on first shift (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM) with rotating weekends.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Perform high-complexity microbiological testing on clinical specimens such as urine, blood, sputum, wounds, and body fluids
  • Read and interpret culture media, distinguishing clinically significant pathogens from contaminants or normal flora
  • Identify microorganisms using manual and automated biochemical methodologies
  • Perform antibiotic susceptibility testing to determine appropriate treatment options
  • Analyze, review, and report microbiology test results, ensuring timely communication of critical findings
  • Recognize and troubleshoot issues or unexpected results, implementing corrective actions effectively
  • Comply with laboratory safety protocols, quality control standards, and regulatory guidelines

What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor degree or higher in a biological, medical, or laboratory science
  • Proficiency in operating general laboratory equipment, including telephones, computers, automated analyzers, centrifuges, microscopes, manual and automated pipettes, and audible alarms
  • Strong reading, writing, and analytical skills
  • A willingness to learn new techniques and technologies, with enthusiasm for continuous professional development

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Certification by the American Society of Clinical Pathologists (ASCP) in Microbiology or Medical Laboratory Science (or equivalent)
  • 1+ years of experience in a clinical microbiology laboratory
  • Clinical laboratory training or experience in high-complexity testing

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • A 401(k) plan with company match to support your retirement goals
  • Work-life balance, including Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

title: Incisore
description:
Buccellati is an Italian jewellery, high-jewellery and silversmithing Maison founded in 1919, admired in the world for its craftmanship and the uniqueness of its creations. Today, the Buccellati jewels stand out for their design and for the techniques used to create them, such as the hand-engraving technique, dating back to the goldsmithing traditions of the Italian “bottega” of the Renaissance times.

The Maison’s unrelenting desire to create objects of rare beauty has made Buccellati renowned in the world for a style that is distinct, inimitable and imbued with sophisticated Milanese heritage, at once glamourous and contemporary.

The Maison has been part of the global luxury group Richemont since September 2019 and the Buccellati family is still present in the Company to perpetuate its style and unparalleled craftsmanship tradition.

Siamo alla ricerca di un Incisore da inserire nel nostro team di produzione a Valbrona. Il candidato ideale sarà responsabile dell'esecuzione di incisioni di alta precisione sulle creazioni Buccellati, contribuendo a mantenere gli elevati standard di qualità e l'estetica distintiva della Maison.

title: Sr Data Governance Analyst - Hybrid Richmond, VA
description:
Senior Data Governance Analyst

Position Summary

DBHDS is seeking an experienced Senior Data Governance Analyst to support the implementation and continuous improvement of enterprise data governance through the effective integration of people, processes, and technology.

The position will collaborate with data owners, data stewards, and enterprise partners to translate governance policies, standards, and decisions into repeatable, sustainable, and measurable business processes that embed data governance into operations and technology delivery.

The ideal candidate is a skilled business analyst and facilitator with a strong understanding of data governance principles who can analyze complex business and data management challenges, interpret policies, elicit requirements, facilitate cross-functional decisions, and translate governance needs into practical solutions.

The role emphasizes governance by design, business process improvement, stakeholder collaboration, operational accountability, and organizational adoption rather than hands-on technical development.

Key Responsibilities

Data Governance Business Analysis and Process Improvement

  • Analyze business processes and data management practices to identify governance gaps, risks, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.

  • Facilitate requirements elicitation, root cause analysis, and current-state and future-state process design for governance-related initiatives.

  • Translate governance policies, standards, business needs, and decisions into actionable business requirements, workflows, procedures, and operational controls.

  • Develop process maps, business requirements, SOPs, RACI matrices, and performance measures to support governance implementation and accountability.

  • Support process implementation, automation, adoption, and continuous improvement to establish sustainable governance practices.

Governance Facilitation and Enterprise Collaboration

  • Facilitate cross-functional working sessions involving data owners, stewards, business units, enterprise architecture, engineering, security, analytics, and external partners.

  • Facilitate complex discussions, reconcile competing priorities, evaluate alternatives, and support informed governance decisions by authorized stakeholders.

  • Clarify governance decision rights, responsibilities, dependencies, and required actions for implementation.

  • Document governance decisions, communicate requirements and outcomes to responsible teams, and coordinate follow-through to implementation.

  • Foster collaboration and accountability for consistent application of governance practices across business and technical stakeholders.

Data Governance Operations and Continuous Improvement

  • Support data owners and stewards in implementing governance policies, standards, roles, and responsibilities within operational processes.

  • Collaborate with data owners, stewards, and enterprise partners to define, document, and monitor meaningful measures of governance effectiveness, stakeholder engagement, compliance, and data quality.

  • Facilitate data quality issue identification, root cause analysis, remediation planning, and continuous improvement.

  • Support data access governance and data sharing processes by ensuring authorized decisions, requirements, and conditions are clearly documented, communicated to execution teams, and tracked through implementation.

  • Collaborate with enterprise partners to embed governance requirements into data onboarding, integration, management, and consumption.

  • Elicit and document business and analytical requirements to help ensure governed enterprise data products meet consumer needs.

Areas of Contribution

The analyst may lead or support prioritized initiatives involving governance decision processes (Awareness, Risks, Issues, and Decisions — ARID), access governance, data sharing, automated data onboarding, Enterprise Master Person Index (EMPI) and reference data management, data quality improvement, compliance reviews, and data product requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience in senior-level business analysis, requirements elicitation, business process improvement, and complex problem-solving.

  • Advanced facilitation skills, including leading cross-functional working sessions, navigating competing priorities, building consensus, and driving decisions to resolution.

  • Proven ability to analyze, design, document, and support implementation of sustainable business processes.

  • Ability to interpret policies, standards, and business requirements and translate them into practical operational processes, business rules, and controls.

  • Working knowledge of enterprise data governance concepts, including data ownership, stewardship, access governance, data quality, compliance, and data lifecycle management.

  • Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

  • Five or more years of experience in business analysis, requirements elicitation, process improvement, or related enterprise business functions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise data governance initiatives, including governance process implementation, data stewardship, data quality, metadata, or access governance.

  • Experience in government, healthcare, or another regulated environment.

  • Familiarity with enterprise data integration, interoperability, master and reference data management, and governed data products.

  • Knowledge of data governance frameworks (e.g. DAMA-DMBOK, DMMI) and process improvement methodologies (BPMN, Lean, Six Sigma).

  • Familiarity with AWS, Snowflake, Commonwealth of Virginia/VITA standards, or relevant professional certifications such as CDMP.

Education

A bachelor's degree in information systems, business administration, information management, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent professional experience and relevant certifications may be considered.

title: Manager, Social
description:
WE HAVE CREATED A WORLD WHERE ART AND SCIENCE ARE BEST FRIENDS

Known is what happens when a data science firm and a creative agency stop arguing and start collaborating. We were built from scratch with PhD data scientists and award-winning creatives working on the same briefs, from day one. That structure earned us an Ad Age #3 A-List ranking, back-to-back Data & Insights Agency of the Year wins, plus Emmys, Cannes Lions, Clios, and Effies across clients in finance, tech, entertainment, consumer goods, and real estate. We're distributed across the U.S. and unapologetically ambitious.

If you're tired of choosing between doing smart work and doing creative work, you'll fit right in here.

BUT ENOUGH ABOUT US, LET'S TALK ABOUT YOU

About the role:

Known’s Media Science team uses advanced analytics, machine learning, statistics, and algorithms to plan and optimize advertising dollars. We partner with our clients to translate their business goals into meaningful metrics, and buy media across all channels to drive those target outcomes.

As a Manager, Social, you own performance and optimization for the campaigns and clients you manage. You will lead paid social team members in daily account management, strategy creation and implementation, tracking performance against goals, and adherence to deadlines, among other topics. You will be responsible for communicating performance both internally to teams at Known as well as externally to clients.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Drive performance for paid social campaigns and amaze our clients, both by meeting their targets and creating insightful narratives
  • Design and author overall team strategy and media approach to paid social management across multiple clients and business objectives
  • Ensure reporting of social performance to clients is of a high standard and build a narrative for the development of the account
  • Ensure best practices are met across all sectors of paid social planning and buying, as well as knowledge sharing across teams
  • Build strong relationships with platform reps and identify partner vendors for future collaboration

  • Day-to-day management and coordination of advertising spend you’re responsible for, including working with channel specialists on strategy, insights, optimizations, and improvements
  • Communicating how modern techniques (e.g. optimization algorithms, automation, and AI) can be used to optimize KPIs and around black-box algorithms in different social channels
  • Building analyses, stories, and presentations for client media plans and reports

WHO YOU ARE AND WHAT YOU HAVE

  • A degree from a well-regarded college or university..
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in management of the buying, strategy, and execution of highly data-driven performance and brand Paid Social campaigns, ideally in a digital agency environment
  • 1+ years of experience managing direct reports; experience managing large teams is a plus
  • A firm understanding of how Paid Social works with Display Media, Paid Search, SEO, Mobile, Social, and Attribution
  • Experience managing paid social campaigns through Sprinklr a plus
  • Experience running campaigns for brands within the the financial services or healthcare industry a plus
  • Experience contributing to new business pitches is a plus
  • Experience auditing a clients social channels is a plus

Skills, Abilities, and Knowledge

  • Understanding of the basic stats and math that inform smart media buying
  • Superb communication and presentation skills
  • Comfort going in-platform to pull analyses when necessary
  • In-platform experience with Meta, TikTok, X, Reddit, YouTube, Pinterest, LinkedIn etc.
  • Expertise designing high performance Social campaigns --e.g. allocation, measurement plan, strategy, and scaling budgets
  • Experience multi-tasking in a fast-paced environment is a plus
  • Experience working directly with data scientists is a plus

Competencies

  • An ability to translate business challenges into quantitative problems, and solve them by whatever means necessary, delivering high quality output to meet the client’s expectations.
  • An ability to delegate tasks to small and junior teams
  • Highly collaborative nature
  • A commitment to managing the quality & accuracy of analytics, ensuring high standards with your and others’ work

SOME OF OUR PERKS

  • Unlimited paid time off
  • 401k with company matching and no vesting period
  • Annual bonuses
  • Generous medical plan
  • Paid parental leave

ONE LAST THING TO ASK YOURSELF

All this might sound great, but you’re probably still wondering, “Would I be a good fit for Known?” or “Would Known be a good fit for me?” Our culture is propped up by four values that we aspire to every day: We are one team. We see the good. We never stop learning. There’s always a better way. At Known we are setting out to build something more than just a company. We are building a legacy filled with exceptionally talented people with a kaleidoscope of backgrounds, experiences, and origin stories who feel encouraged and empowered to bring their whole selves to work, and to partner with us in molding and shaping our culture through our values.

title: Product Strategist
description:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.

Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

Position Description

We are seeking a CIT Solutions Strategist to join our CIT Strategy Team and help shape the future of PIMCO's Collective Investment Trust (CIT) business. The team sits within PIMCO's U.S. Retirement business and supports the growth of the firm's CIT platform. This role is well suited for an adaptable, intellectually curious professional who can lead the detailed, hands-on work that makes CITs successful while connecting that work to evolving client needs.

You will serve as a specialist, strategic resource, and trusted internal partner across the firm, helping to advance PIMCO's CIT capabilities. You will collaborate with Defined Contribution Solutions, Client Management, Product Strategy, Legal, Operations, Compliance, and third-party trust companies to implement CITs, support client adoption, and help internal teams position CIT strategies.

Why this role

  • Strategy and execution together. You will lead projects, timelines, and detailed work behind new launches, working closely with trustees, while connecting CIT decisions to broader client and consultant needs. .
  • Broad collaboration. You will work every day with our trustee partners and colleagues across the firm.. Success depends on building trust and bringing people together around shared goals.
  • A small team and a real voice. The team is newer and small, so you will think like a business owner and have direct impact on how the CIT business operates and grows.
  • Room to innovate. We are seeking someone who is AI-forward and eager to use these tools in day-to-day work to respond to client needs, synthesize documents and data, find gaps and areas of improvement, and apply prior work to new projects and situations. We encourage you to turn what works for you into best practices you share with colleagues.

The CIT Solutions Strategist will bring expertise in CIT structures, governance, operations, fee arrangements, regulatory considerations, and retirement plan investments. The role requires strong analytical capabilities, project leadership, business judgment, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple initiatives. Success also requires a hands-on mindset, equal care for strategy and detail, and a willingness to contribute at every level.

Location

Newport Beach, New York

Responsibilities

CIT Product Development

  • Lead the implementation and enhancement of CIT products and share classes.
  • Partner with the product and distribution teams to identify market opportunities and determine product and share-class needs.

Trustee & Platform Management

  • Serve as a primary liaison with third-party trust companies, with a strong understanding of their practices, operational and reporting requirements, fiduciary responsibilities, and governance frameworks.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to expand collaboration with trustees and support business growth.

Governance, Compliance & Regulatory Oversight

  • Partner with Funds Legal Compliance and Trustees to support adherence to regulatory and fiduciary requirements.
  • Evaluate governance implications of product changes, operational issues, and investor requests, including restricted affiliates, employer securities, trading guidelines, and eligibility restrictions.
  • Proactively monitor regulatory developments and changes across the retirement landscape, assess potential implications for the CIT business, and provide timely, actionable updates to business stakeholders.

Business Management & Strategic Execution

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives across multiple stakeholders and business units. Develop project plans, establish milestones, manage dependencies, and drive execution.
  • Identify risks, develop mitigation strategies, and proactively communicate issues and recommendations.

Stakeholder Support & Education

  • Serve as a trusted internal resource on CIT structures, investor eligibility, product positioning, fees, reporting, governance, liquidity, and operational considerations.
  • Provide accurate, well-supported analyses, recommendations, and communications to internal and external stakeholders.

Operational Excellence

  • Drive continuous improvement of CIT processes and controls. Maintain expertise in CIT workflows, reporting, fee structures, and trustee administration; translate operational considerations into business implications
  • Develop and enhance process documentation and internal knowledge resources.
  • Improve efficiency, scalability, data quality, and controls across the CIT platform, including using AI to identify gaps or errors in internal and trustee-sourced data.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA, CFA, JD, or other advanced designation preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in asset management, retirement solutions, institutional investments, CITs, mutual funds, or related financial services, particularly fixed income, with knowledge of the institutional client base.
  • Demonstrated experience working with CITs, Defined Contribution plans, or institutional investment products, including having worked with CITs in some capacity (e.g., at a trust company or in a product, investment, client, operations, legal, or compliance role).
  • Strong understanding of CIT structures and governance, including trustee and custodial relationships.
  • Deep knowledge of the Defined Contribution and retirement plan markets, including ERISA and retirement industry regulations and the compliance considerations that affect retirement investment vehicles.
  • Working knowledge of investment operations and implementation processes, fee structures, and institutional product development.
  • Experience leading cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and business acumen, with the ability to see CITs in the context of the broader retirement business.
  • Hands-on project management and execution, with the ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams and external trustee partners and to manage competing priorities.
  • Analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including comfort using AI-enabled tools to review information, identify patterns or data issues, and improve processes.
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with high attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to operate independently and exercise sound judgment.
  • A hands-on, business-owner mindset in a small team setting, able to connect the dots and help build scalable infrastructure.

Success Factors

Successful candidates consistently demonstrate:

  • Deep CIT expertise and technical credibility.
  • Strong ownership and accountability, with high-quality execution and limited oversight.
  • The ability to anticipate business needs and provide clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Effective partnership across Product Strategy, Client Management, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Portfolio Management, and trustee partners.

The role actively supports or leads innovation projects and helps drive successful product launches in the market.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Demonstrating innovation and technical service competence to customers, serving as primary technical contact to Decorative Coatings customers in North America, competently serving Architectural Coatings, Pigment Concentrates, Wood Coatings, Flooring and other Decorative Coatings customers whenever necessary. Collaborating closely with the market and customers in all Decorative Coatings applications through on-site visits, conference presentations, events and seminars, and virtual engagements across North America.

  • Representing Business Line CAD and Market Segment Decorative Coatings as a technical expert and serving as a primary point of contact for technical inquiries for Architectural Coatings customers. Identifying opportunities for TSRs. Collaborating with regional ART Head, lab teams, Quality Control, and Complaint Management to resolve customer complaints and identify optimal technical solutions.

  • Implementing innovative ideas for product and process development through I2P projects in partnership with regional ART head, as well as RD&I, other Market Segments and Product Lines.

  • Identifying appropriate work to support new product development projects and supervising scientists and/or technicians on the team to execute that work; filing patent applications as appropriate. Following up with customers in North America to understand performance of experimental products in their formulations.

  • Documents and statistically validate experimental results in alignment with team manager and lab team, with internal and external stakeholders, and preparing publications and promotional material jointly with marketing when required, e.g. factsheets, articles, launch presentations, COATINO® campus content.

  • Actively participating on the Americas Decorative Coatings Market Segment Team. Ensuring alignment with global and regional strategies. Efficiently executing all market-oriented applications development and innovation activities, supporting all market sub-segments as needed.

  • Monitoring market trends, competitive activities, and technology developments, and recommending benchmarking initiatives. Translating customer and market needs into innovative ideas for new product and process development projects.

  • Participating in and, when appropriate, leading internal expert committees, e.g. Center of Excellence for Architectural Coatings, driving the expansion of technical expertise in this field and sharing information within the global organization, e.g. by supporting internal trainings. Proactively transferring knowledge on Additives and formulations to colleagues.

  • Complying with all North American regional and Allentown site EHSQ (Environmental, Health, Safety & Quality) measures and requirements. Supporting team manager, Senior Scientists and Scientists in creating and writing Safe Work Practices (SWPs) and Class A & B Design Hazard Reviews (DHRs) by actively participating in safety assessments and DHR teams related to supervised projects. Ensuring all hazards and regulatory compliances of materials and processes are assessed and communicated.

  • Actively serving on one Allentown site Safety@Evonik subcommittee. Developing and delivering safety meeting material.

  • Updating technical data sheets and product information on the Coating Additives website. Leading the quality assessments for products within this product group when required due to a product quality complaint or to qualify samples in advance of any production changes, supervising a Scientist on the team in any lab evaluations that may be required.

REQUIREMENTS

  • A M.S. or Ph.D. degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related Science is required.

  • Approximately 5 years’ experience in the Chemical Industry supporting customers and developing new additives or resins used in Coatings applications is required.

  • Approximately 5 years’ experience managing new product development projects and supervising the technical work of others.

  • Must have a solid understanding of the chemical structure-property relationships that determine why certain surfactants, dispersants, and other additives work as they do; a strong grasp of which additives to recommend to solve specific problems or achieve desired effects is required.

  • Experience providing technical support and training to customers and distributors and managing internal (R&D, Applied Technology, Marketing, Sales) stakeholders is required.

  • Strong leadership & project managerial skills to build support for, plan, organize and execute projects and strategies is required.

  • Strong teamwork & excellent interpersonal skills to work effectively across regions, functions, and business lines is required.

  • The ability to operate effectively within a complex matrixed organization with multiple stakeholders is required.

  • Fluency in English as well as strong verbal and written communication skills are required.

title: Clinical Team Assistant (CTA)
description:
Join The Denver Hospice and become part of a deeply mission-driven team with a proud legacy of providing exceptional hospice and palliative care to our community. Here, clinical excellence and compassion go hand in hand, supported by dedicated colleagues, excellent benefits, and a shared commitment to elevating care for patients and families when it matters most.

The Denver Hospice has an immediate opening for a Clinical Team Assistant (CTA).

Location: Denver, CO

Status: Full-time

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8a-5p

Hourly Pay Range: $20.14 - $23.67

Supplemental Pay: Based on position, schedule and/or availability: Overtime

Mileage and Expense Reimbursement: Sixty-two and a half cents per mile – one of the highest in the industry!

CULTURE, BENEFITS AND PERKS:

  • We value engagement, community, and outreach initiatives and know it matters for our team members and our patients. We provide welcoming and supportive care to our patients and a work environment where all team members feel respected and valued.
  • We support a culture of work-life balance and provide team members with two, free, confidential and robust benefit programs designed to provide solutions to the logistical and financial problems that arise in life.
  • Employer pays over 90% of employee medical premium in some plans
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with significant Employer Funding: Single $1,000, Family $2,000
  • Healthcare Benefits are effective on the 1st of the month following date of hire
  • Extensive Paid Time Off (PTO/Vacation Pay): 17 days in the first year for FT team members
  • Seven Paid Holidays with an additional Floating Holiday
  • 403(b) Retirement Plan with Employer Match: 50% match up to 8% of total compensation
  • Company-Paid Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Career & Logo wear
  • Education Reimbursement Program
  • Clinical Career Ladders
  • Certification Pay
  • Generous Discover-a-Star Team Member Referral Program
  • Team Member Service Awards
  • Early Wage Access
  • Legal and Identity Protection
  • Robust Leadership Development Training Programs

REWARDING WORK YOU WILL DO:

Facilitates and coordinates the communication of clinical teams. Supports departmental functions on a daily basis and supports problem resolution. Provides clerical/administrative support to clinical managers and is a resource in the rules/regulations that apply to hospice to ensure quality care of patients and families.

  • Demonstrates the ability to contribute to the organization’s vision and mission, and protects confidentiality.
  • Utilizes good customer service skills and supports the clinical hospice, palliative and home health team for both patients and family members including intervention and mediation with patient/family in regards to complaints, service recovery, requests for cares.
  • Performs several scheduling functions including: daily/weekly CNA scheduling for assigned teams, PTO/Sick Call coordination (may include contacting and redeploying staff), bi-annual holiday coverage schedule, monthly schedule, tracking of weekend day utilization, and daily on-call and afterhours schedule.
  • Assists Manager with timecard reviews to include monitoring absenteeism and Paid Time Off (PTO) availability when requested.
  • Tracks upcoming CTI and Face-to-Face (F2F) needs and schedules visits either during IDG meeting or with MD/NP specifically. Coordinates with Palliative team members to schedule CTI or F2F visits for shared MDs or NPs.
  • Provides clerical/administrative support to the Clinical Manager including prep/tear down of team/discipline monthly meetings or weekly interdisciplinary team (IDG) meeting materials. Assist Manager with assigning new patients to specific clinicians. Generates various reports, performs other clerical duties including but not limited to: answering phones, typing letters, updating mailboxes and processing faxes.
  • Supports the Clinical Manager as needed with data collection and report creation of team function. Tracks and transcribes information accurately. This may include: productivity, mileage audits, unverified documentation, etc.
  • Processes equipment requests/orders from field staff/managers/patients; determines appropriateness of requests, and communicates request to durable medical equipment (DME) company. Notifies DME Company of equipment pick-ups.
  • Works with medical supply vendors to order DME and medical supplies based on par levels and specialty needs. Receives order requests via face-to-face, phone, or email. Responds to order requests in a timely and professional manner. Researches specialty product orders as requested by a clinician and maintains records of all patients utilizing specialty products. Prepares supplies for clinician and coordinates delivery through courier and/or vendor or in-person pick up. Uses barcode scanning system in order to track items in/out of supply room and manage inventory levels. Stocks supply room(s) when new shipments arrive and as needed. Provides reports to internal and external customers.
  • Demonstrates proficiency with computers, copiers, fax machines and other standard office equipment.
  • Uses effective organization, time-management and prioritization skills. Ability to handle multiple tasks from multiple sources in a busy setting with frequent interruptions.
  • Facilitates flow of patient information and communication. Utilizes sound judgment when handling telephone calls and triaging to appropriate clinician for further actions.
  • Participants in other task forces or committee work as assigned.

WHAT WE ARE GOING TO LOVE ABOUT YOU:

  • Minimum Education: High school diploma. Postsecondary training/education preferred
  • Minimum Experience: 2-4 years of experience with clinical administrative support including but not limited to staffing/scheduling processes

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to lift/carry a minimum of 30 lbs.

    Care Synergy is a network of mission driven, nonprofit healthcare organizations dedicated to caring for very ill, frail, and primarily elderly individuals by keeping them at home and out of the hospital while maximizing comfort, dignity, and quality of life.

Collectively, the enterprise generates approximately $100 million in annual revenue and serves thousands of individuals and families each year through hospice, home health, palliative care, CAPABLE, wellness, and PACE programs.

title: IETS Supervisor
description:
About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

About the role

The IETS Technician oversees the daily operation and maintenance of the IETS. Ensure wastewater is treated effectively and discharge compliance with environmental regulation. The role also involves supervising technicians, troubleshooting equipment, maintaining records and supporting continues improvement initiatives.

Key responsibilities

  • Act as Competent Person (CP) or trainee for IETS Operation as required by DOE Malaysia.
  • Operate and monitor the industrial Effluent Treatment System (IETS)
  • Ensure treated effluent complies with DOE final discharge standards (Standard B).
  • Perform preventive maintenance and minor repairs on pumps, blowers, dosing system and related equipment.
  • Troubleshoot process and equipment issues to minimize downtime.
  • Supervise and monitor outsourced technicians to ensure compliance with company and safety requirements.
  • Coordinate with vendors to implement plant and site safety improvements.
  • Maintain accurate performance monitoring, operation logs and maintenance activities.
  • Enhanced treatment efficiency and reduce operating costs by recommend process improvements.
  • Participate in emergency responses activities related to wastewater treatment systems.
  • Ensure compliance with Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) Policies.
  • Support the utilities section with the Chillers, Air Compressors, Boilers, UV Light, Hot and Ambient Water supply and operations.

Qualifications and skills

  • Possess a valid CePIETSO (BP) and/or CePIETAO (PCP) certification for WWTP competency.
  • Minimum Diploma in an Engineering discipline, with a Degree being an added advantage.
  • At least 3 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Prior experience within the food manufacturing industry is preferred.

title: Project Manager II
description:
About Us:

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food & beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology.


Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.


Job Description:

Project Manager II

Who You’ll Work With

You will join one of our 45 offices in the US, be part of a committed team of over 1500 professionals, and work in teams and directly with our clients doing work that is shaping the world around us. You will be welcomed into a rapidly growing business and team and empowered to make an impact. You will be valued, cared for, and challenged on your path to becoming a world-class professional consultant and surrounded by leaders who are committed to creating an environment that enables you to realize your own success and fulfillment.

When you join Design Group as a Project Manager, you are joining a team that will challenge you and position you for growth. Design Group is widely known as an industry leader, recognized as a top system integrator, ranking #7 in the 2023 System Integrator Giants; as a Rockwell Platinum Integrator, the highest designation given to Rockwell partners; and as an Ignition Enterprise Premier Integrator. As a part of this team, you will learn from industry leading experts and may even have the chance to be an active participant in industry events like the Ignition Build-A-Thon which Design Group won in 2023!

In this role, you will work with a team of industry experts to help the world’s leading companies solve their most difficult problems. You will join our Control System Integration Practice and partner with seasoned leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to deliver the highest quality solutions to our clients with consistency and accuracy.

What You’ll Do

You'll work individually and in teams to support capital projects and implement solutions for our clients. Together, you will help our clients make critical changes to improve their performance and realize their most important goals.

  • Manage project tasks including hardware and panel design, PLC and HMI programming, SCADA design, power distribution design, and all associated project documentation
  • Manage project execution including proposal preparation, estimating, scheduling, resources, staffing, contract negotiation, order processing, quality control, customer satisfaction, and project set-up
  • Ensure the proper use of company facilities (plant and equipment)
  • Lead, develop and grow the controls & automation business in the local office and region; cultivate and
  • maintain relationships with key client contacts
  • Mentor and guide professionals; provide feedback, evaluation, training, and career development guidance
  • Participate on councils responsible for overseeing and adopting firm-wide standards
  • Handle strategic business planning and development of annual vision plans for the controls & automation group
  • Work with the recruiting team to identify and hire professionals into the controls & automation group
  • Provide quarterly reporting to the office partners and regional partners
  • Coordinate with the finance department to ensure proper reporting of the controls & automation group activities
  • Convey a positive image of Barry-Wehmiller Design Group and support the development of a strong culture consistent with our Guiding Principles of Leadership
  • Make an impact day-to-day with your skills and expertise, strengthening that relationship with our clients and team

What You’ll Bring

  • Twelve more years of experience in developing and providing automation solutions for the consumer products or industrial design industries
  • Experience designing electrical control systems and programming automation systems for process applications
  • Proficiency in Rockwell hardware and software solutions
  • Experience with Siemens, Wonderware, and GE software/hardware (preferred)
  • Experience in food & beverage, pulp & paper, or other industrial industries (preferred)
  • Solid communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to interact with all levels of management, clients, and vendors
  • A willingness to travel for project requirements including installation and start-up activities, client and company sponsored meetings, trainings, industry related seminars, forums, and conventions
  • A bachelor of science in electrical engineering is preferred, but consideration will be given to other engineering degrees based on relevant experience

Our culture and commitment to our people is what sets us apart. We foster an environment of mutual respect, integrity, and unconditional interest in the individual and collective success of our professionals. Our model and entrepreneurial mindset offer a rewarding, challenging, and highly flexible path. As a Project Manager, you will build a meaningful and fulfilling career with the support of professional development resources and mentorships including our First Year Experience program, Individual Development Plans, and Career Path resources and tools. You will be surrounded by exceptional talent who will support your development as both a world-class engineer and a highly effective leader.

Feel like you're on the path to becoming a Project Manager but you're not quite there yet? We'd love to connect with you to see if we can take you from where you are today and grow you into a Design Group Engineering Consultant.

If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. title: Innovation Product Consultant
description:
Department:

Customer Experience & Innovation

Our Company Promise


We are committed to provide our Employees a stable work environment with equal opportunity for learning and personal growth. Creativity and innovation are encouraged for improving the effectiveness of Southwest Airlines. Above all, Employees will be provided the same concern, respect, and caring attitude within the organization that they are expected to share externally with every Southwest Customer.

Job Description:

Job Summary


As an Innovation Product Consultant, you’ll help shape the products and partnerships that elevate the Customer experience across Southwest. Supporting the Customer Amenities Team, you’ll guide strategy and execution for Customer-facing products such as WiFi and connectivity, food and beverage offerings, inflight entertainment, and other onboard amenities. You’ll serve as a connector among Operations, Technology, Marketing, Digital, other business stakeholders, and external vendors, translating Customer and business needs into clear product requirements, launch plans, and sustainable solutions. Through evidence-based recommendations, thoughtful product management, and strong cross-functional collaboration, you’ll help Teams navigate complex decisions, align around shared goals, and bring new experiences to life. Your work will shape and elevate how Southwest manages its amenities portfolio, build trusted partnerships, and deliver meaningful innovations that improve Customer satisfaction while reducing complexity and creating long-term value.


Additional Details

  • The culture of Southwest Airlines means we value the camaraderie, collaboration, and innovation that occurs when we come together and interact face-to-face at our vibrant Corporate Campus. Due to the nature of this role, you would be required to work from our Dallas, TX Headquarters facility during business hours.
  • U.S. citizenship or current authorization to work in the U.S. required and no current or future work authorization sponsorship available.

We’re committed to fair hiring practices and to making employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other legally protected characteristics.


Responsibilities

  • Leads the product management of Customer-facing products, tools and experiences
  • Sets the strategic plan to achieve business and design goals that may include prioritization of focus areas for innovation, optimization of new product deliveries and guiding the adaptation of adjacent processes
  • Acts as the expert of the design, features and specifications of their products
  • Leverages enterprise capabilities and coordinates with product stakeholders to establish a repeatable and efficient product delivery practice
  • Collaborates with business analysts to monitor and analyze performance of assigned products processes, and experiences
  • Supports executive decision making with evidence-based guidance and consulting
  • Communicate timelines, risks, issues, key decisions to multiple stakeholders
  • Encourage consensus among multiple parties with conflicting and diverse viewpoints
  • Build confidence and sustain trusted relationships with key stakeholders
  • May perform other job duties as directed by Employee’s Leader

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to collaborate across multiple stakeholder groups and effectively communicate strategy and plans
  • Skilled in deconstructing complex problems into opportunity areas
  • Ability to use multiple types of quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize and value product enhancements
  • Ability to use design thinking mindsets to solve complex problems and advocate for new solutions
  • Knowledge of product management practices and ability develop and communicate new product design intent, mandatory features and required specifications
  • Ability to manage and align interrelated products in both the physical and digital worlds
  • Knowledge of project management practices and ability to hold multiple delivery teams accountable for meeting business objectives
  • Skilled in process mapping and data visualization tools
  • Ability to use an empathetic approach to change management practices when deploying new products or processes
  • Ability to effectively listen to, understand, and communicate ideas presented in writing and/or in speaking with all levels of the organization
  • Ability to quickly understand assignments and complete them with minimal leadership oversight
  • Skilled in using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions or approaches to problems

Education:

  • Required: High School Diploma or GED

Experience

  • Advanced level experience, seasoned and specialized knowledge in:
    • Leading complex cross-functional initiatives and aligning stakeholders at all levels
    • Developing strategies, plans, and solutions to address complex or ambiguous problems
    • Project management
    • Change management
    • Product management
  • Preferred: Experience launching, managing, and amplifying partnerships
  • Preferred: Experience launching and supporting technical products
  • Preferred: Ability to translate business needs into product requirements and partner effectively with technical Teams without serving as the technical expert

Licensing/Certification

  • N/A

Physical Abilities

  • Ability to perform work duties from limited space work station/desk/office area for extended periods of time
  • Ability to communicate and interact with others in the English language to meet the demands of the job
  • Ability to use a computer and other office productivity tools with sufficient speed and accuracy to meet the demands of the job

Other Qualifications

  • Must maintain a well-groomed appearance per Company appearance standards as described in established guidelines
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or have authorization to work in the United States as defined by the Immigration Reform Act of 1986
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Must be able to comply with Company attendance standards as described in established guidelines

Pay & Benefits

  • Competitive market salary from $103,750 per year to $115,300 per year* depending on qualifications and experience. For eligible Leadership and individual contributor roles, additional bonus opportunities are available and awarded at the discretion of the Company.

Benefits you’ll love

  • Fly for free, as a privilege, on any open seat on all Southwest flights (your eligible dependents too)

  • Southwest offers health plan coverage options that start from the very first day of employment. You'll have 30 days to select and enroll in your health plan, and coverage will be retroactively available to your first day of employment.

title: National Practice Consultant - Risk Management
description:
What We're Looking For

At HNTB, you can create a career that is meaningful to you while building communities that matter to all of us. For more than a century, we have delivered solutions for some of the largest and most complex infrastructure projects across the country. With our continued growth, it is an exciting time to join our team of employee-owners.

This opportunity entails serving as HNTB’s national technical leader for risk management on major transit, rail, and other complex infrastructure programs. The National Practice Consultant provides technical direction, strategic advice, and hands-on support across the full project lifecycle. The role establishes and improves risk and contingency management frameworks; facilitates executive and project-level risk workshops; leads qualitative and quantitative risk analysis; and translates analysis into clear recommendations that protect scope, cost, schedule, funding, and delivery outcomes.

The successful candidate will work across offices, market sectors, practices, and disciplines to support client engagements, strategic pursuits, and 4for4 delivery. This role will partner closely with program and project management, project controls, estimating, scheduling, procurement, contracting, finance, and technical teams. The consultant will also mentor risk professionals, advance consistent tools and standards, and strengthen HNTB’s national thought leadership and market position in infrastructure risk management.

What You’ll Do:

  • Sought out to provide technical input and possible leadership on complex projects within practice area.
  • Identifies, pursues, and executes high-level projects with assigned departments, agencies, and programs.
  • Manages client relationships and guides the application of HNTB services within a specific practice area to best serve the interests of the client and HNTB.
  • Responsible for successful contracting and project execution, working closely with regional HNTB staff and office leadership.
  • Partners with National Practice Leaders to develop and promote technical knowledge and applicability of practice area.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant field
  • 12 years of relevant experience
  • In lieu of a degree 16 years of relevant experience

What We Prefer:

  • Demonstrated expertise developing and implementing a risk management system for a major, complex transit, rail, or infrastructure program.
  • Advanced knowledge of cost risk, schedule risk, contingency management, risk governance, and risk-informed decision-making.
  • Ability to lead high-stakes workshops and build alignment among owners, operators, designers, contractors, regulators, funding partners, and multidisciplinary delivery teams.
  • Ability to translate complex quantitative analysis into clear executive-level insights, options, and recommendations.
  • Strong consulting judgment, client presence, facilitation, writing, presentation, and quantitative analysis skills.
  • Ability to independently manage major workstreams, prioritize competing demands, and maintain quality across multiple programs and geographies.
  • Working knowledge of project controls, estimating, scheduling, change management, procurement, contracting, claims avoidance, and PMIS environments.
  • Commitment to quality, technical excellence, collaboration, mentorship, and consistent application of national best practices.
  • AACE International Project Risk Management Professional (PRMP), PMI Risk Management Professional (PMI-RMP), or equivalent risk credential.
  • 15 or more years of directly relevant experience, including experience leading risk management services for major infrastructure programs as an owner’s representative, PM/CM consultant, designer, contractor, or integrated delivery-team member.
  • Experience across planning, environmental review, design, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, startup, and post-construction phases.
  • Experience with U.S. Department of Transportation risk and oversight processes, including FTA, FRA, FHWA, and FAA practices; familiarity with the FTA Cost Risk Assessment framework and cost-risk model.
  • Hands-on proficiency with one or more quantitative risk tools such as Safran Risk, Lumivero @RISK, Primavera Risk Analysis, or Oracle Crystal Ball, plus advanced Excel capability.
  • Experience integrating quantitative risk analysis with Primavera P6 schedules, cost estimates, contingency drawdown, change control, and executive dashboards.
  • Established professional network and active participation in risk, project controls, program management, transit, rail, or infrastructure industry organizations.
  • Demonstrated success supporting business development, strategic pursuits, client relationships, and thought leadership.

title: Yard Associate
description:
Join Our Team!

Sunbelt Rentals strives to be the customer's first choice in the equipment rental industry. From pumps to scaffolding to general construction tools, we aim to be the only call needed to outfit a job site with the proper equipment.
