title: Research Computing & Systems Administrator
description:
Job Description

Position Summary:

The research Computing and Systems Administrator performs analysis and design on research computing clusters and assists researchers and students with programming support as needed to meet the specific needs of a given research grant. This position is responsible for designing and implementing domain architectures, determining which server-based services are needed to support the mission of the college, and is an integral part of delivering infrastructure services. This position will also assist in developing and maintaining web-based tools for use by Engineering faculty, staff and students.


For full consideration, please upload your resume/CV, cover letter by 11:59 PM (MT) on Sunday, November 15, 2026. This posting will remain open until filled, but applications received after the full consideration date may not be reviewed.


Work Unit:

Colorado State University is a land-grant institution committed to a 150-year-old mission of access to higher education for the citizens of Colorado and to excellence in teaching, research, and outreach. The campus is located in the city of Fort Collins, the county seat of Larimer County. Fort Collins is a progressive community of approximately 171,000 situated 65 miles north of Denver on Interstate 25. Located at an elevation of 5,000 feet, Fort Collins has a clear, dry climate and generally pleasant temperature throughout the year.

The Walter Scott, Jr. College of Engineering (WSCOE) at Colorado State University (CSU) consists of about 3,000 students enrolled in BS, MS, and PhD programs, 145 tenure-track and non-tenure-track faculty, and over 400 support staff and research scientists. The College is home to more than $100 million in research funding and accounts for more than one-third of CSU’s patents. Its state-of-the-art facilities, including the Powerhouse Energy Campus and a world-class laser center scheduled to open in 2026, provide collaborative spaces for students, faculty, staff, and industry partnerships.

Engineering Technology Services (ETS) is responsible for the vision and oversight of all aspects of computing in the College of Engineering, with the exception of the physical network infrastructure. Pedagogical uses of technology, research computing, planning for and maintenance of instructional facilities, technical support for faculty and staff, network management, systems analysis, programming, web-coding, and technical training all fall under the purview of ETS. Networked services are provided to over 3500 engineering students, faculty, and staff.


Essential Job Duties:

  • Help manage multiple existing High Performance Computing (HPC) research clusters operating in the Scott Data Center to include:
    • Performing programming support as needed to meet the specific needs of a given research grant.
    • Maintaining the systems for software/OS upgrades and security patching.
    • Configuring the systems and performing software installation.
    • Help develop webpages to assist with maintaining the cluster.
    • Working with the ETS Financial Coordinator, Procurement, and vendors to secure the components.
    • Assisting with architecture design by working with potential users such as students, faculty, research staff, and the ETS Systems Group while remaining within the funding allowance.
    • Assist with coordinating vendor(s) during site installation.
    • Assisting researchers with adding appropriate CPU and GPU nodes to the clusters .
  • Provide similar research computing administration for clusters owned by specific research groups.
  • Design and program custom software applications.
  • Review, test and implement new technology services for the college.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, and network for UNIX/LINUX servers and workstations.
  • Develop and maintain web-based tools for use by the college.

Conditions of Employment:

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States by the proposed start date. The Department will not sponsor a visa for this position.
  • Pre-employment Criminal Background Check (required for all new hires).
  • This position may occasionally require work outside normal business hours to support critical systems, respond to unexpected service interruptions, and perform scheduled server maintenance and upgrade activities. Such work is expected to be infrequent and will be communicated in advance whenever possible.

Supervision:

None

Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field; will consider an Associate’s degree and at least 2 years of work experience in computer science or a related field in lieu of a Bachelor’s degree.

Minimum Experience:

  • Working knowledge of LINUX system administration including system configuration, NFS filesystems, auto mount, Samba, ssh, and basic networking to include TCP/IP, DNS and DHCP.
  • Experience with all of the following: HTML, CSS, Javascript, SQL, SQLite, and PHP, Python.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML, web standards, design and implementation.
  • Experience creating database structures for applications.
  • Experience working with High Performance Computing systems using Slurm or similar.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with various flavors of Linux to include Debian, RockyLinux, and Ubuntu.
  • Experience with remote desktop, VNC, and shell scripting.
  • Experience with installing and troubleshooting engineering research applications, e.g., Matlab, Cadence, ANSYS Fluent, etc.
  • Experience working with provisioning software such as Ansible or Puppet.
  • Experience with parallel programming in research applications.
  • Experience with AI-powered coding sofware agent.
  • Experience with with Web APIs, AJAX, JSON, and other javascript libraries.
  • Strong understanding of UI.
  • Familiarity with Web 2.0 technologies.
  • Familiarity responsive design.
  • Familiarity with using AI for coding.

Application Instructions:

Please upload a resume and cover letter that specifically address your interest in this job and address the required and any applicable preferred job qualifications for this position. Application materials that do not specifically address this position may not be considered.

Salary Range

$62,700 - $65,700

Required Application Documents

To apply, please upload the following applicant documents. Ensure your materials fully address the required and preferred job qualifications of the position. Please note, applicants may redact information from their application materials that identifies their age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

Cover Letter, Resume/CV

Employee Benefits

Colorado State University is not just a workplace; it’s a thriving community that’s transforming lives and improving the human condition through world-class teaching, research, and service. With a robust benefits package, collaborative atmosphere, and focus on work-life balance, CSU is where you can thrive, grow, and make a lasting impact.

Colorado State University strives to provide a safe study, work, and living environment for its faculty, staff, volunteers and students. · Demonstrated experience with configuration quality assurance, change control, system implementations, release testing, production troubleshooting, and root cause analysis. Working knowledge of SQL-based validation, healthcare coding standards, and electronic claims transactions preferred.

Experience vision, strategy, and discovery:

  • Own the advisor experience vision and end-to-end journey strategy for investment products, grounded in research, data, and evolving advisor and client expectations.

Experience delivery:

Experience measurement and insight:

  • Establish metrics and governance routines to understand advisor and client perceptions, behaviors, and expectations, working with data and measurement teams to keep them accurate, timely, and tied to business outcomes.
  • Analyze performance, report insights, and use them to optimize existing experiences or create new ones, with comprehensive tracking through automated reporting and data visualizations.

People leader and mentor:

Qualifications

Required:

  • 8+ years of total relevant work experience, including experience in client or customer experience, digital product management, or digital strategy.

Preferred:

As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.

We are looking for a new Outbound Supervisor to join our growing TX Fulfillment Center network. This individual will report into our Outbound Manager and oversee daily picking, packing, and shipping operations to ensure customer orders are processed accurately, safely, and on time. This role will lead and support our Outbound associates, coordinate staffing and workflow based on order volume, and help resolve operational challenges related to automation, warehouse management systems, carriers, and customer orders. Working closely with fulfillment leadership, Customer Service, and other cross-functional partners, this individual will identify opportunities for process improvements, drive operational efficiency, and support departmental performance goals. If you’re passionate about fulfillment operations, enjoy leading and developing teams, and are excited to improve processes that help deliver a seamless customer experience, we’d love to hear from you!

Job Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Location: 180,000 sq. ft. in Farmers Branch, TX at 12301 N. Stemmons Fwy, Farmers Branch, TX 75234

Schedule: This role oversees an operation that runs Monday through Saturday from 4:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. CT. While this position generally follows a schedule of Monday through Friday from 2:30 p.m. to 11:00 p.m. CT, leaders are expected to work a varying schedule as needed, including weekends and holidays, to support the business and their teams. Operational demands during peak and seasonal periods may also require additional hours beyond the regular schedule.

Base Salary: The expected starting salary for the position is $65,400 to $81,750 within a full position range of $65,400 to $98,100 annually. This range reflects the long-term earning potential for the role. Our starting pay practice is the minimum to middle portion of the range, depending on experience, qualifications, and internal equity, consistent with applicable law and it is rare for a new hire to start above the midpoint.

Responsibilities:

  • ​​Ensure the Picking Team meets daily Fast Track shipment deadlines with a high standard of accuracy​
  • ​​Wave orders, delegate assignments, and oversee priority replenishments to keep operations on schedule​
  • ​​Ensure the Packing Team meets daily Fast Track shipment deadlines with a high standard of quality and accuracy​
  • ​​Assign packers to stations via the assignment board and reallocate resources across the team as needs shift throughout the day​
  • ​​Monitor and maintain shipment supply inventory and serve as backup to the Picking Team when serving as the sole lead present in Outbound​
  • ​​Serve as the primary point of contact for Customer Service on high-priority orders, incomplete SKUs, packing errors, staged orders, and other issues involving the Picking or Packing Teams​
  • ​​Partner with the Training Team to ensure all associates are trained on operational, safety, and organizational procedures​
  • ​​Monitor individual and departmental performance, providing consistent feedback to drive KPI success​
  • ​​Conduct bi-monthly one-on-one check-ins with each Picking and Packing associate to build rapport and reinforce development​
  • ​​Address personnel and performance-related concerns promptly and professionally​
  • ​​Ensure timecards for Picking and Packing Associates are accurate and up to date​
  • ​​Attend and participate in HR and Operations Leadership meetings weekly​
  • ​​Partner with the Outbound Manager to execute process improvements and assigned projects that support departmental growth​
  • ​​Model professional standards and lead by example throughout the workplace​

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent
  • ​​2+ years of leadership experience in a fulfillment, warehouse, or distribution environment​
  • ​​Proven experience overseeing daily operations, delegating tasks, and ensuring adherence to productivity and quality standards​
  • ​​Demonstrated ability to train, coach, and develop associates to achieve departmental goals​
  • ​​Working knowledge of warehouse management systems (WMS), RF scanners, and standard operating procedures​
  • ​​Strong understanding of safety practices and ability to promote a safe and compliant work environment​
  • ​​Fundamental understanding of inventory, supply chain, and logistics concepts​
  • ​​Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, especially Word, Outlook, and Excel​
  • ​​Strong problem-solving and time-management skills, with excellent attention to detail​
  • ​​Strong verbal and written communication skills​
  • ​​Ability to work independently, multitask, and follow established processes and procedures​
  • Ability to push and pull objects up to 60 pounds of force independently
    • Employees are expected to seek help or use appropriate equipment to ensure safety for any task involving pushing or pulling that exceeds 60 pounds
  • Ability to stand and walk for up to 8-10 hours and up to 20,000 steps per day

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree in Supply Chain, Distribution Management, or a related field
  • ​​Prior experience collaborating cross-functionally to implement process improvements or operational initiatives​
  • ​​Familiarity with performance management, including conducting feedback sessions and supporting employee development​
  • ​​Experience overseeing both picking and packing functions within a fulfillment or distribution environment

Why work with us:

  • We have awesome benefits – We offer a wide variety of benefits to help support you and your loved ones. These include:
    • Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, vision, and voluntary life insurance options
    • 401(k) with up to 4% company match
    • Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays
    • Company-paid life insurance and long-term disability
    • Discounted auto, home, and pet insurance programs
    • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
    • Confidential mental health, financial planning, and legal support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
    • $750 annual professional development budget
    • LinkedIn Learning membership
    • Company rewards and recognition program
    • And more!
  • We empower ownership – We all contribute to our success and we all share in it. Our Ownership for All program ensures each SupplyHouse team member will benefit financially from the company’s growth and accomplishments.
  • We promote work-life balance – We value your time and encourage a healthy separation between your professional and personal life to feel refreshed and recharged. Look out for our monthly catered lunches, team building activities, out-of-office events, and Micro Markets to keep you energized!
  • We support growth – We strive to innovate every day. In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide opportunities for career growth through our annual merit and bonus opportunities, hands-on training, internal mobility options, professional development budget, and LinkedIn Learning membership.
  • We give back – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee-nominated contributions, support for non-profit organizations, and more.
  • We listen – We value hearing from our employees. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage you to use it! We actively elicit feedback through our annual feedback groups, regular 1:1 check-ins, employee listening initiatives, and company-wide ideas form to incorporate suggestions and ensure our team enjoys coming to work every day.

Check us out and learn more at !

Our focus is on honesty, judgment, and how you approach problem-solving. We appreciate your transparency and look forward to learning more about your skills.

title: Freight Agent - BOS
description:
Department:

Ground Operations

Our Company Promise


We are committed to provide our Employees a stable work environment with equal opportunity for learning and personal growth. Creativity and innovation are encouraged for improving the effectiveness of Southwest Airlines. Above all, Employees will be provided the same concern, respect, and caring attitude within the organization that they are expected to share externally with every Southwest Customer.

Job Description:

*** For external applicants only:
(1.) Southwest Airlines will consider your interest for this position if you are currently a resident of the State of Massachusetts.
(2.) Southwest Airlines will not consider your interest for this position if you have been interviewed by phone, virtually, and/or inperson
and not selected for the Freight Agent position at BOS within the last 12 months.***

Pay & Benefits:

Pay of $21.01 per hour*, with the opportunity for future increase per applicable collective bargaining agreement wage scale based on time in position. Opportunities for overtime and shift premiums.

Benefits you’ll love:

  • Fly for free, as a privilege, on any open seat on all Southwest flights (your eligible dependents too)
  • Southwest will help fund your Retirement Savings Plan, which includes a dollar for-dollar 401(k) Company match contribution up to 10% of your eligible earnings**
  • Potential for annual profit-sharing contribution in the Southwest Retirement Savings Plan—when Southwest profits, you profit***
  • Competitive health insurance for you and your eligible dependents
  • Southwest offers health plan coverage options that start from the first day of employment. You'll have 30 days to select and enroll in your health plan, and coverage will be retroactively available to your first day of employment.
  • Explore more benefits you’ll love: .


Want to be part of a small but mighty Team that helps move important shipments across the country? Freight Agents at Southwest work outside and in our Cargo facility to safely load and unload cargo, including packages, U.S. Mail, fresh seafood, and even life-saving medical items. You’ll work with other airport Teams to keep flights on schedule and make sure shipments get where they need to go. You’ll help Customers who ship with Southwest Cargo, adjust priorities as needed, and support a smooth operation every day. As a Cargo Agent, you’ll learn new skills, work with a close Team, and play a big part in helping Southwest succeed. See what a day as a Freight Agent looks like:


Additional details

  • This role is part of a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), which means pay, schedules, and other job details are set through an agreement with the labor union.
  • Work schedules are based on seniority and may include early mornings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. There may be times when mandatory overtime is required to support flight operations, but there are also opportunities to trade shifts and find a schedule that works for you.
  • U.S. Citizenship required under Federal regulations.
  • Learn more about becoming a Freight Agent and check out the FAQs:

We’re committed to fair hiring practices and to making employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other legally protected characteristics.


Responsibilities

  • Provides friendly service to and maintains positive relationships with all internal and external Customers
  • Works in a cooperative spirit to ensure the success of our Company
  • Works in air freight facilities
  • May be exposed to a wide variety of weather conditions and jet and machinery noise and fumes
  • Responsible for opening/closing of the air freight facilities at which they are working
  • Handles Station AMS and radio communications traffic as needed
  • Checks Cargo information for each flight
  • Answers Cargo facility telephones
  • Resolve Customer situations by providing Positively Outrageous Service
  • Writes and submits irregularity reports as required
  • Checks cargo on hand to see that it is properly logged and accounted for
  • Checks that all board mail and Company material is dispatched and sent to indicated Stations
  • Responsibilities include greeting and handling Customers in a polite and friendly manner
  • Re-manifest cargo due to weight restrictions, delayed or cancelled flights, lost, delayed, or damaged shipments
  • Conducts Federally Mandated screening of all cargo shipments according to the Southwest Airlines TSA approved security program
  • Handles cash, checks, credit cards, and coupons as forms of payment for shipments. Computes charges, makes change and balances daily transactions.
  • Handles any aspect of processing a cargo shipment by operating a computerized point-of-sale system; resolving related complaints and problems
  • Properly maintains and wears the uniform by Company regulations and presents a neat and professional appearance while on duty
  • Provides friendly service to all co-workers and Customers. Performs special task or assignments as delegated by Supervisor or Station Management personnel
  • Responsible for ground security and assuring operations follow security procedures
  • May perform the duties of an Operations Agent. Further information can be found in the Operations Agent Job Description
  • Must be able to meet any physical ability requirements listed on this description
  • May perform other job duties as directed by Employee's Leaders

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to work well with others as part of a team, meet the public, and work under stressful situations
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain GSC qualification
  • Must comply with DOT drug and alcohol testing program
  • Ability to read documents, follow instructions, learn and understand ramp operations procedures, rules and regulations
  • Ability to type and/or use a computer keyboard with sufficient speed to meet demands of the job
  • Must successfully complete Operations/Freight Agent training program with a 90% or greater average and evaluation / probationary period
  • Must be aware of hazardous situations and be able to handle emergencies as needed
  • Able to work under pressure and handle many functions at once with many different offices and/or groups of people
  • Must work under tight time constraints to accomplish quick turns of aircraft
  • Must possess good written and oral skills
  • Must be able to effectively communicate verbally by telephone, face to face and public address systems
  • Must be able to be alert to moving vehicles or aircraft and use radio equipment
  • Must be able to communicate information and instructions verbally or via radio equipment

Education

  • Required: High School Diploma or GED
  • Preferred: College coursework or degree

Experience

  • Preferred: Two years of airline/military related work experience in ramp/operations/provisioning functions

Licensing/Certification

  • Must be able to obtain a SIDA badge and meet all local airport requirements
  • Must possess a valid state motor vehicle operator's license
  • May be required by Station Leadership to obtain a Customs Seal and meet all requirements to work international flights

Physical Abilities

  • Must be able to lift and move items of 70 pounds and/or more
  • Must be able to climb, bend, kneel and stand on a frequent basis and for extended periods
  • Must be able to carry heavy items up and down jetway stairs
  • Must be able to distinguish each color displayed on every type of screening equipment
  • Must be able to hear and respond to the spoken voice and to audible alarms generated by screening equipment
  • Must maintain the ability to wear prescribed uniforms

Other Qualifications

  • Must maintain a well-groomed appearance per Company appearance standards as described in established guidelines
  • Must be a U.S. citizen
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Must be able to comply with Company attendance standards as described in established guidelines
  • Ability to work shift work and/or overtime
  • Ability to read, speak and write English
  • Foreign language skills are desirable, but not required

*The pay amount doesn’t guarantee employment for any particular period. **401(k) Company match contributions are subject to the plan’s vesting schedule. Match contributions may vary based on the position.

***Profit-sharing contributions are subject to the Retirement Savings Plan vesting schedule and are made at the discretion of the Company.

Pay Rate:

$21.01

title: Philadelphia Program Leader
description:
Who We Are + What We Do:

Booster is a mission-driven school fundraising company focused on cultivating virtuous leaders who want to change the world. Booster partners with over 6,000 schools each year and impacts over 3 million students across all 50 states. At the heart of our culture, our six virtues guide everything we do: Gratitude, Wisdom, Care, Courage, Grit, and Celebration. We deliver engaging, innovative, and active fundraising experiences for elementary and middle schools nationwide. From high-energy fun runs to all-in-one fundraising platforms and custom gear, we’ve helped schools raise over $1 billion for education. Booster is a fun, fast-paced, and purpose-filled place to work, where every day offers the opportunity to make a real impact in the lives of students and school communities.


Are you Booster’s Next Program Leader?

As a Program Leader, you’re in charge of leading our Booster programs on school campuses. You’ll lead a team with excellence, help schools reach their fundraising goals, and positively impact students. This is a full-time position and is ideal for someone early in their career who wants meaningful, hands-on experience.

How You’ll Impact Booster’s Mission:

  • Program Leadership - You are responsible for all day-to-day program operations, communications, and details to ensure a remarkable experience.

  • Event Management - You lead high-energy experiences, oversee team delegation, think through event details, safety, and coordinate all logistics.

  • Team Leadership - You lead your team on campus to help create remarkable experiences for schools through delegation, feedback, clear instruction, and celebration.

  • Student Engagement - You creatively use resources and daily interactions to engage, motivate, and create fun experiences for students.

  • Client Care - You build trust with our clients through excellent service, effective communication, and intentional care.

What You’ll Bring to The Table:

Here are some signs that you’d be a great fit for this role:

  • Excellent Communication - You can connect professionally with students, faculty, and staff through written and verbal communication.

  • Positive Attitude - You display optimism, enthusiasm, and intentionality when interacting with clients and the team.

  • Growth Mindset - You demonstrate a continual desire to learn and grow both personally and professionally.

  • Good Judgment - You have a strong sense of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

  • Outcome-oriented - You are a hard worker who gets things done in a timely and efficient manner.

  • Enthusiastic - You connect enthusiastically with students, faculty, and staff.

Additional Requirements:

  • You're a licensed driver with reliable transportation

  • You can pass Booster's Background and Motor Vehicle check

  • You're able to lift up to 45 lbs and remain active throughout the day

  • Full-day availability (7:00 am–4:00 pm) on scheduled workdays

Our Work Environment Includes:

  • Exciting and Engaging Culture: Team events, award ceremonies, epic celebration trips, free lunches, dinners, and more.

  • Tech: Macbook and $50 per month cell phone allowance

  • Music Subscription: $12 per month for Spotify subscription

  • Insurance Benefits: Medical, Vision, and Dental, plus potential moving/recruiting bonuses

  • Paid Time Off: 10 days

  • All major holidays and a 2-week December break

COMPENSATION: $35,000 - $38,000, non-exempt

Are you ready to change the world with us? Follow us on Instagram at @boostercareers for a behind-the-scenes look at life at Booster.

title: Head of Design eBiz
description:
Head of Design eBiz


The Head of Design is responsible for driving the overall aesthetic and user experience vision for all our digital products from our mobile app, website, to our emails as well as future digital products. Build and protect design execution – from discovery, to synthesis, to the product development process. Build and protect a design culture –ensuring that the team understands the importance of our core values, innovation, and collaboration. Develop a strong team of designers – focusing on recruiting, training, and ongoing coaching. This position is responsible for ensuring execution of the product vision – defining and driving the product strategy across the website and mobile app. Develop and implement strategic plans for development, improvement, and distribution of the website and mobile app. Build and protect product execution – from planning, to discovery, to the product development process. Responsible for implementing product development process, developing product goals, strong knowledge of SEO and implementation of best practices, developing and coordinating implementation of acquisition and retention programs, developing and managing growth/penetration, managing monthly forecasts, managing the product profitability, managing products to maximize performance, managing product enhancements, and maintaining or reducing product costs. Partner with the business units on new product introductions; with Marketing for advertising & promoting the product(s); with Information Systems for technology and applications support for the product(s). Monitor profitability, productivity and growth targets of assigned product line and make recommendations/corrections to improve attainment of Club's goals and objectives. Conduct market and competitive research in order to effectively evaluate marketing plans and goals, and to develop optimum sales/service/distribution effectiveness. Negotiate and manage outside vendor contracts. Report findings and recommendations to senior management. Build and protect a product culture –ensuring that the team understands the importance of our core values, innovation, and collaboration. Develop a strong team of product managers, owners, and designers – focusing on recruiting, training, and ongoing coaching.

Job Duties

  • Define the design workflow and team structure that will enable streamlined collaboration between designers and the product, marketing, and engineering teams. Ensures execution of the product vision by defining and driving the product strategy for website and mobile app software development. Direct the development, planning and implementation of product and process development for new products. Responsible for developing innovative and creative solutions that meet existing market needs, increase the value of current products and/or introduce new product/service opportunities. Utilizes trends, developments in the market place and customer research to shape product and service offerings. Activities include, but are not limited to, conducting thorough market analysis and research, defining product features and workflows, developing and implementing new product features, developing distribution plans, creating cost-benefit analysis, working with the assigned marketing team to create a marketing plan and appropriate support materials, and interfacing with both internal and external resources to implement programs. Responsible for managing timelines and internal and external resources to launch products.
  • Act as the brand steward in ensuring a consistent aesthetic standard across our digital products. Explore, create, and maintain a design style guide and interaction/UX pattern library for all our digital channels. Provide strategic direction for all assigned product lines within the website and mobile app. Determine what products or features to add to the line, marketing/promoting product line; devising sales channel strategies; tracking revenue and margins; product pricing; positioning products in local markets; initiating measures for product cost containment and cost reduction; tracking industry trends, product segment growth, and market share; ensuring cooperative approach, and proactive communication by team members to support overall product and Club objectives.
  • Explore, evaluate, and recommend improvement to processes and tooling for an efficient design delivery. Communicate design strategy to the team and ensure efficient and seamless transition to new process. Oversee the implementation of strategic marketing plan for the assigned product line. Research market for business opportunities and ensure integration of product line with the Club’s MRM strategy. Implement the organizational SEO strategy across products.

  • Coach and mentor the design staff and look after their well being as professionals and as creative individuals. Foster an environment of collaboration, inspiration, and shared problem solving.
  • Keep up to date with current and emerging design and technology trends and standards, and evaluate potential implementation for the organization. In this capacity, attend design conferences, build a network of designers from similar organizations as AAA to discuss operational challenges and potential solutions, constant reading and intake of design-specific information, and exploring current and emerging industry tools, frameworks, and practices.
  • Position requires a high degree of independent decision-making and problem solving skills. Informs the development and implementation of new processes.
  • Regularly makes decisions involving the direction of major initiatives. Implements plans that affect the strategic direction of digital product lines. Informs the development and implementation of new processes.


Qualifications

  • 7-9 years User Interface/Experience Design or related experience. Required
  • 7-9 years E-Commerce Product Management or related experience. Required
  • Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Intimate knowledge and experience with industry standard design tools.
  • A strong design sensibility as demonstrated with a portfolio of digital design work.
  • Familiarity with web and mobile development (feasibility/limitations) required.
  • Ability to work with a cross-functional team of product managers/owners, designers, QAs, and software engineers.
  • Advanced ability for creating simple and intuitive user interfaces.
  • Strong empathy towards the user and their goals.
  • Strong presentation skills in presenting ideas and designs to various stakeholders and executive staff.
  • Strong product visionary and understanding of SEO, Website and Mobile app development
  • Demonstrated experience shipping a product.



Travel Requirements

travel, entertainment, services and more!)

title: Sr. Manager Financial Operations
description:
The Sr. Manager Financial Operations leads the end-to-end transactional finance operations covering Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C). This role integrates Cash Management/Treasury operations with AP and AR to deliver efficient, controlled, and technology-enabled processes. The Sr. Manager is a front-line leader—coaches supervisors and technicians—and a disciplined process owner who standardizes workflows, leverages ERP/automation tools, and drives KPI-based performance.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The following duties are normal for this position. These are not to be construed as exclusive or all-inclusive. Other related duties may be required and assigned.

  1. Lead, coach, and develop AP/AR supervisors and Cash Manager; set expectations, routines, and accountability.
  2. Create cross-training and coverage plans to handle peak volumes, vacations, and system changes.
  3. Foster a service-level mindset (SLAs) and continuous improvement culture across the team.
  4. From time-to-time evaluate team workload and adjustments to structure to ensure adequate support and resources
  5. Own end-to-end AP processing (invoice intake, validation, exceptions, approvals, payment runs) and vendor experience.
  6. Own end-to-end AR processing (invoicing, cash application, deductions management, collections, dispute resolution) and customer experience.
  7. Define and maintain standard operating procedures, RACI, and controls across AP/AR; enforce segregation of duties with support and collaboration of the Controller
  8. Oversee daily cash positioning, bank reconciliations, and payment file integrity; manage bank portals/connectivity. Maximize efficiency and time of use of cash flowing in and out of the organization
  9. Drive short-term cash forecasting in coordination with FP&A and Controller; optimize payment timing and collections to improve working capital trading off available early payment discounts with time-value of cash
  10. Coordinate bank account administration, signatories, and treasury controls; support insurance and debt reporting as needed.
  11. Deploy and govern automation (e.g. OCR/e-invoicing/RPA), vendor/customer portals, and ERP workflows (SAP preferred).
  12. Utilize dashboards for DSO, DPO, invoice cycle time, automation rate, exception aging, and cash forecast accuracy.
  13. Partner with IT to harden data governance, master data, and audit trails across P2P/O2C.
  14. Ensure GAAP-compliant posting, reconciliations, and documentation for audits.
  15. Implement fraud prevention measures (approval limits, vendor master controls, bank validation).
  16. Own internal control remediation plans and monthly certification / reconciliations of key accounts.
  17. Coordinate with Procurement on PO compliance and vendor onboarding; with Sales/Customer Service on billing and collections.
  18. Coordinate with Sales/Customer Service on an efficient and collaborative approach on clearing trade deductions.
  19. Align with FP&A and Controller on cash forecast process, close calendars and policy changes.
  20. Communicate performance packs and action plans to the CFO/Controller regularly.
  21. Own payment calendars and collection strategies; approve AP/AR process changes and business rules.
  22. Authorize automation configurations and portal policies within governance frameworks.
  23. Approve vendor/customer master changes and treasury control procedures within defined limits.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Knowledge/Skills:

  • ERP proficiency (SAP preferred), vendor/customer portal experience, and strong Excel/BI skills.
  • Hands-on, decisive frontline leader; clear communicator with strong coaching skills.
  • Process-oriented and data-driven; comfortable with change management and standardization.
  • High integrity and ownership mindset; bias for continuous improvement and customer/vendor service.

Ability to:

  • Ability to lead, develop, and hold teams accountable while fostering a collaborative, service-oriented culture.
  • Ability to analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Ability to prioritize competing demands and manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to drive change management initiatives, including system implementations, automation projects, and process standardization efforts.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or related field; Associate Degree in combination with relevant, specific experience is acceptable. Professional certification (CPA/CMA/CTP) preferred.

Physical/Safety Requirements:

  • Tolerate extended periods of sitting at desk.
  • Ambient noise is louder than a traditional office setting.

Position Title:

*Deputy Chief Trial Counsel

Job Description:

The Oregon Department of Justice (DOJ) is recruiting for a highly skilled and motivated Deputy Chief Trial Counsel (Legal Practice Attorney Administrator 1) to join the Trial Division, which defends the State of Oregon, its agencies, and employees in civil litigation and pursues affirmative litigation to advance Oregon’s values. The Trial Division includes five major sections that handle a broad spectrum of state and federal litigation: Corrections Litigation Unit, Civil Litigation Section, Special Litigation Unit, and Federal Oversight Unit.

As the Deputy Chief Trial Counsel, you will serve as a key executive leader responsible for shaping the strategic direction, operational strength, and legal impact of the division. Working in close partnership with the Chief Trial Counsel, you will exercise strategic leadership by helping develop and implement division‑wide policies, long‑term operational plans, and forward‑looking strategic objectives that support consistent, high‑quality legal services across the state. You will oversee multiple legal sections, providing clear direction, fostering accountability, and promoting operational excellence while supporting section managers and senior trial attorneys in meeting performance standards and organizational goals. Through strong decision‑making and sound judgment, you will lead and coordinate significant civil litigation and legal services involving complex, high‑profile, and sensitive matters of statewide importance, ensuring that legal strategies are well‑reasoned, risk‑aware, and aligned with public policy priorities. In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to attorneys, state agencies, and state officials, offering expert guidance on nuanced legal issues while demonstrating integrity, discretion, and a commitment to public service.

Additionally, you will strengthen the division’s legal and operational capabilities by promoting continuous improvement in legal strategy, case management standards, and quality assurance practices. You will apply collaborative leadership and strong communication skills to build partnerships across teams, resolve cross‑functional challenges, and promote transparency in decision‑making. Your responsibilities will also include contributing to budget planning, monitoring expenditures, optimizing resource allocation, and evaluating program performance through data‑driven analysis, all of which support effective stewardship of public resources. As a people‑centered leader, you will play a pivotal role in workforce development by mentoring attorneys and staff, leading training initiatives, conducting performance evaluations, and cultivating an inclusive, growth‑oriented environment that supports employee engagement and continuous learning. title: Director, Supply Chain Lead Product Data Analyst
description:
Job Description Summary:

Digital data products are central to how the North America Operating Unit (NAOU) Supply Chain plans, executes, and continuously improves end‑to‑end performance across sourcing, manufacturing, transportation, and customer fulfillment. Our Supply Chain Digital Enablement Team builds enterprise‑scale data products that create visibility, decision intelligence, and measurable business outcomes for planning, operations, and leadership across NAOU.


We are hiring a Lead Product Data Analyst to join our Supply Chain Digital Enablement Team. This role is embedded within empowered, cross‑functional product teams and partners closely with Product Managers, Data Architects, Data Engineers, Product Designers, and business stakeholders to translate complex supply chain data into trusted insights and scalable data products.

This is a Director-level role.


About the Role

Product Data Analysts are core contributors to the design, development, and adoption of supply chain data products. In this role, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy in complex, ambiguous problem spaces, helping teams understand operational performance, evaluate opportunities, and measure outcomes across the end‑to‑end supply chain.


You will lead sophisticated analyses, shape data models and metrics, and influence prioritization and trade‑offs by grounding decisions in data. Beyond executing analysis, you will help elevate analytical standards across the organization by modeling strong analytical practice, strengthening measurement discipline, and enabling self‑service insight for product teams and stakeholders.


This role is a strong fit for someone who thrives at the intersection of supply chain operations, data engineering, and advanced analytics—turning complex, multi‑source operational data into clear insight, reliable reporting, and decision‑ready products.


What You Will Do

Supply Chain Analytics & Insight

  • Develop a deep understanding of end‑to‑end supply chain processes and data, including procurement, manufacturing, inventory, transportation, and customer fulfillment.
  • Analyze large, complex datasets to identify performance drivers, risks, trade‑offs, and improvement opportunities across planning and execution.
  • Translate operational and optimization data into actionable insights that inform product strategy, roadmap decisions, and business priorities.
  • Go beyond describing what happened to explain why it happened and what actions should follow.
  • Proactively surface insights that help teams focus on the highest‑value opportunities.
  • Informally mentor analysts and partners through collaboration, review, and shared best practices.

Data Product Development & Measurement

  • Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to define product objectives, success metrics, KPIs, and outcome‑based measures.
  • Design, maintain, and document analytical models, metrics, and business logic that support scalable data products and decision intelligence.
  • Support movement from static reporting toward reusable, trusted data assets and analytical products.
  • Advise on the appropriate level of analytical rigor based on decision risk, business value, and operational impact.

Data Quality, Modeling & Integration

  • Work closely with data architect and data engineering teams to define, validate, and evolve data models in Microsoft Azure.
  • Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, reliable, and aligned to supply chain process realities.
  • Act as a steward of data quality, metric definitions, and analytical assumptions across products.
  • Document data logic, metrics, and methodologies to support transparency, reuse, and auditability.

Insight Communication & Influence

  • Create dashboards, analytical views, and narratives that make complex supply chain data accessible and actionable.
  • Communicate insights clearly to technical and non‑technical audiences, including supply chain leaders.
  • Contribute to a data‑informed culture by raising analytical fluency across supply chain product teams.
  • Collaborate with other analysts, data architects, data engineers, and data scientists to align insight across domains.

Tools & Technologies

This role will actively use and support data products built on:

  • Microsoft Azure Synapse Analytics and Microsoft Fabric.
  • PySpark Notebooks for data exploration, transformation, and analysis.
  • Microsoft Azure Pipelines for analytics workflows and data product deployment.
  • SQL‑based analytics across large‑scale enterprise datasets.
  • Visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI.

What You Will Need

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, industrial engineering, supply chain, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence supporting complex operational or supply chain domains.
  • Advanced SQL querying and mastery of Python or another scripting language, including PySpark.
  • Extensive experience working with supply chain data from systems such as SAP S/4HANA (e.g., procurement, inventory, planning, manufacturing, order‑to‑cash), Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and other supply chain systems.
  • Statistical methods and modeling techniques, with working knowledge of machine learning models.
  • Data quality assessment, validation, and root cause investigation.
  • Proven ability to influence decisions through data and clear communication.
  • Strong collaboration skills and experience working within cross‑functional product or platform teams.
  • Ability to work independently and to foster a data-driven culture of growth.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in a related quantitative or supply chain field.
  • Experience supporting enterprise‑scale supply chain data platforms or analytics products.
  • Experience applying forecasting and optimization modeling to supply chain planning, execution, or operational decision-making.
  • Knowledge of Azure and Microsoft Fabric storage and compute concepts that support scalable analytics products.

Skills

  • Analytical Rigor: Breaks down complex operational questions into clear, structured analyses using SQL, scripting, statistical methods, and root cause investigation.
  • Supply Chain Acumen: Understands end‑to‑end supply chain processes and metrics.
  • Product & Systems Thinking: Connects data insight to scalable data products and business outcomes.
  • Data Storytelling: Communicates insights with clarity through visuals and narratives.
  • Collaboration & Influence: Builds trust across supply chain, product, and technology partners.

title: Patient Service Representative
description:
Health Images is looking for a Full Time Patient Service Representative to join our team in Castle Rock!
Monday - Friday 11:30AM - 8:00PM | Position Pay Range $18.40 - $22.81
This position requires attendance of a mandatory, 2-week training period at our Diamond Hill center in Denver

Summary/Objective:

The Patient Service Representative (PSR) focuses on the delivery of patient care and facilitates the needs of the physician. Focuses purely on the patient in front of them and ensures the patient knows and feels that they are the most important person in that moment. Creates an environment where our patients know they are a priority and provides spectacular service by doing what is necessary to take care of the patient. Performs administrative tasks such as answering phones, data entry, patient check in/out, and assists in scheduling patient appointments. Enters charges, verifies patients’ insurance coverage, receives payments from patients, and issues receipts. Supports company initiatives by adopting new approaches, practices, and processes to deliver unmistakable quality, spectacular service, and operational excellence on a consistent basis.

Essential Functions

1. Answers inbound calls to the Center.

2. Provides a friendly and warm greeting to all patients and/or providers.

3. Checks scheduled patients in/out and ensures proper documentation is received from patient.

4. Collects co-pays, co-insurance, and deductible if necessary.

5. Listens and resolves patient, provider, and any customer complaints. Communicates to PSR Lead and/or Area Manager as needed.

6. Ensures accurate data entry for patient registration.

7. Assists with medical records as needed.

8. Ensures all queues are processed in a timely and efficient manner while adhering to all process & compliance requirements.

9. Manages eRIS Center workflow, including daily schedule, billing complete, priors grid, delinquent exams, waitlist, report delivery queues, and collection of TOS.

10. Stays abreast of known carrier related issues and is able to identify carrier specific concerns, (i.e. out of network, specific plan limitations, etc.)

11. Monitors schedule and ensures all data, attachments, history, etc. have been done before exam is completed.

12. Facilitates no-show appointments (calling patients, cancelling, rescheduling).

13. Reschedules and cancels appointments as needed/directed (receives incoming/outgoing calls to patients).

14. Monitors waiting room to avoid extended wait time and to assists patients as needed.

15. Requests orders and processes new/same-day requests.

16. Requests all patients complete a satisfaction survey after their exam.

17. Other duties as assigned.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This position has no supervision responsibilities.

This job operates in an outpatient clinical environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands and fingers to handle, feel or operate objects, tools or controls, and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to talk and hear.

description:

Working closely with brewery leadership and cross-functional teams, the Process Lead develops team members’ technical and leadership skills, fostering accountability and sound decision-making. Responsibilities include mastering process control through data analysis, loss elimination, and asset optimization.

title: Embedded Software Engineer, Satellite Antenna (Starlink)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

EMBEDDED SOFTWARE ENGINEER, SATELLITE ANTENNA (STARLINK)

Starlink is SpaceX’s unprecedented satellite constellation designed to deliver high-speed broadband internet to underserved and remote areas around the world. By deploying thousands of satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO), we’ve created a global network that bridges the digital divide, enabling reliable connectivity for homes, business, vessels, aircraft, and more.

As a member of the Antenna Software team, you’ll own software for bring-up, characterization, and operation of advanced phased array systems. You’ll drive features at every layer of the stack, from embedded software running on microcontrollers in custom beamforming ASICs, to characterizing antennas in anechoic chambers, to defining the RF test required to produce hundreds of phased arrays per month, to building tools to analyze the on-orbit performance of our fleet of thousands of satellites serving millions of users.

Prior RF experience is not a requirement to be successful here – we’re looking for ambitious engineers who thrive when they’re diving deep on challenging, interdisciplinary problems.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop embedded software for custom modem and beamformer silicon ASICs that form the foundation of Starlink’s phased array antennas
  • Write flight-critical software to ensure intended operation of the antenna throughout the lifecycle of the satellite
  • Collaborate with phased array antenna engineers to build and implement new techniques to measure antennas as part of our CI/CD process
  • Analyze on-orbit performance data and investigate methods to improve performance and debug issues
  • Drive production RF test features to verify hardware in the factory while maintaining a rapid rate of production
  • Design and build automated measurement systems to characterize phased arrays radiating at 10-20GHz
  • Provide software engineering expertise and mission-critical support to the broader Payload Engineering organization

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or electrical engineering
  • 1+ years of programming experience in embedded C or C++ or Rust (internships, collegiate clubs, and project work can apply)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience and understanding of RF fundamentals and/or communications theory
  • Familiarity with radio-related lab measurement equipment and techniques such as spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, and signal generators.
  • Experience with phased array antenna systems
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, autonomously driven, and demanding start-up atmosphere
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed for mission critical deadlines

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $125,000.00 - $165,000.00
Level 2: $145,000.00 - $200,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

Job Purpose/Overview

Specimen Processors are responsible for receiving, preparing, and processing most samples that come into the department.

Role Summary

We are seeking an exceptional investor to join our global equity research platform as an Investment Analyst covering the Biotechnology sector. The successful candidate will perform fundamental analysis of the sector to identify key trends and the best-positioned companies, develop and communicate investment recommendations within the firm, and contribute directly to portfolio performance. The role also provides thought leadership on healthcare trends and mentorship to more junior members of the healthcare investment team. We are looking for intellectually curious, highly competitive investors with a passion for markets, businesses, and the pursuit of alpha. This role is based in Baltimore.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is an exceptional investor with strong fundamental research skills, independent judgment, and the conviction to develop differentiated investment views. They are intellectually curious, highly driven, and skilled at identifying business inflection points and uncovering unique insights. This role offers significant responsibility, direct engagement with senior portfolio managers, and meaningful influence on global portfolio outcomes. The successful candidate thrives in a collaborative, high-performance environment and embraces AI as a tool to enhance research and investment decision-making. Responsibilities

Generate High-Conviction Investment Ideas:

  • Develop differentiated investment views and identify attractive investment opportunities across the Biotechnology industry.
  • Build and maintain detailed financial models, industry frameworks, and company analyses.
  • Form independent conclusions regarding business quality, management effectiveness, competitive positioning, valuation, and long-term earnings power.
  • Generate actionable recommendations supported by rigorous analysis and clear investment reasoning.

Conduct Deep Fundamental Research:

  • Perform extensive primary research through meetings with company management teams, competitors, suppliers, customers, industry experts, and other key industry participants.
  • Analyze financial statements, industry data, market trends, and alternative information sources to develop unique insights.
  • Conduct field research, including company visits, industry conferences, and channel checks where appropriate.
  • Develop a deep understanding of industry value chains, competitive dynamics, technological change, and long-term secular trends affecting the Healthcare sector, specifically Biotechnology companies.

Influence Investment Decisions:

  • Present well-supported investment recommendations to portfolio managers and other investment professionals.
  • Clearly articulate investment theses, key catalysts, downside risks, valuation frameworks, and expected risk/reward outcomes.
  • Engage in rigorous debate, challenge consensus thinking when warranted, and contribute to a culture of intellectual honesty and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor portfolio holdings and recommendations, providing ongoing updates as facts and circumstances evolve.

Leverage Technology and AI to Enhance Research:

  • Utilize AI-powered research, data analysis, and workflow tools to increase research depth, efficiency, and insight generation.
  • Incorporate emerging technologies, alternative data sources, and advanced analytical techniques into the investment process.
  • Develop repeatable research workflows that leverage AI to enhance information synthesis, company analysis, modeling, and idea generation.
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt new technologies that can improve research quality and create a sustainable investment edge.

Qualifications

Required:

  • MD, PhD, or other advanced life-science degree.
  • Minimum 3-4+ years of investment experience in the Biotechnology sector.
  • Demonstrated academic excellence and a passion for investing.
  • Consistently shows maturity and sound judgment, with the ability to inspire confidence in high pressure or stressful situations.
  • Competitive nature with an investment mindset, supported by a deep interest in equity markets.
  • Strong quantitative analysis capabilities.
  • Exceptional communication skills, enabling the delivery of high quality, technically rigorous written research.
  • Baltimore (re)location.

Preferred:

  • Previous experience covering Biotechnology stocks.
  • Understanding of drug development, clinical trial phases, regulatory approval pathways (FDA/EMA), pricing, and reimbursement.
  • Ability to incorporate regulatory risk, policy changes, and ESG considerations into investment theses.
  • Previous experience leveraging AI-enabled research tools to enhance equity analysis and investment decision making, while applying rigorous judgment to validate insights.

title: Surface Water Engineer I
description:
About Parametrix

Parametrix is a 100% employee-owned consulting firm helping clients deliver resilient infrastructure, vibrant and livable communities, and environmentally sustainable solutions. We are a team of professional construction managers, engineers, management consultants, planners, scientists, and surveyors dedicated to delivering outstanding client service. We build lasting partnerships and collaborate with our clients to envision possibilities and create tomorrow, together.

Recognized as a top workplace, we’re committed to a culture that values work-life balance, professional growth, and the well-being of our people.

About the Opportunity

Parametrix is seeking an entry-level engineer to join our Stormwater and Surface Water team in Greater Washington. This position will support projects involving stormwater management, drainage design, flood mitigation, water quality, fish passage, stream restoration, regulatory compliance, stormwater parks, and other similar infrastructure improvements that help communities manage and protect their surface water resources.

We are looking for individuals who have recently completed a degree in engineering and are excited to build their careers in stormwater and surface water planning, analysis, and engineering. You will work alongside experienced engineers and technical professionals who are committed to mentorship, collaboration, and helping you develop a strong foundation in consulting and project delivery.

The position will be based in Seattle office. We offer flexibility for a hybrid work schedule while prioritizing in-person collaboration, teamwork, and mentorship.

Your Role on the Team:

  • Support the planning, design, and delivery of stormwater, drainage, and surface water infrastructure projects.
  • Assist with hydrologic and hydraulic analyses, engineering calculations, technical reports, design plans, specifications, and cost estimates.
  • Contribute to planning projects for stormwater system and watershed management, regulatory compliance, and climate resilience, and design projects involving stormwater parks, stormwater collection and conveyance systems, detention and water quality treatment facilities, flood mitigation, stream restoration, and green stormwater infrastructure.
  • Support stormwater drainage and other civil design for a range of infrastructure projects.
  • Work collaboratively with engineers, planners, designers, scientists, and other technical professionals across disciplines.
  • Participate in site visits, field investigations, data collection, and construction support activities.
  • Learn applicable design standards, stormwater regulations, modeling tools, and client expectations.
  • Receive mentorship and progressively take on greater technical and project responsibilities as your skills develop and your career path advances.
  • Build relationships within a supportive, employee-owned culture that values curiosity, initiative, teamwork, and fun.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • A bachelor's or master’s degree in civil engineering, environmental engineering, water resources engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • A strong interest in stormwater management, surface water engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, climate resilience, and sustainable infrastructure.
  • Engineer-in-Training certification or plans to pursue it.
  • A collaborative approach to project work and the initiative to take ownership of your tasks, ask questions, share your ideas, seek feedback, follow through, and learn from others.
  • Interest in working on a variety of projects and developing a well-rounded understanding of stormwater and surface water engineering.
  • Ability to participate in site visits and fieldwork as project needs require.

Why Join Parametrix?

Employee Ownership & Great Benefits: As a 100% employee-owned company, you will share in and contribute to Parametrix's success. You will earn stock in your Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) account and be an important contributor to our collective achievements.

Our Benefits include:

  • Comprehensive Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, short- & long-term disability insurance)
  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (financial profit sharing)
  • Performance-based bonuses
  • 401(k) Plan
  • Paid Time Off (both vacation & sick/wellness time accruals)
  • Paid Holidays
  • Parental Bonding Leave

Exciting, Award-Winning Project Work: Our work earns recognition for its innovation and positive impact on communities, giving you the opportunity to contribute to projects that make a difference. Learn more at

Flexible Work Arrangements: We understand the importance of work-life balance and offer flexible work arrangements to support our employee-owners' diverse needs. Whether it is hybrid, remote, or in-office, we provide options that allow you to work in a way that best suits your lifestyle while staying connected and engaged with your team.

Hourly Range
$36.05—$39.40 USD

Compensation is determined by factors such as education, experience, location, and role. As employee-owners, we are eligible for performance-based bonuses and our salaries are reviewed annually. We value transparency and look forward to discussing our compensation structure.

Our Commitment to You

Parametrix is committed to being an inclusive workplace, where team members of all backgrounds and experiences are welcome. As an equal opportunity employer, it is our policy and culture to provide opportunities to all persons based on merit and fitness to perform job duties. Employment decisions are based solely on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, religion, age (40 or older, as protected under the ADEA), disability (including physical, mental, or sensory), genetic information (including testing and characteristics), protected veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws or regulations.

At Parametrix, we are dedicated to encouraging an inclusive and accessible workplace. We welcome and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Your Information Matters
