title: Claims Specialist
description:
Parker's is seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused Claims Specialist to support the administration of workers' compensation, general liability, auto liability, property, unemployment, and other insurance claims from initial reporting through resolution. Working closely with the Risk Manager, Human Resources, Operations, Legal, and insurance partners, this role investigates claims, maintains accurate records, communicates with key stakeholders, and helps protect Parker's employees, customers, assets, and financial interests while minimizing organizational risk.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Claims Administration & Case Management

  • Manage assigned claims across multiple lines of insurance, including workers' compensation, general liability, auto liability, property, unemployment, and other claims.
  • Coordinate all aspects of the claim lifecycle from incident reporting through closure.
  • Notify insurance carriers of new claims and serve as the primary point of contact throughout the claims process.
  • Assist injured employees throughout the claims process, including coordinating return-to-work efforts with managers, medical providers, and Human Resources.
  • Schedule appointments, obtain medical updates, and monitor case progress.
  • Monitor claim activity and follow up with adjusters, medical providers, attorneys, employees, customers, supervisors, and leadership to facilitate timely claim resolution.
  • Conduct thorough investigations by collecting evidence, interviewing involved parties, reviewing documentation, and maintaining complete, accurate, and compliant claim records.
  • Analyze claim trends, exposures, and recurring incidents to recommend strategies that reduce risk, control costs, and improve workplace safety.
  • Prepare detailed investigative summaries, reports, and recommendations for management.

Unemployment Claims Administration

  • Prepare and defend unemployment claims by researching applicable regulations, compiling supporting documentation, and developing comprehensive responses.
  • Represent Parker's during unemployment appeal hearings, telephone hearings, mediations, and other proceedings as assigned.
  • Organize case files, prepare witnesses, present supporting documentation, and communicate the company's position professionally and effectively.
  • Maintain regular communication with Operations and Human Resources to obtain information necessary to support claim decisions.

Collaboration & Compliance

  • Partner with the Risk Manager, General Counsel, Human Resources, Operations, insurance carriers, third-party administrators, and external counsel to achieve favorable claim outcomes.
  • Assist with claim reviews, reserve evaluations, settlement discussions, and resolution strategies.
  • Identify potential legal issues including EEOC matters, wrongful termination concerns, or litigation exposure and communicate findings to appropriate leadership.
  • Prepare injury-related reports, management summaries, and other documentation as requested.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws governing workers' compensation, unemployment, liability claims, and insurance reporting.
  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive employee, customer, and company information.

    Operational Excellence

    • Maintain organized claim files while utilizing claims data and trend analysis to improve processes, reduce risk, and support audit readiness.
    • Support departmental projects and continuous improvement efforts.
    • Perform other duties as assigned.

    Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

    • Exceptional analytical, investigative, and critical thinking skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and prepare and present findings to leadership.
    • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
    • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to build strong relationships and resolve conflict professionally.
    • Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
    • Ability to research laws, regulations, policies, and claim documentation to support informed decision-making.
    • Knowledge of workers' compensation, unemployment, general liability claims, risk management, and applicable federal and state regulations.
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint), Google Workspace, and claims management systems.

    EDUCATION AND REQUIREMENTS

    Required

    • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
    • Experience preparing reports, claim documentation, and written correspondence.

    Preferred

    • 2+ years of experience administering workers' compensation, general liability, unemployment, property, auto liability, or related insurance claims preferred.
    • Experience in retail, hospitality, convenience store, or multi-location operations.
    • Experience with claims management systems and risk management software.

    Physical Requirements

    • Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.
    • Frequent use of standard office equipment.
    • Ability to occasionally attend meetings, hearings, inspections, or other work-related activities as needed.

title: Senior Cyber GRC Specialist
description:
Why Mobility Global?

At Mobility Global, our mission is to provide trusted information that helps billions of people build, sell, and own vehicles with confidence. As we shape the next generation of automotive intelligence through innovation, AI, and industry-leading data, we're creating new opportunities for our customers, our business, and our people.

Role Summary

The Senior Cyber GRC Specialist is an individual contributor responsible for assessing and managing cybersecurity risks arising from third-party relationships and deviations from approved security policies and standards. The role serves as a technical risk advisor across Security, Technology, Procurement, Legal, Privacy, and business teams.

This position requires practical cybersecurity knowledge to review technical controls, ask appropriate follow-up questions, challenge incomplete or unsupported responses, evaluate compensating controls, and translate technical risk into clear business impact. The role assesses risk and provides recommendations; formal risk acceptance remains with the authorized business and security approvers.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform risk-based cybersecurity assessments of vendors, suppliers, SaaS providers, cloud service providers, and other third parties during onboarding, reassessment, renewal, and material service changes.
  • Review security questionnaires, independent assurance reports, certifications, penetration test summaries, architecture information, vulnerability management practices, incident response capabilities, and other relevant security evidence.
  • Engage vendor and internal technical teams to clarify security architecture, control design, identified gaps, remediation commitments, and residual risk.
  • Identify and document third-party cyber risks, determine risk severity, recommend risk treatment, and track agreed remediation actions through closure.
  • Apply assessment depth based on service criticality, data sensitivity, connectivity, hosting model, regulatory exposure, and potential business impact.
  • Administer the security exception management lifecycle, including intake, completeness review, risk assessment, routing, approval coordination, expiration, renewal, closure, and reporting.
  • Evaluate exception requests against applicable security policies and standards, including the business justification, scope, duration, technical exposure, compensating controls, remediation plan, and residual risk.
  • Challenge exception submissions when risks are not adequately understood, supporting evidence is insufficient, or proposed compensating controls do not reasonably reduce exposure.
  • Partner with Security Architecture, Cloud Security, Application Security, Infrastructure, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, and other subject matter experts when specialized validation is required.
  • Prepare clear risk recommendations for authorized approvers and governance forums while maintaining appropriate separation between risk assessment, risk ownership, and risk acceptance.
  • Maintain accurate risk records and supporting evidence in the designated governance, risk, and compliance platform.
  • Develop and report metrics on assessment volume, risk severity, remediation status, overdue actions, exception aging, renewals, expirations, and risk concentrations.
  • Identify recurring control gaps and trends across vendors and exceptions and recommend improvements to policies, standards, assessment criteria, contract requirements, and governance processes.
  • Support audits, certifications, regulatory inquiries, and customer assurance activities related to third-party cyber risk and security exception management.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of risk methodologies, procedures, templates, decision criteria, and stakeholder guidance.
  • This role would report to the Senior Manager, Cyber Governance & Risk Management.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5 -10 years of experience in cybersecurity, information security risk, technology risk, third-party risk management, security architecture, security engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience performing technical security assessments of vendors, cloud services, applications, infrastructure, or enterprise technology environments.
  • Experience evaluating policy or control exceptions, compensating controls, remediation plans, and residual risk is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of identity and access management, multifactor authentication, privileged access, cloud security, network security, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, application security, encryption, logging and monitoring, incident response, resilience, and data protection.
  • Ability to interpret common security evidence, including SOC reports, ISO 27001 certifications, penetration test summaries, vulnerability information, security architecture documentation, and control descriptions.
  • Working knowledge of recognized cybersecurity and risk frameworks, such as ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Controls, and TISAX.
  • Strong analytical judgment with the ability to distinguish administrative gaps from material technical risk and to evaluate whether proposed controls adequately reduce exposure.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with technical teams, vendors, business owners, procurement, legal, privacy, auditors, and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation, organization, and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple assessments, exceptions, and remediation actions concurrently.
  • Ability to operate independently, escalate material concerns appropriately, and provide objective, evidence-based risk recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certification such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CCSK, CCSP, Security+, or an equivalent credential.
  • Experience with a governance, risk, and compliance platform or third-party risk management solution, such as ServiceNow, Archer, LogicGate, OneTrust, or a comparable platform.
  • Experience supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, TISAX, customer assurance, regulatory compliance, or audit activities.
  • Prior technical experience in security engineering, security architecture, cloud security, vulnerability management, incident response, or a security operations function.

This is a hybrid role with in-office expectations determined by location and subject to change based on evolving business needs.

What’s In It for You

  • Competitive compensation package, including base salary and incentive opportunities where applicable.
  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits for employees and eligible dependents.
  • Retirement savings programs, including company matching contributions where available.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Mobility Global is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected, supported, and empowered to succeed. We provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process and employment for qualified individuals with disabilities.


Recruitment Fraud Alert

Mobility Global will never ask candidates to pay money at any stage of the hiring process, including for applications, interviews, background checks, training, or equipment. If you receive a suspicious communication or request for payment or personal financial information, please exercise caution and report it immediately.

title: Director, Extended Care Operations
description:
Job Description Summary

‎

The Director, Extended Care Operations leads the operational strategy implementation, design, standardization, and performance of CareMore’s non-clinic-based Extended Care programs across markets. Acting independently within the strategic direction established by senior clinical and business leadership, this role makes functional operating decisions, establishes operational policies and standards, and resolves highly complex, ambiguous issues spanning clinical teams, markets, care settings, and external partners.

In partnership with the Extended Care Medical Director, the Director is accountable for operational performance, resource deployment, service reliability, and financial stewardship that support measurable improvements in care delivery for high-risk and frail patients. The role directly leads the Extended Care Coordinator team and influences clinical and cross-functional leaders responsible for program execution.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

Core Responsibilities


1. Functional Operating Model and Strategy Implementation

· Lead design and implementation of standardized operating models across Extended Care markets and programs, translating CareMore strategy into functional policies, operating plans, and measurable standards.

· Establish operational decision rights, roles, escalation protocols, service levels, governance, and cross-setting handoffs; determine and implement changes within delegated authority.

· Resolve ambiguous cross-functional operating issues and drive adoption of new practices across care centers, network partners, hospitals, SNFs, and support services.


2. Workforce Leadership and Capacity Decisions

· Direct the central Extended Care Coordinator team, including hiring recommendations or decisions within delegated authority, performance management, training, succession and staffing plans.

· Own workforce capacity planning for coordinator support and recommend or approve resource deployment and headcount changes within established budget and approval limits.

· Partner with clinical leaders to establish clinician coverage and productivity operating standards; influence execution across teams without implying direct supervisory authority over clinicians.

3. Care Coordination and Operational Governance

· Direct operating standards for referral intake, patient assignment, outreach, tracking, discharge, and escalation across programs.

· Establish and monitor reliable patient-transition workflows across hospitals, post-acute facilities, home-based care, and primary care teams.

· Make timely cross-program operational decisions to address service gaps, handoff failures, and competing resource demands within delegated authority.


4. Performance, Budget and Vendor Accountability

· Set operational performance targets and measurement approaches across Extended Care programs and lead corrective actions when performance is below standard.

· Manage the department operating budget; make material spending and resource allocation recommendations and decisions within approved authority, and explain financial tradeoffs to senior leaders.

· Partner with clinical leaders and analytics to assess utilization, cost per patient, program effectiveness, and ROI; use findings to adjust operating models.

· Oversee Extended Care vendors, establish service expectations, evaluate performance, and lead operational remediation or escalation.

5. Cross-Functional Leadership and Transformation

· Influence senior leaders outside the immediate reporting line to align priorities, adopt standardized practices, and resolve dependencies across markets.

· Lead complex operational transformation initiatives with defined milestones, risks, resource plans, and measurable outcomes over annual and multi-year planning cycles.

· Present recommendations, performance trends, risks, and investment tradeoffs to clinical and business leadership.


Performance Accountability

Operational outcomes

· Care at Home referral conversion and time to establish care; ISNP enrollment and retention.

· Facility-team alignment to high-density hospitals and SNFs; ISNP visit cadence and productivity.

· Care at Home episodic and longitudinal panel management and visit productivity.

· Coordinator task completion, volumes, service levels, and handoff reliability.

· Department operating expense, cost per patient served, resource utilization, and vendor performance.

Clinical outcomes (in partnership with clinical leadership)

· ISNP hospitalizations, readmissions, and Stars/BOI gap closure.

· SNF average length of stay and 30-day return-to-acute rate.

· Supportive Care engagement and appropriate hospice transitions.

· Care at Home impact on high-risk/frail patient hospitalizations.


Qualifications

Required

· Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, or related field.

· 8+ years of progressive healthcare operations, population health, or strategic operations experience, including 3+ years in leadership.

· Experience designing, scaling, and governing healthcare programs or operating models across multiple teams or markets.

· Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary teams through highly complex organizational change and influencing senior stakeholders.

· Experience managing operational performance, budgets, workforce planning, resource tradeoffs, and program evaluation.

· Strong analytical judgment, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.


Preferred

· Master’s degree in healthcare administration, business, or related field.

· Experience in delegated-risk medical groups or other risk-bearing healthcare organizations.

· Experience with high-risk Medicare populations, care transitions, home-based care, or facility-based services.

· Experience leading managers or multiple operational teams.


‎

Compensation Range:

$108,466.00

to

$162,698.00

Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs.

This role will define and drive the Biltmore Shop technology roadmap with a focus on building, testing, iterating, and scaling what works. The Product Manager will collaborate closely with design, dev, and marketing to build seamless, high-converting experiences that deepen customer engagement.

title: Cybersecurity Governanace, Risk & Compliance Sr. Analyst
description:
About Marvell

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

This role partners closely cross functionally to identify risks, assess security controls, and support alignment with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and internal policies. The successful candidate will help protect Marvell's data, intellectual property, and AI-enabled capabilities while supporting the secure adoption of emerging technologies.

What You Can Expect

As a Senior Cybersecurity Compliance & Governance Analyst, you will play a key role in strengthening Marvell’s cybersecurity governance, compliance, and assurance program. You will partner across Cybersecurity, IT, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and business teams to translate regulatory, customer, industry, and internal security requirements into practical, sustainable controls.

This role is ideal for an experienced cybersecurity compliance professional who enjoys solving complex problems, influencing cross-functional teams, improving how compliance programs operate, and helping a global organization demonstrate trust to customers, auditors, regulators, and other stakeholders.


You will support cybersecurity frameworks, standards, and regulatory requirements such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, CIS Controls, HIPAA, and other applicable requirements, while helping mature and automate Marvell’s broader cybersecurity compliance and governance capabilities.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support cybersecurity governance, compliance, and assurance initiatives across the organization.
  • Assess and validate security controls against applicable cybersecurity frameworks, standards, and regulatory requirements such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, CIS Controls, HIPAA, and other relevant requirements.
  • Support HIPAA security compliance, including assessing safeguards applicable to protected health information (PHI/ePHI), identifying control gaps, maintaining supporting documentation, and coordinating remediation with relevant stakeholders.
  • Coordinate and support internal audits, external assessments, customer reviews, regulatory compliance activities, and security certifications.
  • Drive audit and assessment readiness, including control validation, evidence collection, documentation review, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Identify compliance and control gaps, evaluate risk, and partner with control owners to develop practical and sustainable corrective action and remediation plans.
  • Track compliance findings, control deficiencies, and remediation activities through closure and provide clear visibility into progress and risk.
  • Develop and maintain cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, control documentation, and governance processes.
  • Partner with technical and business teams to ensure security controls are appropriately designed, implemented, documented, and operating effectively.
  • Support customer security assurance and due diligence activities, including security questionnaires, compliance inquiries, and requests for security evidence.
  • Monitor evolving cybersecurity regulatory, industry, and customer requirements and translate changes into actionable program and control improvements.
  • Develop meaningful compliance metrics, dashboards, and leadership reporting to communicate program health, risk, remediation progress, and control effectiveness.
  • Conduct control testing and compliance reviews to identify opportunities to strengthen, simplify, and standardize control execution.
  • Collaborate with Cybersecurity, IT, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and other business teams on security, privacy, and compliance initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline and automate compliance processes, such as evidence collection, control monitoring, workflow management, and reporting, to improve scalability and effectiveness.
  • Support strategic cybersecurity initiatives that advance governance, regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and assurance maturity.
  • Serve as a trusted compliance partner who promotes accountability, security awareness, and practical cybersecurity best practices across the organization.
  • Manage the lifecycle and periodic review of cybersecurity policies, standards, and procedures, including framework mapping, content adequacy and reasonableness review, stakeholder approvals, and ongoing maintenance.

What We're Looking For

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity compliance, governance, risk, audit, information security, or related functions.
  • Strong working knowledge and practical experience assessing and implementing controls against cybersecurity frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, CIS Controls, and other applicable industry or regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience supporting HIPAA compliance, including evaluating security controls associated with PHI/ePHI and familiarity with the HIPAA Security Rule and applicable administrative, physical, and technical safeguards.
  • Experience supporting internal and external cybersecurity audits, regulatory assessments, customer assessments, certification activities, or similar assurance initiatives.
  • Hands-on experience with control assessments, control testing, evidence management, gap analysis, remediation tracking, and audit readiness.
  • Ability to interpret regulatory, industry, customer, and framework requirements and translate them into practical security controls and processes.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise technology and security domains such as cloud security, identity and access management, security operations, vulnerability management, enterprise infrastructure, and IT service management.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify security and compliance gaps, assess associated risk, and partner with stakeholders to implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Strong program and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, global environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical and regulatory concepts for technical, business, and executive audiences.
  • Experience communicating cybersecurity compliance risks, findings, metrics, and program updates to leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Ability to build strong cross-functional relationships and influence outcomes where direct authority may not exist.
  • Experience governing cybersecurity policies, standards, and procedures, including framework alignment, periodic review cycles, content adequacy and reasonableness assessments, and stakeholder approvals.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Lead Implementer, HCISPP, GIAC certifications, or other applicable cybersecurity, audit, privacy, or compliance credentials.
  • Experience supporting cybersecurity compliance and governance programs within a large, global technology organization.
  • Experience working across multiple cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory, and assurance frameworks and developing common controls that efficiently address overlapping requirements.
  • Experience with GRC platforms and compliance automation, such as automated evidence collection, continuous control monitoring, workflow automation, and compliance reporting.
  • Experience supporting customer security assurance, third-party risk, privacy, regulatory compliance, or similar assurance programs.
  • Experience partnering with Legal and Privacy teams on security and compliance requirements involving sensitive or regulated information.

Preferred Qualities

  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to quality and sound risk-based decision-making.
  • Self-motivated, curious, and comfortable taking ownership of complex compliance initiatives.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, global environment.
  • Strong stakeholder management, relationship-building, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to move comfortably between detailed control analysis and executive-level communication.
  • A continuous improvement mindset with a focus on making compliance processes simpler, more scalable, and more effective.
  • A practical approach to cybersecurity compliance that balances risk reduction, regulatory obligations, customer expectations, and business objectives.

Expected Base Pay Range (USD)

121,490 - 182,000, $ per annum

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.


This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.


Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements

Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights include an employee stock purchase plan with a 2-year look back, family support programs to help balance work and home life, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and a recognition and service awards to celebrate contributions and milestones. We look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process.

Any applicant who requires a reasonable accommodation during the selection process should contact Marvell HR Helpdesk at TAOps@marvell.com.

Interview Integrity

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

10

Network Engineer

Global Network Services is seeking a Network Engineer with a strong interest in network automation to help build and operate S&P Global's multi-cloud network platform. This role is central to our drive to replace manual network provisioning with repeatable, code-driven delivery across AWS, Azure and GCP. You will write and extend automation, implement cloud network changes, and support the platform in production - working alongside senior engineers who will guide you on design decisions and review your work. This role suits an engineer who enjoys both writing code and understanding the network it configures, and who wants to grow their cloud networking depth in a large and varied environment.

Job Responsibilities

Network Automation and Infrastructure-as-Code

  • Write, test and maintain Terraform modules to provision cloud network services across AWS, Azure and GCP, working to patterns set by the senior engineering team.
  • Build scripts and tooling in Python and Ansible to remove repetitive manual network tasks and improve consistency.
  • Extend existing automation to cover new network services and use cases, and help keep shared modules current as cloud platforms evolve.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for network change, including automated validation and pre-deployment testing.
  • Help develop automated configuration and compliance checks so deviations from approved standards are detected early.
  • Follow good engineering practice in shared repositories - version control, peer review, readable modular code and clear documentation.
  • Identify manual tasks in your own work that could be automated, and propose them to the team.

Cloud and Hybrid Networking

  • Implement and support cloud network solutions across AWS, Azure and GCP based on agreed designs and requirements.
  • Configure and maintain core cloud networking components including VPCs and VNets, subnets, Transit Gateway attachments, VPC peering, route tables, security groups, load balancers and DNS.
  • Support hybrid connectivity across AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute and site-to-site VPN.
  • Respond to network requests and troubleshoot network failures to diagnose, isolate and resolve issues, escalating to senior engineers where appropriate.
  • Apply routing fundamentals including BGP and OSPF when supporting connectivity between cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Prepare and execute approved network changes within agreed maintenance windows, including documented back-out steps.

Collaboration and Continuous Improvement

  • Work with application, security and infrastructure colleagues to deliver network changes that meet enterprise standards and compliance requirements.
  • Produce and maintain low-level documentation, automation runbooks and standard operating procedures.
  • Provide support to operations engineers on network issues, and participate in on-call rotation and out-of-hours change windows as required.
  • Identify and act upon opportunities for continuous improvement to reduce risk, optimise efficiency and capacity, and improve standards.
  • Build knowledge of cloud networking and network automation, and share what you learn with the team.

Basic Required Qualifications:

  • Proven experience (5+ years) in enterprise networking, including hands-on experience working in a cloud environment.
  • Practical hands-on experience with network automation, including Terraform and Python, and familiarity with version control using Git.
  • Hands-on cloud networking experience in at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP, with working knowledge of a second.
  • Working experience with cloud networking services such as VPC, subnets, security groups, route tables, Transit Gateway, Route 53 and ELBs, or their Azure and GCP equivalents.
  • Good knowledge of networking standards, protocols and technologies, including routing (BGP, OSPF), switching, VPNs, DNS and load balancing.
  • Ability to read network configuration as code and understand the network impact of a change before deploying it.
  • Good troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the judgement to know when to escalate.
  • Willingness to learn, take direction from senior engineers and act on code review feedback.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a cross-functional team.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and commitments.
  • Self-motivated, able to progress tasks independently once direction is agreed.

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

  • Exposure to enterprise firewalls, particularly Fortinet and Palo Alto Networks, in cloud or data-centre deployments.
  • Exposure to network segmentation and micro-segmentation approaches in cloud or hybrid environments.
  • GCP networking experience, including VPC design, Cloud Router, Shared VPC and Private Service Connect.
  • Familiarity with Cloud Native NaaS (Network as a Service) platforms such as Alkira, Prosimo or Aviatrix.
  • Experience with Cisco, Arista and F5 load balancers or similar network equipment.
  • Exposure to Ansible, automated network testing, or network observability platforms such as Selector AI or ThousandEyes.
  • Relevant certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect Associate or Advanced Networking Specialty, Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate, Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer, CCNA or CCNP, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
  • Experience working in a regulated financial services environment with formal change and audit requirements.

Grade: 10 {5 to 10 yrs}

Shift Time: 2 pm to 11 pm IST

Job Location: Hyderabad / Gurugram / Noida / Bengaluru

Working Model: Hybrid, twice a week work from office.

title: Live Fire Structures Test & Evaluation Engineer (Associate, Experienced or Senior)
description:
Live Fire Structures Test & Evaluation Engineer (Associate, Experienced or Senior)

Company:

The Boeing Company

Boeing is seeking a Live Fire Structures Test & Evaluation Engineer (Associate, Experienced or Senior), to work in the Structures and Mechanical Test (STR) capability as part of the Structures Test and Evaluation Engineering team located in Berkeley, MO.


The STR capability supports structural, mechanical and material properties test programs for all Boeing Divisions, including Boeing Commercial Aircraft (BCA), Boeing Defense Systems (BDS), and Boeing Space Programs with an emphasis on BDS. The STR capability also support Birdstrike and Live Fire testing in support of BDS and Phantom Works programs.

As part of this team, you will have the opportunity to work on the latest military aircraft and weapons programs, such as T-7A and MQ-25A, and support our legacy programs like F-15 and F/A-18 into the future. The St. Louis STR team supports tests ranging from material testing, airframe component testing to full-scale static and fatigue testing. The ideal candidate should work well under pressure, have excellent all around communication skills, leadership, interpersonal, organizational skills, and be very detail oriented.

This position will focus on Live Fire test and Vulnerability test planning and test fixture design. You will also support test oversight onsite at multiple Boeing, Government and supplier test sites. A background in related Live Fire testing, structural testing and similar capabilities and/or backgrounds in structural, dynamic or environmental testing is also desired.

Travel to customer, supplier and government test sites will be required during off-site setup and test execution periods, to ensure proper testing per test planning and specification.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Live Fire Test Planning for multiple programs.
  • Working with business partners to plan, design, set up and perform Live Fire testing.
  • Work with and lead a team through test design, integration and test conduct activities in the structural test labs.
  • Gather test requirements, develop test procedures, design and analyze test fixtures, leads in the fabrication and setup of the tests, and leads in the test conduct phase
  • Coordinate with the business partner, team members, shop (touch-labor) personnel, and other support personnel
  • Use knowledge in structural and Live Fire test design, CAD systems, and analysis concepts, including test techniques and hydraulic operations to design test fixtures and organize test operations
  • Exhibit a high degree of mechanical aptitude, which includes an understanding of 2D design drawings, 3D Model Based Design and manufacturability, producibility and reliability of test hardware designs.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with various integrated and cross-functional teams in situations that require significant judgment and decision making
  • Integrate test fixture assemblies per design best practices, Boeing safety requirements and customer requirements
  • Track, Document and produce internal test reports on assigned testing projects
  • Work with lab personnel to lead efforts to troubleshoot test fixtures, test equipment, instrumentation and test article issues
  • Present data to internal teams and business partners during design process reviews and test readiness reviews
  • Analyze test data to ensure test readiness and data validity
  • Conduct research in test technologies to improve lab efficiency and capability
  • Interface with other members of project or program teams, management, and technical staff to define and implement test engineering solutions
  • Help to lead in the current and future direction of the Boeing Structures Testing and Live Fire Testing capabilities across the Boeing Enterprise
  • Travel 5-10% of the time to various test sites to support testing.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement
  • 1+ years of experience working with computer aided design such as CATIA, Solidworks, or Siemens NX
  • 1+ years of experience with structural testing, mechanical testing and/or flight testing
  • 1+ years of experience with Live Fire and/or other vulnerability testing
  • Experience with Vulnerability assessment and/or Penetration test

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):

  • A current active DoD Secret Clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, or Civil Engineering
  • Experience leading Live Fire Testing previously on military applications.
  • 3+ years of experience with vulnerability testing on aerospace applications
  • Experience with Siemens NX design software specifically.
  • 5+ years of related test lab work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 5+ years of experience with 3D Design software, such as Siemens NX, SolidWorks and/or CATIA

title: Technical Quality Assurance Inspector III
description:
Sierra Space Careers:

At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth.

Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond.

Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission-ready throughout space.

We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

About the Role

The Technical Quality Assurance Inspector III is responsible for performing inspections of manufacturing goods during and at the completion of the manufacturing process. This role involves conducting visual, detailed dimensional and electrical inspections of individual items, sub-assemblies or final system assemblies. The inspector will interpret complex prints, manufacturing drawings, diagrams, wire cards, and lists to approve or reject in-process or final assemblies, ensuring compliance with stringent industry standards and certifications. This position is for a CMM Programmer/Operator with working knowledge of PC-DMIS. When not performing CMM-related work, the candidate will perform Receiving, In-Process and Final inspections (document review, visual inspection, and dimensional inspection using non-CMM measurement equipment). May take part in supporting root cause analysis of non-conformances and support continuous improvement activities.

In this role, you will program and operate CMM equipment using PC-DMIS. You will also perform inspections of manufacturing goods during and at the end of the manufacturing process, certify completed products, and conduct detailed dimensional and electrical inspections of individual items, sub-assemblies, or final system assemblies. When not performing CMM-related work, you will perform Receiving, In-Process and Final inspections, including document review, visual inspection, and dimensional inspection using non-CMM measurement equipment. You will interpret complex prints, manufacturing drawings, diagrams, wire cards, and lists to approve or reject in-process or final assemblies while ensuring compliance with quality standards, specifications, and industry certifications. Additionally, you will document inspection results, maintain accurate records, and communicate inspection findings to relevant stakeholders and management. You will assist in drafting work instructions and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), utilize Microsoft Office suite tools for documentation and reporting, and develop and maintain proficiency in industry standards and certifications, including NASA and IPC. Furthermore, you will provide guidance and mentorship to Level 1-2 inspectors and support internal and external audits.

About You

Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission.

We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Typically, 4+ years of relevant experience.
  • Certifications: Progress towards multiple NASA and IPC industry standard certifications.
  • Completion of basic GD&T training.
  • Understanding of technical schematics and documents.
  • Understanding of electrical wiring concepts.
  • Functional use and knowledge of Microsoft Office suite tools, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Ability to understand and interpret geometric dimensioning and tolerance.
  • Experience drafting work instructions and SOPs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field.
  • Working knowledge of PC-DMIS for CMM programming and operation, with experience performing Receiving, In-Process, and Final inspections, including document review, visual inspection, and dimensional inspection using non-CMM measurement equipment (e.g., calipers, micrometers, height gauges).
  • Advanced certifications in quality assurance or inspection (e.g., ASQ Certified Quality Technician, Certified Quality Engineer, or Certified Quality Inspector).
  • Working towards Six Sigma or Lean Six Sigma certifications.
  • Proficiency with standard inspection tools and equipment, including hand inspection tools and equipment.
  • Developing statistical process control (SPC) techniques and data analysis.
  • Basic familiarity with non-destructive testing (NDT) methods and equipment.
  • Experience with quality management software and databases, such as SAP QM or similar.
  • Basic knowledge of electrical testing equipment and techniques, including oscilloscopes and multimeters.
  • Experience in a regulated industry, such as aerospace or defense, with an understanding of industry-specific standards and regulations including AS9100.
  • Proven ability to provide technical guidance to Level I & II inspectors.

Compensation:

Pay Range:

$24.86 - $34.19

Your actual base compensation will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge and skills, education, experience, internal equity and market competitiveness.

IMPORTANT NOTICE:

To conform to U.S. Government international trade regulations, applicant must be a U.S. Citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or U.S. Department of Commerce.

Elevate Your Career

At Sierra Space, we are committed to your personal and professional development. We empower you to make profound and meaningful contributions and foster a vibrant culture of collaboration, where teamwork ignites breakthrough innovations.


We also offer a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, and more.

Sierra Space is an industry-leading space and defense technology company providing satellites, spacecraft, and enabling mission systems and components. We deliver mission-proven technologies to our customers that safeguard our nation, protect space-based assets and enable space exploration.

Application Deadline: This role will remain posted until a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

Please note: Sierra Space does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to Sierra Space team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of Sierra Space, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

Sierra Space Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need special assistance or a reasonable accommodation related to applying for employment with Sierra Space or at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us.

title: Supervisor Inland
description:
APM Terminals

Supervisor Inland

Har du lyst til at tage det næste skridt og få en mere koordinerende rolle i Inland?

Som Supervisor bliver du et vigtigt bindeled mellem teamet og den ansvarlige leder. Du vil ikke have personaleansvar, men du får et tydeligt ansvar for at støtte og koordinere det daglige arbejde og bidrage til, at teamet har de rette forudsætninger for at lykkes.

  • sikre, at arbejdet forløber efter planen, og at teamet har det, de skal bruge for at løse deres opgaver

  • identificere udfordringer og sikre, at de rette tiltag bliver iværksat
  • bidrage til teamets fortsatte udvikling og forbedringsarbejde

For at lykkes i rollen tror vi først og fremmest, at du har lyst til at tage et større ansvar og udvikle dig i retning af en ledende rolle.

Du:

  • tager ansvar og driver opgaver fremad
  • kommunikerer tydeligt og konstruktivt
  • har let ved at samarbejde og skabe gode relationer
  • kan motivere andre og skabe retning i det daglige arbejde

  • kan balancere gode relationer med det ansvar, der følger med en Supervisor-rolle

En mulighed for at tage det næste skridt

title: SHERQ Systems Specialist
description:

title: Store Collega JD Mall of the Netherlands| 20u
description:
JD Mall of the Netherlands zoekt nieuwe collega's (20 uur) die ons team willen ondersteunen en versterken!

Als Store Collega speel je een belangrijke rol in het creëren van een uitstekende winkelervaring. Je zorgt ervoor dat klanten zich welkom, ondersteund en gewaardeerd voelen, en helpt hen bij het ontdekken van onze producten. Je brengt energie naar de winkelvloer door klanten vriendelijk te begroeten, de presentatie van de winkel verzorgd te houden, voorraadaanvulling uit te voeren en hoge service- en kwaliteitsnormen te waarborgen. Dankzij jouw positieve instelling, teamgeest en klantgerichte aanpak draag je bij aan een vlot draaiende winkel en de hoge standaard waarvoor wij bekendstaan.

Ben je klaar om aan de slag te gaan in een dynamische retailomgeving, nieuwe vaardigheden te ontwikkelen en deel uit te maken van een ondersteunend team? Dan is dit een mooie kans om impact te maken en een sterke basis te leggen voor je verdere loopbaan.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je verwelkomt klanten op een vriendelijke en professionele manier en helpt hen bij het vinden van de producten die bij hun wensen passen.
  • Je gebruikt de beschikbare winkeltools en digitale systemen om voorraad te controleren, productinformatie te delen en de klantenervaring te ondersteunen.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de winkelvloer netjes, verzorgd en goed aangevuld blijft, zodat productpresentaties aantrekkelijk en inspirerend zijn.
  • Je ondersteunt dagelijkse winkelactiviteiten, zoals kassawerkzaamheden, het aanvullen van voorraad en het naleven van alle veiligheids- en winkelrichtlijnen.

Wie we zoeken

  • Je hebt een positieve en enthousiaste houding die past binnen een dynamische en klantgerichte retailomgeving.
  • Je beschikt over sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en voelt je comfortabel in het contact met klanten en collega's.
  • Je bent leergierig, neemt graag nieuwe taken op en wilt jezelf verder ontwikkelen.
  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en bereid om verschillende diensten te werken, waaronder avonden, weekends en drukke seizoensperiodes.

Wat jou extra sterk maakt

  • Je hebt een oprechte interesse in merken, trends en nieuwe producten.
  • Je neemt initiatief en stapt gemakkelijk op klanten af om hen verder te helpen.
  • Je hebt oog voor detail en zorgt ervoor dat de winkel er steeds verzorgd en uitnodigend uitziet.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen en door te groeien binnen de organisatie.

Wat wij bieden

Wij zijn een werkgever die gelijke kansen hoog in het vaandel draagt en zich inzet voor een werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich gewaardeerd, gerespecteerd en ondersteund voelt. We geloven dat diversiteit onze organisatie sterker maakt en streven ernaar dat alle collega's, ongeacht achtergrond, identiteit of levenservaring, zich kunnen ontwikkelen en een betekenisvolle bijdrage kunnen leveren. title: Processing Specialist - $20.00/hr
description:
What is a Processing Specialist?

Processing Specialists receive material (steel) and turn it into parts that our customers order by bending or cutting it with lasers and/or saws before cleaning it, inspecting it, and loading it on trucks to be shipped to the customer. This position helps the company create a culture of safety by following all safety policies and safe work practices.

What can you expect from the job?

  • 1st shift – 7:00 a.m. – 3:30 p.m., Monday-Friday
  • Exposure to the elements
  • Dirty working conditions
  • Regular exposure to moving mechanical or machinery parts
  • Moderately stressful and constantly changing work environment
  • Lots of walking and standing – up to 8 hours a day
  • Frequent lifting, pushing, or pulling of material up to 51lbs.

What are the requirements?

  • Valid driver’s license
  • 18+ years old
  • Basic math skills
  • Basic literacy for reading instructions and using hand tools
  • Basic computer skills

Who does well in this position?

If you like working with your hands, you don’t mind a little dirt, and you prefer working with people, this may be a good position for you. As one of our team members says, “I was never a suit and tie kinda guy anyway.” Our best Process Specialists are responsible, thorough, careful, and persistent. If this sounds like you, we want you to apply!

Pay and Benefits

  • Starting pay of $20.00 an hour
  • Quarterly profit sharing bonus opportunity

  • Opportunity for merit increase every 90 days based on performance

  • Annual holiday bonus based on company performance
  • Opportunity to work overtime
  • 401k retirement contribution matching – 50% company match up to 6% of your annual wages
  • Company covers about 80% of the cost of medical insurance for you and your family
  • Company covers 100% of the cost for a life-insurance policy
  • Company covers 100% of the cost for both short and long-term disability insurance policies
  • Children of long-term employees can apply for company scholarships
  • Paid personal time available for use as it accrues (max of one week per year)
  • One week of paid vacation after 6 months
  • Two weeks of paid vacation after one year

What is Steel and Pipe Supply?

Steel and Pipe Supply buys steel and sells it to large customers that make products like farm equipment, powerline towers, storage tanks, frames for stadiums, and more. In addition to storing steel, some of our service centers process it – cut, bend, decoil, etc. – to make life easy for our customers. At the Kansas City Service Center, we’re a close-knit, open-minded family with a competitive streak that makes our warehouse a fun place to work. If you’re not sure whether Steel and Pipe Supply is right for you, feel free to stop by and ask for a job preview – we’d be happy to show you around!

What is it like to work at Steel and Pipe Supply?

title: Product Lead, Customer Data and Platforms
description:
LHV Bank Limited is a UK-licensed bank operating across three core business segments: Retail Banking, SME Lending, and Banking Services (BaaS). The bank is a wholly owned subsidiary of LHV Group, a listed financial services provider headquartered in Estonia. LHV Bank operates under a full UK banking licence granted in May 2023.

The Bank supports over 200 fintech clients with embedded financial infrastructure, provides retail savings products via digital channels, and offers SME credit solutions across the UK. In line with its regulatory responsibilities and growth ambitions, LHV Bank is committed to maintaining a robust and proportionate financial crime control environment.

Expanding our services, LHV Bank now provides personal banking solutions. Our offerings include current accounts with competitive interest rates, fixed-rate bonds for long-term savings, and debit cards. Customers can conveniently access these services through the LHV App, enabling secure account opening and management.

Role overview

Lead the strategy and delivery of the bank’s customer data, CRM and customer operations platforms, including AI-supported customer service. Improve customer data quality and consistency, and ensure platforms and processes are scalable, well controlled and clearly owned.

Own product direction, the domain roadmap and customer data requirements, working with Engineering, Data and business owners on design and delivery. Lead and develop the Product Manager and Business Analyst, delegating platform prioritisation and continuous improvement to the PM and requirements analysis and delivery support to the BA.

Work closely with Engineering, Data, Compliance, Risk and Customer Operations. Deliver agreed data and platform dependencies for AFC, segment onboarding, Single Customer View (SCV), tax reporting and data retention programmes, while ownership of those areas remains with the relevant teams.

This is a hands-on leadership role in a small bank, combining strategic direction with practical delivery through clear delegation and effective partnerships.

Key accountabilities

  • Own and deliver the domain strategy and roadmap, balancing customer needs, business value, regulatory requirements, risk and available capacity.
  • Own the customer data model, requirements and quality standards, working with Engineering, Data and business owners to standardise definitions, control changes and prioritise improvements across business lines.
  • Establish clear ownership, intake, prioritisation, processes and controls across the domain, managing and escalating risks within agreed authority.
  • Embed relevant data protection, financial crime and Consumer Duty requirements into product design and delivery, working with accountable business and control owners.
  • Lead the product direction and controlled adoption of AI-supported customer service, agreeing use cases, monitoring, human escalation and fallback arrangements with relevant teams.
  • Guide platform investment and lifecycle decisions, assessing whether to extend, buy, build, consolidate or retire solutions based on evidence, cost, risk and long-term value.
  • Define and monitor measures of data quality, platform adoption, customer outcomes and operational efficiency, using findings to prioritise improvements and assess supplier performance.
  • Build alignment across business lines, technical teams and senior stakeholders, securing agreement on priorities, investment and dependencies, including potential group-wide harmonisation or migration.
  • Lead and develop the PM and BA, setting clear expectations, delegating responsibility and coaching them to deliver agreed outcomes.

Experience

Essential

  • Experience owning a product area and roadmap, applying discovery, prioritisation and outcome measurement to deliver measurable improvements.
  • Experience leading and developing people through effective delegation, coaching and clear accountability.
  • Ownership of a CRM or customer operations platform in a regulated environment.
  • Strong understanding of customer data models, quality, integrations and change control, with sufficient technical confidence to challenge proposals and assess trade-offs with Engineering and Data.
  • Practical experience applying UK financial services and data protection requirements to customer data or customer operations products.
  • Experience establishing clear ownership, prioritisation and governance across teams, and influencing senior stakeholders across business, technical and control functions.
  • Evidence of balancing strategic priorities with hands-on delivery in a changing environment with competing demands and limited resources.

Desirable

  • Salesforce experience.
  • Experience with AI-supported customer service or automation.
  • Experience of data migration or group-wide harmonisation.

Some of our benefits (only applicable to UK based roles not Internship programmes)

  • Competitive salary &lots of opportunities to learn, grow and progress professionally.
  • Open and inclusive culture.
  • Hybrid working.
  • Fantastic offices and great working environment.
  • Vitality Health Plan (includes private health insurance, travel insurance, gym discounts)
  • Health cash Plan (Medicash health plan Level 3)
  • 6% employer pension contribution.
  • Life assurance – 4 x salary.
  • Income protection insurance – 75%
  • 28 days holiday plus 3 additional days, & further days for various key life events as well as the opportunity to sell up to 5 days per calendar year.
  • Swap public/bank holidays each year for alternative days that align with your personal, cultural, or religious observances.
  • Enhanced family friendly and family forming policies.
  • Access to a wide range of retail discounts.
  • Team Socials.

title: Auditor
description:
We are a world leader in Testing, Inspection and Certification (TIC) , delivering high quality services to help clients meet the growing challenges of quality, safety, environmental protection and social responsibility.


We’re looking for a qualifed Auditor to join our team in Iraq.

Experience & Skills Required

Education

  • Engineering or Science graduate (minimum Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline)..

Experience

  • A minimum of 4 years of professional experience in large or medium‑sized industrial organizations.
  • Practical, hands‑on experience across key operational functions such as planning, production, quality assurance / quality control (QA/QC), maintenance, or project management.
  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in the relevant management system scheme(s) (e.g. QMS, EMS, OHSMS).
  • Auditing experience (first‑party, second‑party, or third‑party) is considered an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and reporting skills.
  • Good communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong organizational and time‑management skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • High level of professionalism, integrity, and ethical conduct.

Languages

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Fluent Arabic (written and spoken).
  • Kurdish (not mandatory).

Main Duties and Responsibilities

  • To conduct audits in accordance with ISO 19011, Bureau Veritas CER Management System and Bureau Veritas Group policies and procedures.
  • Control and perform assigned on‑site audit activities, including audit preparation, execution, and reporting, in line with Audit Preparation and Audit Realisation processes.
  • Collect, verify, and evaluate objective evidence to assess conformity of management systems against audit criteria and applicable requirements.
  • Identify, document, and classify audit findings, including nonconformities, observations, and opportunities for improvement, based on objective evidence.
  • Participate in opening and closing meetings and, when formally authorized and competent to perform the duties of an audit team leader (Lead Auditor), chair such meetings.
  • Communicate audit progress, audit findings, and conclusions to the client in a clear, objective, and professional manner.
  • Periodically communicate audit progress, constraints, or concerns to the audit team and relevant Bureau Veritas stakeholders.
  • Perform audits independently, when authorized, and when competent to perform Lead Auditor duties for the specific audit, as endorsed by the Local Technical Manager.
  • Support audit conclusions by providing objective inputs derived from assigned audit activities.
  • Prepare and submit audit reports that are complete, accurate, and compliant with CER Management System and accreditation requirements.
  • Escalate unresolved issues, ethical concerns, impartiality risks, or deviations from audit requirements through defined CER reporting channels.
  • Maintain confidentiality, independence, and impartiality in line with the Bureau Veritas Code of Ethics and Group policies.
  • Participate in competence maintenance, qualification, calibration, and knowledge‑sharing activities as required by the CER Management System..

Deliverables

The Auditor is responsible for delivering the following outputs within the assigned audit scope:

  • Audit plans, checklists, and audit preparation documentation.
  • Objective evidence records supporting audit findings and audit conclusions.
  • Complete, accurate, and compliant audit reports.
  • Clearly documented nonconformities, observations, and supporting objective evidence.
  • Timely submission of audit reports in accordance with defined service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Follow‑up records related to nonconformity closure verification, where applicable.
  • Accurate and complete audit data entered into designated Bureau Veritas systems and tools.
  • Inputs required for technical review and the certification process, as applicable.
  • Contributions to continuous improvement, lessons learned, and auditor knowledge management

SHAPING A WORLD OF TRUST - WHAT WE VALUE AT BV

We create trust between businesses and we are committed to cultivating an open and inclusive environment wherever we operate and so do our employees. Being part of the BV family is more than just working, it’s being convinced that you will leave your mark…. in shaping a world of trust.

title: Head of Digital Bancassurance
description:
Empowering Africa’s tomorrow, together…one story at a time.

With over 100 years of rich history and strongly positioned as a local bank with regional and international expertise, a career with our family offers the opportunity to be part of this exciting growth journey, to reset our future and shape our destiny as a proudly African group.

My Career Development Portal: Wherever you are in your career, we are here for you. Design your future. Discover leading-edge guidance, tools and support to unlock your potential. You are Absa. You are possibility.

Job Summary

Own and co-create user-centric digital products to deliver business impact and carry end-to-end responsibility for decisions and outcomes related to one or more digital products.

Job Description

Job Purpose:

· The role holder is accountable for building and growing Digital Bancassurance as a significant, profitable distribution business, with P&L accountability for Digital Distribution and end-to-end responsibility for the digital acquisition, sale and servicing of insurance products to the bank's customers.

· The role acts as the Tribe Lead for Digital Bancassurance, setting commercial vision and mobilizing multidisciplinary teams across Bancassurance, Digital, Product, Technology, Data, Customer Experience, Operations, Marketing, Risk and Compliance to deliver simple, relevant and scalable digital insurance propositions.

· The role is accountable for translating the bank's customer base, digital reach, data and technology capabilities into insurance penetration, premium growth, fee/commission income, customer value and sustainable profitability.

· Success is measured not simply by the delivery of digital functionality, but by the commercial performance, customer adoption and economics of Digital Bancassurance.

Key Accountabilities

Digital Bancassurance Strategy – 20%

· Define and execute the Digital Bancassurance strategy and business plan.

· Establish the ambition for insurance distribution across mobile, internet and other digital channels.

· Identify priority insurance propositions, customer segments and digital journeys.

· Develop a multi-year roadmap for growing Digital Bancassurance contribution to the overall Bancassurance business.

· Identify opportunities to embed appropriate insurance propositions within customers' everyday banking journeys.

· Ensure that digital insurance propositions complement rather than compete with assisted distribution channels.

Profit and Loss (P&L) & Commercial Ownership – 15%

Hold end-to-end P&L accountability for Digital Distribution within Bancassurance. Accountabilities include:

· Revenue and profitability.

· Digital premium generation.

· Fee and commission income.

· Customer acquisition economics.

· Operating and distribution costs are within the assigned mandate.

· Investment business cases and benefits realization.

· Revenue forecasting and performance management.

· Product and channel profitability.

· Return on digital investment.

The role should be accountable for moving Digital Bancassurance beyond a capability or delivery agenda into a measurable commercial business.

Digital Distribution & Sales – 15%

Own the performance of digital channels as distribution channels for Bancassurance.

· Responsibilities include:

· Drive insurance sales through the bank's digital channels.

· Grow the proportion of eligible insurance business originated digitally.

· Increase conversion from digital customer interactions into insurance sales.

· Drive cross-sell and upsell across relevant customer segments.

· Optimize customer acquisition and sales funnels.

· Reduce abandonment during quotation, application and purchase.

· Develop contextual and event-driven insurance propositions within banking journeys.

· Drive migration of appropriate insurance servicing activities to digital.

· Work with Marketing and Analytics to execute targeted digital campaigns.

Bancassurance Tribe Leadership – 10%

Act as Tribe Lead for Digital Bancassurance, accountable for translating strategy into prioritized, commercially valuable execution.

Lead cross-functional squads incorporating capabilities such as:

· Bancassurance and insurance product

· Digital product management

· Technology and engineering

· Data and analytics

· Customer experience and design

· Marketing

· Operations

· Risk and Compliance

· Legal

· Finance

The Tribe Lead will:

· Define the tribe's objectives and measurable outcomes.

· Own the business roadmap and prioritization.

· Maintain a value-based backlog.

· Resolve cross-functional dependencies and execution barriers.

· Prioritize investment and capacity against customer and commercial value.

· Ensure delivery remains aligned to P&L objectives.

· Establish clear accountability across participating teams.

· Measure value realized after implementation rather than treating technology deployment as completion.

End-to-End Digital Insurance Journeys – 10%

Drive the digitization and simplification of the insurance lifecycle, including where applicable:

Discover → Understand → Quote → Apply → Underwrite → Pay → Issue → Service → Renew → Claim

Priorities should include:

· Straight-through digital fulfilment.

· Reduced manual intervention.

· Faster time to purchase.

· Pre-population using available customer information.

· Appropriate consent and disclosures.

· Simple premium-payment journeys.

· Digital policy documentation and servicing.

· Digital renewals.

· Digital claims notification/first notification of loss where appropriate.

Product & Proposition Management – 10%

· Partner with Bancassurance product teams and insurance partners to create propositions suitable for digital distribution.

· Simplify products and processes that create friction in digital channels.

· Determine which products and customer segments present the strongest opportunities for digital distribution.

· Use customer insights to refine product features, pricing, packaging and journeys.

· Establish test-and-learn mechanisms for new propositions before scaling.

· Ensure propositions create demonstrable value for both customers and the business.

Data, Analytics & Personalisation – 5%

Use customer and behavioral data as a core driver of Digital Bancassurance growth.

Key responsibilities include:

· Customer segmentation.

· Propensity modelling and targeting.

· Next-best product and next-best-action strategies.

· Contextual insurance offers.

· Digital funnel analytics.

· Campaign effectiveness.

· Conversion analytics.

· Customer lifetime value.

· Experimentation and A/B testing.

Build a performance culture where commercial decisions are based on measurable customer behavior rather than channel activity alone.

Customer Experience – 5%

Be accountable for the quality of the Digital Bancassurance customer experience.

· Design insurance journeys around customer needs rather than internal organizational structures.

· Simplify insurance terminology and purchase processes.

· Reduce unnecessary steps and documentation.

· Identify and eliminate points of customer abandonment.

· Monitor customer feedback, complaints and journey performance.

· Ensure consistent experience between banking and insurance journeys.

· Ensure customers can clearly understand what they are purchasing, the associated benefits, exclusions and obligations.

Insurance Partnerships & Ecosystem – 5%

Work with existing and prospective insurance partners to develop digitally enabled propositions.

· Establish effective operating models with underwriting partners.

· Influence insurers to digitize integration and servicing capabilities.

· Identify opportunities for API-enabled insurance propositions and ecosystem partnerships.

· Ensure partnership economics support the Digital Bancassurance P&L.

· Monitor partner service, operational and customer outcomes.

· Identify new strategic partnerships that broaden customer propositions or accelerate digital distribution.

Risk, Governance & Regulatory Compliance – 5%

Ensure growth is achieved within the required banking and insurance control environment.

Responsibilities include:

· Appropriate customer disclosures and consent.

· Product governance.

· Data privacy.

· Information and cybersecurity.

· Fraud prevention.

· Financial crime controls.

· Operational resilience.

· Technology risk management.

· Regulatory requirements applicable to Bancassurance.

· Customer treatment and conduct.

The role should ensure that controls are designed into digital journeys rather than added after propositions have been developed.

Preferred Qualification

· Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Insurance, Economics, Technology or a related discipline.

· MBA or equivalent postgraduate business qualification advantageous.

· Relevant professional qualifications in insurance, banking, digital product management or agile delivery advantageous

Preferred Experience

Typically, 10+ years of relevant senior experience spanning a combination of:

· Bancassurance or insurance

· Digital financial services

· Digital sales/distribution

· P&L management

· Product management

· Customer experience

· Digital transformation

· Agile/product/tribe leadership

· Commercial partnerships

· Demonstrable experience building or scaling a digital distribution business with measurable revenue and customer outcomes should be a key selection criterion.

Absa Bank Kenya is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference will be given to suitable candidates from designated groups whose appointments will contribute towards achievement of equitable demographic representation of our workforce profile and add to the diversity of the Bank.
