title: Wholesale Manager - North UK
description:
Founded in 1906 as a manufacturer of writing instruments, MONTBLANC today creates exclusive products including watches, jewelry, writing instruments and leather goods which reflect our high demands with respect to culture, quality, design, tradition and craftsmanship. With more than 25 subsidiaries and 600 boutiques MONTBLANC is present all over the world.

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Wholesale Manager to join our Montblanc UK team. This pivotal role is responsible for effectively driving our business across the North Territory & Ireland, ensuring maximum profitability and productivity by overseeing all activities within our extensive network. You will be instrumental in developing our partnerships, executing our strategic vision, and negotiating and implementing robust sales plans across all channels in your designated area. This is a field-based role, requiring significant travel.


HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

  • Cultivate and nurture relationships with existing customers, striving to achieve and surpass forecasted sales goals through proactive sell-out activities, effective Shop-in-Shop (SIS) implementations, and regular direct and online client meetings.
  • Manage and visit wholesale accounts across all channels within the territory, with approximately 80% of the role being field-based.
  • Define and manage range plans, oversee product phase-outs, and successfully introduce new products across all categories (including NOS, Model stock, and Auto replan).
  • Enhance Montblanc's presence in stores, elevate visual merchandising to Maison standards, and negotiate prime retail locations.
  • Ensure online and in-store policies, operational standards, and procedures are clearly communicated, understood, and rigorously implemented by our partners, whilst also proposing continuous improvement actions.
  • Regularly monitor all online sites and activities to safeguard and uphold brand image in strict accordance with Montblanc guidelines.
  • Take ownership of sales planning processes, including Sales Budgets, 5-Year Plans, and Action Plans, with full accountability for accounts and the implementation of related strategies.
  • Execute weekly reports, conduct thorough sales analyses, manage sell-out declarations, oversee stock inventories, and handle all other activities pertinent to account management (e.g., booster activities). Provide accurate analysis of weekly and seasonal trade performance with clear, immediate feedback and actionable plans to boost sales.
  • Forge strong, collaborative relationships with all internal departments, including Visual Merchandising, SIS, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Finance.
  • Manage orders and follow-ups, regularly liaising with the logistics team on all operational activities, and meticulously monitoring back orders and deliveries.
  • Provide essential Visual Merchandising support in stores as required.
  • Regularly deliver engaging and comprehensive category training sessions to all accounts.
  • Undertake any other ad hoc tasks as necessary to support the business.


HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

  • Strong wholesale sales experience, with a proven a strong track record of personal ownership in managing and developing business with key partners.
  • Possess a strong strategic, analytical, and entrepreneurial mindset, coupled with a positive and charismatic demeanour.
  • Excellent communication, organisational, and presentation skills.
  • Availability to travel extensively (approximately 80% of the time), with the ability to work autonomously and thrive within a fast-paced environment, adept at multi-tasking whilst maintaining daily responsibilities.
  • A keen interest and background in fashion and luxury goods.
  • Field-based role requiring a full UK driving licence.
  • In-depth knowledge of the UK/Ireland market, extensive customer service experience, and a comprehensive understanding of key retailers, including multi-channel businesses and department stores.
  • Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint. Familiarity with SAP is a distinct advantage.

description:
Job Location

JAKARTA GENERAL OFFICE

We've spanned three centuries thanks to three simple ideas: leadership, innovation and citizenship. You'll be at the core of breakthrough innovations, be given exciting assignments, lead initiatives, and take ownership and responsibility, in creative workspaces where new insights thrive. All the while, you'll receive outstanding training to help you become a leader in your field.

What we Offer:

Continuous mentorship – you will collaborate with peers and receive both formal training as well as day-to-day mentoring from your manager multifaceted and encouraging work environment– employees are at the centre, we value every individual and support initiatives, promoting agility and work/life balance.

Overview of the Job:

A new BAND 1 position at Material Process Delivery (MPD) Base Business (BB) department (sub function of Product Supply) for market Asia, Middle, East Africa (AMA) region. Position is based out of Jakarta, Indonesia & however it’s a location free role & so need travel to different location across region for TT activity, which will be need based.

The candidate will be responsible for multifaceted tech skills of pharmaceutical product formulation development & technology transfers, right from stages of formulation development to scale up & commercial scale process validation at various contract manufacturing sites across Asian region. Going forward, life cycle management regards to manufacturing technology, new raw material qualification & trouble shooting shall be handled.

The role includes tech transfer of new/existing products to contract manufacturing (CM) locations and to collaborate/support to multi-function teams (ESS- Production, QA, Procurement, CM site MFTs) during manufacturing of initial EO batches, validation batches.

The role requires co-ordination with MPD- Process team members & MFTs on various technical tasks during product life cycle management. Monitor, review, approve technical documents & the stability study data of commercial/Non-commercial PV batches kept at various conditions in line with Asian, ICH/WHO stability guidelines.

Your Team

The New BAND 1 role shall be based out at Jakarta Indonesia & will report to Sr. Manager MPD -Process (B2) BB AMA PHC based out at Mumbai. There are 3 sub-functional wings of MPD viz. Process Development &, Pkg. Material development.

MPD AMA PHC BB team had total 12 No. of FTEs stationed at India Mumbai.

How success looks like

  • Tech transfer of existing products manufactured at Existing contract manufacturing (CM) locations in Indonesia to New contract manufacturing locations & those are exported to different markets within Asean Countries. Role needs travelling to CM locations across region (66-75% travel time needed for this role)
  • Participation in NSS & Technical trouble shooting activities at manufacturing locations (need based).
  • Compliance to various P&G system like Digital specs. Management & Quality system, e.g. Veeva for CCP, Deviation management, CAPA.
  • Liaison with LRA /LCM folks for various RA requirements as per BOH requirement. Review & approvals of technical documents & data of Dossier for different markets as per Part P & Part S technical part of CTD /Non CTD dossier.
  • Participate in review of stability study of various batches incubated in line with Asian, ICH/WHO stability guidelines & related task thereof.
  • Participate in supplier qualification of in scope raw materials being used in the formulation & to follow respective SOP for material qualification. To liaison with Safety Team regards to safety clearance of individual raw materials.

Responsibilities of the role

  • Coordination with MPD (process, Analytical, Pkg Function) and various Multi-functional Teams (ESS QA, GTM QA, CM site production & QA, CQA, ESS Operations, Purchases) so to facilitate support in Technology Transfer (TT) of products at existing & new CM [contract manufacturing] locations across AMA region as well as to co-ordinate with other region while product TT is planned from sending units of other region e.g. EU, LATAM.
  • Review & approve various technical documents like TTP/MFR/HTS/TTR prior & post TT and dossiers of prospective C&G products to be outsourced.
  • Shall lead the supplier qualification activities per P&G SOP for qualification of New Supplier.
  • Participate in periodic meetings with multi-functional Teams and opine/present on technical matters so to update leadership & MFT members on the progress of regional projects’ from MPD Process PoV.
  • Ownership of document management software (VEEVA) for initiating change control, deviation & CAPA systems including create/review/approve technical standards for RM, Intermediates and FG.
  • Ensure compliance to P&G PHC SOPs those impacts MPD Process function. Participate in internal quality audits , its compliance & draft the response to audit observations.
  • Creation/review of technical writeup that is to be furnished to BOH in response to Deficiency letter issued.
  • Participation in stated below activities, Documentation, review of stability studies i.e. Initiation & maintenance of stability data of following types of batches.
  • To support MPD – Compliance Function in ensuring internal & external regulations in this regards.
  • Shall be responsible for review & interpretation of stability results [have sound knowledge of ICH & WHO guidelines on OOS/OOT, Stability studies]
    • Existing site to New Site Tech. Transferred products Evaluation batches, Non- commercial PV batches & commercial PV batches.
    • Savings initiatives (NSS) & Business Continuity Plan Initiatives– batches e.g. commercial PV batches/Small scale (EO) batches.

Role Requirements

  • Sound knowledge (10-14 years) of various dosage forms having expertise in handling /trouble shooting in various equipment used in commercial scale manufacturing of these dosage forms e.g. FBP granulation (Top spray, bottom spray) & Film coating, Sugar-coating tablet techniques, along with hard Gelatine capsules, Oral Liquid, Nasal & Injection [SVP]dosage form is a needed skill.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal skills, power point presentation skills, both oral and written English & Bahasa (Indonesia).
  • Agile, shall have good managerial skills, shall be a team leader and should have problem solving ability.
  • Should have a positive attitude, result oriented, competent and a good team-player with a customer Centric approach.
  • Good digital/soft skills to work in the digitized space required for technical documents' generation.
  • Good Project Management, Planning & Organizing skills.
  • Knowledge of various ICH guidelines on stability, process validation and quality & risk Management, Pharmacopoeia like IP/BP/USP, EP etc.
  • Sound knowledge of technical documentation [ pre & post Technology Transfer documentation] is required & which shall be aligned with Global Technical/quality guidelines viz, Asian, ICH, WHO. Expert in compose/review of CTD dossier quality module – Part P& Part S.

  • Master’s degree in business administration from recognized institute, would be an add-on qualification for the role.

title: Associate Director S&OP Excellence and Planning Analytics
description:
Earlier this year, Unilever announced an agreement to combine its Foods business with McCormick & Company, creating a scaled global flavour powerhouse. The proposed combination would bring together iconic Foods brands, including Hellmann’s and Knorr, with McCormick’s portfolio to create a global leader across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by strong retail and foodservice platforms. McCormick brings more than 135 years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions, with completion estimated for mid-2027.

JOB PURPOSE

This role exists to strengthen how the North America Foods business plans, decides, and delivers across demand, supply, inventory, service, cost, and business waste. As Associate Director, S&OP Excellence and Planning Analytics, you will lead the planning excellence and analytics agenda that connects business ambition with practical, reliable operating plans. You will help build a more resilient, data-driven, and collaborative supply chain that enables trusted Foods brands to serve customers and consumers with confidence. This is inclusive of planning technology, analytics, and process.

You will be part of a team that believes planning is more than a process. It is a critical way of bringing people together, making better decisions, and creating the conditions for sustainable growth.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role, you will lead the development and continuous improvement of integrated planning and sales and operations planning practices across North America Foods (Retail and Foods Solutions; US and Canada). You will partner closely with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Material Planning, Manufacturing, Finance, Customer Development, Marketing, and senior Supply Chain leaders to ensure the business has clear plans, strong governance, reporting/tools, and actionable insights to support growth, service, efficiency, and transformation.

  • Lead a team of WL1s/2s to drive the sales and operations planning excellence agenda. Ensure robust process and technology are in place to ensure demand, supply, inventory, service, cost, and financial assumptions are connected through clear business rhythms and decision-making forums.
  • Partner with integrated planning teams to identify risks, opportunities, and gaps within planning technology/process and drive improvement plans. Identify / build business cases or drive cross functional process improvement.
  • Strengthen integrated planning capability by improving processes, tools, routines, governance, and ways of working across the North America Foods planning community.
  • Lead planning performance management, including the maintenance and creation and use of clear measures, scorecards, dashboards, reports, and insights that help teams make faster and better decisions. This can include modifying existing dashboards due to new business insights
  • Drive continuous improvement, simplification, and standardization across planning processes to improve reliability, reduce complexity, and support scalable ways of working.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for Planning TSAs.
  • Support the transition to the future Foods organization by helping design, build, and embed planning capabilities that enable business continuity from day one and maturity over time.
  • Build trusted relationships across functions and levels, creating a collaborative planning culture where teams are aligned, accountable, and focused on shared outcomes.

WHAT THE FIRST YEAR LOOKS LIKE

During the first year, you will play a visible role in building planning excellence for the future North America Foods organization. You will learn the current planning landscape, connect with key partners across the business, and help establish the routines, measures, and decision-making forums needed to support business continuity and performance.

In your first few months, you will focus on understanding the end-to-end planning processes, key business priorities, current pain points, and transition requirements. You will build relationships with the planning community, data/tech teams, and cross-functional partners, assess existing tools and processes, and identify where stronger governance or simplification is needed.

As the year progresses, you will lead improvements to planning routines, performance reporting, and sales and operations planning governance. You will help teams align on clear roles, timelines, inputs, decisions, and escalation paths, while supporting capability-building across the planning organization.

By the end of the first year, you will have helped create a stronger integrated planning foundation for North America Foods, with clearer decision-making, improved planning visibility, stronger cross-functional alignment, and practical tools that support service, inventory, cost, waste reduction, and growth.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Significant experience 10y+ in integrated planning, demand planning, supply planning, business planning, supply chain transformation, or related end-to-end supply chain roles.
  • Strong understanding of sales and operations planning, forecasting, inventory management, capacity planning, supply planning, service management, and business waste reduction.
  • Experience leading cross-functional planning decisions and balancing service, inventory, cost, responsiveness, and growth priorities.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear business recommendations.
  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders and leading change in a complex, fast-moving environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to build capability, improve processes, and create practical ways of working that teams can adopt and sustain.
  • Strong understanding of planning tools and technology including back end master data.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in consumer goods, food and beverage, manufacturing, retail, or another complex supply chain environment.
  • Experience leading sales and operations planning improvements, integrated planning transformation, or planning excellence programs across multiple teams or markets.
  • Experience with advanced planning systems, enterprise resource planning systems, business intelligence tools, or planning analytics platforms.
  • Experience supporting organization transition, business separation, integration, or large-scale transformation activities.
  • Advanced degree or professional certification in supply chain, operations, planning, project management, or continuous improvement.

title: Team Leader - PowerGen
description:
Summary:

The Team Leader lead will be responsible for the personnel and product in their work center(s). They will handle personnel training, quality, safety, and continuous improvement initiatives in their area. Product and personnel status will be measured and reported on to the Production Supervisor. Team Leads are responsible to monitor and manage the completion of shop orders and operations as determined by the part number routing, ensuring operations are complete on time and at or under the allotted labor hours. They actively manage the safety culture, implement refined policies, and ensure their cells are in safe working order. They also review quality data to ensure that manufacturing quality is improving and that the MoM and work instructions are updated to reflect corrective actions.

Minimum Qualifications: (Education, Experience, Knowledge, and Skills):

  • High School Diploma, GED, or Equivalent.
  • 1 year of manufacturing experience.
  • Ability to understand and interpret mechanical and electrical drawings is required.
  • Must have organization and time management skills; this position requires the management of multiple critical tasks concurrently.
  • Ability to efficiently plan and meet project schedule deadlines, while maintaining contingency plans to preserve committed timeline.
  • Must possess an advanced understanding of workflows in production and prioritize work.
  • Capable of recognizing individual strengths and developmental needs within the team; constructs training to encourage proficiency and overall employee productivity within the cell.
  • Possess an advanced competency using ERPs in a manufacturing environment.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Team leaders will be responsible for as many as 15 operators and all shop orders within their department’s work centers.
  • Maintains accurate service records, constructs preventative maintenance plans, schedules equipment services, while mitigating unnecessary interruptions to production schedules.
  • Accurately maintain compliance of all required documentation and production reporting.
  • Must be the steward of quality: observe machine operation, technician output, identify defects, and deviations from standards. Utilize discrepancy data obtained to troubleshoot and conduct a root cause analysis; provide solutions and training to mitigate noncompliance.
  • Sets the pace of work within cell utilizing IFS routings and data to determine if expectations are met.
  • Review part number routings before beginning work, reporting issues to Production Supervisor.
  • Accurately reports schedule – on time/late/ahead of schedule.
  • Utilize forecast planning to mitigate parts shortages and ensure timely notification is sent to material handlers, preventing interruptions in production.
  • Responsible for keeping manufacturing traveler and Bus BoM/Kanban usage updated and filling in appropriate location upon job completion.
  • Accurately maintain and review worked/hours allocated to jobs, ensure reporting is precise, while preparing for contingency planning to mitigate excessive O&M expenditures.
  • Responsible for team safety and improvement of initiatives.
  • Process change request from ECOs on SO within cell.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

This position will require standing, stooping, bending, and limited lifting of up to 50lbs.

Exposure to weather, extreme heat or cold, noise intensity level, exposure to toxic or caustic chemicals, wet and/or humid, vibration, proximity to moving mechanical parts.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of the position. All employees may have other duties assigned at any time.

description:

At Molson Coors, we tackle big challenges and defy the status quo. Here’s to crafting careers and creating new legacies.

In the role of Sr. Engagement Coordinator in Fort Worth, Texas you will serve as the Engagement Coordinator that leads employee engagement, internal communications, community relations, and brewery events. This role works closely with the Sr. Manager, Human Resources, and brewery leadership team to develop and execute communication strategies, cultivate positive employee experience, support volunteer and community initiatives, and drive programs that strengthen brewery culture and community engagement. This role will operate onsite at our Fort Worth Brewery.

You will play a key role in shaping the employee experience at our Fort Worth Brewery by leading engagement initiatives, supporting internal communications, coordinating community partnerships, and executing programs that connect employees to our business, our brands, and one another. This role requires a highly organized and proactive professional who can effectively manage multiple priorities, build relationships across all levels of the organization, and deliver exceptional experiences for employees and community stakeholders alike.

  • Lead internal brewery communications, campaigns, announcements, and messaging to enhance employee engagement and organizational alignment.

  • Develop and distribute communications across multiple channels, including digital signage, presentations, leadership messages, employee communications, and site-wide campaigns.
  • Lead the planning and execution of brewery events, celebrations, recognition programs, and employee engagement initiatives, including communications, logistics, budgeting, and vendor management.
  • Manage internal and external event planning requirements, including vendor coordination, permitting, volunteer management, and participant communications.
  • Attend leadership and operational meetings and support initiatives that align with brewery objectives, priorities, and World Class Supply Chain principles.

  • You have a Bachelor’s degree OR equivalent experience (5+ years) in the field communications, employee engagement, event planning, community relations, human resources, or a related field.
  • Experience managing project budgets and external vendor relationships.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and Teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging for diverse audiences.

  • Ability to establish credibility and build trusted partnerships with employees, leaders, community organizations, and external partners.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and event coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to identify opportunities, solve problems, and drive execution.

  • Self-starter with strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.
  • Demonstrated ability to foster employee engagement and cultivate a positive workplace culture.
  • You love a challenge. You complete complex projects quickly and adeptly with your understanding of the business priorities
  • You build relationships and collaborate to get to the desired outcome

title: Fulfillment Technician
description:
Knoxville, Tennessee, United States of America

Extraordinary Care. Extraordinary Careers.

With one of the nation’s largest, most innovative long-term care pharmacy services providers, there is no limit to the growth of your career.

East Tennessee Pharmacy Services, a member of the Guardian family of pharmacies, has an exciting opportunity for you to join our rapidly growing team in Knoxville, Tennessee.

Why East Tennessee Pharmacy Services? We’re reimagining medication management and transforming care.

Who We Are and What We’re About:

Our core focus is delivering customized medication management solutions to support healthcare organizations serving seniors and individuals with complex care needs. With our comprehensive suite of tech-enabled pharmacy services and a dedicated team of professionals committed to enriching the lives of those we serve, we are redefining how pharmacy care is delivered.

We offer an opportunity to learn and grow your career in a fast-paced, diverse, and inclusive environment. If you are looking for a challenging, team-oriented environment in which you can put your expertise to work, then this is the place for you.

Come join our growing team and learn how to operate some of the most cutting-edge pharmacy technology! No experience required; training provided!


Details:

  • Schedule: Rotating shifts Monday-Friday 10am-7pm
  • This role will be performed onsite at a closed-door pharmacy in Knoxville, TN
  • Must have a valid TN pharmacy technician license.

We Offer:

  • Opportunities to learn how to operate pharmacy automation equipment, such as Parata.
  • Comprehensive training provided side by side with the training team.
  • We offer full benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Dental, Life Insurance, and a matching 401K option.
  • Competitive hourly pay.

Under the supervision of a Registered Pharmacist, the Fulfillment Pharmacy Technician I is responsible for the filling and packaging of prescriptions in an accurate and timely manner for delivery to our customers.

Attributes:
• Work Ethic/Integrity – must possess intrinsic drive to excel coupled with values in line with company philosophy
• Strategy and Planning – ability to think ahead, plan and manage time efficiently
• Problem Solving – ability to analyze causes and solve problems at both a strategic and functional level
• Team Oriented – ability to work effectively and collaboratively with all team members

Essential Job Functions (include the following):

  • Prepare prescription orders by verifying information and pulling appropriate prescriptions from inventory.
  • Apply labels to medication packaging, scan and assemble into appropriate bins in an accurate and timely manner.
  • Alert pharmacist on duty of any medication that is not scanning properly.
  • Participate in training and development activities to gain proficiency in other Fulfillment workflow areas.
  • Communicate inventory needs to ensure adequate supply of medication available to complete all orders.
  • Assist in maintaining inventory at appropriate levels, including removing expired or unused meds, marking used bottles and keeping inventory neat and arranged in-order. May assist in physical inventory.
  • Consistently meet pharmacy's established accuracy and productivity levels.
  • Work collaboratively with other supervisors/functional areas to keep work flowing smoothly and efficiently.
  • Maintain clean and orderly workstation. Put medications away and replenish all stock supplies needed.
  • Comply with local, state, and federal laws, regulations, and policies pertaining to the dispensing of prescription medications.
  • Other essential functions and duties may be assigned as needed

Education and Certifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED (per state requirements)
  • Pharmacy Technician license/certification/registration (per state requirements); National Certification preferred (PTCB)


Skills and Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of related experience (technical knowledge/skills may substitute for experience)
  • Basic computer skills required
  • Ability to work independently and deliver to deadlines
  • Great attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment working on multiple tasks simultaneously, while adhering to strict deadlines
  • Quality minded; motivated to seek out errors and inquire about inaccuracies


Work Environment:
• Ability to work flexible hours

What We Offer:

Guardian provides employees with a comprehensive Total Rewards package, supporting our core value of, “Treat others as you would like to be treated.”

Compensation & Financial

  • Competitive pay
  • 401(k) with company match

Family, Health & Insurance Benefits (Full-Time employees working 30+ hours/week only)

  • Medical, Dental and Vision
  • Health Savings Accounts and Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Company-paid Basic Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment
  • Company-paid Long-Term Disability and optional Short-Term Disability
  • Voluntary Employee and Dependent Life, Accident and Critical Illness
  • Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts

Wellbeing

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Guardian Angels (Employee assistance fund)

Time Off

  • Paid holidays and sick days
  • Generous vacation benefits based on years of service

The Guardian Difference

Our clients require pharmacy services that aren’t “cookie cutter.” That’s why every Guardian pharmacy is locally operated and empowered with the autonomy to tailor their business to meet their clients’ needs.

Our corporate support offices, based in Atlanta, Ga., provide services such as human resources, business intelligence, legal, and marketing to promote the success of each Guardian location.

Regardless of your role at Guardian, your voice and talents matter. Because healthcare is an ever-changing industry, we encourage innovative thinking, intellectual curiosity, and diverse viewpoints to ensure we stay competitive in today’s dynamic business environment.

At Guardian, we are dedicated to fostering and advancing a diverse and inclusive workforce.

Join us to discover what your best work truly looks like.

title: Global Manufacturing Data & OT Engineer - Scent
description:
Job Summary

Ready to help accelerate digital transformation across IFF's global Scent manufacturing network?

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients, health & biosciences, and specialty solutions. We combine science, creativity, and innovation to create products that enrich everyday life.


Digital Transformation: Enabling smarter, more connected operations through data, technology, and digital solutions that drive business performance and operational excellence.

Why Choose Us?

We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.

title: District Manager - Greater San Francisco Bay Area
location: Greater San Francisco, California, United States
description:
Great Brands – Bigger Purpose

Part of Chile-based Viña Concha y Toro, the leading wine producer in Latin America and one of the world's largest wine companies, Viña Concha y Toro USA (VCT-USA) is a premier U.S. wine marketer and the nation's leading importer of South American wines. Our diverse portfolio features acclaimed brands from California, Chile, and Argentina, including Bonterra, Casillero del Diablo, Don Melchor, Fetzer, Frontera, Ranch Wine, Trivento, and 1000 Stories.

A Certified B Corporation, Bonterra Organic Estates—our Hopland, California-based winery—strives to lead the industry in sustainability through our commitments to regenerative farming, renewable energy, and circular packaging. Located in Mendocino County, our California operations include winemaking, production, and approximately 830 acres of estate vineyards dedicated to crafting exceptional wines while advancing environmental stewardship and social responsibility.

As District Manager based in the Greater San Francisco Bay Area, you will be responsible for growing the VCT-USA portfolio across independent retail, on-premise accounts, and chains. In this role, you will be responsible for driving performance, distribution and market share with primary focus on North Bay—Sonoma, Napa, Mendocino counties—as well as east to Sacramento. This role is primarily sales‑ and activation‑focused, executing key initiatives to strengthen customer relationships and support commercial growth. This role influences results through effective communication, collaboration, and field execution. You will report to the Regional Manager.

This remote, home office-based role entails extensive driving within the field in order visit accounts, do work withs and attend distributor meetings. Overnight travel will be approximately 10%-15%.

If you are a motivated sales professional who excels at building relationships, identifying opportunities, delivering results, and eager to be active in the market three to five days per week developing customer relationships, driving sales initiatives, and working alongside distributor partners, then we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accountable for market-level sales activation and driving key brand programs.
  • Build strong relationships with top retail accounts, local chains, retail buyers and on-premise decision-makers to identify key selling opportunities.
  • Develop strong relationships with distributor teams to multiply efforts and gain share of mind.
  • Coordinate market work-withs, surveys, and sales blitzes with distributor teams.
  • Provide daily/weekly market performance recaps and identify execution gaps to distributor and VCT-USA management.
  • Achieve assigned sales, distribution, depletion, and market share objectives.
  • Develop target account lists and execution plans to drive distribution and sales growth.
  • Present sales programs, pricing initiatives, promotional opportunities, and brand priorities to customers and distributor partners.
  • Monitor account execution, including pricing, distribution, merchandising, displays, cold box placements, menu placements, and promotional compliance.
  • Utilize CRM systems, reporting tools, and sales analytics to identify opportunities and monitor performance.

Annual Business Planning

  • Accountable for market activation and KPIs within assigned area of responsibility.
  • Develop and execute annual and quarterly territory business plans.

Depletions

  • Execute all confirmed chain/brand programs applicable to assigned territory.

title: Lead Consultant - Cybersecurity Commissioning, Verification & Validation
description:
A WORLD LEADER IN TESTING, INSPECTION & CERTIFICATION SERVICES

Bureau Veritas offers dynamic, exciting employment opportunities with an attractive salary/benefit package and an opportunity to play a vital role with a global organization. If you would enjoy working in a dynamic environment and are looking for an opportunity to become part of a stellar team of professionals, we invite you to apply online today.

Bureau Veritas is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and as such we recruit, hire, train, and promote persons in all job classifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetics, status as a protected veteran, or any other non-job-related characteristics.

This position is responsible to ensure equal opportunity in employment in that all persons are treated equally and on the basis of merit, in decisions regarding selection, placement, promotions, training, work assignments, transfers and other personnel actions.

City: Remote

State: Remote


Job Summary:

The Lead Consultant, Cybersecurity Commissioning, Verification & Validation is a senior technical delivery role responsible for executing and leading cybersecurity commissioning, verification, validation, and assurance activities across industrial and cyber-physical environments.

The role focuses primarily on delivery. The individual will lead technical assessments, develop and execute verification procedures, review engineering and cybersecurity evidence, perform field and remote validation activities, document findings, support remediation, and ensure cybersecurity requirements are implemented and operating as intended.

The Lead Consultant works directly with client engineering, operations, commissioning, construction, security, system integrators, OEMs, and other project stakeholders to integrate cybersecurity verification into the broader engineering and commissioning lifecycle.

The role requires a practical understanding of operational technology, industrial control systems, cybersecurity architecture, commissioning practices, and technical assurance. The individual must be capable of translating cybersecurity requirements and design intent into executable test procedures, objective evidence, technical findings, and actionable remediation.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Cybersecurity Commissioning Leadership

  • Lead cybersecurity commissioning activities for new and existing industrial and cyber-physical environments.
  • Translate cybersecurity requirements, specifications, standards, and design requirements into executable commissioning and verification procedures.
  • Develop commissioning plans, verification checklists, test scripts, evidence requirements, and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate cybersecurity commissioning activities with broader engineering, construction, integration, and operational readiness activities.
  • Verify that cybersecurity requirements have been implemented as intended prior to operational acceptance.
  • Identify incomplete, incorrectly implemented, or unverified cybersecurity requirements and document associated technical risks.
  • Support retesting and closure of commissioning findings following remediation.
  • Maintain clear traceability between cybersecurity requirements, verification activities, evidence, findings, remediation, and closure.

Verification & Validation

  • Lead cybersecurity verification and validation activities across OT and cyber-physical systems.
  • Validate implemented cybersecurity controls against design documentation, specifications, approved architectures, client requirements, and applicable standards.
  • Perform technical verification through configuration review, evidence inspection, system observation, targeted testing, and stakeholder walkthroughs.
  • Evaluate whether implemented controls are technically effective and appropriate for the operational environment.
  • Identify differences between documented design, configured implementation, and actual operating conditions.
  • Develop structured V&V test procedures with defined objectives, prerequisites, test steps, expected results, evidence requirements, and acceptance criteria.
  • Maintain accurate validation records and supporting evidence throughout execution.
  • Support regression or repeat validation following system changes and remediation activities.

Technical Delivery Leadership

  • Lead the technical execution of cybersecurity commissioning and V&V engagements from planning through final reporting.
  • Review system architecture, network diagrams, control narratives, security requirements, configuration documentation, asset information, and other engineering artifacts.
  • Identify technical prerequisites and evidence required before commissioning and validation activities begin.
  • Coordinate execution with client representatives, engineering teams, system integrators, OEMs, and other responsible parties.
  • Track technical findings, outstanding evidence, dependencies, retesting requirements, and remediation status.
  • Escalate technical risks and execution blockers that may affect cybersecurity readiness or completion of validation activities.
  • Ensure technical findings are supported by objective evidence and clearly communicated.
  • Produce technically rigorous commissioning records, validation reports, findings, and final deliverables.
  • Support effort estimation, resource planning, and scheduling for assigned engagements.

Industrial Control Systems Expertise

  • Apply practical knowledge of industrial and operational technology environments, including:
  • PLC-based control systems
  • Distributed Control Systems (DCS)
  • SCADA systems
  • Building Management and Building Automation Systems (BMS/BAS)
  • Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS)
  • Industrial networks
  • Field devices and intelligent electronic devices
  • Engineering workstations and operator interfaces
  • Historians, application servers, and supporting infrastructure
  • Understand industrial network architectures, segmentation, zones and conduits, firewalls, remote access, communications paths, and security boundaries.
  • Assess cybersecurity controls without unnecessarily disrupting operational or safety-critical systems.
  • Understand the interaction between cybersecurity controls, system availability, engineering requirements, operational constraints, and functional safety.

Cybersecurity Control Validation

Lead and perform validation activities covering areas including:

  • Network segmentation and security boundaries
  • Firewall and access-control implementation
  • Secure remote access
  • Identity and access management
  • Privileged access
  • Authentication and authorization
  • System and device hardening
  • Secure configuration
  • Unnecessary services and communications
  • Patch and vulnerability management
  • Backup and recovery
  • Logging and monitoring
  • Endpoint security
  • Security monitoring integration
  • Time synchronization
  • Configuration and change management
  • Engineering workstation security
  • Application and server security
  • Physical and logical access controls
  • Asset inventory and system documentation
  • Cybersecurity recovery readiness

Engineering & Field Validation

  • Conduct on-site and remote validation activities within industrial and cyber-physical environments.
  • Validate security controls against actual system configurations rather than relying solely on documentation or questionnaire responses.
  • Review configurations and supporting artifacts necessary to demonstrate control implementation.
  • Work safely within live, operational, pre-operational, and commissioning environments.
  • Coordinate testing activities to minimize potential impact to production, availability, safety, or system functionality.
  • Recognize when a cybersecurity test could introduce operational risk and establish an appropriate validation approach.
  • Support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis when controls cannot be successfully validated.
  • Clearly distinguish between verified controls, partially verified controls, failed validation, and controls that cannot be tested because prerequisites or evidence are unavailable.

Findings, Remediation & Closure

  • Develop clear technical findings supported by objective evidence.
  • Translate validation failures into practical remediation actions for engineering, integration, cybersecurity, and operations teams.
  • Differentiate between design issues, implementation issues, configuration issues, documentation gaps, and operational readiness issues.
  • Support technical discussions with responsible stakeholders to determine practical remediation approaches.
  • Validate remediation through targeted retesting and evidence review.
  • Maintain traceability of findings through remediation and closure.
  • Identify residual risks that cannot be resolved through technical remediation and support appropriate escalation.

Standards & Methodology

  • Apply relevant cybersecurity standards, practices and guidelines to commissioning and verification activities, including:
  • ISA/IEC 62443 (2-1, 3-3, 3-2, 4-2)
  • NIST SP 800-82
  • ISA84.00.09 v3 (2024)
  • PLC Top 20 Secure Programming Practices
  • Client cybersecurity requirements and engineering standards
  • Applicable regulatory and sector-specific requirements
  • Cyber-informed engineering principles
  • Translate standards and cybersecurity requirements into practical, testable engineering controls.
  • Contribute to development and improvement of repeatable commissioning and V&V methodologies, procedures, checklists, templates, and technical guidance.
  • Support consistency in how evidence is collected, findings are documented, and controls are validated across engagements.

Tools, Lab & Technical Capability

  • Use appropriate technical tools to support cybersecurity verification and validation activities.
  • Support development of representative laboratory environments for validation of test procedures and methodologies.
  • Test commissioning procedures in controlled environments before applying them to sensitive operational systems where appropriate.
  • Help evaluate technical tools and approaches used for OT cybersecurity validation.
  • Contribute lessons learned from engagements into reusable testing procedures and internal technical guidance.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide technical guidance to consultants and engineers supporting commissioning and V&V engagements.
  • Review test procedures, evidence, findings, and technical deliverables prepared by other team members.
  • Help junior team members understand industrial systems, commissioning methodology, validation techniques, and safe testing practices.
  • Promote strong engineering discipline, evidence-based validation, safety awareness, and structured problem solving.
  • Support consistent documntation and reporting practices across engagements.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No supervisory responsibilities

Skills

The requirements listed below are representative of acquired skills required.

Operational Technology (OT) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS):

  • In-depth knowledge of PLC-based control systems, Distributed Control Systems (DCS), SCADA systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), industrial networks, and field devices.
  • Understanding of industrial network architectures, segmentation, zones and conduits, firewalls, remote access, and security boundaries.

Cybersecurity Standards and Frameworks:

  • Familiarity with ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, ISA84.00.09 v3 (2024), and PLC Top 20 Secure Programming Practices.
  • Ability to translate standards and cybersecurity requirements into practical, testable engineering controls.

Cybersecurity Control Validation:

  • Expertise in validating network segmentation, firewall and access-control implementation, secure remote access, identity and access management, system and device hardening, patch and vulnerability management, logging and monitoring, and endpoint security.

Verification & Validation (V&V) Methodologies:

  • Ability to develop structured V&V test procedures with defined objectives, prerequisites, test steps, expected results, evidence requirements, and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience in conducting on-site and remote validation activities within industrial and cyber-physical environments.

Tools and Lab Environments:

  • Proficiency in using technical tools to support cybersecurity verification and validation activities.
  • Experience in developing representative laboratory environments for validation of test procedures and methodologies.

Industry-Specific Knowledge:

  • Industrial and Cyber-Physical Environments
  • Practical experience working with industrial control systems and associated infrastructure.
  • Experience in industrial or OT commissioning, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and systems integration.

Competency

The requirements listed below are competencies required to perform the job successfully.

Communication:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to clearly document findings, develop remediation recommendations, and communicate technical information to non-technical stakeholders.

Team Leadership & Mentorship:

  • Ability to provide technical guidance to consultants and engineers, review technical deliverables, and mentor junior team members.
  • Promotion of strong engineering discipline, evidence-based validation, safety awareness, and structured problem-solving.

Problem-Solving:

  • Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills to identify and address implementation gaps and technical issues.

Attention to Detail:

  • Strong attention to technical detail to ensure accurate validation of cybersecurity controls and documentation of findings.

Safety-First Approach:

  • Demonstrated commitment to safety when working with operational systems and in industrial environments.

Project Management:

  • Ability to manage multiple technical workstreams and dependencies, and support effort estimation, resource planning, and scheduling for assigned engagements.

Education, Certifications, and Experience (required)

  • 7+ years of relevant experience across operational technology, industrial automation, control systems engineering, industrial cybersecurity, commissioning, systems integration, systems or component validation, engineering assurance, or related cyber-physical environments.
  • Practical experience working with industrial control systems and associated infrastructure.
  • Experience executing technical testing, commissioning, verification, validation, assurance, or system acceptance activities.
  • Experience working directly with technical teams in industrial, critical infrastructure, data center, manufacturing, utility, Oil & Gas, or comparable operational environments.
  • Experience reviewing engineering documentation, architecture diagrams, system configurations, technical requirements, and implementation evidence.
  • Experience documenting technical findings and developing practical remediation recommendations.
  • Ability to develop structured test procedures and objectively determine whether requirements have been successfully implemented.
  • Understanding of industrial cybersecurity architecture and security control implementation.
  • Familiarity with relevant cybersecurity standards, practices and guidelines, including:
  • ISA/IEC 62443 (2-1, 3-3, 3-2, 4-2)
  • NIST SP 800-82
  • ISA84.00.09 v3 (2024)
  • PLC Top 20 Secure Programming Practices
  • Cyber-informed engineering principles
  • Understanding of how cybersecurity activities interact with engineering, construction, integration, commissioning, operations, and system lifecycle processes.
  • Ability to travel to client sites as required for commissioning and validation activities.

title: SVP, Head of AI Solutions Technology
description:
Role Summary/Purpose:


Help Synchrony accelerate responsible AI adoption and deliver measurable business impact by leading the technology capability that transforms prioritized business-unit AI use cases into advanced solutions. As SVP, Head of AI Solutions Technology, you will oversee delivery across multiple programs, lead AI initiatives from concept to real adoption, and ensure AI solutions accelerate transformation across business units and functions.

Reporting to the Chief AI Officer, you will lead a team of AI experts responsible for designing and delivering capabilities for high-priority enterprise programs. You will partner closely with the AI leadership and teams across product, engineering, data, architecture, security, risk, legal, compliance, and the business to translate opportunities into executable technical roadmaps and durable technology outcomes.

You are a hands-on technical leader with deep AI expertise, strong software engineering experience, and the ability to lead through complexity. You can engage directly with business units, analyze workflows, understand business goals and transformation plans, design target-state architectures centered on agentic AI, and drive responsible AI delivery.

This role enables the Chief AI Officer to translate Synchrony’s strategy for embedding generative AI into business workflows into disciplined execution and advanced agentic AI solutions. The SVP, Head of AI Solutions Technology, will provide the technical leadership and delivery discipline required to move priority use cases from concept through implementation and initial adoption.


Essential Responsibilities:


  • Lead AI solutions technology across strategic business-unit and enterprise use cases, managing technical leads and delivery teams across multiple concurrent programs to deliver secure and scalable AI solutions.
  • Serve as a hands-on technical leader for complex AI designs, including solution architecture, model integration, data flows, APIs, workflow automation, agentic patterns, evaluation strategies and observability.
  • Translate prioritized AI opportunities into executable roadmaps, delivery plans, and technical milestones aligned to business-unit outcomes, enterprise priorities, and responsible AI guardrails.
  • Establish and enforce AgenticAI development standards to be used across the enterprise
  • Partner with architecture, cybersecurity, data, infrastructure, platform, risk, legal, compliance, privacy, and model governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet enterprise control, resiliency, auditability, and responsible AI expectations.
  • Lead design reviews and technical decision forums for major AI initiatives, ensuring teams make sound tradeoffs across build-versus-buy, model selection, integration patterns, scalability, latency, cost, maintainability, and risk.
  • Build reusable AI assets, services, shared components, reference architectures, implementation playbooks, and delivery patterns that reduce cycle time and improve consistency across AI programs.
  • Develop and grow high-performing AI technology talent, including hiring, coaching, succession planning, performance management, technical mentorship, and creation of a culture of excellence.
  • Drive disciplined execution across Agile delivery teams, ensuring clear ownership, transparent progress, active risk management, strong dependency coordination, and rapid escalation of blockers.
  • Partner with the product and business leaders to clarify requirements, identify feasibility constraints, define success metrics, and ensure AI solutions are designed for adoption, usability, and measurable value.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, platforms, and vendors, and recommend practical adoption paths that strengthen Synchrony’s AI technology capability while managing risk and complexity
  • Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.

Required Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline and 12+ years of software engineering, data engineering, machine learning or AI
  • Proven track record leading tech organizations or multi-team technical programs delivering complex, enterprise-scale technology solutions.
  • Hands-on Experience with modern AI application patterns, including RAG, agentic workflows, model orchestration, evaluation frameworks, LLMOps/MLOps, vector search, and AI platform capabilities.
  • Ability to operate amid ambiguity, rapidly evolving AI technology, and competing enterprise priorities while maintaining technical quality, team focus, and delivery momentum.
  • Deep software engineering experience across architecture, APIs, cloud-native delivery, data integration.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical design work, make architecture tradeoffs, partner with enterprise architecture teams, and communicate technical decisions clearly to senior leaders and delivery teams.
  • Experience managing technical leads, AI engineers and/or data scientists, including staffing, prioritization, performance management, coaching, standards, and talent development.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to explain complex AI topics, risks, tradeoffs, costs, and delivery implications in clear business language.
  • Experience operating in Agile with strong delivery management, dependency coordination, and cross-functional execution discipline.
  • Experience building internal AI platforms, reusable components, or accelerators that improve delivery speed and consistency across teams.
  • Ability and flexibility to travel for business as required

Desired Qualifications:


  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.
  • Understanding of responsible AI, model risk, data privacy, cybersecurity, legal, compliance, auditability, access controls, and operational risk considerations relevant to AI systems in a regulated environment.
  • Experience leading AI engineering in financial services, banking, payments, credit, risk, fraud, servicing, marketing, operations, or another highly regulated domain.
  • Experience managing technology vendors, cloud providers, AI platforms, consulting partners, or shared engineering resources, including scope, delivery, cost, quality, and operational accountability.

Grade/Level: 15

title: Lab Generalist I (Overnight Shift)
description:
We understand that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today, and that’s why we’re inspired to make A Better World for Pets. Antech is comprised of a diverse team of individuals who are committed to each other’s growth and development. Our culture is centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom. Current Associates will need to apply through the internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on Menu or View All Apps, select the Jobs Hub app, then click the magnifying glass to Browse Jobs.

Work Shift: 2am - 10:30am Tuesday–Sunday, With Two Scheduled Days Off Each Week. Weekend Coverage Is Required.

The Specific Days Worked May Vary Based On Business Needs.


The Target Pay for this position is $18.80 an hour. At Antech, pay decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, education, training and budget.

PURPOSE OF JOB:

The Laboratory Generalist 1 receives and prepares samples for laboratory analysis and tests, sets up instruments, runs tests and reads, interprets, and releases results.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential function. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential function.

  • Receives and prepares samples for laboratory analysis or sends out tests
  • Performs startup and required maintenance on analyzers
  • Perform all required quality control per Quality Assurance guidelines.
  • Train in all areas according to all Standard Operating Practices.
  • Enter and release results.
  • Participates in improving lab efficiency, quality, and cooperation
  • Participate in all departmental training programs.
  • Reconcile pending list.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

We share a collaborative obligation to ensure that we conduct ourselves in the utmost ethical manner and that we hold each other accountable to the values and standards of the organization. Every Associate is responsible for asking questions, seeking guidance, and reporting concerns and/or violations of company policy or ethical standards. Antech Diagnostics has several processes in place to communicate with leadership and expects that Associates will have a commitment to integrity and uncompromising values.


EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

  • High school diploma or equivalent, 2- or 4-year degree in science-related field preferred.
  • Prior lab experience preferred

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, and ABILITIES

  • Laboratory skills and experience
  • General science background

  • Attention to detail and ability to work independently
  • Organized with the ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • The ability to communicate information so others will understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.
  • Personal computer skills, strong typing ability, and knowledge of Microsoft Office

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Stationary Position- must be able to remain in a stationary position for up to 2 hours.
  • Constantly operates a computer and other lab equipment accurately and efficiently.
  • Occasionally required to bend, kneel, stoop, or crouch
  • May be required to lift, move, and carry up to 50 lbs.
  • Heavy microscopic work
  • The ability to observe details at close range
  • Proficiency in the English language which allows for participation in team meetings, accurate entry of data into company systems and understanding of written directions.
  • Extended hours may be needed
  • Laboratory environments with potential biohazards present that are mitigated by the mandatory use of PPE.
  • Work under close to moderate supervision
  • Potential for exposure to agents known to cause zoonotic disease in humans and use of potentially hazardous chemicals as defined by the National Hazard Communication Standards. A complete list of such chemicals is available from department supervision.

About Antech

Antech is a leader in veterinary diagnostics, driven by our passion for innovation that delivers better animal health outcomes. Our products and services span 90+ reference laboratories around the globe; in-house diagnostic laboratory instruments and consumables, including rapid assay diagnostic products and digital cytology services; local and cloud-based data services; practice information management software and related software and support; veterinary imaging and technology; veterinary professional education and training; and board-certified specialist support services.

Benefits

Benefits eligiblity is based on employment status.

  • Paid Time Off & Holidays

title: Senior Frontend Developer – Digital Archiving Access Team
description:
As the living, growing home of our national story, The National Archives is a special place to work. We’re an institution nearly 200 years old with a collection spanning 1,000 years of history.


We’ve set ourselves the challenge of becoming the 21st Century national archive - a different kind of cultural and heritage institution: Inclusive, Entrepreneurial, Disruptive. We won’t become this overnight. It will take time, focus, effort and daring.


That’s where you come in. Because we can’t do this without you.

Job Overview

Recruitment Stage: External

Salary: £60,000 per annum (£57,354 plus £2,646 market supplement)

Contract type: Permanent

Band: F / SEO

Closing date: 18th November 2026 at midnight


Help people find the evidence they need.

Join The National Archives’ Digital Archiving team to build and run services that open government and court records for everyone. Our Access to Digital Records products increase transparency and support open justice, while setting best practice for access to digital records.

What you’ll work on:

• Access Your Records (AYR) – secure, self service access for government departments to born digital records transferred to The National Archives (currently in private Beta).
• Find Case Law (FCL) – the public site for judgments and tribunal decisions, including data feeds under an innovative licensing approach—an important step towards open justice.

Both services are growing: AYR is moving beyond MVP, and FCL is expanding with richer metadata and new publishing workflows. Your work will help us scale features while keeping services robust and secure.

What you’ll do:

• Own and deliver frontend features across AYR and FCL—set technical direction, write high quality code, and work with external suppliers when needed.

• Operate production services—monitor, troubleshoot, and improve resilience, robustness and stability.
• Coach and mentor developers; line manage a junior colleague.
• Champion secure engineering and consistent standards; contribute to code reviews and quality practices.
• Stay curious and share—engage with the wider dev community, evaluate new technologies, and help colleagues keep up with digital preservation developments.

What you’ll bring:

• Strong experience delivering server side rendered accessible interfaces (WCAG 2.2 AA)

• Strong web fundamentals (HTML, CSS/SASS, JavaScript) with an “open by default” mindset that makes reuse easy through components, design systems etc.
• Comprehensive approach to testing new features and bug fixes and delivering in an AGILE team

• Good knowledge of common frontend security vulnerabilities and how to mitigate them.

• Experience operating live services and explaining complex systems clearly to others.

Nice to have:

• Working to the Government Digital Service Standard.

• Understanding of python web frameworks such as Django and Flask


Working here:

• Hybrid working: We typically ask colleagues to be on site around 60% of the time—especially early on—so you can meet users and teammates.

• Security: SC clearance (or willingness to obtain) is required. This requires candidates to have been resident in the UK for at least the past three years. (Please do not apply if you have been resident in the UK for less than three years as your application will be rejected).
• Inclusive culture: We’re committed to improving the diversity of our workforce and warmly encourage applications from under represented groups

This is a full time post. However, requests for part-time working, flexible working and job share will be considered, taking into account at all times the operational needs of the Department.


APPLICATION PROCESS:

• Please submit your work history and a short statement highlighting relevant projects (links welcome). If you’ve built open source tools or public services, we’d love to see them.

• Interview: Interviews will be held on-site and will include a technical test

Selection for interview will be based on the ‘essential’ requirements as listed below so please make sure that your work history and your statement provide evidence for each of the criteria.

Essential criteria
• A strong track record of delivering production-quality, server-side rendered frontends with deep knowledge of HTML, CSS (including preprocessors such as Sass), JavaScript and templating, building services that work without JavaScript and layering enhancements on top
• Experience designing and optimising performant web interfaces, with a strong understanding of browser and network fundamentals (for example HTTP, caching, cookies, headers and the same-origin policy), and how HTML, CSS and JavaScript affect page load times, rendering, responsiveness and user-perceived performance.
• Experience building interfaces that meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines at level AA, tested with assistive technologies, using a design system (such as the GOV.UK Design System) or shared components and patterns
• A good understanding of common web security risks and how to prevent them (for example cross-site scripting and cross-site request forgery), with experience implementing security controls in services where security matters, ideally those that handle sensitive or personal data
• Experience of automated testing at several levels (for example unit, integration, visual, accessibility and performance tests), choosing tests that catch real problems rather than just covering code, balancing confidence against speed, and working with continuous integration and delivery in an agile team
• Experience keeping a codebase easy to change by applying and enforcing frontend standards and conventions (for example from GOV.UK, MDN or an agreed house style), through linting and formatting configuration, code review and refactoring, and building and documenting reusable component libraries (with tools such as Storybook) and driving adoption across teams or products
• Experience coaching or mentoring other developers, formally or informally, with a clear interest in developing people, giving constructive feedback, supporting technical growth, and sharing knowledge across teams.
• Experience making sound technical decisions, weighing trade-offs and explaining the reasoning clearly to different audiences, working closely with designers, user researchers and product managers, and acting as a frontend expert who collaborates with peers beyond their own team

Desirable criteria
• Experience line managing developers, including setting objectives, holding regular one-to-ones, and supporting performance and progression
• Experience with a Python web framework such as Django or Flask, or a willingness to learn quickly
• Experience working to the GOV.UK Service Standard
• Experience operating production services, monitoring systems and responding to incidents
• Experience with search or large information content-heavy services
• Familiarity with cloud-hosted and containerised deployment

(Desirable criteria will only be used in the event of tied candidates during the selection process)

Artificial intelligence
Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action.

Job Description

You will deliver and integrate software to form complete services within the Access to Digital Records team, which is part of the Digital Archiving department. The Access to Digital Records team provides services for access to government records and court records, supporting people to find the evidence that they need. These important information services increase transparency of how the government and the courts make decisions which shape people’s lives, as well as developing archival best practice in providing access to digital records.


We currently have two products in active development. The Access Your Records service provides secure, self-service access to government departments and other bodies to born-digital records that have been transferred to The National Archives. It is currently in its private Beta phase. [link Brief]

The Find Case Law service () provides public access to court judgments and tribunal decisions. It provides case law as data via an atom feed under an innovative licensing regime. It is an important step towards open justice and transparency of the justice system.

The Access to Digital Records team is committed to improving and developing these products, as well as developing or enhancing additional services to facilitate better access to digital records.

Working closely with the Lead Developer, you will plan and lead frontend development on sets of related stories across our products, including the Access Your Records service and the Find Case Law service.

As a Senior Frontend Developer, you will have a deep understanding of our frontend and how it fits with the services behind it and take responsibility for teaching frontend patterns, standards and accessibility practice. You will work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams, coach and mentor more junior colleagues, and support what you ship in production while continuously finding ways to improve frontend quality; performance, accessibility, security and maintainability.

This role would suit someone who is motivated to increase access to public digital records, who thinks hard about how the technological landscape is changing, enjoys working in agile teams, and wants to take ownership of significant technical deliverables while developing their leadership skills.


Role and Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain accessible, performant, progressively enhanced user interfaces following the GOV.UK Design System and our own design systems, to serve a variety of citizen and government needs, taking responsibility for the quality of the code produced and making sure it follows agreed standards
  • Complete features end-to-end, design and implement automated testing plans to help the team deliver with confidence, and champion accessibility, making sure services meet the current Web Content Accessibility Guidelines at level AA and are tested with assistive technologies
  • Develop and expand our own shared component libraries, so that components are documented, tested and reused consistently across products
  • Own and evolve frontend standards and tooling across all products, including code linting and formatting configuration aligned to government and organisational standards, testing practices, and continuous integration and delivery
  • Take ownership of frontend security, performance and maintainability, working with backend developers and the wider security function to protect sensitive data
  • Evaluate and recommend relevant software technologies and products, so that the organisation gains optimum benefit from technological advances
  • Act as the team’s frontend expert, advising on patterns and approaches, helping to prioritise and direct technical work, and acting as a sounding board for the Lead Developer on frontend decisions, capability and standards
  • Mentor and coach developers, leading by example in code review and pair programming
  • Line manage a more junior developer in the team, with support from the Lead Developer; agree goals for continuous self-improvement, hold regular one-to-ones, give constructive feedback and support their progression
  • Work closely with designers, user researchers, backend developers, key stakeholders and external suppliers where needed, turning prototypes and research findings into working software that meets the needs of users, the business and the organisation’s digital strategy
  • Act as a digital ambassador across the organisation and wider government by collaborating with developers in other teams and departments, contributing improvements and components back to shared design systems, identifying good practices for the organisation to adopt, supporting recruitment, and sharing experience, for example through blog posts and technical talks
  • Support production services during working hours as part of the in-house support rota by triaging alerts, issues with CI/CD, and investigating and fixing bugs

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is
found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service
D&I Strategy.

Benefits

Generous benefits package, including pension, sports and social club facilities, onsite gym, discounted rates at our on-site cafe and opportunities for training and development. Annual leave entitlement of 22 days per calendar year (rising to 25 after the first year, and incrementally to 30 days after six years) and 10½ days public and privilege holidays per annum.

​

Security

Nationality requirements

title: Senior Principal Compliance Specialist, Ethics & Investigations
description:
WHY MOBILITY GLOBAL?

At Mobility Global, our mission is to provide the trusted information that helps billions of people build, sell, and own vehicles with confidence. As we shape the next generation of automotive intelligence through innovation, AI, and industry-leading data, we're creating new opportunities for our customers, our business, and our people.


Join a team singularly focused on transforming the automotive industry. S&P Global Mobility is Mobility Global: the company behind CARFAX, automotiveMastermind, Market Scan, and Polk Automotive Solutions. Our strength comes from our people, and here, the progress you make helps the entire automotive ecosystem move faster and with greater confidence.
