• 10X Washington Post Top Workplace

• 3X St. Louis Post-Dispatch Best Places to Work


THE TEAM

Join Mobility Global's Compliance & Ethics team as a senior member, partnering with Human Resources, Legal, Cyber Defense/Information Security, Audit, and other corporate functions.


RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT

Mobility Global seeks a Senior Principal, Ethics & Investigations who combines investigative depth with the ability to strengthen and evolve practical processes. This hands-on role will lead complex internal investigations across issue types and help operate the Americas Investigations Center of Excellence while building the oversight and engagement model for investigations conducted by international HR partners.


The Senior Principal will bring substantial workplace-investigations and employment law experience; strengthen triage, investigation quality and global consistency; and establish C&E's partnership with Cyber Defense/Information Security to address insider threats. This is a highly visible, hands-on, global role requiring both strong judgment and operational rigor in a fast-moving environment where the playbook is still being written. The Senior Principal will help define Mobility Global's culture of integrity, establish trusted and defensible processes, and support the growth and success of the newly standalone public company.


Complex Investigations

• Lead sensitive, complex internal investigations across all issue types, including discrimination, harassment, retaliation, workplace conduct, conflicts of interest, fraud, data exfiltration, and misuse of Company resources or information.

• Own the end-to-end investigations lifecycle from scoping through closure: develop investigation plans, conduct interviews, assess evidence and credibility, apply Company policies, and prepare concise, defensible reports and executive briefings.

• Handle high-risk matters involving senior personnel, complex facts or significant cross-functional coordination, maintaining investigative independence and partnering with HR and Legal on appropriate follow-up.

• Maintain investigation independence, confidentiality, and objectivity in accordance with best practices.

• Ensure evidence handling, documentation, case management, and record retention meet litigation and regulatory expectations.

Americas COE & International Investigations Oversight

• Build and operationalize C&E's oversight and engagement model for international HR-led investigations with HR and Employment Legal, defining responsibilities, planning, escalation, quality review and findings consultation, subject to local law and works council requirements.

• Develop and enhance global investigations policies, procedures, governance frameworks and practical guidance to promote consistent practices that meet applicable local requirements.

• Develop and equip HR and other authorized investigators with training, tools, consultation and quality review, incorporating local expertise and jurisdiction-specific flexibility.

Insider Threat & Information Protection Investigations

• Establish and lead C&E's investigative partnership with Cyber Defense/Information Security to help mitigate insider threats, including suspected misuse, unauthorized access, transfer or exfiltration of confidential information.

• Define joint workflows, referral criteria, roles, escalation paths and handoffs with Cyber Defense/Information Security, Privacy, Legal, and HR, distinguishing technical monitoring, independent fact-finding, legal advice and employment decisions.

• Lead the conduct-investigation component of insider-risk matters, integrating technical evidence into the broader factual record and identifying opportunities to strengthen controls.

Investigation Process Enhancement

• Help enhance Ethics Helpline operations, partnering closely to ensure accurate triage, categorization, routing and assignment of concerns based on risk, complexity and capacity.

• Partner with C&E colleagues to continuously enhance and evolve investigation standards, workflows, playbooks and templates covering intake, evidence management, documentation, stakeholder communications and closure.

• Help oversee investigations case management systems, including workflow design, documentation standards, data quality and reporting integrity; develop metrics and dashboards to track timeliness, outcomes and emerging conduct risks.

• Lead root-cause analysis to identify policy, process, control or cultural factors contributing to misconduct; partner on remediation, track corrective action completion and assess effectiveness.

• Prepare clear, accurate reporting for senior management and governance forums on significant matters, investigation trends, systemic issues and remediation progress.


Broader Ethics & Compliance Support

• Support risk-based review and resolution of conflicts of interest disclosures, including employee guidance and appropriate mitigation or management plans.

• Contribute to ethics training, awareness and speak-up initiatives, translating investigation insights into practical guidance and prevention efforts.

• Support policy drafting and governance initiatives, including the Code of Business Ethics.

• Support other Compliance & Ethics priorities and perform other duties as assigned.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Basic Required Qualifications

• Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school and admission to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

• 10+ years of progressively responsible internal corporate investigations experience, including substantial experience investigating discrimination, harassment, retaliation and workplace conduct.

• Working knowledge of employment law and demonstrated experience partnering with HR and employment counsel on sensitive investigations.

• Proven ability to independently lead complex, high-risk investigations, assess evidence and credibility, and produce clear, fact-based findings and policy analysis.

• Demonstrated success building, enhancing or evolving investigation processes, governance frameworks or programs, not simply conducting cases.

• Strong process discipline, judgment and discretion; ability to manage competing priorities and deliver in an evolving environment.

• Excellent writing and executive communication skills, with the ability to build trusted cross-functional partnerships and drive execution without direct authority.

• Thrives without a set playbook: a hands-on operator with a can-do attitude who carries a caseload while helping write the playbook, works independently and adapts as processes and priorities evolve.


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience coordinating investigations across jurisdictions and advising or overseeing local HR investigative partners in a multinational environment.

• Experience partnering with Cyber Defense, Information Security or Insider Threat teams on employee-related information misuse or exfiltration investigations.

• Experience developing training, quality-review practices and case-management reporting; familiarity with NAVEX EthicsPoint or similar platforms.


WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

• Competitive compensation package, including base salary and incentive opportunities where applicable.

title: Director, Supply Chain Lead Data Architect
description:
Job Description Summary:

The Supply Chain Lead Data Architect will own the supply chain data model and the data-product architecture that enables trusted analytics, decision intelligence and data science across the North America Operating Unit. This leader will treat data as a product: defining the business purpose, consumers, ownership, quality expectations, access patterns, lifecycle and measurable value of the data assets the organization depends on. The role combines supply-chain domain mastery with enterprise data modeling, platform product strategy and modern engineering fluency. Partnering with supply chain, product, analytics, data science, Global Data and AI, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Governance and platform teams, the successful candidate will translate business decisions into interoperable, secure, governed and reusable data capabilities that improve performance and deliver measurable business value.

This is a Director-level role.


About the Role

Own Supply Chain Data Products and Enterprise Data Models

  • Define and execute the supply chain data-product strategy and multi-year architecture roadmap that enables analytics, reporting, decision intelligence and data science.
  • Develop and own the canonical supply chain data model, including conceptual, logical and physical models, shared business definitions and semantic layers for domains such as demand, supply, inventory, manufacturing, logistics, customer service and performance.
  • Establish reusable patterns for data products, ingestion, integration, lakehouse and warehouse platforms, APIs, events and streaming, master and reference data, semantic models, analytics and data-science consumption.
  • Lead architecture reviews and technology decisions, balancing decision value, interoperability, scalability, security, quality, reliability, performance, cost and speed to market.

Enable Integration Interoperability and Modern Data Engineering

  • Connect supply chain data requirements with enterprise platforms, applications and standards, reducing duplicate data, fragmented definitions, point-to-point integrations and technical debt.
  • Define integration and interoperability standards across ERP, manufacturing, warehouse, transportation, planning, customer and external-partner systems using APIs, events, common identifiers and governed data contracts.
  • Set engineering standards for CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, orchestration, observability, metadata, lineage, data quality, reliability and operational support.
  • Drive reusable frameworks, platform capabilities and product operating practices that accelerate delivery and make data easy to discover, understand, access and use responsibly.
    Improve workload performance, resilience and cost efficiency across cloud data, analytics and data-science platforms.

Translate Business Decisions into Data Requirements

  • Work with supply-chain leaders to identify the decisions that matter most, the measures that define success and the data required to improve planning, service, cost, inventory, capacity, resilience and sustainability outcomes.
  • Convert business priorities into clear data requirements, data-product backlogs, domain models, data contracts, acceptance criteria and delivery roadmaps that technical teams can execute.
  • Define patterns that enable data scientists and analysts to use governed, explainable and fit-for-purpose data, including feature-ready data, semantic models and secure self-service access.
  • Partner with data science and engineering teams to move analytical and predictive solutions from prototypes to secure, observable and reliable production capabilities.
  • Establish architecture guardrails for privacy, security, governance, model use, explainability, evaluation and appropriate human oversight where AI is applied.

Lead Cross Functional Delivery and Augmented Teams

  • Serve as a trusted partner to supply-chain, product, finance, operations, data science and technology leaders; communicate architecture choices, dependencies, tradeoffs, value, cost and risk in clear business language.
  • Lead cross-functional teams and augmented resources, setting clear outcomes, architectural guardrails, delivery expectations and quality standards while building capability in internal teams.
  • Facilitate alignment across organizational boundaries, resolve design decisions and sequence investments to deliver the highest-value data products first.
  • Improve the discoverability, accessibility, quality and usability of trusted supply-chain data so teams can move from questions to decisions more efficiently.

Drive Governance Quality Value and Enterprise Alignment

  • Establish data-product governance with clear ownership, stewardship, quality rules, service expectations, metadata, lineage, retention and least-privilege access from design through operations.
  • Partner with NAOU Digital and Data, Global Data and AI, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Governance and platform organizations to align supply-chain solutions with enterprise direction.
  • Establish measures and operating reviews for data quality, adoption, reuse, time to insight, delivery speed, reliability, cost, risk reduction and realized supply-chain value.
  • Build a high-performing culture focused on accountability, product thinking, value creation, inclusion, quality and continuous improvement; mentor technical talent and augmented team members.
  • Enable teams to make decisions within clear architectural guardrails and continuously improve the data-product portfolio based on stakeholder feedback and performance evidence.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; advanced degree is a plus.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in data architecture, enterprise data modeling, data engineering or analytics platforms, including leadership of complex enterprise-scale transformations.
  • 7+ years of experience leading architects, engineers, technical leaders, augmented resources or multidisciplinary platform teams, including responsibility for talent development and delivery outcomes.
  • Demonstrated supply-chain domain expertise and experience translating supply-chain processes and decisions into data requirements, business definitions, data models and analytical products.
  • Demonstrated expertise designing enterprise conceptual, logical and physical data models; canonical data models; master and reference data; semantic models; and data products for analytics and data science.
  • Demonstrated experience designing cloud-native architectures spanning lakehouse and warehouse platforms, data products, streaming, APIs, events, semantic models and analytical consumption.
  • Experience with enterprise cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Power BI and Azure Databricks, or comparable technologies.
  • Strong understanding of integration and interoperability patterns, including APIs, event-driven architecture, data contracts, common identifiers and operational-system integration.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, DataOps, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, orchestration, observability and cloud cost-management practices.
  • Deep understanding of data governance, security, privacy, metadata, lineage, data quality, stewardship, access control and data-product operating practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior business and technology leaders, lead decisions across organizational boundaries, manage augmented resources and communicate complex topics in clear business language.
  • Experience translating technology investments into measurable outcomes across data quality, reliability, adoption, reuse, speed, cost, risk and realized business value.
  • Proven track record of working independently, applying platform product strategy and fostering a growth mindset culture in a data-product environment.

title: Mech System Design & Analysis Engineer - Solar Array and Battery - Satellite Systems (Associate)
description:
Mech System Design & Analysis Engineer - Solar Array and Battery - Satellite Systems (Associate)

Company:

The Boeing Company


The Integrated Design Engineering Organization is seeking a highly motivated Satellite Solar Array and Battery Mechanical Design Engineer, Mid-Career or Senior level, to join the Space Mission Systems Satellite Engineering Team. This candidate will be a part of a high-performing engineering team that is immersed in development and high non-recurring projects. The candidate will be accountable to provide all aspects of mechanical design engineering support of the solar array and battery technologies, which include designing substrates, yoke structures, panel layouts, battery packs, etc. Additionally, the candidate will be accountable for the electro-mechanical architecture of battery and solar array designs, and the ability to support programs as a responsible engineering authority (REA). The candidate will be required to work closely with our Solar Array and Battery REA and Analysis team members as well as our partnering organizations from Systems Engineering, Stress, Dynamics, Materials & Processes, Production Engineering, Quality, Supplier Management, and Spectrolab. This candidate will need to work closely with their respective Technical Lead Engineers, Management, and Program Leadership to support the program deliverables. This role will include accountability for all Satellite Solar Array technologies supporting Government and Commercial Satellites with some additional support across other space applications. The candidate should have experience working with Solar Array and/or Battery technologies (substrates, cells, panels, integration, system requirements, etc). The candidate must exemplify The Boeing Behaviors in day-to-day operations. This position is in El Segundo, California.


Primary responsibilities include:

  • Lead functional teams as potential Technical Lead Engineer, Boeing Designated Expert, or REA
  • Lead project planning and ensure execution on program commitments as a potential Solar Array REA driving the design, build, test, and installation of solar array substrates, solar cells, panels, and wings to the spacecraft
  • Support/Lead design configurations by following regulatory and company approved processes and procedures.

  • Develop mechanical and electrical designs (mechanical/electrical layouts, yoke/structures, harnesses, etc) using Creo and Autocad implementing appropriate Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing, DFMAT, critical clearance, and material selection processes

title: RA- Luther Crest, Full time-Night shift
description:
Job Description:

Introduction

At EverTrue, team members at all levels find their calling in our mission of Older Adults Living Life to the Fullest. In this work environment, all team members are part of a community and appreciated by the people they work with – residents and coworkers – every day.

Summary

Provides supportive and functional care to residents with routine daily care in accordance with our established community care procedures and as may be directed by nursing leadership; Works collaboratively as a member of the interdisciplinary team with a focus on maintaining the resident as the director of their own care.

Job Responsibilities

1. Supports residents in attaining and/or maintaining their highest practicable level of functioning by providing and/or assisting residents with personal care and performance of all routine activities of daily living

2. Provides care and services in accordance to current standards of practice as defined by training standards and EverTrue Clinical Policies and Procedures

3. Maintains the appropriate resident care environment and responds to resident requests for assistance in a timely manner

4. Follows all safety procedures and protocol as dictated by EverTrue policy, federal and state regulations and standard nursing practice and reports all hazardous conditions, defective equipment and accidents or incidents to their nursing leader immediately

5. Performs and provides proper resident observations and record keeping; Functions as the resident’s advocate, participates in care planning and communicates to their nursing leader and interdisciplinary team any changes observed

6. May be instructed to assist and escort residents to/from dining room and in-house activities; monitor residents in the dining room at mealtimes

7. May be assigned the responsibility of documenting residents’ vital signs including blood pressure, temperature respiration, weight checks, and other pertinent information

8. If working in the state of Pennsylvania, may be assigned to serve as the administrator designee (if aged 21 years or older) in the absence of the “Personal Care Administrator” or PC/AL Clinical director; Evaluates immediate circumstances and contacts highest level of authority to discuss next steps

Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Previous resident/patient care experience preferred

  • If working in Pennsylvania, a High School diploma, GED, or active registry status on the PA state nurse aide registry is required

  • Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos; Ability to write simple correspondence

  • Ability to effectively present information in one on one and small group situations

  • Basic computer skills, limited to retrieving data and data entry

  • Must possess the ability to make independent decisions when circumstances warrant such action

  • Must have patience and be willing and able to demonstrate professional behavior in interactions with difficult situations or individuals, including residents and resident families

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

The physical activities, demands, and working conditions described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job duties and responsibilities.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to touch, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; and talk to hear. The employee frequently is required to sit; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to climb or balance and taste or smell. The employee must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. and push/pull 45 lbs.

A well-lighted and ventilated working area that has its own temperature control system (air-conditioning and heat). Is subject to emotionally upset residents, or family members. Is willing to work beyond normal working hours and on weekends and holidays when necessary. Is subject to exposure to fumes or airborne particles, and toxic or caustic chemicals. Is subject to exposure to infectious waste, diseases, conditions, etc., including exposure to the AIDS and Hepatitis B virus within guidelines of standard precautions. title: Chemical Operator
description:
About PVS Chemicals, Inc.

PVS enables our world through the safe and reliable delivery of chemistry, either created by us or sourced through trusted partners. The products and services that we provide touch everyone in some unique way. We are passionate about the work we do and abide by our guiding principles, The Nicholson Nine, to be a safe and sustainable chemical provider the world trusts. With a career at PVS, you'll play a vital role in the daily lives of millions of people.

Description: The opportunity to be a part of a team that manufacturers and distributes high quality chemicals. It is an opportunity to be exposed to all aspects of an office and plant environment including Safety, General Administration, Logistics, Vendor /Supplier Management, and Customer Service. The Operator shall uphold the fundamentals of the Nicholson Nine, the Responsible Care Guiding Principles, and all Environmental, Health, Safety and Security requirements.

Responsibilities (May include but not limited to):

GENERAL

  • Comply with all aspects of the PVS Environmental, Health, Safety and Security Policy (Nicholson Nine)
  • Adhere to the Responsible Care Guiding Principles
  • Start up and shut down of the production process in a safe manner and ensure the process is secure while not running
  • Operate production equipment in a safe manner, this includes the operation of the reduction process, oxidation process, maintaining fume scrubbers, transferring products and raw materials, and the cleaning of various filters located throughout the production process
  • Run quality analysis titrations and document results of ferric chloride, ferrous chloride and stannic chloride produced to ensure that the product produced is within specifications
  • Monitoring levels, pressures, temperatures and other parameters
  • Maintain at required intervals the reports and documentation necessary to record daily production numbers
  • Receive, load, and prepare for transport of hazardous materials
  • Computer knowledge of Adage, Excel, Access, Outlook and Word
  • Maintain housekeeping in all areas of the plant, warehouse, and office building
  • Perform all assigned tasks in a safe and environmentally conscious manner
  • Participate in all plant safety meetings and required safety training
  • Assist as necessary in maintaining plant security
  • Unload and load rail cars as necessary to support plant production
  • Move rail cars as necessary for loading and unloading
  • Assist in the performance of maintenance activities as required to keep the plant running safely and efficiently. This includes but is not limited to:
  • Changing out of pumps, motors, valves, miscellaneous plant equipment
  • Installation and repair of plant piping
  • Cleaning out of production tanks
  • Repair of heat exchangers
  • Trouble shoot equipment problems
  • Assist with various plant projects relating to equipment upgrades and rebuilds
  • Safe operation of plant mobile equipment including skid-steer, man-lift, forklift, shuttle wagon, crane
  • Assist with the preventive maintenance program
  • Assist with incident investigations
  • Write and review operating procedures
  • Complete Hazard Elimination Cards
  • Participate in PVS Technologies safety committee when requested to

REQUIRED EDUCATION / TRAINING / EQUIVALENT EXPERIENCE:

  • Previous experience working in a chemical plant is preferred
  • Training in the handling of hazardous materials, lock out tag out, PPE, confined space is preferred
  • The individual for this position must be mechanically inclined with a strong maintenance background
  • Must be able to perform basic plant maintenance tasks without close supervision
  • Must be physically able to work outdoors in all weather conditions
  • License to operate a forklift, man-lift and bobcat is preferred
  • Individual cannot have any physical restrictions that would prevent them from obtaining a license to drive any of this equipment
  • Individual must not have any physical restrictions that would prevent them from wearing a respirator
  • Must be able to work weekends and on any shift that may be required to meet plant production needs
  • Must be able to lift 50 lbs.

Each employee is required and encouraged to uphold the fundamentals of the Nicholson Nine and Responsible Care Guiding Principles. Environmental, Health, Safety and Security is a responsibility of every PVS Employee.

Reports to: Plant Manager

Note: The responsibilities and tasks outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may change as determined by the needs of the company.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Coverage
  • Life Insurance
  • Short Term Disability
  • Health Savings Account
  • 401K Matching

PVS values diversity and is committed to upholding the laws and regulations published by the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission. As an equal opportunity employer, PVS makes all employment-related decisions based upon qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Applicants must be able to pass a drug screen and background check.

title: Compliance Specialist
description:
At Ayvens, progress starts with you.

Our ambitions to shape the future of sustainable mobility are powered by our talent. Join us, and get better with every move.

At Ayvens we have an opening for an experienced Deal Flow Compliance Coordinator – KYC

What are you going to do?

As our new experienced Deal Flow Compliance Specialist – KYC, you will play a key role within the Group Compliance framework, ensuring compliance with Société Générale Group requirements and applicable national and international regulations. You will act as a subject matter expert and escalation point for complex and high-risk KYC cases, supporting the organization in mitigating financial crime, corruption, sanctions, ESG and

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Reviewing and validating complex and high-risk KYC files escalated by Ayvens entities, assessing risks related to AML/CFT, anti-corruption, sanctions, ESG and reputational exposure.
  • Acting as a trusted advisor to local Compliance teams by providing guidance on due diligence reviews, sanctions and PEP investigations, and complex corporate ownership structures.
  • Serving as a key escalation point to Société Générale Group on complex compliance matters and supporting decision-making processes.
  • Ensuring alignment of local KYC practices with Group Compliance standards, policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Producing management reporting, dashboards and insights for governance committees and senior stakeholders.
  • Identifying emerging compliance risks, incidents and trends, while recommending mitigation and control enhancements.
  • Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, training programs, awareness activities and optimization of Compliance processes across the Group.

Who are we looking for?

The ideal candidate has the analytical expertise and stakeholder management skills required to assess complex compliance risks in an international environment. You are a seasoned Compliance professional who can confidently navigate challenging KYC cases, provide expert guidance to stakeholders, and contribute to robust governance and risk management practices across multiple jurisdictions.

You will have relevant experience in a similar role, preferably holding a Master's degree in Law, Finance, Audit or Risk Management.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in KYC, AML, Compliance, Financial Crime Prevention or Internal Audit.
  • Strong knowledge of AML/CFT, fraud, anti-corruption regulations and international sanctions frameworks.
  • Proven ability to analyze sanctions and PEP screening results, adverse media findings and distinguish genuine risks from false positives.
  • Solid understanding of complex KYC investigations, ownership structures and corporate hierarchies.
  • Excellent analytical, synthesis and decision-making skills, with the ability to communicate recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Strong command of Microsoft Office applications; VBA knowledge is considered an advantage.
  • Fluent in English is required.

What do we offer?

We're on this journey together. By investing in professional growth, rewards and incentives, plus plenty of training and experience on the job, we create an inspiring environment for our colleagues that fosters high performance with positive impact.

Enjoy comprehensive rewards and recognition.

We believe in rewarding you holistically, through compensation, competitive benefits and rich development opportunities.

Benefit from a healthy, positive work atmosphere.

We offer a wide variety of benefits to help keep you mentally and physically strong and to find the perfect work–life balance.

Find a shared sense of belonging.

We create an engaging environment where you can be your authentic self and harness your commitment, curiosity and collaboration.

Build a sustainable future.

We’re conscious of our environment and the societies we’re part of and we work together to drive electrification and lead the way to decarbonisation.

Make your Move at Ayvens

Ayvens provides a unique opportunity: the chance to accelerate the transition to electric, lead the way to decarbonisation and shape the industry’s digital transformation. Behind the wheel, our people make the difference, driving us towards our ambitions. Ayvens is home to the best talent in the industry – so if you’re looking for a fulfilling career with positive impact, we’d love to discuss your opportunities with us!

Ready to make your move at Ayvens? Join a global leader in sustainable mobility and follow @ayvens, @lifeatayvens, and Ayvens on LinkedIn to check out what’s happening at Ayvens!

Our commitment

We’re committed to building a culture where everyone can be themselves and where everyone gets an equal chance to make their journey count. If you’d like to learn more about our DE&I journey – and how you can contribute – please find out more on Career pages of our website.


Why Ayvens?


With over 3.1 million vehicles managed across more than 40 countries, we provide full-service leasing, flexible subscription services, fleet management services and multi-mobility solutions to customers of all sizes, including large corporates, SMEs, professionals, and private individuals. At Ayvens, we believe that our success is driven by our commitment to customer satisfaction. title: Emergency Medical Technician- (911 Gloucester EMS)
description:
At Virtua Health, we exist for one reason – to better serve you. That means being here for you in all the moments that matter, striving each day to connect you to the care you need. Whether that's wellness and prevention, experienced specialists, life-changing care, or something in-between – we are your partner in health devoted to building a healthier community.

If you live or work in South Jersey, exceptional care is all around. Our medical and surgical experts are among the best in the country. We assembled more than 14,000 colleagues, including over 2,850 skilled and compassionate doctors, physician assistants, and nurse practitioners equipped with the latest technologies, treatments, and techniques to provide exceptional care close to home. A Magnet-recognized health system ranked by U.S. News and World Report, we've received multiple awards for quality, safety, and outstanding work environment.

In addition to five hospitals, seven emergency departments, seven urgent care centers, and more than 280 other locations, we're committed to the well-being of the community. That means bringing life-changing resources and health services directly into our communities through our Eat Well food access program, telehealth, home health, rehabilitation, mobile screenings, paramedic programs, and convenient online scheduling. We're also affiliated with Penn Medicine for cancer and neurosciences, and the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia for pediatrics.

Employee

Regular

24

Job Information:


Summary:

Provides high-quality 911 emergency medical response and/or non-emergency interfacility transport to the community and surrounding areas. Responsible for patient assessment, treatment, and safe transport following state protocols and medical command directives. Ensures compassionate and efficient care for patients in both emergency and/or scheduled transport settings. Operates ambulances safely and professionally, maintains equipment readiness, and ensures accurate documentation. Works in a fast-paced, high-impact environment with minimal supervision to support optimal patient outcomes.

Position Responsibilities:

Conducts thorough patient assessments and provides appropriate basic life support (BLS) care in accordance with New Jersey Statewide EMS Protocols and medical command directives. Administers high-quality, evidence-based care while ensuring patient safety and comfort.

Operates an ambulance safely and professionally in accordance with New Jersey motor vehicle laws and department driving policies. Demonstrates defensive driving techniques, maintains situational awareness, and ensures the vehicle remains operational, fueled, and properly equipped. Reports any mechanical or operational issues promptly.

Accurately and thoroughly documents patient assessments, interventions, patient responses, and transfer of care details using the department’s electronic patient care reporting (ePCR) system. Ensures all documentation meets regulatory, quality assurance, and legal standards. Promptly responds to quality assurance and medical oversight requests.

Conducts and documents vehicle and equipment check at the start of each shift. Ensures ambulances are properly stocked, equipment is in working order, and supplies are replenished as needed. Reports shortages and operational concerns to department management.

Maintains all Virtua-owned medical equipment, vehicles, and facilities in a safe, clean, and organized manner. Follows all infection control protocols and ensures proper decontamination of the ambulance and equipment after each patient transport.

Actively participates in the training and onboarding of new staff, students, and inter-agency personnel. Provides mentorship, monitors trainee performance, and offers constructive feedback to enhance clinical competency. Models professionalism, teamwork, safety, and adherence to department protocols.


Position Qualifications Required / Experience Required:

Previous EMS field experience preferred.

New graduates from accredited EMT programs will be considered.

Required Education:

High school diploma or GED required

Graduate of a recognized Emergency Medical Technician-Basic Training Program.

Training/Certifications/Licensure:

Certified as an Emergency Medical Technician – Basic by the Commissioner of Health & Senior Services of the State of New Jersey. Certification is preferred from NJ, PA or the National Registry.

Current certification in Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) to the professional rescuer level, and EVOC.

Valid driver’s license required. Must be at least 18 years of age and meet insurance requirements.

Must complete yearly PPD, Fit Test, Corporate Compliance, HIPAA and Safety Day training by the date set forth by the department.

title: Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) End User & Vendor Support Manager
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.


Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) End User & Vendor Support Manager

EDW Operations | Help Desk & ITSM | Vendor Support | Data Integration | Medicaid & Healthcare Technology

The Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) End User & Vendor Support Manager leads day-to-day end-user support, Help Desk operations, vendor support, access management, training, documentation, and service delivery for a complex enterprise data environment.

This role serves as a key point of coordination across users, vendors, technical teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure timely issue resolution, strong SLA performance, operational readiness, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

  • Lead day-to-day EDW End User and Vendor Support, including Help Desk operations, incident and service request management, access and provisioning, training, documentation, and vendor support.

  • Oversee support for State and authorized third-party users, including intake, triage, assignment, escalation, follow-up, and resolution of incidents and service requests.

  • Ensure Help Desk and ticket-management activities meet established service-level agreements (SLAs), priority definitions, response requirements, escalation procedures, and contractual expectations.

  • Manage and improve support processes across EDW applications, reporting and analytics tools, data access, authentication, file-transfer services, and other enterprise data services.

  • Coordinate vendor onboarding and interface support, including connectivity, access, data-exchange and file-transfer requirements, testing dependencies, operational readiness, issue tracking, and escalation.

  • Partner with application, infrastructure, security, reporting, data, technical, and business teams to route and actively manage support requests through resolution.

  • Monitor service performance, support trends, recurring incidents, and operational issues, driving corrective actions and continuous service improvement.

  • Manage communications to users, vendors, customer stakeholders, and internal teams regarding incidents, service interruptions, processing delays, access issues, and operational dependencies.

  • Oversee user documentation, knowledge articles, job aids, training materials, support procedures, and knowledge-management content, ensuring resources remain current and accessible.

  • Coordinate user onboarding, identity and access management, role-based access, authentication, and application provisioning in partnership with security and application administrators.

  • Support user-access reviews, audit readiness, compliance activities, and operational evidence collection related to EDW support and access processes.

  • Monitor inbound and outbound data exchanges, coordinating resolution of file delivery, connectivity, data-processing, integration, and vendor-related issues.

  • Partner with customer project, contract, security, technical, and business stakeholders on operational reporting, SLA performance, issue resolution, risk management, and continuous improvement.

  • Maintain disciplined use of Azure DevOps, SharePoint, and approved systems of record to support traceability of requests, documentation, decisions, and operational evidence.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.

  • Minimum of 5 years of supervisory, service delivery, operations, or support-management experience.

  • Minimum of 3 years of enterprise application, end-user, Help Desk, or technical support experience.

  • Experience managing multi-channel user support, incident management, service request management, escalation, SLA monitoring, and customer communications.

  • Experience coordinating support across technical teams, business users, external vendors, and customers in a complex enterprise environment.

  • Experience managing vendor dependencies, third-party integrations, operational escalations, and data-exchange/interface support.

  • Experience with enterprise ticketing/ITSM, collaboration, documentation, and reporting platforms.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical and operational issues to users, vendors, technical teams, customers, and leadership.

  • Experience developing operational procedures, training materials, user documentation, knowledge articles, job aids, and performance reporting.

  • Knowledge of identity and access management, information security, audit readiness, documentation controls, and enterprise support processes.

  • Ability to analyze operational trends and recurring service issues, coordinate corrective actions, and improve service delivery.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure DevOps or comparable ITSM/ticketing tools, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, business intelligence/reporting tools, and managed file-transfer solutions.

  • Experience supporting public-sector healthcare, Medicaid, CHIP, health data, or government technology programs.

  • Experience supporting enterprise data warehouses (EDW), analytics platforms, reporting environments, data integration, or complex data ecosystems.

Why Join Us

This role provides an opportunity to lead a highly visible EDW support and service-delivery function supporting users, vendors, and stakeholders across a complex enterprise environment. You’ll work at the intersection of data, technology, customer support, vendor management, and healthcare operations, helping improve service performance, user experience, and operational reliability.

Flexible Working

At Conduent, we want you to be yourself. We recognize that everyone is different and that how people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.

In this role, you can expect the following working conditions:

Remote work: Work in a way that allows you to work from home and have time onsite when needed to connect with other team members and business leaders.

title: Associate Engineer, Process R&D
description:
Job Summary

Are you ready to turn engineering ideas into innovative flavor delivery solutions used in products around the world?

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

Taste: Crafting unique, technology-enabled flavor designs that define the identity of food and beverage brands, shape trends in flavor building and fuel market success.

The role is based in Union Beach, New Jersey, United States (onsite role).

Be part of a collaborative, innovative and solution-oriented team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.

As an Associate Process Engineer, Flavor Encapsulation, you will support IFF’s strategic mission of Re-Imagine Delivery® by designing solutions that help drive consumer preference in our customers’ products. You will join a close-knit research team advancing encapsulation and delivery technologies for flavors.

In this role, you will develop and optimize processes for novel encapsulation technologies involving volatile and non-volatile flavors. You will apply engineering principles, formulation knowledge and process expertise to solve technical challenges and help move new technologies from laboratory development through commercialization.

Where You’ll Make a Difference

  • Design, execute and document laboratory, pilot-scale and manufacturing process trials
  • Analyze experimental results and process data to support technical decisions and advance projects
  • Develop and optimize encapsulation, flavor delivery, drying and related processing technologies
  • Prepare technical reports, experimental summaries, operating procedures and project documentation
  • Collaborate with scientists, engineers, manufacturing teams and external partners to achieve project objectives
  • Support technology scale-up and transfer from development through commercialization
  • Troubleshoot process and equipment issues using sound engineering and scientific principles
  • Support pilot plant operations, equipment evaluations, commissioning activities and process improvement initiatives
  • Maintain accurate experimental records in electronic laboratory notebook systems, participate in safety reviews and present technical findings to internal stakeholders

What Makes You the Right Fit

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, food engineering, process engineering or a related engineering discipline
  • Up to three years of experience in process development, manufacturing, pilot plant operations or research and development
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to collect, analyze and interpret technical and process data
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings to stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced research environment
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and technical documentation systems
  • Ability to work safely in laboratory, pilot plant and manufacturing environments while following company safety policies and procedures

How Would You Stand Out?

  • Experience with flavor, food, ingredient, encapsulation, spray-drying or related processing technologies
  • Experience with pilot plant operations, process scale-up, manufacturing operations or continuous improvement
  • Familiarity with statistical analysis, experimental design, electronic laboratory notebooks and data management systems

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to work in laboratory, pilot plant and manufacturing environments
  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment
  • ATment operations for extended periods during trials

Why Choose Us?

  • Conduct hands-on research involving innovative flavor encapsulation and delivery technologies
  • Work across laboratory, pilot-scale and manufacturing environments
  • Contribute to projects from early-stage development through scale-up and commercialization
  • Collaborate with scientists, engineers, manufacturing teams and external technical partners
  • Build experience in process development, equipment evaluation and technical problem-solving

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. title: Product Designer
location: New York, New York, United States; San Francisco, California, United States
description:
About Taskrabbit:

Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more.

At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast-paced. We’re looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we’re creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.

Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!

This role operates on a hybrid schedule requiring two days of in-office collaboration per week. The position can be based in either our San Francisco office or our new New York City office (opening January 2026).

About the Job

Taskrabbit's mission is to transform lives, one task at a time. As a member of the Product Design team, you'll advance that mission through close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders to uncover problems and build solutions that reach millions of Clients and Taskers around the world.

What You’ll Do

Product Design plays a role in each phase of the product development process, from user research exploration and early concepting with PMs through prototyping, design system contributions and post-handoff engineering support. You’ll join a highly collaborative team based in the US and partner with colleagues from UX Research, Product, Data, and Engineering. Expect a high level of ownership and autonomy on assigned projects.

Responsibilities

With support from the Product Design Manager and senior designer peers:

  • Wireframe and validate design directions through sketches, Figma, and usability testing
  • Lead cross-functional workshops to define problems clearly and align on solutions
  • Deliver detail-oriented designs grounded in best practices, with rigor around copywriting, user flows, error states, edge cases, and micro-interactions
  • Build prototypes to validate assumptions and communicate interactions to stakeholders
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, and iteration cycles
  • Navigate stakeholder concerns and advocate for design decisions backed by evidence, user research, and inclusive design principles
  • QA staging builds to ensure proper implementation of your designs
  • Iterate on and expand Taskrabbit design system components and patterns
  • Contribute to critiques and team feedback loops
  • Develop proficiency in AI-assisted design and data literacy to strengthen your work

Who you are

You know the difference between problems that deserve deep thinking and ideas that need fast execution. You blur role boundaries in a product org if it helps your idea come to life. Curiosity, rigor, and strong opinions shape how you work.

You have a few years of product design experience and want to deepen your skills in scoping, systems thinking, and cross-functional collaboration. You’re ready to grow alongside senior designers and your manager in a role with real ownership and impact.

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in a product design role
  • Strong command of visual design principles
  • Ability to express early ideas via sketches, wireframes, or AI prototypes, and provide a narrative around why the solution satisfies business and user needs
  • Ability to produce polished design specs in Figma with appropriate annotations for engineering to build
  • Ability to contribute work that adheres to an established design system
  • Strong communication skills, including explaining design decisions and tradeoffs to various audience types
  • Experience supporting or conducting user research (interviews, usability studies)

Along with your resume, please submit a link to your Design Portfolio that demonstrate your design thinking.

Compensation & Benefits:

At Taskrabbit, our approach to compensation is designed to be competitive, transparent, and equitable. Total compensation consists of base pay + bonus + benefits + perks.

The base pay range for this position is $106,4000 - $141,000. This range is representative of base pay only, and does not include any other total cash compensation amounts, such as company bonus or benefits. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed above and will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, geography, and level.

You’ll love working here because:

  • Taskrabbit is a Hybrid Company. We value flexibility and choice but also stay committed to regular in-person connection.
  • The People. You will be surrounded by some of the most talented, supportive, smart, and kind leaders and teams -- people you can be proud to work with!
  • The Diverse Culture. We believe that we make better decisions when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. Women make up half of our leadership team and our diversity representation is above that of the tech industry average.
  • The Perks. Taskrabbit offers our employees with employer-paid health insurance and a 401k match with immediate vesting for our US based employees. We offer all of our global employees generous and flexible time off with 2 company-wide closure weeks, Taskrabbit product stipends, wellness + productivity + education stipends, IKEA discounts, reproductive health support, and more. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Taskrabbit’s commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:

An Active Commitment to Equity within our Company and Platform. We are an inclusive community where all who share our mission and values belong. Our diverse team represents the communities we serve, breaking down systemic barriers, and transforming lives- one action at a time.

Taskrabbit is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military/veteran status, or disability status. Taskrabbit is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. Taskrabbit will consider for employment all qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law.

This tool does not make hiring decisions — every application and response is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team to determine fit for the role. title: Non-Invasive Cardiology Technologist - Days
description:
Serious Medicine is what we do. Being extraordinary is who we are. Every colleague plays a key role in upholding this promise to our patients and their families.

First Shift (United States of America)

Non-Invasive Cardiology Technologist - Days

Nebraska Medicine is seeking a Non-Invasive Cardiology Technologist to support our growing cardiovascular services team. The ideal candidate brings strong cardiac monitoring knowledge, expertise in rhythm analysis, excellent communication skills, and a commitment to providing outstanding care to our patients.


We offer both full-time days and full-time nights on separate job postings. Please apply to the position that matches your preferred schedule, or apply to both if you are interested in being considered for either shift.

Location: Nebraska Medical Center | Nebraska Medicine Omaha, NE


Why Work at Nebraska Medicine?

  • Together. Extraordinary. Join a team that values your skills, delivering exceptional care through collaboration.
  • Leading Health Network: Work with the region’s top academic health network, partnering with UNMC to transform lives through education, research, and patient care.
  • Dignity and Respect: We value all backgrounds and experiences, reflecting the communities we serve.
  • Educational Support: Enjoy up to $5,000/year in tuition assistance, a 35% discount at Clarkson College, and career advancement opportunities with covered educational costs.

Be part of something extraordinary at Nebraska Medicine!


Duties: Non-Invasive Cardiology Technologist

Utilize advanced arrhythmia recognition skills, holter scanning, perform adult and pediatric EKGs, specialty EKG, apply holter monitors and cardiac event recorders. Directly interact with patients, nurses, staff, and physicians. Transcribe test results into hospitals Electronic Health Record (HER).

Required Qualifications: Non-Invasive Cardiology Technologist

• High school education or equivalent required.

• The following combination of experience will be considered for this position:

Completion of an approved Nebraska Medicine Internship:
• Successful completion of the Non-Invasive Cardiology department's pre-hire examination assessing cardiac arrhythmia recognition required.
• Completion of the Nebraska Medicine EKG internship position required.
OR
Completion of relevant experience:
• Successful completion of the Non-Invasive Cardiology department's pre-hire examination assessing cardiac arrhythmia recognition required.

• Ability to work on call required.

• Ability to work holidays is required.
• Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required, must be from an American Heart Association (AHA) endorsed program (effective for new hires starting January 1, 2023 or later).
• Certification in either Certified Cardiographic Technician (CCT) or Certified Rhythm Analysis Technician (CRAT) by Cardiovascular Credentialing International (CCI) within 24 months of hire or transfer date required.

• Associate's degree with emphasis in cardiac anatomy and physiology or equivalent combination of education and/or experience working in non-invasive cardiology in an acute care setting preferred.

title: Senior Presales Consultant
description:
At Regnology our greatest asset is our people. We value diversity and foster an inclusive environment that supports learning, safety, and growth. By investing in our team, listening to customers, and encouraging creativity, we drive continuous innovation and improvement.
We offer a flexible, innovative environment where your ideas matter and your career can thrive.
Regnology is a global leader in regulatory reporting, helping financial institutions, regulators, and tax authorities improve data quality, efficiency, and cost savings. Our mission: to safeguard financial markets through smarter, future-ready solutions.

What you'll do


As a Senior Presales Consultant, you will be part of our international presales team and will be responsible for driving and coordinating presales activities for our Risk Solutions in EMEA, with a strong focus on Asset & Liability Management (ALM) and financial risk management, alongside our Regulatory products.

As a trusted advisor and domain expert, you support customers and prospects across EMEA in evaluating how our solutions and services address their ALM and balance-sheet challenges, financial risk management needs, target architecture, and related regulatory requirements.

You combine deep content expertise with the ability to lead complex opportunities and mentor peers across the sales cycle.


Your key accountabilities are:

  • Lead and coordinate senior presales activities for Risk and Regulatory offerings throughout the sales cycle, streamlining the sales process and identifying opportunities with existing and new customers
  • Prepare and attend client meetings and workshops, acting as a product, service, and domain expert across ALM, financial risk management, and regulatory topics
  • Meet current and prospective clients to understand the challenges they face and propose corresponding Regnology solutions
  • Reply to requests for proposal or information (RfPs / RfIs), covering functional and technical queries and leveraging GenAI to accelerate delivery while ensuring quality and accuracy
  • Prepare and conduct deep-dive presentations, product demos, workshops, and proofs of concept (PoCs)
  • Prepare and maintain standard written responses, product presentations, and standard product demos for Sales and Account Management
  • Position SaaS-based and GenAI-enabled solutions within complex client environments across functional, technical, integration, security, and operational dimensions
  • Support pipeline quality and promote Regnology solutions in partnership with the wider sales team, balancing win rates against costs and risks
  • Continually expand technical and functional product knowledge and feed market and customer insights back to Product Management and Marketing
  • Collaborate continuously with Sales, Product Management, Implementation Services, and other internal stakeholders to drive awareness of market trends and customer needs
  • Lead mixed teams across organizational pillars on larger or complex opportunities, providing guidance and mentoring to peers

Why we should decide on you


  • At least 8 years of experience with IT software and expertise in financial market enterprise architectures (consulting / IT background desirable), with deep expertise in risk management and ALM, based in Europe
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable explaining products to both customers and senior internal stakeholders
  • Fluency in English; additional languages (e.g., French, German, Spanish) are desirable
  • Strong customer and service orientation, with excellent listening skills
  • Proven experience in ALM and risk management, with detailed knowledge of:
    • ALM and related balance-sheet / IRRBB topics
    • Credit Risk, Basel frameworks, ICAAP, IFRS 9 / expected credit loss, and related portfolio or lending contexts
    • Regulatory reporting requirements and supervisory expectations across EMEA and selected other markets (e.g., EBA, ECB, PRA, BoE, FINMA, SARB, and other competent authorities)
    • Outsourcing services and implementation services
  • Sound understanding of modern banking architectures and ability to position SaaS-based and GenAI-enabled solutions in complex client environments (functional, technical, integration, security, and operational aspects)
  • Comfortable using Generative AI as part of your day-to-day presales work, and able to discuss its opportunities, limitations, and responsible use with clients in a regulatory environment
  • Strong understanding of how to articulate the business value of features and capabilities of solutions and services
  • Degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or equivalent is desirable
  • Passion for working internationally in a constantly growing, agile company
  • Hands-on mentality and creative mindset to effectively integrate new ideas into the business
  • Proactive, communicative personality who uses feedback as a basis for optimization
  • Collaborative and responsible mindset, with an appreciation for working in a multicultural team
  • Openness to travelling for work

Why you should decide on us


  • Market Leadership: Join a global leader where our agile culture and innovative spirit allow you to shape the future of financial stability.
  • International Scope: Take ownership of high-profile international projects and benefit from our global internal mobility initiatives.
  • Growth & Mentorship: Access a wide range of our technical and functional training opportunities, and contribute to mentoring within the presales community.
  • Culture of Inclusion: We foster a supportive, transparent atmosphere with frequent team events and a commitment to diversity.

To get started, we only need your CV. We look forward to meeting you in a virtual or personal interview!

At Hail Creek, everything we do is about developing our people, optimising our asset and improving our future. We positively impact our people and communities. We are seeking a proactive and highly organised Training Systems Administrator to support our Health, Safety, and Training team. Reporting directly to the Training Superintendent, this role is pivotal in ensuring our training scheduling, records, and documentation align with SSE requirements, industry standards, and compliance with the Coal Mining Safety and Health Act.

You will provide comprehensive administrative support for various training activities, including training needs analysis, inductions, onboarding for employees and contractors, and conducting training system and skills audits. Ensuring the availability of training resources, equipment, and materials for both internal and external training, including quarterly offsite whole-of-mine training days, will be a key responsibility. Additionally, you will manage training costs and maintain accurate and timely records for all training assessment activities.

Training & Development

Support the site’s training system/standards, aiming to achieve industry best practice in compliance with all requirements of:


  • The Coal Mining Safety and Health Act & Regulations
  • Ensure training resources, equipment and materials are available for both internal and external training
  • Provide administrative support such as inductions and onboarding for employees and contractors
  • Control costs in line with Safety & Training department budget;
  • Ensure accurate and timely records are maintained for all training assessments activities conducted

Training Information Systems

  • Ensure that Hail Creek Mine is provided with effective, timely, and high quality training data enabling control and analysis of site training records

About You

To thrive in this position, you should possess administration experience paired with exceptional interpersonal and facilitation skills to effectively engage with diverse management levels and external stakeholders. As a highly organised professional, you should demonstrate responsiveness, enthusiasm, innovation, self-motivation, and a drive for success within a dynamic environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Word, Excel, and Outlook) is essential, alongside strong verbal and written communication skills to consistently meet deadlines. Experience in systems such as SAP, Workday or Damstra will be highly regarded.


Qualifications & Requirements

Essential

  • Hold or be working towards a Qualifications in Business Administration

Desirable

At Hail Creek Open Cut, we are committed to ensuring our people feel valued and supported. In return for your contribution, we offer:

  • Direct employment with Glencore – we are a responsible miner of coal that has a track record of operational excellence
  • A competitive package with lifestyle benefits
  • Annual short term performance bonus
  • Above award Annual Leave entitlement
  • Access to Coal Mining Industry Long Service Leave - one of the most generous long service leave schemes
  • Provision for Education Assistance if you are wanting to further your studies down the track.

Location & Lifestyle

This role offers the flexibility to live locally or take advantage of our modern onsite accommodation village. Located just over an hour from the Mackay, Hail Creek Open Cut provides easy access to the stunning Airlie Beach and Whitsunday Islands. Our diverse workforce travels from across Queensland, including Rockhampton and Townsville, making it a well-connected and accessible location.


Why Glencore?

At Glencore, our people are empowered to think and act like entrepreneurs. We recognise and reward initiative, accountability, and strong leadership, while supporting individuals to grow and advance their careers. If you are motivated, caring, intuitive, and responsive, you’ll thrive in a culture that values performance, progression, and continuous development.


Apply now

  • U.S. Citizenship.

Partnering closely with Account Managers, hospital stakeholders, and IT teams, you will drive the implementation of smart beds and connected medical devices that improve clinical workflows and patient care.

We're looking for a hands-on, agile professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys collaborating across functions, and is passionate about advancing healthcare through technology.

Given the geographical scope of the role, the ideal candidate will be located in Northern Belgium and comfortable with frequent travel to customer sites across the Netherlands.


What You'll Do

Lead Connectivity Implementations

  • Manage the local deployment of connected medical devices in hospitals, in line with regional connectivity strategy.
  • Partner with hospital IT teams and key stakeholders to develop and execute successful implementation plans.
  • Identify decision-makers and influencers involved in connectivity initiatives and help advance Baxter's intelligent healthcare solutions within their organizations.
  • Train end users and provide Level 1 post-go-live support, including incident management and escalation.
  • Collaborate closely with Account Managers, Sales Managers, and Connectivity Implementation teams to ensure seamless project delivery.

Support Customer Engagement & Pre-Sales Activities

  • Participate in consultative discussions with healthcare providers to design connectivity solutions that support their clinical workflows.
  • Work alongside marketing and clinical teams to develop connected care pathways and workflow solutions for healthcare facilities.

What You'll Bring

You are a self-starter who can turn strategy into action and build trusted relationships across all levels of healthcare organizations, including senior hospital leadership. You combine technical expertise with a strong understanding of clinical workflows and healthcare technology integration.


Technical Expertise

  • Experience implementing and supporting medical device connectivity solutions in hospital environments.
  • Strong knowledge of HL7 v2.x (ADT, ORM, ORU) and healthcare interoperability workflows.
  • Solid understanding of TCP/IP networks, VLANs, firewalls, and secure hospital IT infrastructures.
  • Experience deploying virtual machines in VMware ESXi or Hyper-V environments.
  • Familiarity with Active Directory, Windows and Linux Server environments, SQL databases, and cybersecurity requirements for connected medical devices.
  • Experience with interface testing and end-to-end troubleshooting between medical devices and EHR/EMR systems is preferred.
  • Knowledge of DICOM, FHIR, and IHE profiles is highly desirable.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with clinical, biomedical engineering, and IT infrastructure teams.

Professional Experience & Skills

  • Strong understanding of healthcare environments, clinical workflows, and healthcare data integration.
  • Proven success in managing projects and influencing multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Ability to work independently, learn quickly, and deliver results in a dynamic environment.
  • Fluent in Dutch and English; French is an advantage.

Why Join Baxter?

This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of healthcare innovation, helping hospitals leverage connected technologies that enhance patient care and operational efficiency. Join a team that is transforming healthcare while making a meaningful impact on lives every day.


Ready to make a difference? We look forward to hearing from you.

description:
Join Kyocera International, Inc.

We’re hiring a Clean Line Technician at our Vancouver, WA location!

Join a stable, long-term opportunity where your work matters. We’re hiring a Clean Line Technician to support production and ensure high-quality output in a fast-paced manufacturing setting.

Pay Range - $20-$25 per hour (Actual base pay based on factors such as relevant experience, education, market, qualifications, and skills.)

Shift: 2nd shift (M-Thu, 4x10), shift premiums available

With nearly 80,000 employees globally, Kyocera is a leading manufacturer of high-tech ceramics in various industries, including aerospace, automotive, Medical applications, and semiconductor processing. Our innovative materials are found in everything from smartphones to space shuttles! Check out our profile video!

Look at these PERKS!

  • Competitive pay, benefits, and hours
  • 120 hours of vacation accrued per year to start
  • 10 Paid Holidays per year
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Pension
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Flexible schedules
  • Tuition reimbursement

We have a long-tenured staff (many with over 30 years of service!), a vital company mission, and an excellent benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, paid time off to volunteer, paid leave options, tuition reimbursement, an employer-paid Pension and a 401(k) with both Roth and a healthy company match. Our larger locations also feature onsite gyms, walking tracks, exercise rooms, and employee gardens!

We strive to have a diverse workforce from all backgrounds, including minorities, women, and veterans, who bring their experience to support the innovation and quality that Kyocera is known for.

Kyocera International, Inc. also has a robust corporate culture and philosophy based on the experiences and writings of our founder, Dr. Kazuo Inamori, which you can learn more about here: . Our company motto is “Do the right thing as a human being,” and we try to use that motto constantly in our decision-making.

What You'll Do:

The Clean Line Technician will perform various tasks in Chemical and Clean Room environments designed to ensure manufactured parts meet customer required cleanliness specifications. They will be responsible for processing parts through the Rough Clean Line, Chem Line, visual inspection, Clean Room packaging, and Packaging. They will also be responsible for maintaining proper chemical tank composition and interacting with and processing hazardous chemical waste.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Follow all safety standards and procedures to maintain a safe and organized working environment.
  • Follow all quality standards and procedures to ensure part quality meets customer and internal specifications.
  • Use various approved tools and chemicals to hand work parts to meet visual inspection criteria.
  • Load multiple parts of different dimensions and weight into baskets to be ran through the Chem Line.
  • Performing incoming and final visual inspection following documented procedures to ensure parts meet customer and internal standards.
  • Package and label parts in a clean room environment using sealer.
  • Work individually or as a team to meet deadlines and maintain efficient production output while following all safety and quality standards.
  • Creates or updates work instructions and other associated process documentation following documented procedures.
  • Performs basic maintenance of area equipment. Responsibilities may include PM’s and basic repair.
  • Build chemical tanks following written procedures and perform analysis on chemical compositions and adjustment of chemical tanks to ensure they are within specification.
  • Use forklift, drum lift, and pallet jacks to transport hazardous waste. Perform basic waste treatment tasks to ensure waste is within specification.
  • Use various equipment to test part cleanliness and some dimensional measurements to ensure parts meet required specifications.
  • Perform basic assembly following procedure for various parts.
  • Communicates with Supervisor / Manager when obstacles or issues are present that prevent workflow and offers potential solutions.
  • Offers ideas for continual improvement and may help implement these ideas after approval.
  • Will train and/or inspect or check work of lower level technicians and operators.
What You'll Bring:
  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • 1–3 years of related experience required, preferably in a manufacturing or production environment; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
  • Ability to read, write, and understand verbal and written instructions in English, including manufacturing prints.
  • Basic computer skills, including Excel, Outlook, and spreadsheets.
  • Basic problem-solving skills with the ability to assess situations and determine the best course of action.
  • Willingness to wear latex or nitrile gloves, masks, chemical PPE, and/or cleanroom apparel as required.
  • Ability to stand, walk, or sit for extended periods on the production floor and handle small parts and hand tools.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 35 lbs.
  • Must successfully complete forklift certification within 90 days of hire.
  • Must be eligible to work in an ITAR environment and successfully pass a drug screen and background check.

description:

title: Senior Analyst
description:
When you’re the best, we’re the best. We instill an environment where employees feel engaged, satisfied and able to contribute their unique skills and talents while living and working as their authentic selves. We provide extensive opportunities for personal and professional development, building both employee competence and organizational capability to fuel exceptional performance through an inclusive environment both now and in the future.

Summary:


In this role, you will support Vizient’s Capital Equipment Solutions (CES) team through advanced data analysis, reporting, and operational insights that inform capital equipment strategies and business decisions. You will aggregate and interpret complex data, evaluate financial performance, identify trends and opportunities, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. You will work independently on complex analytical initiatives and collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance data quality, reporting capabilities, and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities:


  • Perform complex analyses of capital equipment purchasing activity, capital planning, spend, utilization, savings opportunities, and financial performance.

  • Experience analyzing complex datasets, reconciling information across multiple systems, and developing actionable insights.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex information clearly and effectively.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.

title: Control Tower Operator-1
description:
