Acting as the central point of contact between customers, carriers, origin and destination stations, and internal stakeholders, the Control Tower Operator ensures operational excellence, visibility, service compliance, and timely resolution of shipment exceptions.

The role requires strong analytical skills, customer focus, operational expertise, and the ability to manage multiple shipments and stakeholders simultaneously in a fast-paced logistics environment.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Shipment Monitoring & Visibility

  • Monitor airfreight shipments from booking through final delivery.

  • Track and manage shipment milestones and transportation events.

  • Ensure adherence to agreed transit times and customer-specific SOPs.

  • Maintain accurate shipment status updates within transportation management systems.

  • Provide proactive communication regarding shipment progress and potential delays.

Exception Management

  • Identify transportation disruptions, delays, capacity constraints, or service failures.

  • Execute contingency plans to minimize operational impact.

  • Escalate critical issues according to established escalation procedures.

  • Coordinate recovery actions with airlines, gateways, customs teams, and local operations.

Customer Service & Communication

  • Serve as the primary operational contact for assigned customers.

  • Provide regular performance updates and shipment visibility reports.

  • Respond to customer inquiries in a timely and professional manner.

  • Manage service issues and customer complaints, ensuring prompt resolution.

Operational Coordination

  • Coordinate with origin and destination offices to ensure seamless shipment execution.

  • Liaise with airlines, handling agents, trucking providers, and other service partners.

  • Ensure compliance with customer requirements, contractual obligations, and service level agreements (SLAs).

  • Validate documentation and shipment data accuracy.

Performance Management

  • Monitor operational KPIs and customer service metrics.

  • Support root cause analysis of service failures.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

  • Contribute to performance reviews and operational reporting.

Required Qualifications

Education & experience

  • Bachelor's degree and/or experience in the Forwarding industry is an advantage.

  • Fluently English both written and verbally.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Power BI.

  • Data analysis and reporting capabilities.

  • Familiarity with transportation management systems (TMS), cargo tracking platforms, and ERP systems is an advantage.

Core Competencies

Operational Excellence

  • Strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage high shipment volumes.

  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills.

Customer Focus

  • Proactive customer communication.

  • Strong service orientation.

  • Relationship management capabilities.

Problem Solving

  • Analytical mindset.

  • Ability to make decisions under pressure.

  • Effective escalation and recovery management.

Communication

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to engage with global stakeholders.

  • Professional presentation and reporting skills.

Teamwork & Collaboration

  • Cross-functional collaboration.

  • Ability to work in multicultural environments.

  • Positive and solution-oriented attitude.

title: Assistant Director of Civil Rights for ADA Equity
description:
Job Description

Position Summary:

The Division of Title IX and OEO is seeking an Assistant Director of Civil Rights for ADA Equity to provide daily oversight of University ADA access and accessibility compliance, including the ADA accommodation process for university employees, pregnancy accommodations (Title IX and employees), guidance and support for the Student’s with Disability Services, physical infrastructure, and provide training to university community. Upholding strict confidentiality standards and utilizing independent judgment and strong analytical reasoning skills are essential.

This position reports to the Executive Director for Civil Rights Compliance.

This is a 12-month full-time administrative professional position.


For full consideration, please apply by Monday, November 16, 2026, 11:59 PM (MT).


Essential Job Duties:

  • Serve as the University’s subject matter expert on ADA access, accessibility, disability accommodation processes, and barrier removal, providing consultation and guidance to employees, supervisors, administrators, and campus partners.
  • Lead and facilitate workplace accommodation requests, including employee disability accommodations and pregnancy accommodations for employees and students, and maintain accurate case documentation and records.
  • Collaborate with Human Resources, Student Disability Center, Facilities, and other campus partners to address accommodation requests, accessibility concerns, and compliance obligations.
  • Review construction, renovation, and design plans; conduct accessibility assessments and site visits; identify barriers; and recommend solutions to ensure compliance with ADA accessibility requirements.
  • Develop, modify, and provide guidance on university policies, practices, protocols, emergency response plans, and accessibility standards to support continued ADA compliance and inclusion.
  • Develop and deliver training, educational programming, outreach activities, and presentations related to disability access, ADA requirements, accommodations, and accessibility resources.
  • Process discrimination complaints by conducting informational meetings, issuing notices, facilitating informal resolutions, and providing administrative support related to discrimination claims.
  • Participate in university committees, community partnerships, regulatory inquiries, litigation support activities, and emerging ADA initiatives to advance accessibility and inclusion across the institution.

Conditions of Employment:

title: Director - Derivatives Development
description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

13

The Team

The Derivatives Data and Valuation Services group provides independent pricing, data and valuation services across a broad spectrum of vanilla through complex derivatives to many of the world’s largest asset managers, investment banks, fund administrators, auditing firms and regulators. Key solutions include Totem, Portfolio Valuations, OTC Derivatives Data and complementary services such as Initial Margin Calculation. The global team has deep subject matter expertise across derivatives markets and maintains strong relationships with both buy-side and sell-side institutions. Our Business Development team operates at the intersection of clients, markets, Product and Sales, helping determine not only how we grow our existing services, but where our derivatives franchise should develop next.


The Impact

Business Development acts as the link between evolving client and market needs and our product strategy. In this role, you will have direct responsibility for driving the commercial growth of OTC Derivatives Data while helping shape its longer-term strategy. The role requires someone who can go beyond selling an existing service. You will need to understand derivatives products and client workflows in sufficient depth to identify emerging needs, translate them into commercially viable opportunities and work with Product to bring new solutions to market. You will also work as part of a broader global team responsible for the strategy and commercialization of our overall derivatives solutions, identifying opportunities to connect OTC Derivatives Data with our valuation, consensus, margin and other capabilities.


What’s in it for you

    • See your direct impact through business growth, strategic client relationships and expansion of our services
    • Become a market-facing subject matter expert in derivatives data and workflows
    • Work alongside global experts across derivatives, valuations, data, Product and Sales
    • Engage directly with sophisticated market participants to understand how derivatives markets and workflows are changing
    • Help define future areas of growth rather than simply commercializing an established product set
    • Develop new services and use cases in partnership with clients and Product
    • Contribute to the strategy of a broader, market-leading derivatives solutions franchise

Responsibilities

    • Own and help execute the commercial growth strategy for OTC Derivatives Data, including business plans, target segments, sales campaigns and strategic growth initiatives
    • Develop a deep understanding of OTC derivatives markets, instruments and workflows, including how derivatives data is used across trading, risk, valuation, collateral/margin, operations and related investment processes
    • Work closely with clients and prospects to understand their current workflows, pain points and evolving requirements, translating market feedback into actionable product opportunities
    • Partner with Product to identify and evaluate new datasets, analytics, delivery mechanisms, workflows and adjacent use cases that could expand the OTC Derivatives Data franchise
    • Identify longer-term growth opportunities arising from changes in market structure, technology, regulation and client workflows
    • Develop clients as design partners for new products, services and capabilities
    • Conduct direct client and prospect engagement through senior-level meetings, conferences, panels, roundtables and webinars
    • Build strong relationships with key market participants and develop a network that provides insight into evolving derivatives market trends
    • Serve as a market and product SME for OTC Derivatives Data, providing Sales with technical knowledge, competitive differentiation, discovery questions and effective positioning
    • Partner closely with Sales on commercialization, pricing, licensing structures, permitted use cases and delivery models
    • Develop compelling client presentations, marketing materials, sales collateral and responses to requests for proposals
    • Conduct competitor and market analysis, with particular focus on identifying gaps in the market and areas where differentiated data or workflow integration can create sustainable competitive advantage
    • Contribute thought leadership through industry publications, conferences, panels, webinars and other market-facing channels
    • Actively participate in sales conferences, special events, client engagement initiatives and relevant industry associations
    • Work collaboratively within the broader Derivatives Data and Valuation Services team, looking beyond individual product boundaries to identify opportunities across OTC Derivatives Data, Portfolio Valuations, Totem, Initial Margin and other derivatives solutions
    • Bring an enterprise mindset to client conversations, recognizing when a client problem can be solved through a broader combination of data, valuation and workflow capabilities



What We’re Looking For

    • 5-10+ years of experience in derivatives, capital markets, market data, financial technology or a related field
    • Expert working level knowledge of OTC derivatives products and markets, ideally spanning multiple asset classes such as rates, credit, FX, equities and/or commodities
    • Practical understanding of derivatives workflows and how banks, asset managers and other financial institutions consume derivatives data, rather than purely theoretical derivatives knowledge.
    • Previous roles may include Derivatives Trading, Risk, Valuations or Research.
    • Ability to engage credibly with sophisticated derivatives practitioners across trading, risk, valuation, operations and technology functions
    • Strong commercial awareness with a demonstrated ability to identify client needs and convert them into revenue opportunities
    • Strategic mindset and curiosity about how derivatives markets are evolving, with the ability to identify opportunities beyond today's product offering
    • Ability to connect changes in market structure, technology, regulation and client operating models to potential new products and commercial opportunities
    • Ability to move comfortably between detailed product discussions and senior-level strategic conversations
    • Demonstrated ability to manage complex client relationships with the objective of increasing revenue and strengthening long-term partnerships
    • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across Product, Sales and other business functions in a global organization
    • Team-oriented mindset with the ability to optimize for the broader derivatives franchise rather than a single product
    • Ability to influence without direct authority and build alignment around new commercial and product initiatives
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex derivatives concepts clearly to both technical and executive audiences
    • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to challenge existing assumptions, develop new ideas and drive them from concept through commercialization
    • Comfortable representing the business externally through senior client engagements, conferences, roundtables and thought leadership

title: Store Collega JD Mall of the Netherlands| 38u
description:
JD Mall of the Netherlands zoekt nieuwe collega's (38 uur) die ons team willen ondersteunen en versterken!

Als Store Collega speel je een belangrijke rol in het creëren van een uitstekende winkelervaring. Je zorgt ervoor dat klanten zich welkom, ondersteund en gewaardeerd voelen, en helpt hen bij het ontdekken van onze producten. Je brengt energie naar de winkelvloer door klanten vriendelijk te begroeten, de presentatie van de winkel verzorgd te houden, voorraadaanvulling uit te voeren en hoge service- en kwaliteitsnormen te waarborgen. Dankzij jouw positieve instelling, teamgeest en klantgerichte aanpak draag je bij aan een vlot draaiende winkel en de hoge standaard waarvoor wij bekendstaan.

Ben je klaar om aan de slag te gaan in een dynamische retailomgeving, nieuwe vaardigheden te ontwikkelen en deel uit te maken van een ondersteunend team? Dan is dit een mooie kans om impact te maken en een sterke basis te leggen voor je verdere loopbaan.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je verwelkomt klanten op een vriendelijke en professionele manier en helpt hen bij het vinden van de producten die bij hun wensen passen.
  • Je gebruikt de beschikbare winkeltools en digitale systemen om voorraad te controleren, productinformatie te delen en de klantenervaring te ondersteunen.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de winkelvloer netjes, verzorgd en goed aangevuld blijft, zodat productpresentaties aantrekkelijk en inspirerend zijn.
  • Je ondersteunt dagelijkse winkelactiviteiten, zoals kassawerkzaamheden, het aanvullen van voorraad en het naleven van alle veiligheids- en winkelrichtlijnen.

Wie we zoeken

  • Je hebt een positieve en enthousiaste houding die past binnen een dynamische en klantgerichte retailomgeving.
  • Je beschikt over sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en voelt je comfortabel in het contact met klanten en collega's.
  • Je bent leergierig, neemt graag nieuwe taken op en wilt jezelf verder ontwikkelen.
  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en bereid om verschillende diensten te werken, waaronder avonden, weekends en drukke seizoensperiodes.

Wat jou extra sterk maakt

  • Je hebt een oprechte interesse in merken, trends en nieuwe producten.
  • Je neemt initiatief en stapt gemakkelijk op klanten af om hen verder te helpen.
  • Je hebt oog voor detail en zorgt ervoor dat de winkel er steeds verzorgd en uitnodigend uitziet.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen en door te groeien binnen de organisatie.

Wat wij bieden

Wij zijn een werkgever die gelijke kansen hoog in het vaandel draagt en zich inzet voor een werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich gewaardeerd, gerespecteerd en ondersteund voelt. We geloven dat diversiteit onze organisatie sterker maakt en streven ernaar dat alle collega's, ongeacht achtergrond, identiteit of levenservaring, zich kunnen ontwikkelen en een betekenisvolle bijdrage kunnen leveren. Als onderdeel van een succesvolle en voortdurend evoluerende organisatie krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan onze strategische prioriteiten: mensen centraal stellen, voorop blijven lopen op het gebied van digitale innovatie, nauw aansluiten bij de behoeften van onze klanten en streven naar operationele excellentie. We staan open voor nieuwe ideeën en verwelkomen mensen die elke dag een positieve impact willen maken.

We waarderen de inzet en betrokkenheid van onze medewerkers en bieden daarom een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden en voordelen:

  • Staff korting op alle merken van de JD Group
  • 24 vakantiedagen (op basis van full-time)
  • Korting bij andere retailers in Nederland via de 'www.corporate-benefits.nl' app.
  • Nationale en internationale carrièremogelijkheden
  • Toegang to onze online leerplatform
  • Korting op zorgverzekering
  • Toegang tot 'Telus Health' wellnessplatform
  • Pensioenregeling

KLAAR OM DEEL UIT TE MAKEN VAN TEAM JD?

Wacht niet langer en solliciteer nu! We willen je graag leren kennen!

Opgericht in 1981 met één winkel in het noordwesten van Engeland, is JD Group uitgegroeid tot een toonaangevende wereldwijde omnichannel retailer in Sports Fashion- en Outdoor-merken. De groep telt momenteel 4.850 winkels (stand per 1 februari 2025) verspreid over 49 landen (inclusief franchises en joint ventures), met een sterke aanwezigheid in het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Europa, Noord-Amerika en Azië-Pacific. JD Sports Nederland is te vinden op 33 locaties in het hele land, zoals Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Groningen en Venlo.

Een integriteitscheck via het waarschuwingsregister van de Fraud Approach Detailhandel Foundation maakt deel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Databricks Focused)
description:
Putting people first, every day

BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

Your Opportunity

BDO Digital is seeking an experienced and technically proficient Senior Data Engineer (Databricks Focused) to join our Technology Advisory Services practice. This role blends technical leadership with hands-on data engineering, focusing on delivering scalable, secure, and production-grade data pipelines using Azure and Databricks. The successful candidate will also lead client engagements, aligning data initiatives with business objectives to create real-world impact.


Key Responsibilities
Data Engineering and Platform Development

  • Design, build, and optimize robust data pipelines using Databricks, Delta Lake, and Apache Spark.
  • Develop scalable ETL processes for structured and unstructured data, ensuring data quality and reliability.
  • Implement data integration solutions across cloud and on-premises sources, leveraging Databricks and Azure Data Lake.
  • Automate data ingestion, transformation, and validation workflows.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and enhance data pipeline performance and reliability.
  • Ensure compliance, security, and operational excellence across all data workflows.

Client and Team Leadership

  • Serve as a primary technical lead for client engagements focused on data engineering and analytics solution delivery.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable data architectures and operational plans.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate data solutions into production environments.
  • Mentor junior team members and promote adoption of best practices in data engineering and cloud analytics.

Data Application

  • Convert business requirements and analytics prototypes into robust, scalable data solutions.
  • Apply appropriate data modeling and transformation techniques to support analytics and machine learning initiatives.
  • Document data pipelines and contribute to internal knowledge sharing.

Qualifications
Required

  • Educational Background: A Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a closely related discipline. Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
  • Professional Experience: A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including at least 3 years of direct experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, and cloud data platforms. Proven success in deploying and maintaining large-scale data solutions in production environments.
  • In-depth knowledge of the Microsoft Azure ecosystem, with demonstrated experience using services such as Azure Data Lake, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse, and Azure DevOps.
  • Very strong proficiency with Databricks, including hands-on work with Delta Lake, Apache Spark, and data pipeline orchestration. Experience optimizing performance and reliability in production.
  • Advanced programming skills in Python and/or Scala, with practical experience using data engineering libraries and frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD practices, with experience designing and maintaining pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or ARM templates for automating environment provisioning and deployment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with a range of stakeholders, including data scientists, engineers, business partners, and executive leadership. Proven ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.

Preferred

  • Certifications: Professional certifications such as Databricks Certified Data Engineer or Microsoft Certified, e.g. Azure Data Engineer Associate.
  • Experience with data governance, data security, and compliance frameworks.
  • Consulting experience and excellent communication and client management skills.


The expected range of compensation for this role is $84,000 to $128,000.


Why BDO?

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences.


At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars—Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next - shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together.

Our firm is committed to providing an environment where you can be successful in the following ways:

  • We enable you to engage with how we change and evolve, being a key contributor to the success and growth of BDO in Canada.
  • We help you become a better professional within our services, industries, and markets with extensive opportunities for learning and development.

Job Description

Interested in launching an exciting engineering career by joining a world class manufacturing site of a leading global company, home of iconic brands like Ariel, Pampers, Gillette, Pantene, Always, Lenor or Oral-B?.

If you are excited to gain real experience from FMCG production plant with world-renowned technologies and have truly meaningful work from the first day, join our team in Rakona plant as Manufacturing Internship/Trainee. We are looking for engineering students who can handle dynamic work environments and who know how to think outside of the box. If you would like to be a part of this challenge and you are passionate about inventing, developing, reapplying, and delivering processes and packing technologies, then Manufacturing Internship/Trainee is excellent for you!

Take a sneak peak into the our culture and operation in this video!

📝 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Internship/Traineeship is the opportunity to be on the production floor meeting different challenges. It's up to you to make decisions and the results of those decisions through. Discovering our leading technologies which are world-renowned and also the P&G standards and methods. In the end, you will build your own capabilities through the job experience, mentoring and training. Internship/traineeship takes place in the 2 following areas:

Production - Packing
Here you would get our products into their final packaging and set up in pallets. Your mission will be to create studies of performance loss (on equipment, skills, organization), identifying one or more key projects to achieve the performance targets of the packing lines, establishing methods for solving technical problems, maintenance systematization, implementation of production management tools to the production and work on the installation and startups of new equipments.

Production - Making
This is the department that produces our products based on the recipes we get from Research & Development. Your mission will be to make the study and analysis of performance loss (equipment, organization, skills), ensuring smooth communication between different departments (logistics, packing, projects etc.), crafting learning programs for operators and team leader to help them to develop their skills, establishing systematization tools, simplifying process and work standardizing.

This role is an excellent and unique opportunity to learn real hand-on experiences you will not get from school. You’ll expand your knowledge based on personal experiences with industry experts and you'll work on the latest high-tech control and manufacturing technology. All of that supported by great managers who will invest in your development as part a multifunctional team in which trust, team spirit, accountability and respect are very important.

2-3 months full time experience. Available during summer period (June to September).

Traineeship

6 months at least 60% of working hours experience. Available during whole year.

Your presence in our
  • Friendly & respectful working environment: At the core of our organization are our employees, whom we deeply value. We foster a diverse work environment that places great importance on work-life balance, ensuring that each individual is supported and empowered to thrive.

  • Health and safety are a top priority with all of our roles and sites. We continue to collaborate with medical and health professionals and take all recommended precautions in our buildings to keep people healthy.
  • Developing our talent is a priority: we have a culture of growth and internal promotion that sets us apart. At Procter & Gamble, we give individual meaning work and responsibility from day one with effective and consistent training and mentoring. In this way, we demonstrate our employees' strengths and develop them.

Senior Consultant – Product Security & Compliance (Connected Products)

Location: United States (Remote)
Business Unit: Cyber Security

Imagine your customer is a leading industrial component manufacturer, specializing in top-notch manufacturing and transportation equipment. You have ambitious goals: to streamline processes, ensure top-quality security for your client’s products, and assure cybersecurity. That’s where you come in. Our analysis will bridge any gaps across design, engineering, SDLC and technical control testing, and regulatory readiness, helping clients meet requirements such as the EU CRA, IEC 62443, and other product security standards.

With our expertise in testing, inspection and independent security validation services, you will assist your client in raising their cyber resilience like never before. Your success story? It's written in client readiness and satisfaction, secure products, and audit-defensible evidence. Now also imagine the same story, but for products such as vehicles, medical devices, ships, IoT products, network equipment, software products, etc. Doesn’t it sound like an exciting mission?

Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity provides cybersecurity services covering people, organization, technology, of products, and connected ecosystems.

We have reputable clients and they request expertise to increase their level of cybersecurity, and regulatory readiness.

Role Overview

The Senior Consultant – Product Security & Compliance is a doer role responsible for delivering product security and compliance engagements while supporting the growth of Bureau Veritas’ Cyber Security services across North America.

This role focuses on helping clients translate regulatory requirements for North American customers, into practical, engineering-aligned product security controls, harmonized with frameworks across sectors with current compliance standards and frameworks

The individual will work across industrial, IoT, embedded, software, medical technology, transportation, and cloud-connected product environments, supporting execution of engagements, development of repeatable offerings, and business development activities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Client Engagement Delivery

  • Execute and support delivery of product security consulting engagements, including:
    • Product security maturity assessments
    • CRA, IEC 62443, IoT security, automotive, medical device,- standards and regulatory readiness and gap assessments
    • Threat modeling, abuse case analysis, and product risk assessments
    • Secure architecture review and security requirement definition for connected products
    • Secure product development lifecycle (PDL/SDL) and technical product technical requirements implementation support
    • Product security, maturity modelling, scoring, heatmaps, and remediation roadmaps
  • Translate regulatory and standard requirements into engineering actions, test cases, control frameworks, and evidence expectations
  • Produce structured, audit-defensible deliverables aligned to BV methodologies

2. Regulatory Harmonization & Product Security Compliance

  • Apply and operationalize product cybersecurity regulatory frameworks across engagements
  • Support harmonization and implementation across product security regulations and standards, including:
  • Regulatory Standards and Frameworks:
    • EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA)
    • NIS2 Directive
    • Relevant North American IoT security initiatives (e.g., NIST, FCC, and related connected-device security expectations)
  • Secure Development Lifecycle & Process Standards:
    • IEC 62443-4-1
    • NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)
    • OWASP SAMM
    • ISO/IEC 27034 and secure software engineering practices
  • Technical Security Requirements & Baselines:
    • EU Common Criteria
    • IEC 62443-4-2
    • ETSI EN 303 645 (IoT security)
    • NIST IoT cybersecurity guidance
    • OWASP ASVS and API security frameworks
  • Software Supply Chain & SBOM:
    • SBOM standards and formats (SPDX, Cyclone-DX)
    • NIST supply chain risk management guidance
  • Sector-Specific Frameworks (as applicable):
    • ISO/SAE 21434 and UNECE R155/R156 (automotive)
    • FDA and MDCG cybersecurity guidance (medical devices)
    • ISO 14971 (medical risk management)
  • Develop and use:
    • Control mappings, and CRA/IEC/sector-specific requirement crosswalks
    • Evidence matrices, assessment checklists, and regulatory traceability models
    • Compliance scoring models, maturity models, heatmaps, and remediation roadmaps
    • Help clients move from regulatory interpretation → implementation → verification → readiness

3. Product Security Engineering & Architecture Support

  • Support clients in securing connected product architectures, including:
    • Embedded systems and firmware, device operating systems, and product interfaces
    • Industrial and IoT devices, network equipment, and operational technology components
    • Software applications, APIs, and web management interfaces
    • Cloud-connected product backends, and supporting infrastructure
  • Contribute to:
    • Threat models
    • Security architecture definitions
    • Identity, communication, and data protection strategies
  • Assist in defining aligned technical product security requirements and validation criteria mapped to EU CC, CRA, IEC 62443, OWASP, NIST, ETSI, and sector-specific expectations

4. Security Verification & Validation Support

  • Contribute to product and system-level security validation activities,
  • Support development of test cases, validation frameworks and evidence packages aligned to regulatory and standard requirements
  • Help structure outputs into certification and regulations ready evidence packages

5. Business Development (Seller-Doer Expectation)

  • Support growth of product security, and regulatory compliance services through:
    • Client discussions, technical solutioning and discovery workshops
    • Proposal development and response support
    • Participation in discovery workshops and scoping sessions
  • Help position BV as a trusted partner for product security, CRA readiness, and connected-product assurance
  • Contribute to service offering development and reusable artifacts

6. Capability Development & Team Contribution

  • Contribute to building repeatable product security, and compliance methodologies and templates
  • Support development of:
    • Regulatory aligned frameworks
    • Product security assessment models
    • Testing and validation structures
  • Mentor junior consultants and support team knowledge development
  • Collaborate with global BV teams and technical specialists

Required Experience

Core Experience

  • 6–10 years of experience in cybersecurity with exposure to product security, industrial systems, embedded systems, or connected devices
  • Experience working in consulting or client-facing delivery roles
  • Hands-on involvement in security assessments, risk analysis, vulnerability management, or architecture engagements

Technical Competencies

  • Understanding of:
    • Threat modeling and risk assessment methodologies
    • Secure development lifecycle (SDL) concepts
    • Product and system security architecture
    • Software supply chain security (SBOM, SCA)

title: District Leader In Training (Charleston Market)
description:
The District Leader in Training (DLIT) is a developmental leadership position designed to prepare high-potential leaders for future District Leader opportunities within the convenience store industry. Through structured training, hands-on operational experience, and leadership development, the DLIT gains the knowledge and skills necessary to develop store leadership teams, drive business performance, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

The DLIT begins with an intensive training program focused on both front-end and kitchen (food service) operations, people leadership, and business management. Following initial training, DLIT will operate a store while continuing to develop the competencies required to successfully oversee store operations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Responsibilities:

  • Successfully complete a structured District Leader in Training program designed to develop the leadership, operational, and financial competencies required for future multi-unit leadership responsibilities.
  • Partner with District Leaders to drive consistent execution of merchandising, food service, safety, and customer experience standards across multiple locations.
  • Lead daily store operations across front-end and kitchen functions during development rotations, ensuring excellence in customer service, food service, merchandising, safety, and adherence to company standards.
  • Analyze operational and financial performance metrics to identify trends, drive informed business decisions, and develop action plans that improve business results.
  • Develop proficiency in financial reporting, labor management, inventory control, expense management, and profitability analysis.
  • Support the development and execution of action plans that drive sales growth, operating performance, and profitability.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition, District Leaders, and Store Leaders to support recruiting efforts, participate in candidate interviews, assist with selection decisions, and help build high-performing store teams.
  • Build leadership capability within Store Leaders and store teams through coaching, performance management, recognition, and development planning.
  • Participate in district business reviews, store assessments, and strategic planning initiatives to support business objectives.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, operating standards, asset protection initiatives, safety expectations, and regulatory requirements.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, engagement, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
  • Serve as a role model for company values, leadership expectations, and exceptional customer service.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Demonstrated leadership ability with experience motivating, coaching, developing, and holding team members accountable for performance and growth.
  • Strong customer service orientation with a commitment to delivering an exceptional customer experience.
  • Business acumen with the ability to analyze operational and financial metrics, identify trends, and make informed decisions to improve business performance.
  • Foundational knowledge of retail operations, including front-end operations, kitchen operations, food preparation, merchandising, inventory management, labor planning, and expense control.
  • Effective problem-solving, critical-thinking, and decision-making skills in a fast-paced, multi-unit retail environment.
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels of the organization.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and attention-to-detail skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, reporting requirements, and compliance standards.
  • Adaptability, resilience, and willingness to embrace change in a dynamic retail environment.
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and accountability, with proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, reporting tools, and retail management systems.

EDUCATION AND REQUIREMENTS

Required:

  • High school diploma or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of leadership experience in retail, convenience store, restaurant, hospitality, or multi-unit operations.
  • District Leaders in Training are expected to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours to support training objectives and business needs.
  • Demonstrated experience leading teams and delivering business results.
  • Strong communication, coaching, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to analyze data and solve operational challenges.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
  • Ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned market.

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, management, or a related field; or equivalent leadership experience.
  • Experience within the convenience store, fuel retail, grocery, restaurant, or multi-unit retail industry.
  • ServSafe Food Protection Manager certification (or equivalent) preferred
  • Experience in kitchen operations and training, including food preparation, food safety, and training team members on kitchen procedures.
  • Prior experience as a Store Manager, General Manager, or similar leadership role.
  • Experience recruiting, hiring, and developing frontline and leadership talent.
  • Demonstrated success driving sales growth, operational performance, and employee engagement.
  • Experience managing profit and loss performance, labor budgets, and key business metrics.
  • Proven ability to lead through change and influence results across multiple teams or locations.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to work in a retail convenience store environment, including exposure to varying temperatures and standing for extended periods of time.
  • Be able to lift up to 50lbs

Positions are available in Summerville, Ladson, North Charleston, and Charleston.

title: Graphic Design Specialist
description:
Are you a creative professional with a strong sense of brand identity and a passion for innovative design? At Auld & White Constructors, our growing Marketing team plays a vital role in telling our story, supporting business development efforts, and showcasing the people and projects that set us apart. As our Graphic Design Specialist, you’ll take ownership of AWC’s visual identity, bringing fresh ideas and creative expertise to everything from proposals and print materials to photography and video.

Why Join Auld & White Constructors?

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits
  • Join a growing company where you’ll have the opportunity to help shape and elevate our brand
  • Bring your creativity to life across a diverse range of projects, people, and marketing initiatives
  • Consistently ranked one of Jacksonville’s “Best Places to Work”

Position Summary

The Graphic Design Specialist is a newly created role within AWC’s growing Marketing team. It focuses on three core areas: proposal and print design, video production and graphics, and photography. Reporting to the Marketing Manager, this role will create compelling visual content that helps win work, strengthens our brand, and tells our story across proposals, presentations, social media, and our websites.

We see AI as a tool that enhances a designer’s creativity and capabilities rather than replacing them. We’re looking for someone who can use these tools to explore more creative directions, speed up production, and focus on the decisions that make our brand distinct. This position works primarily in the office, with time spent on jobsites and at events as needed.

Position Description

  • Design and produce RFP/RFQ proposals, presentations, and capability materials that reflect AWC’s brand identity and support business development
  • Create graphics and produce engaging, dynamic video content, including shooting and editing short-form and social media video
  • Plan, shoot, and edit photography and video of staff, projects, jobsites, and events for use in marketing materials and social media
  • Design brochures, flyers, advertisements, and other marketing collateral for print and digital channels
  • Design vehicle wraps, signage, event medals, awards, and other branded materials
  • Maintain company and project websites, ensuring content and branding remain current and consistent
  • Serve as AWC’s brand champion, owning the visual identity and ensuring consistency across all internal and external marketing materials
  • Coordinate with vendors for printing, signage, and production services as needed

What You’ll Bring

  • 5–7 years of professional design experience, including brand identity work
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating brand identity work, ideally including proposals or B2B marketing materials
  • Proficiency in Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop
  • Video production experience, including shooting, editing, and producing dynamic, engaging content
  • Photography experience capturing candid team moments and architectural subjects, with an understanding of light, shade, and shadow
  • Openness to using AI tools to strengthen design, photography, and video work, with the judgment to know when they improve the result and when they don’t
  • Motion graphics experience in Premiere Pro or After Effects is a plus

title: Executive Credit Officer
description:
Position Summary

The Executive Credit Officer (ECO) manages Busey’s Commercial Approval and Underwriting Processes for the regions they support and oversee. The ECO serves as a credit resource for business lines as well as working with senior management on corporate initiatives.

Duties & Responsibilities

Portfolio & Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain sound borrower relationships while actively monitoring portfolio performance and associated credit risk
  • Ensure risk rating systems remain current and accurately reflect portfolio risk, including appropriate regulatory loan grades and PD/LGD assessments
  • Review and approve field examinations, audits, loan reviews, regulatory examinations, Annual Loan Servicing Reviews (ALSRs), non-accrual recommendations, charge-offs, Troubled Debt Restructuring (TDR) assessments, and Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) analyses and reserve recommendations
  • Monitor borrower performance and emerging risks, ensuring timely identification and resolution of credit concerns

Credit Advisory & Structuring

  • Provide credit counseling and consultative guidance on transaction analysis and structuring to align requests with the bank's credit policies and risk appetite
  • Facilitate timely and well-supported credit analysis, loan structuring, and decision-making for both new credit requests and relationship renewals
  • Partner with Relationship Managers, Credit Analysts, Underwriters, and other stakeholders to gain early involvement in the credit process, influencing deal structure and risk mitigation strategies

Business Partnership & Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with Commercial Banking teams through regular communication, leadership meeting attendance, and visits to regional and remote offices
  • Promote open dialogue and early collaboration in the credit process while supporting client calling activities and business development efforts
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to banking teams by balancing growth objectives with prudent risk management

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Credit Officers and Commercial Underwriters
  • Provide guidance and oversight to ensure timely, accurate, and well-reasoned credit recommendations
  • Foster adherence to credit policy, regulatory requirements, and sound underwriting practices across the team

Workflow & Operational Management

  • Partner with Regional Presidents and banking leadership to manage underwriting workflows and ensure timely support for new and existing client relationships
  • Oversee resource allocation and process efficiency to meet service level expectations while maintaining strong credit quality standards
  • Drive consistency, accountability, and operational excellence throughout the credit approval process

Education & Experience

Knowledge of:

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal, organizational, analytical, presentation, and critical thinking skills
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the overall departmental function, including expert knowledge in Busey’s Commercial/Credit line of business

Ability to:

  • Provide accurate and timely Commercial Analysis and Approval
  • Take independent action within established options and develops new procedures and approaches to problems when necessary
  • Analyze situations and solve problems
  • Perform duties and make decisions under frequent time pressures

Education and Training:

  • Requires Bachelor’s degree with a concentration in Business or Finance; advanced degree preferred
  • Requires 15+ or more years of Commercial Credit experience with prior single signature approval authority
  • Requires 15+ years’ experience in a progressive management/leadership role
  • Requires proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office

Every day, our associates live Busey’s core values, doing better business, building stronger relationships and creating thriving communities—while delivering meaningful value to shareholders.


Compensation and Benefits

Salary offered is based on factors, including but not limited to, the job duties, required qualifications and relevant experience, and local market trends. The role may be eligible for bonus or incentives based on company and individual performance.

(Base Pay Range: $260,000 - $300,000/year)

Busey provides a competitive Total Rewards package in return for your time, talents, efforts and ultimately, results. Your personal and professional well-being—now and in the years to come—are important to us. Busey’s Total Rewards include a competitive benefits package offering 401(k) match, profit sharing, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, company-paid life insurance and long-term disability, supplemental voluntary life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, wellness incentives and an employee assistance program. The Market Intelligence Cyber Governance and Compliance team serves as the strategic bridge between security requirements and business objectives, advocating for robust security practices while enabling commercial success.   • Analyze and interpret complex regulatory requirements, assess scope and organizational compliance capabilities, and develop comprehensive guidance for development and technical teams to ensure adherence

  • Establish and maintain a comprehensive knowledge repository of pre-approved security positions, standardized language, and control framework mappings to drive consistency and efficiency across engagements

  • Working knowledge of financial services and enterprise regulatory environments, including GDPR, DORA, NIS2, EU AI Act and related compliance regimes
  • Proven track record of making independent, defensible risk decisions in high-pressure deal environments with measurable business impact

title: BGS F/A-18 Sustainment Chief Program Engineer (CPE)
description:

Company:

The Boeing Company

Boeing Global Services (BGS) is looking for an energetic, talented, and forward-thinking Engineering Multi-Skill Manager (M-level) to join our USN Engineering Product Support team in St. Louis, MO. This role would be the BGS F/A-18 Sustainment Chief Program Engineer (CPE) in addition to leading a team of systems engineers and product integrator direct reports involved in working on sustaining activities for F/A-18 support after delivery

The CPE has responsibility for overall safety, technical integrity, and engineering execution excellence for the F/A-18 Sustainment activities and supporting systems. The CPE is a key member of the F/A-18 BGS Program Leadership Team and is accountable to the BGS F/A-18 Program Director. This position is the BGS senior engineering leader for the program and the senior technical interface to customers, teammates, and suppliers. This individual is also responsible for program technical integration across Boeing business units. This position will operate per PRO-6924, which outlines the Chief Program Engineer role. This is a high visibility, fast paced, challenging assignment with direct customer interface.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Lead a team with diverse mix of logistics and engineering supporting Boeing Global Service (BGS) F/A-18 statement of work.
  • Ensure safety and product integrity for the sustainment & support of F/A-18

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, lift up to 25 pounds, and work in a manufacturing environment with production equipment.

title: Associate Director, Medical Information
description:
Location: This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.

The Opportunity

Praxis is seeking an Associate Director, Medical Information to build and lead our AI-enabled Medical Information capability as we prepare for potential launch and future portfolio growth. This role will establish the strategy, operating model, content standards, and governance needed to deliver high-quality Medical Information at scale.

You will serve as a senior scientific expert for complex Medical Information escalations while shaping how technology and human expertise work together to support healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, and other stakeholders. You will oversee scientific response content, ensure AI-generated responses are accurate, balanced, current, and appropriately governed, and use inquiry insights to continuously improve the Medical Information experience.

This is a high-ownership builder role for a leader who combines strong scientific judgment with operational discipline and curiosity about technology. You will work across Medical, Legal, Regulatory, and other functions to establish a scalable capability that is launch-ready, responsive to stakeholder needs, and built to evolve with the Praxis portfolio.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Own Medical Information strategy and operating model: Define and evolve the Medical Information strategy, processes, service model, metrics, and technology roadmap to support launch readiness and future portfolio growth.
  • Lead complex Medical Information: Serve as the senior escalation point for complex or high-impact inquiries, providing or overseeing timely, accurate, balanced, and scientifically appropriate responses to healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, specialty pharmacies, payers, and other stakeholders.
  • Build and govern scientific content: Lead development and maintenance of a rigorous, scalable Medical Information content library. Establish standards for scientific quality, consistency, currency, and audience-appropriate communication, incorporating relevant literature and emerging data.
  • Lead AI-enabled Medical Information: Shape the effective use of AI across Medical Information, providing human oversight of AI-generated responses and establishing appropriate quality, governance, and validation standards. Identify opportunities to improve response quality, knowledge bases, content coverage, and workflows through technology.
  • Turn inquiries into insight: Establish a structured approach to analyzing inquiry trends, recurring questions, and emerging information needs. Translate those insights into content improvements, educational opportunities, stakeholder insights, and enhancements to the Medical Information experience.
  • Drive cross-functional governance and launch readiness: Partner with Medical, Legal, Regulatory, and other stakeholders to establish appropriate review and governance processes, documentation, and standards. Ensure the Medical Information capability is prepared to support launch and operates effectively as products and stakeholder needs evolve.
  • Build the team and capability: Establish scalable ways of working and help develop the people, partnerships, and capabilities needed to deliver Medical Information with speed, quality, and consistency. Promote a culture of ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

  • PharmD, RN, or bachelor’s degree in a life-sciences discipline; PharmD strongly preferred.
  • 7+ years of relevant pharmaceutical or biotechnology experience, with substantial Medical Information experience and direct experience responding to unsolicited medical inquiries. Experience supporting launch-stage or commercial products strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to build or lead Medical Information capabilities, including strategy, content development, inquiry management, governance, processes, and metrics.
  • Strong scientific judgment and demonstrated ability to evaluate clinical literature and emerging data and translate complex information into clear, accurate, balanced responses for diverse audiences.
  • Excellent medical writing and communication skills, with confidence engaging directly with healthcare professionals and other stakeholders.
  • Experience developing and governing Medical Information response content and knowledge repositories, ideally using modern inquiry management and digital platforms.
  • Demonstrated interest in and practical understanding of AI-enabled Medical Information, including the judgment to distinguish where technology can improve scale and experience from where human expertise and oversight are essential.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to build trust and alignment across Medical, Legal, Regulatory, and operational teams.
  • A builder and owner who moves with urgency, brings structure to ambiguity, identifies gaps early, and continuously raises the quality and scalability of the function.
  • Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, operate effectively in a fast-moving environment, and adapt as business and portfolio needs evolve.

The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

The Vice President, Retirement Product Strategy & Development is a senior product leadership role with general management responsibility for Retirement Partners’ product team and accountability for the retirement product and platform portfolio. This leader will shape and execute the product vision, own integrated development roadmaps, and translate enterprise strategy into scalable capabilities that materially improve the advisor and client experience.

Working across Technology, Operations, Research, Legal, Product Risk, Finance, Comprehensive Advice, Marketing & Communications, Sales, and other Wealth Management teams, the VP will lead complex initiatives from opportunity identification and business case development through design, launch, commercialization, adoption, and ongoing optimization. The role requires a leader who can combine deep retirement expertise, product-management discipline, commercial judgment, and strong cross-functional influence to deliver measurable business outcomes.


Strategic Priorities:

This role will lead and/or materially advance priorities that strengthen LPL’s integrated retirement and wealth proposition, including:

  • Launching solutions that provide advisors access to active workplace retirement accounts and held-away retirement assets.
  • Developing and commercializing pooled and multiple-employer solutions, including PEP/MEP/MEAP capabilities, to accelerate net-new plan growth.
  • Expanding the Small Business Owner retirement and workplace-benefits suite, including NQDC and Cash Balance Plan capabilities.
  • Delivering a competitive, fully custodied retail retirement suite across SEP, SIMPLE, and Solo 401(k) products.
  • Modernizing retirement experiences, data, workflows, and platform capabilities to reduce advisor friction and improve scalability.
  • Optimizing the retirement-to-wealth flywheel through stronger rollover, retention, participant advice, and cross-sell capabilities.
  • Building disciplined go-to-market strategies for new product launches that drive advisor awareness, adoption, and measurable commercial impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Own product vision and roadmap. Set the strategic direction and integrated roadmap for Retirement Partners’ products and platforms, balancing advisor needs, market opportunity, economics, regulatory requirements, risk, and technology dependencies.
  • Lead product development end to end. Convert strategic opportunities into clear business cases, product requirements, journey maps, workflows, and executable development plans; guide initiatives from concept through launch and continuous improvement.
  • Drive commercialization and adoption. Partner with Marketing, Communications, Sales, Consulting, and Service teams to develop positioning, launch plans, advisor education, adoption strategies, and success measures for new and enhanced solutions.
  • Serve as a retirement product authority. Act as a subject matter expert across Retirement Partners offerings, including BOR, 401(k), NQDC, 403(b), HSAs, pooled-plan solutions, retail retirement products, and related platform capabilities.
  • Bring the advisor voice into product decisions. Engage advisors to understand needs, pain points, and emerging opportunities; translate feedback into prioritized roadmap decisions that support holistic wealth management.
  • Create differentiated advisor experiences. Lead the design and enhancement of end-to-end workflows and journeys that make retirement solutions easier to understand, adopt, implement, and service.
  • Lead through influence. Mobilize cross-functional teams across Technology, Operations, Legal, Risk, Finance, Research, Comprehensive Advice, and other product organizations to remove barriers and deliver enterprise-scale outcomes.
  • Strengthen product governance and risk management. Partner with Product Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Operations to embed effective due diligence, operational readiness, controls, and ongoing monitoring throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Stay ahead of the market. Monitor regulatory developments, competitor offerings, pricing, policy, platform innovation, and advisor trends; turn insights into actionable recommendations that strengthen LPL’s competitive position.
  • Build product-management excellence. Help standardize product-management disciplines, decision frameworks, prioritization, measurement, and commercialization practices across Retirement Partners and partner organizations.
  • Lead and develop talent. Provide direction, coaching, and accountability to the product team while building a high-performance culture focused on strategic thinking, execution excellence, collaboration, and measurable outcomes.

What are we looking for?

We want strong collaborators who can deliver a world-class customer service experience for LPL’s Financial Professionals. We are looking for people who thrive in a fast-paced environment, are client-focused, team-oriented, and are able to execute in a way that encourages creativity and continuous improvement.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 10 years of relevant financial-services experience, with significant experience in retirement, product management, product development, institutional accounts, or related businesses.
  • Deep knowledge of retirement products, workplace and individual retirement markets, institutional accounts, and the regulatory environment.
  • Demonstrated success developing and launching complex financial products, platforms, or digital capabilities from strategy through commercialization.
  • Strong strategic and commercial acumen, with the ability to evaluate market opportunities, economics, customer needs, risk, and execution tradeoffs to make sound product decisions.
  • Proven ability to lead large, cross-functional initiatives in a highly matrixed organization and drive decisions without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, roadmap prioritization, agile development, workflow and journey design, and go-to-market execution.
  • Exceptional executive communication, storytelling, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate advisor and client insights into scalable product solutions and measurable business outcomes.
  • Ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, resolve escalations, and maintain momentum on strategically important initiatives.
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to develop talent, build alignment, and inspire teams around a compelling product vision.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Success in this role will be measured by the ability to turn Retirement Partners’ strategy into an integrated, competitive product portfolio that improves the advisor experience, expands retirement capabilities, accelerates adoption and growth, strengthens retention, and creates more seamless connectivity between retirement and wealth.

The primary purpose of this role is to provide support to the manufacturing team in achieving its production goals and customer quality requirements. This includes monitoring and escalating any issues to the production supervisor, engaging the team, helping drive to continuous improvement within the area, and performing supporting tasks to allow the operators to focus on their main tasks.

  • Experience and proven capability in performing all the jobs in the area being supported

The Manufacturing – Engineering Technician (MET) works with the Manufacturing Engineer (ME) or Production Supervisor to provide support to Production. It aims to enable a fast response to BOM, design, or manufacturability improvements or problems that impede assembly operations.

The MET also acts as a liaison between design engineering and production team members during prototype and pilot builds. The MET also supports Manufacturing Engineering by identifying areas where Manufacturing Assembly Instructions (MAI’s) / standardized work instructions would improve productivity and/or quality. The MET also assists in the design and implementation of new tooling and/or fixtures.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Two year degree in Engineering or equivalent work experience with 4+ years of experience in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in manufacturing and/or assembly lines is needed. Welding and/or metal fabrication is desired.
  • Strong computer AutoDesk skills, including Microsoft Office applications and experience with computer database systems.
  • Experience with CAD programs (Solidworks; Autocad is a plus), to properly troubleshoot manufacturability issues.
  • Basic understanding of an ERP System- preferably, IFS
  • Results-oriented, able to maintain positive relationships with all levels of staff, be a team player, and be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated competency in identifying root causes of manufacturability problems and suggesting corrective measures.
  • Demonstrated strong communication skills during the resolution of assembly problems with assembly team members and shop supervisors.
  • Ability to work in cross functional teams to achieve operational results required.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of BOMs and product structures. Be able to read and interpret engineering drawings.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills.

Consumer & Sports

Strategic narrative development for lifestyle, fashion, beauty, wellness brands, and advisory and communications support for teams, leagues, brands, and investors at the intersection of sports, media, and culture.

Technology

Works with startups, technology companies, investors, and innovators to build visibility, shape narratives, and support business growth.

title: Manager, Channel Partner
description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

PayPal is looking for a commercially minded Manager,Channel Partner to own and grow our existing partner portfolio in Australia, including live eCommerce platform, PSP and software partners that bring merchants to PayPal. The focus is on deepening the partnerships we already have, not signing new ones.

You will lead programs that move partners and their merchants onto PayPal’s latest stack and bring on merchants not yet using PayPal, while keeping each partner relationship healthy and passing higher-value opportunities to our BDR and sales teams.

This is a hands-on, commercial role within a small, senior team, not an administration or reporting position. You will report to the Head of Channel Partnerships and Business Development, work across Product, Solutions and Integration, Marketing, Legal, Risk, and the Enterprise and SMB sales teams, and be accountable for delivering measurable, incremental volume.

Experience managing a portfolio of live channel, platform, PSP, ISV or agency partners in payments, fintech, eCommerce or SaaS, with a track record of growing partner-sourced volume or revenue. Strong commercial and negotiation skills, including agreeing upgrade plans, incentives, revenue share and renewals with senior partner stakeholders, and persuading partners to change integrations that already work for them.


A working understanding of merchant payments, including checkout, API and SDK integrations, onboarding and KYC flows, and Pay Later products, with the ability to translate between partner engineers and Product. Data-driven and marketing-minded, comfortable using Salesforce and BI tools to size opportunities and build partner scorecards, and designing partner-led and co-marketing campaigns that deliver measurable results.


Strong project and stakeholder management across Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Finance and Sales, with the ability to run several partner programs at once and hold partners and internal teams to dates. Knowledge of the ANZ eCommerce and payments ecosystem (platforms, PSPs, accounting and business software, agencies) is a strong advantage. title: Transaction Manager
description:
Job Description

To support in the execution of and management of financial transactions adhering to regulatory compliance and defined policies and procedures.
To play a crucial role in ensuring accurate deal booking and adherence to established processes within the organisation’s Transaction Management function. Mitigate operational and reputational risk by validating the quality and accuracy of transaction data, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements, and supporting effective risk management practices.
To collaborate with various stakeholders, including traders, risk management teams, and back-office processing functions, to uphold data integrity, streamline processes, and enhance the overall efficiency and accuracy of transaction management.
  • Conduct detailed reviews of transaction data to identify discrepancies, verify completeness, and ensure data integrity within transaction systems, thus supporting reliable financial reporting.
  • Engage in the due diligence process by compiling the necessary documentation and liaising with relevant advisors.
  • Act as a key point of contact, addressing inquiries, providing updates, and ensuring a high level of service throughout the transaction process to maintain client satisfaction and trust.
  • Monitor and ensure all transactions adhere to internal policies and external regulatory requirements, including KYC (Know Your Customer) and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) standards, to prevent legal and financial penalties.
  • Assist in the execution of transactions, coordinating closing logistics, finalising documentation, and ensuring all procedural requirements are met for successful transaction completion.
  • Validate that all transactions are booked accurately and in line with client instructions and regulatory requirements to minimise booking errors and reduce operational risk.
  • Identify and flags any inconsistencies or irregularities in transaction data, escalating issues promptly to mitigate financial and reputational risk.
  • Attend DCF's for all new deals and comment on Legal Agreements and ensure that the legal agreements can be operationalised.
  • Engage with the Deal Team and the TM to ensure that deal intention is understood and that Transaction Management can provide the support required to implement the deal and conduct the ongoing maintenance required.
  • Ensure processes are followed and backdate approval is required where necessary.
  • Ensure New Deal implementation is approved according to Legals and the DCF.
  • Reconcile transaction records across different systems to confirm data consistency and integrity across platforms.
  • Participate in projects aimed at improving transaction management processes, focusing on automation, accuracy, and efficiency to enhance data quality standards.
  • Communicate transaction data quality insights to internal stakeholders, including traders and risk managers, ensuring transparency and promoting proactive issue resolution.
  • Develop and monitor key metrics for data quality within the transaction management function, ensuring consistent and quantifiable improvement.
  • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and client service in transaction management data quality, contributing to operational excellence.
  • Track and report on transaction-related risks, collaborating with senior managers to develop and implement effective risk mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with internal teams i.e., legal, compliance, credit, and operations to ensure cohesive and efficient transaction management.
  • Engage in ongoing training and development activities to build expertise in transaction management
  • Build and sustain collaborative working relationships with relevant peers and stakeholders to achieve productivity synergies.
  • Participate in specialist communities of practice and contribute positively to own and organisational knowledge improvement.
