title: Store Collega JD Amsterdam Kalverstraat| 38u
description:
JD Amsterdam Kalverstraat zoekt nieuwe collega's (38u) die ons team willen ondersteunen en versterken!

Als Store Collega speel je een belangrijke rol in het creëren van een uitstekende winkelervaring. Je zorgt ervoor dat klanten zich welkom, ondersteund en gewaardeerd voelen, en helpt hen bij het ontdekken van onze producten. Je brengt energie naar de winkelvloer door klanten vriendelijk te begroeten, de presentatie van de winkel verzorgd te houden, voorraadaanvulling uit te voeren en hoge service- en kwaliteitsnormen te waarborgen. Dankzij jouw positieve instelling, teamgeest en klantgerichte aanpak draag je bij aan een vlot draaiende winkel met de hoge standaard waarvoor wij bekendstaan.

Ben je klaar om aan de slag te gaan in een dynamische retailomgeving, nieuwe vaardigheden te ontwikkelen en deel uit te maken van een ondersteunend team? Dan is dit een mooie kans om impact te maken en een sterke basis te leggen voor je verdere loopbaan.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je verwelkomt klanten op een vriendelijke en professionele manier en helpt hen bij het vinden van de producten die bij hun wensen passen.
  • Je gebruikt de beschikbare winkeltools en digitale systemen om voorraad te controleren, productinformatie te delen en de klantenervaring te ondersteunen.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de winkelvloer en de stock room netjes, verzorgd en goed aangevuld blijft, zodat productpresentaties aantrekkelijk en inspirerend zijn.
  • Je ondersteunt dagelijkse winkelactiviteiten, zoals kassawerkzaamheden, het aanvullen van voorraad, stock room werkzaamheden en het naleven van alle veiligheids- en winkelrichtlijnen.

Wie we zoeken

  • Je hebt een positieve en enthousiaste houding die past binnen een dynamische en klantgerichte retailomgeving.
  • Je beschikt over sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en voelt je comfortabel in het contact met klanten en collega's.
  • Je bent leergierig, neemt graag nieuwe taken op en wilt jezelf verder ontwikkelen.
  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en bereid om verschillende diensten te werken, waaronder avonden, weekends en drukke seizoensperiodes.

Wat jou extra sterk maakt

  • Je hebt een oprechte interesse in merken, trends en nieuwe producten.
  • Je neemt initiatief en stapt gemakkelijk op klanten af om hen verder te helpen.
  • Je hebt oog voor detail en zorgt ervoor dat de winkel er steeds verzorgd en uitnodigend uitziet.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen en door te groeien binnen de organisatie.

Wat wij bieden

Wij zijn een werkgever die gelijke kansen hoog in het vaandel draagt en zich inzet voor een werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich gewaardeerd, gerespecteerd en ondersteund voelt. We geloven dat diversiteit onze organisatie sterker maakt en streven ernaar dat alle collega's, ongeacht achtergrond, identiteit of levenservaring, zich kunnen ontwikkelen en een betekenisvolle bijdrage kunnen leveren. Als onderdeel van een succesvolle en voortdurend evoluerende organisatie krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan onze strategische prioriteiten: mensen centraal stellen, voorop blijven lopen op het gebied van digitale innovatie, nauw aansluiten bij de behoeften van onze klanten en streven naar operationele excellentie. We staan open voor nieuwe ideeën en verwelkomen mensen die elke dag een positieve impact willen maken.

We waarderen de inzet en betrokkenheid van onze medewerkers en bieden daarom een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden en voordelen:

  • Staff korting op alle merken van de JD Group
  • 24 vakantiedagen op basis van full-time
  • Korting bij andere retailers in Nederland via de 'www.corporate-benefits.nl' app.
  • Nationale en internationale carrièremogelijkheden
  • Toegang to onze online leerplatform
  • Korting op zorgverzekering
  • Toegang tot 'Telus Health' wellnessplatform
  • Pensioenregeling

KLAAR OM DEEL UIT TE MAKEN VAN TEAM JD?

Wacht niet langer en solliciteer nu! We willen je graag leren kennen!

Opgericht in 1981 met één winkel in het noordwesten van Engeland, is JD Group uitgegroeid tot een toonaangevende wereldwijde omnichannel retailer in Sports Fashion- en Outdoor-merken. De groep telt momenteel 4.850 winkels (stand per 1 februari 2025) verspreid over 49 landen (inclusief franchises en joint ventures), met een sterke aanwezigheid in het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Europa, Noord-Amerika en Azië-Pacific. JD Sports Nederland is te vinden op 33 locaties in het hele land, zoals Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Groningen en Venlo.

Een integriteitscheck via het waarschuwingsregister van de Fraud Approach Detailhandel Foundation maakt deel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure.

title: Analyst, Infrastructure
description:
CLOSING DATE:

November 11, 2026

Opportunity

The Analyst, Infrastructure role is an exciting opportunity for an early-career investment professional to gain broad exposure across the full infrastructure investment lifecycle, including new investment evaluation, asset management, and portfolio management. In this role, you will support the assessment of prospective investments through financial modelling, market research, valuation analysis, and due diligence, while also contributing to the ongoing monitoring and value creation of existing portfolio investments. You will work closely with senior investment professionals and cross-functional internal teams to prepare investment materials, analyze portfolio performance, track market developments, and support strategic decision-making. This role is well suited to someone with strong analytical and financial skills, a collaborative mindset, and a genuine interest in infrastructure investing and institutional asset management.

Responsibilities Include:


New Investment Pursuits:

  • Build and work with complex dynamic financial models utilized in the assessment, structuring, and financing of investment opportunities
  • Identify key value drivers and financial risks, performing sensitivity and scenario analyses to evaluate potential impacts
  • Benchmark valuations through research on comparable public companies and precedent transactions
  • Develop a view on the appropriate return commensurate with the risks embedded in the underwritten business plan
  • Assist in the due diligence process and incorporate the findings into a financial model
  • Participate in or guide key due diligence workstreams conducted on investment opportunities, including coordination and review of the work performed by third-party advisors (commercial, technical, legal, financing, accounting, tax, environmental, etc.)
  • Prepare due diligence and market research analyses for discussion with senior investment professionals
  • Assess the pertinent factors of potential investment opportunities, including historical and projected financial information, strategic positioning and value proposition, industry dynamics, regulatory environment, etc.
  • Prepare presentations, memos, and investment recommendations for the various approval processes required while pursuing new investment opportunities
  • Communicate investment findings and recommendations clearly through investment memoranda and approval materials, outlining key risks, expected returns, and detailed market and asset-level considerations

Asset Management:

  • Support ongoing oversight, performance monitoring, and value-creation initiatives for portfolio investments
  • Prepare various ad hoc analyses of portfolio companies’ performance and trajectories
  • Gain exposure to governance processes by observing board and limited partner advisory committee meetings
  • Collaborate with portfolio company management to develop and maintain financial models used for valuation, performance monitoring, and strategic decision-making
  • Develop and evaluate business cases for portfolio company value-creation initiatives (e.g., debt refinancings, expansion projects, management compensation, etc.)
  • Assist with the analysis of add-on investments, divestitures, and refinancing opportunities


Portfolio Management:

  • Lead the preparation of recurring and ad hoc asset class reports and presentations (e.g., quarterly client updates, CIO reports, internal and external presentations, etc.)
  • Work with senior investment professionals to track the infrastructure pipeline of new opportunities
  • Conduct research and develop action plans on matters affecting existing investments, including those relating to tax, regulation, law, and competitive position
  • Stay up to date on pertinent industry developments and publications and disseminate relevant information to the rest of the investment team
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, such as Asset Management, Investment Risk Management, Client Management, Legal, Valuations, Sustainable Investing, Compliance, Economics & Investment Research, Tax, Communications, Investment Performance & Analytics, and other corporate functions


Our Ideal Candidate Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate degree in a relevant field; completion or demonstrated pursuit of a Professional Designation (e.g., CFA, CPA, CBV, CAIA, etc.) or a master’s degree in a relevant field is considered an asset
  • One (1) to three (3) years of relevant experience; prior experience in Investment Banking, Equity Research, Project Finance, Management Consulting, Investment Management, Transaction Services, Accounting, Corporate Finance, or Business Development within an operating company is an asset
  • Experience in the infrastructure and/or energy sectors is considered an asset
  • Demonstrated interest and experience in investing and analyzing businesses across various sectors and geographies, with a keen enthusiasm to deepen understanding of institutional infrastructure investments
  • Strong understanding of finance, accounting, and business concepts, sound judgement, excellent analytical, quantitative, and research skills, and an ability to perform in-depth, critical analysis
  • Prior experience in complex financial modelling, asset valuation, and presentation building is highly regarded
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and thrive under high-pressure situations to meet strict deadlines
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, with the ability to balance multiple priorities
  • Highly resilient with a proven ability to adapt quickly and shift priorities in response to changing business needs
  • Possesses a positive outlook, even in challenging situations, and exhibits a strong commitment to fostering a collaborative work environment
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with a demonstrated ability to influence others and present effectively to senior-level audiences
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a team player attitude; able to build effective relationships
  • Self-motivated with unquestioned personal and professional integrity
  • Advanced skills in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; prior work-related or academic experience using Bloomberg, Capital IQ, or FactSet is viewed favorably
  • Demonstrates a willingness to further their education through the pursuit of a professional designation (or has already started one) is considered an asset
  • Willingness and availability to travel both domestically and internationally as required
  • Working proficiency in a second language is considered an asset
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to AIMCo’s core values of excellence, transparency, humility, integrity, and collaboration, and inspiring the same in others.

Success Measures:


Year One Success is achieved by demonstrating adaptability and perseverance in the face of shifting priorities while making positive contributions to team culture. Additionally, the successful candidate will have evaluated several types of infrastructure investments, worked on various financial models, provided analysis based on market research and due diligence workstreams, and created investment committee presentations for a diverse set of investment opportunities.


**This role will close November 10th, 2026 @ 11:59 pm (MST)**

Final candidates will be asked to undergo a security screening, which includes a credit bureau and a criminal record investigation, the results of which must be acceptable to AIMCo.

description:
The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Drives targeted growth of business relationships through proactive loan origination and intentional deposit expansion while applying disciplined credit judgment and risk management practices. Combines business development with introductory knowledge of financial analysis to structure sound lending solutions aligned with client needs and the bank’s risk appetite. Actively mitigates fraud and credit risk through rigorous due diligence, portfolio monitoring, and regulatory adherence, ensuring sustainable growth, strong asset quality, and long-term client retention. This role serves as a key pipeline for advancement into Business Banker II role or a similar position.


Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develops and executes targeted prospecting and relationship expansion strategies, leveraging professional referral networks, outbound calling, and community engagement to generate qualified loan and core deposit growth opportunities aligned to defined credit risk parameters. Drives growth in core deposits and fee income by delivering referrals to Treasury Management, merchant services, and other internal partners that position the bank as the client’s primary financial institution.
  • Partners with internal stakeholders, including branch team, credit, treasury, and operational teams, to coordinate solutions, streamline deal execution, and enhance the overall client experience while supporting efficient growth and risk management. Maintains an extensive knowledge of the products and services available to our Business Customers.
  • Performs initial financial analysis, including cash flow, liquidity, leverage, and global debt service coverage, to assess borrower capacity, identify risk exposure, and support sound credit decisions. Structures and recommends credit solutions, including appropriate loan terms, collateral positioning, and pricing, to optimize risk-adjusted return while meeting client financing needs.
  • Manages the full loan lifecycle by coordinating application intake, documentation validation, underwriting engagement, stipulation resolution, and closing to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant execution. Demonstrates the ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously, balancing client interactions, credit analysis, and deal execution to meet deadlines and drive consistent results.
  • Actively manages and expands a portfolio of business relationships by deepening client engagement, increasing loan outstandings, driving primary operating deposit relationships, and ensuring ongoing portfolio health through proactive loan renewals, past due management, and timely resolution of credit-related issues to enhance client profitability, retention, and portfolio performance. Drives growth in core deposits and fee income by delivering referrals to treasury management, merchant services, and other internal partners that position the bank as the client’s primary financial institution.
  • Independently monitors portfolio risk and performance by evaluating financial trends, and risk rating movements, proactively identifying emerging credit issues and implementing timely mitigation strategies to protect asset quality. Proactively mitigates fraud and operational risk by validating client identity and business legitimacy, analyzing transaction patterns, enforcing due diligence standards, and escalating suspicious activity in alignment with internal controls and regulatory requirements. Ensures compliance with all applicable regulations and bank policies, including BSA/AML and Fair Lending, through consistent documentation, audit readiness, and adherence to established risk frameworks.
  • It is the responsibility of this role to take ownership of all tasks and challenges that they encounter in the operation of their assigned position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, or related field or equivalent experience in a related field

Minimum Experience

  • 2–3 years of banking experience with a strong emphasis on business lending, credit analysis, and deposit relationship management.

Professional Expectations

  • Demonstrates a consistent track record of achieving or exceeding loan production, deposit growth, and revenue goals.

Licenses & Certifications

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

title: Product Manager - Control Products
description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

Product Manager – Control Products

Banjo & KZValve

If you're looking for a place where your work directly influences innovation, customer success, and business growth, you've found it. Banjo and KZValve are leaders in flow control and fluid handling technologies serving agriculture, industrial, transportation, and specialty markets around the world. Our products help customers move, measure, and control fluids in some of the most demanding applications.

As part of IDEX, we combine the agility of entrepreneurial businesses with the resources and operating discipline of a global industrial organization. We are looking for a Product Manager who will help drive product growth, support new product development, and serve as a key link between customers, engineering, operations, sales, and marketing.

Position Summary

The Product Manager is responsible for managing and growing an assigned product portfolio within the Control Products business. This role serves as a key Voice of Customer (VOC) resource, helping translate market needs into product improvements, roadmap priorities, and commercialization plans.

Directly reporting to the VP of Innovation and working closely with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Product Leadership, the Product Manager supports product strategy, new product development, portfolio optimization, and go-to-market execution. Success is measured through product performance, customer engagement, successful product launches, and contribution to portfolio growth.

This position is located at Greenwood, NE.

Mission

Support the growth and success of the Control Products portfolio by understanding customer needs, identifying market opportunities, supporting product development initiatives, and helping execute strategies that improve customer value and business performance.

Using IDEX 80/20 principles, the Product Manager helps prioritize opportunities, simplify complexity, and focus resources on the products, customers, and applications that create the greatest impact.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Market Analysis

• Develop a strong understanding of assigned products, technologies, applications, competitors, and market segments.

• Support the development and execution of product roadmaps and growth initiatives.

• Monitor market trends, competitive activity, customer requirements, and emerging technologies.

• Assist with product positioning, value proposition development, and strategic planning activities.

• Contribute market insights that support portfolio investment decisions.

Voice of Customer & Market Intelligence

• Develop relationships with customers, OEMs, distributors, and end users.

• Participate in customer visits, trade shows, and industry events to gather market insights.

• Capture and communicate customer needs, application challenges, and improvement opportunities.

• Support VOC programs and ensure customer feedback is incorporated into product planning.

• Maintain awareness of industry trends, regulations, and competitive developments.

title: KBI: US - Materials Coordinator
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Manufacturing Material Coordinator position performs material checks for all Process Orders in a staged location in the warehouse. These checks include the completeness of Process Order materials needed by manufacturing. This position will be responsible for transferring materials for Process Orders from the warehouse staged location to the designated manufacturing locations within the CMF GMP facility to support continuous manufacturing operations. This movement will occur physically and systematically to ensure full traceability and compliance with KBI procedures. This position is also responsible for cycle counts, requests, and restocking of material to Kan-Ban locations within the CMF GMP facility. This position may also require assisting Manufacturing to obtain additional materials as needed for processing and moving staged materials from CNC locations to the designated airlocks in the processing suites.


Must be able to document and record activities in electronic systems and paper systems, and comply with regulatory requirements, cGMP’s, Policy Documents, and SOPs. Must be able to maintain training at 95% or greater.


Must always wear proper PPE and follow all safety guidelines outlined by the SOP and site policies when working in the facility.


Must be able to perform general tasks as assigned by supervisor to support manufacturing, i.e staging materials, material movement, and other general clean room tasks.


This position requires shift work and gowning for a cleanroom environment. This position requires PPE.

JOB RESPONSIBILIITES

  • The Manufacturing Material Coordinator is responsible for material movement from warehouse staging areas to manufacturing staging areas. This includes using cleaning agents and a PAPR (powered air-purifying respirator) to transition materials through material airlocks.
  • This position will require movement of gaylords and adherence to Standard Operating Procedures.
  • This position requires inventory checks of Kanban locations and restocking of materials when minimum levels are reached.
  • Performs material checks for Process Orders needed by Manufacturing.
  • Communicates with warehouse personnel about missing items and ensures that all materials have been accounted for.
  • Performs material movement of gaylords and totes from warehouse staging areas to manufacturing staging areas.
  • Maintains and restocks Kan-Ban locations in the manufacturing areas.
  • Computer: Perform material movement, maintaining training and job-related functions.
  • Perform other various tasks as assigned by the Supervisor/Manager.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
Knowledge, Skills, Abilities


Material Coordinator I: High school diploma or Associate degree with 0+ years of experience. Bio Works Certificate preferred. Language Ability


Material Coordinator II: High school diploma or Associate degree with 18+ Months of experience. Bio Works Certificate preferred. Reasoning Ability


Language Ability

  • Ability to read and interpret English documents such as safety rules, standard operating procedures, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to communicate with coworkers and supervisor.

Reasoning Ability

  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

Math Ability

  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to stand, walk, wear steel-toe shoes, and have the ability to push, pull, squat, lift, reach, and carry materials and roll containers as needed, but not to exceed the Essential Physical Functions of the job description.

Computer Skills

  • Word, Excel, E-mail and SAP

Equipment Use

  • Computer/Tablet, radio, Copy and Fax Machine

WORKING CONDITIONS

Because this job involves Spor-Klenz, PAPRs or respirators (full-face and half-face) are required. Facial hair must be kept short enough to ensure a proper seal when wearing the respirator.

  • This position requires standing for long periods. This position also requires bending, lifting, pushing, carrying, pulling, and kneeling.
  • This position is considered “Essential Personnel,” requiring 7-day-a-week work coverage even when the company is closed (e.g., inclement weather).

description:

Torch Technologies is seeking a highly skilled Hypersonic Aerothermal Test Engineer/Analyst to support the 715th Test Squadron (715 TS) at the Arnold Engineering Development Complex (AEDC). The 715 TS operates world-class aerodynamic and propulsion test facilities, and this role is critical to advancing the nation's hypersonic weapon and flight systems. This position is located onsite at Arnold AFB, TN.


As a Test Engineer/Analyst, your duties will include the following, but are not limited to:


Test Planning & Execution:

  • Lead the complete test inquiry, planning, and execution process for hypersonic ground tests in arcjet test facilities, ensuring alignment with government and customer requirements.
  • Advise and assist government and customers in assessing test conditions and addressing test cell/test article interactions.
  • Develop requirements, test objectives, measures of performance, and success criteria to support the evaluation of hypersonic weapon systems.
  • Lead Technical, Safety, and Readiness Review Boards.

Data Analysis & Reporting:

  • Perform in-depth analysis of test data to meet analysis objectives.
  • Prepare quick-look reports and detailed technical reports to document test planning, data processing, analysis, conclusions, and recommendations.

Modeling & Simulation:

  • Utilize commercial and in-house simulation codes and analysis tools to support testing activities.

Technical Support & Expertise:

  • ​Provide senior aerothermal test engineering and/or analysis expertise in areas such as aerothermal testing and analysis, Thermal Protection System (TPS) ablation, Fluid-thermal-structural interaction (FTSI) modeling and simulation, computational heat transfer, optical diagnostic techniques, and statistical methods.

Collaboration & Communication:

  • Work in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing work to balance multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Collaborate effectively with senior staff and peers, communicating clearly and concisely in both oral and written formats.

Required Qualifications:

  • U.S. Citizenship
  • Education - Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university.
  • Must be able to obtain/maintain Secret DoW security clearance. Active clearance must be maintained throughout employment tenure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or Aerospace Engineering.
  • At least 5 years' of direct experience in hypersonic flight or ground testing.
  • Advanced degree and background or coursework in areas related to aerothermal testing, TPS ablation, FTSI modeling, computational heat transfer, or optical diagnostics.
  • Proficiency with Scientific Python (primary code) and Matlab (secondary).
  • Experience with statistical analysis techniques and data-driven decision making.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience fostering cooperation and teamwork with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong adherence to safety and security protocols in a test environment.

title: Hematology Technician I (Day)
description:
We understand that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today, and that’s why we’re inspired to make A Better World for Pets. Antech is comprised of a diverse team of individuals who are committed to each other’s growth and development. Our culture is centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom. Today Antech is driving the future of pet health as part of Mars Science & Diagnostics, a family-owned company focused on veterinary care.

Current Associates will need to apply through the internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on Menu or View All Apps, select the Jobs Hub app, then click the magnifying glass to Browse Jobs.

Work Schedule: 11:00am - 7:30pm Tuesday - Saturday


The Target Pay for this position is $22.55 an hour. At Antech, pay decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, education, training and budget.


Job Purpose/Overview

The Hematology Technician I performs cytology accessioning, staining and laboratory testing. Prepares samples, sets up instruments, runs tests and reads, interprets and releases results.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Build CBC/UA loads, slide preparation and staining
  • Assist with prepping Avian / Exotic specimens as requested
  • Spin manual hematocrits
  • Prepare blood smears and perform re-checks as directed using LTP when necessary
  • Manage the LTP process
  • Perform all required tests including Destiny Testing, including PT and PTT, Fibrinogen, UA Front End, Plasma protein and Feline blood typing
  • Equipment verification with control samples
  • Responsible for accurately matching slides with respective TRF’s.
  • Build cytology and path review to loads per protocol following Cyto schedule and make sure Load Distribution Log is completed accurately every shift
  • Properly transfer Cytology table loads as required
  • Accession and label all paperwork, specimen slides, tubes and jars
  • Gross and prepare smears, mono-layered cytospins and cell blocks
  • Packing cases for in-house pathologists and for transportation
  • Monitor and reconcile pending, distribution list and complete the daily distribution email.
  • Ensure bar-coded racks are arranged correctly and loaded onto instruments
  • Perform all required quality control per QA guidelines including all instrument maintenance and temperature charts subject to review
  • Run all needed quality control and calibration by department
  • Reads, understands and follows applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOP's), including safety and quality procedures
  • Maintains clean and organized work area. Restock supplies as needed
  • Participate in improving lab efficiency, quality, and cooperation
  • Consult with senior peers on non-complex Hematology tasks to learn through experience
  • May be asked to participate in enterprise initiatives, special projects, and other duties as assigned


Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent with 6 months of experience as a Hematology Lab Aide and/or 2-, 3- or 4- year degree in science-related field preferred.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Laboratory skills, with experience setting up, running and operating lab instruments preferred
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to learn new assignments efficiently and support the work of other teams during low demand periods
  • Communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Positive, can-do attitude
  • Basic math, interpretive and analytical skills.
  • Strong data entry skills required
  • Personal computer skills, proficient use of Microsoft Office and ability to learn new software


Working Conditions

  • Stationary Position- must be able to remain in a stationary position for up to 2 hours
  • Constantly operates a computer and other lab equipment accurately and efficiently.
  • Occasionally required to bend, kneel, stoop, or crouch
  • Required to lift, move, and carry up to 20 lbs.
  • The ability to observe details at close range
  • Extended hours may be needed
  • Laboratory environments with potential biohazards present that are mitigated by the mandatory use of PPE
  • Potential for exposure to agents known to cause zoonotic disease in humans and use of potentially hazardous chemicals as defined by the National Hazard Communication Standards. A complete list of such chemicals is available from department supervision.

About Antech

Antech is a leader in veterinary diagnostics, driven by our passion for innovation that delivers better animal health outcomes. Our products and services span 90+ reference laboratories around the globe; in-house diagnostic laboratory instruments and consumables, including rapid assay diagnostic products and digital cytology services; local and cloud-based data services; practice information management software and related software and support; veterinary imaging and technology; veterinary professional education and training; and board-certified specialist support services.

title: Account Supervisor, Real Estate
description:
ABOUT ORCHESTRA

Orchestra is a strategic communications and marketing company built for today’s complex and fragmented world. From decoding audiences to designing bold strategies, Orchestra integrates people, platforms, and stories that stick to help clients build lasting influence. The company offers programs that span from the highest level strategic business counsel through to tactical execution. Orchestra brings together 700+ people with experience across consumer and lifestyle, technology, nonprofit and philanthropy, real estate, sports, travel, hospitality, and more. Made up of leading firms BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward and Small Girls PR. It also launched Brightmode, a talent acquisition firm for communications professionals, and Versus Media Group, a strategy-first political media team. Learn more at .

People of all backgrounds and abilities are strongly encouraged to apply. Orchestra is committed to building and maintaining a diverse staff, and recognizes that its continued success depends on hiring and retaining high-quality creative professionals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Opportunities for advancement exist, and we are committed to helping all staff develop and grow.

ABOUT THE CITIES TEAM

BerlinRosen’s Cities practice comprises over 70 communications professionals who bring a unique campaign-style approach to strategic communications. We work with visionary clients in New York, Los Angeles and other major cities across the country on issues ranging from urban planning, affordable housing, issue advocacy, social impact and progressive policy, public affairs, healthcare, higher education, real estate, travel, lifestyle, arts & culture and more. Whether it’s winning community and political support, policy change, elevating new projects and brands or launching some of our city's most visited attractions, we help our clients shape the future of cities.

The Real Estate team helps visionary companies in real estate, infrastructure, hospitality, architecture and design who are shaping the future of cities.

We work with industry leaders, award-winning institutions and global innovators including SL Green and Brookfield Properties, 92Y and Lincoln Center, Ennead and Practice for Architecture and Urbanism, Breaking Ground and Regional Plan Association, Northwell Health and the New York Proton Center, Waldorf Astoria New York and the Wythe Hotel.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

BerlinRosen is seeking an Account Supervisor to join our team. In this role, you will develop and implement platform agnostic communications campaigns. You will work with a team of expert colleagues and lead the day-to-day account flow by managing junior staff and clients relations. This is a great opportunity for someone who is interested in honing their communications skills in support of Fortune 500 companies, large global organizations with expansive portfolios across every real estate asset class, and who can work directly with senior executives at these firms to plan and implement holistic communications strategies. As part of the Real Estate vertical, you will be encouraged to take the lead on client initiatives and work, and help further grow the practice area.

Role location: This role is based in our New York, N.Y. office on a hybrid basis. The Cities team is in-office 3 days per week.

ACCOUNTABILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS

As an Account Supervisor on the Cities team, you will…

  • Conceptualize and drive new story angles and other media opportunities for clients, such as landing feature stories even when there is no news to announce, or drafting a persuasive and compelling pitch on behalf of a client for a high-profile interview, award or conference
  • Consistently place stories through persistence and creativity, identifying new targets and approaches until the story lands
  • Write high-quality client deliverables including strategic plans, press releases, talking points, invites, LinkedIn content, social copy and blogs with minimal oversight
  • Serve as day-to-day client contact & lead client calls including managing client communications in a timely manner
  • Conceptualize and execute client event activations from press conferences and openings to experiential marketing activations
  • Ideate and secure partnerships and promotions with like-minded brands and media partners
  • Work cross-functionally within the BerlinRosen and broader Orchestra portfolio to deliver the best solutions for clients, including earned, owned and paid channels as appropriate
  • Identify organic growth opportunities with existing clients and support new business pitches
  • Drive day-to-day execution with little guidance and stay organized and on track of client deliverables
  • Mentor junior staff, providing feedback on writing, pitching and client service

Essential skills:

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience leading communications strategy with a PR agency
  • edia relations experience across real estate, business and urbanism, plus corporate communications and executive thought leadership
  • Strong storytelling skills with the ability to provide examples of pitches and other materials that clearly demonstrate these capabilities
  • Versatile writer, who is comfortable and well versed in writing in an informal and formal capacity
  • Savviness and creativity in media relations and pitching, social media content ideation and influencer engagement, with the ability to identify new targets and thoughtful angles until the story lands
  • Ability to confidently communicate clearly and effectively both verbally and in writing, with varying levels of staff, clients and the media
  • Organized with a proven ability to handle multiple assignments at once, work quickly, think on their feet and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Proven ability to become a savvy and nimble student of the news and quickly identify new media opportunities and narratives to insert our clients’ voices into the news cycle

Note: Interested in this role but it’s not quite the right match? Applicants who meet some but not all or exceed the above criteria are still encouraged to apply! We are eager to speak with candidates with diverse backgrounds and can assess role leveling on an individual basis.

WORKING AT BERLINROSEN

Compensation philosophy: BerlinRosen offers competitive industry rate salary bands with the goal of retaining and growing talented individuals. We regularly review and adjust our compensation structure as needed to ensure equity across teams and levels.

Salary range (commensurate with experience and skills): $95,000-$110,000

title: Network Contracting Director
description:
Job Description Summary

‎

The Director, Network Contracting is responsible for leading the strategy, development, medical expense management, and oversight of CareMore Health’s hospital and ancillary provider networks, ensuring high-quality, coordinated, and cost-effective care. This leadership role oversees a small team of contracting professionals responsible for negotiating, implementing, and administering agreements serving Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and other managed care populations.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the hospital and ancillary contracting strategy in alignment with CareMore Health's enterprise objectives, value-based care initiatives, affordability targets, and market growth priorities.
  • Translate long-term network strategies into annual contracting plans, measurable business objectives, and operational priorities across multiple provider segments and geographic markets.
  • Lead contracting strategies that improve access, satisfy network adequacy, affordability, quality performance, and member experience.
  • Evaluate healthcare market trends, competitive intelligence, reimbursement innovation, and regulatory changes to proactively position CareMore's hospital and ancillary network for future growth and sustainability.

Contracting & Network Management

  • Provide executive oversight of contracting activities across hospital and ancillary networks.
  • Guide negotiations for high-value, strategically significant agreements, serving as executive sponsor for complex negotiations.
  • Oversee reimbursement strategies, alternative payment models, and value-based contracting initiatives that support improved patient outcomes and financial sustainability.
  • Ensure timely execution, implementation, and ongoing administration of hospital and ancillary agreements while maintaining compliance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor contract performance and partner with internal stakeholders to address network gaps and contracting opportunities while controlling medical expense and meaningfully reducing the cost of care.

Analytics & Strategic Planning

  • Leverage analytics, financial modeling, utilization data, and market intelligence to evaluate performance and identify contracting opportunities.
  • Complete financial and performance modeling for non-complex contract changes to develop rate proposals, form negotiation strategy, and measure impact to the business.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing contracting organization of contracting professionals.
  • Establish clear performance expectations, succession plans, and professional development opportunities that build organizational capability and leadership bench strength.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement, and customer service across the contracting organization.
  • Ensure effective workload planning, resource allocation, prioritization, and organizational alignment to meet evolving business priorities.

Financial & Business Partnership

  • Partner with Finance, Local Markets, Clinical Operations, Utilization Management, and Strategy leaders to evaluate the financial and operational impacts of contracting decisions.
  • Oversee development of executive reporting, performance analyses, reimbursement modeling, and contracting analytics that support enterprise decision-making.
  • Provide strategic recommendations regarding reimbursement methodologies, network optimization, and healthcare affordability initiatives.
  • Monitor cost trends, utilization patterns, quality performance, and network economics to identify opportunities for improvement and risk mitigation.

Governance & Operational Excellence

  • Establish and maintain enterprise contracting governance, documentation standards, contract lifecycle management processes, and operational controls.
  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, Credentialing, Configuration, Provider Operations, and Claims leadership to ensure seamless implementation and administration of agreements.
  • Ensure compliance with delegated Health Plan requirements, network adequacy standards, accreditation requirements, and organizational policies.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance contracting workflows, operational efficiency, reporting capabilities, and data integrity.
  • Adapt quickly to changing business priorities and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
  • Represent CareMore Health in executive provider meetings, industry forums, and strategic partnership discussions as appropriate.

‎

description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Senior Product Manager is responsible for the overall strategy, growth, profitability, and lifecycle management of a product portfolio across Banjo and KZValve. This role serves as the Voice of Customer (VOC), translating market needs into product roadmaps, business cases, and commercialization strategies that deliver sustainable growth.

The Product Manager acts as the general manager of the product portfolio, driving alignment across Sales, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Marketing to develop differentiated solutions and create value for customers. This position is located in Crawfordsville, IN, and reports to VP – Innovation.

Own and grow an assigned product portfolio by developing winning product strategies, translating customer insights into differentiated solutions, and leading cross-functional execution to deliver above-market growth and expanding profitability.

Utilizing the IDEX 80/20 operating principles, the Product Manager ensures resources, investments, and product development efforts are focused on the most attractive markets, customers, and applications while reducing complexity and improving portfolio health.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


Strategic Product Leadership

  • Develop a deep understanding of assigned products, applications, technologies, customer segments, competitive dynamics, and market trends.
  • Define and execute multi-year product and technology roadmaps aligned with business growth objectives.
  • Establish clear value propositions and portfolio positioning across key end markets.
  • Identify growth opportunities through customer segmentation, adjacent market expansion, technology development, and strategic partnerships.

Boeing’s Defense, Space and Security (BDS) Space, Intelligence, and Weapons Systems (SI&WS) organization is seeking a Senior Systems Engineering Integration & Test Manager to lead a multi-program portfolio within the Integrated Air and Missile Defense domain in Huntsville, AL. This leader will provide oversight and direction to a systems engineering organization supporting a broad range of programs, including PAC-3, SBV, Avenger, Air and Missile Defense (ABMD), and Indirect Fire Protection Capability Increment 2 (IFPC).


The successful candidate will lead and develop teams of systems engineers and project support personnel, applying systems engineering principles to define requirements, guide technical execution, manage interfaces, and coordinate across multiple IPTs and stakeholders. This role requires expertise in workforce planning, technical execution, portfolio alignment, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure integrated solutions meet performance, cost, schedule, and mission objectives with technical excellence. Close partnership with program leadership, IPT leads, and functional organizations will be essential to support program documentation, requirements development, test and integration planning, proposal execution, and overall program success.


Position Responsibilities

  • Provide leadership and oversight for systems engineering support across multiple IAMD and Intelligence Systems programs
  • Lead and develop a team of engineers and support personnel across sustainment, development, and proposal efforts
  • Establish priorities, allocate resources, and manage workforce planning across multiple program demands
  • Partner with program managers, IPT leads, and functional leaders to align systems engineering activities with program objectives
  • Ensure requirements development, integration planning, verification support, and technical execution are aligned with program needs
  • Support and oversee technical review preparation, milestone reviews, and engineering execution planning
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts, including Lean initiatives, process improvements, and tool adoption

  • 10+ years of engineering or systems engineering experience
  • 7+ years of leadership, supervisory, or program management experience

title: Credentialing & Enrollment Coordinator
description:
MyOme’s mission is to provide clinically actionable genetic information to patients throughout their lives. We combine clinical-grade whole genome sequencing, advanced AI methods for genome interpretation, and seamless digital tools for doctors and patients to order and access results. Our team is composed of seasoned entrepreneurs, scientists, and operators, and we're backed by top-tier investors.

Position Overview:

The Credentialing & Enrollment Coordinator owns MyOme’s laboratory payer enrollment lifecycle, ensuring the lab is credentialed, enrolled, and set up to bill and get paid by every payer we work with. This role manages initial enrollments, revalidations, and maintenance across Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers, including the EDI claim and ERA/EFT enrollments that make electronic billing and payment possible. Working within our Revenue Cycle Management team, you will keep payer and provider data accurate in our billing system, so claims route correctly and remittances post cleanly. Your work directly protects cash flow and prevents denials as MyOme expands its payer network. The ideal candidate brings hands-on credentialing experience in a clinical laboratory or diagnostics setting, strong command of CMS-855B, PECOS, NPPES, and CAQH, and the organization to track dozens of applications and deadlines at once.

What You'll Do:

  • Prepare, submit, and track laboratory enrollments and revalidations with Medicare (CMS-855B via PECOS), state Medicaid programs, Medicare Advantage, and commercial payers.
  • Manage EDI claim enrollments (837) and ERA (835) and EFT enrollments with payers and clearinghouses, coordinating testing and go-live with the billing system vendor.
  • Perform XiFin file maintenance, including payer, provider, NPI, and ordering-physician setup, so claims route and remittances post correctly.
  • Maintain the lab’s credentialing data and documents, including NPPES, CAQH, CLIA and CAP certificates, state lab licenses, and W-9s, and track expiration and revalidation dates.
  • Keep a credentialing and enrollment tracker current with application status, effective dates, payer IDs, and follow-up actions.
  • Follow up with payers on pending applications and resolve enrollment-related denials, holds, and rejections with the billing team.
  • Support network contracting by submitting post-contract enrollments and confirming loaded rates and effective dates.
  • Report enrollment status, risks, and upcoming deadlines to RCM leadership, and flag anything that could delay billing.
  • Document enrollment procedures and payer-specific requirements to build a repeatable process as the payer network grows.

What You'll Need:

  • Associate’s degree required
  • 3–5 years of credentialing and payer enrollment experience, including at least 2 years in a clinical laboratory, genetic testing, or diagnostics setting.
  • Hands-on experience enrolling labs (facility/group enrollment, not only individual providers) with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers.
  • Working knowledge of CMS-855B, PECOS, NPPES, CAQH, and CLIA requirements, and how enrollment status affects claim adjudication.
  • Demonstrated experience completing EDI (837) and ERA/EFT (835) enrollments with payers and clearinghouses.
  • XiFin experience strongly preferred, including payer and provider file maintenance.
  • Exceptional organization and attention to detail, with a track record of managing many concurrent applications and deadlines.
  • Clear, persistent communicator who can work payer provider-relations teams to resolution.
  • Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for tracking and reporting.

Location, Compensation, and Benefits:

  • Location: Remote in the US
  • Compensation: Annual salary range of $75,000 - $85,000, commensurate with experience. This role is eligible for equity.
San Francisco Bay Area pay range
$75,000—$85,000 USD

  • Professional development opportunities
  • Company-sponsored off-sites and team meals during in-person meetings
  • Direct access to company leadership and the opportunity for career growth

Diversity, Inclusion, and Equal Opportunity:
MyOme values diversity in all forms. We believe that diverse perspectives drive better science and better patient outcomes. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace that empowers every individual.

Why Work at MyOme?
Join us if you:

  • Want to make an impact at the intersection of healthcare and technology, changing the way people engage with their health at the genetic level

  • Experience with Boolean search techniques, passive candidate sourcing, and targeted recruiting campaigns.
  • Experience managing multiple requisitions and partnering directly with technical hiring managers.

About Awetomaton

We build software that enables humans to make informed decisions from raw intel data, with a specialization in satellite collection. We are a Dayton-based defense startup that believes there is a critical skill & culture gap - one we are filling with high-output, mission focused engineering talent. Results matter to our customers. We've never lost a customer because we deliver what they need. Awetomaton is where you do work that matters with a passionate team in an environment that inspires your creativity.

Benefits

We provide industry leading benefits that balance your health & wellbeing today, as well as lay a solid financial future into retirement. Highlights of our benefit plan include:

  • Flexible time off totaling 36 days / year. No questions asked.
  • 100% 401k company match up to IRS annual limits. This is a benefit of up to $24,500 for 2026.
  • Health plan through Blue Cross Blue Shield with Health Savings Account (HSA). We pay 95% of employee premiums including family plans.
  • Employee favorite: Tech and Wellness reimbursement of $3000 / year. Treat yourself with the newest gadgets or athletic gear. No approvals required.

The program requires the intern to commit to 10 weeks of participation in all formal training, mentoring, on-the-job learning, and opportunities to interact with senior leaders.

· Program starts June 1, 2027, and ends August 6, 2027

· Pay rate: $25/hr

What we will do:

We provide the tools and training necessary to succeed, as well as provide intentional development opportunities such as:

· Exposure to senior leadership to discuss the project, strategy, and milestones.

· Network opportunities with cross-functional teams to learn about various areas within the organization.

· Personalized strengths coaching.

· Participate in company meetings and key culture events.

· Value-added project management skills.

· Intern-led community impact project and various team-building activities outside of work.

What you will do:

The intern will support the Digital Connections & Collaboration team in exploring practical applications of artificial intelligence, workflow automation, business intelligence, and digital process optimization. Working alongside leaders responsible for community engagement, digital collaboration, reporting, and operational excellence, the intern will help identify opportunities to streamline work, improve access to information, enhance reporting, and increase staff capacity through technology.

This role will focus on practical use cases such as Microsoft Copilot, Power BI, Power Automate, AI agents, workflow design, reporting frameworks, knowledge management, and digital engagement analytics while contributing to real business challenges and strategic initiatives. By the end of the internship, the intern will leave behind usable artifacts such as working flows, prototypes, dashboards, reporting frameworks, documented processes, and implementation recommendations that the team can maintain, refine, and scale after the summer.

AI Exploration & Enablement

· Research and prototype practical AI use cases that improve productivity, reporting, knowledge discovery, and decision-making.

· Explore Microsoft Copilot, GPT-based tools, AI agents, workflow orchestration concepts, and related emerging technologies.

· Design and test prompts, instructions, and workflows that help users retrieve information and complete tasks more efficiently.

· Document findings, recommendations, and responsible-use considerations for future implementation.

Reporting, Analytics & Insights

· Partner with leaders and key stakeholders to identify the questions group leaders and senior leadership need answered quickly and consistently.

· Support development of dashboards, reports, and KPI frameworks using Power BI, enterprise data platforms, and related analytical tools.

· Help define the KPIs, metrics, business rules, and data requirements needed to support accurate AI-assisted queries, dashboards, and automated insights.

· Validate AI-generated or automated outputs against source data to ensure results are accurate, explainable, and appropriate for business use.

Process Improvement, Automation & Innovation

· Prototype reporting workflows that connect adoption signals, member engagement, unanswered questions, content activity, and follow-up opportunities.

· Create sample prompts, GPT instructions, agent workflows, or Copilot-enabled use cases that translate natural-language questions into reliable reporting outputs.

· Document workflows, assumptions, data definitions, prompts, and recommendations so the team can continue refining and scaling the solution after the summer.

· Provide regular progress updates and deliver a final readout with a demo, lessons learned, recommended next steps, and opportunities for broader automation.

What you will need:

· Enrolled in a four-year accredited college, university, or graduate program in good academic standing.

· Must have completed the sophomore year as an undergraduate before the start of the internship, or have recently completed your degree.

· Basic understanding of working in a hybrid environment, workplace ethics, and effective communication.

· Strong computer skills with Microsoft 365 and an eagerness to learn; exposure to Power BI (Power Query, visuals and basic DAX), Power Automate, Databricks, SharePoint/OneDrive and Teams is a plus, or show similar skills from coursework or projects.

· Demonstrates analytical, critical thinking and spreadsheet skills (Excel pivot tables, lookups, etc.) required.

· Experience using AI tools like ChatGPT and/or Microsoft Copilot to draft communications, summarize threads and turn ambiguous requests into tasks with responsible use practices (no sensitive data, validate outputs, document prompts).

· Good organization and planning skills, and demonstrate effective project coordination, facilitation, and implementation based on past work or school experiences.

· Effective oral and written communication skills and the ability to analyze and synthesize information for problem-solving are preferred.

· Strong interpersonal skills for interacting across the team and potentially with internal Vizient business partners, external members, and suppliers.

title: Staff VP Process Reengineering
description:

Position Title:

Staff VP Process Reengineering

Job Description:

Staff VP Process Reenineering

Location: May be located in any Elevance Health PulsePoint office preferably in Indianapolis, IN, Atlanta, GA, Mason, OH, Richmond, VA, Norfolk, VA or Woodland Hills, CA.

This role requires associates to be in-office at least 3 days per week, fostering collaboration and connectivity, while providing flexibility to support productivity and work-life balance. This approach combines structured office engagement with the autonomy of virtual work, promoting a dynamic and adaptable workplace. Alternate locations may be considered. Please note that per our policy on hybrid/virtual work, candidates not within a reasonable commuting distance from the posting location(s) will not be considered for employment, unless an accommodation is granted as required by law.

Summary

This role serves as a key enabler of enterprise transformation efforts by identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, and optimize end-to-end processes across organizational boundaries. The position helps drive cross-functional alignment, improve operational performance, and ensure solutions address root causes rather than symptoms

Team Scope

This Staff VP will lead a team of 40 associates.

Position Responsibilities

  • Drive adoption of a process-first mindset across Transformation Office, business and operational teams.
  • Allocate process SMEs to lead process reengineering initiatives for business units, partner teams, and initiatives led by the Transformation Office.
  • Lead enterprise process transformation and optimization initiatives.
  • Facilitate cross-functional process analysis, redesign, and implementation efforts.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiencies, reduce complexity, and enhance business outcomes.
  • Advance Process Engineering capabilities, governance, and continuous improvement practices across the enterprise.

Enterprise Process Transformation

  • Further instill a process-first mindset as initial steps in the transformation journey before automating processes.
  • Lead process improvement and transformation initiatives aligned with strategic business objectives.
  • Partner with Transformation Office and business leaders to identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and simplification.
  • Drive adoption of a process-first approach when evaluating business challenges and operational changes.

End-to-End Process Analysis

  • Analyze current-state processes to identify inefficiencies, risks, handoff challenges, and improvement opportunities.
  • Design future-state processes that improve customer, provider, associate, and business outcomes.
  • Facilitate process mapping, value stream analysis, and root cause identification activities.

Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement

  • Apply Process Engineering methodologies and best practices to improve operational performance.
  • Establish measurable process outcomes and monitor performance against defined success metrics.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts through data-driven analysis and stakeholder engagement.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate across business, operational, and technology teams to drive alignment on process improvements.
  • Facilitate discussions that balance business needs with enterprise-wide process considerations.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on process design, governance, and transformation strategies.

Capability Development

  • Contribute to the growth and maturity of Process Engineering as a strategic enterprise capability through AI and Automation.
  • Promote process management disciplines, standards, and governance practices across the organization.
  • Support knowledge sharing, best practice development, and process-first thinking throughout the enterprise.

Portfolio Management

  • Effectively prioritize incoming requests to support process reengineering initiatives.
  • Assign resources to lead reengineering efforts.
  • Manage portfolio of work (currently 25+ initiatives) to ensure completion within budget, agreed timelines, and appropriate level of quality.
  • Ensure proper measurement, tracking and reporting of financial benefits associated with each initiative.

Position Requirements

Requires a BA/BS and a minimum of 10 years of experience managing large scale projects in a complex business and systems environment, including minimum 5 years of management experience; or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background.

Preferred Skills, Capabilities and Experiences

  • Master’s degree preferred.
  • Deep analytical skills, proven execution experience across complex technology ecosystems, and a demonstrated collaborative leadership style focusing on achieving value strongly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of the customer journey and customer redesign strongly preferred.
  • Lean Six Sigma / Black Belt certification or other process
  • improvement certification preferred.

title: Product Manager - Fittings
description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Product Manager is responsible for managing and growing an assigned product portfolio within the Control Products business. This role serves as a key Voice of Customer (VOC) resource, helping translate market needs into product improvements, roadmap priorities, and commercialization plans.

Working closely with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Product Leadership, the Product Manager supports product strategy, new product development, portfolio optimization, and go-to-market execution. Success is measured through product performance, customer engagement, successful product launches, and contribution to portfolio growth.

This position is located in Crawfordsville, IN, and reports to VP – Innovation.


MISSION:

Support the growth and success of the Control Products portfolio by understanding customer needs, identifying market opportunities, supporting product development initiatives, and helping execute strategies that improve customer value and business performance.

Using IDEX 80/20 principles, the Product Manager helps prioritize opportunities, simplify complexity, and focus resources on the products, customers, and applications that create the greatest impact.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


Product Strategy & Market Analysis

  • Develop a strong understanding of assigned products, technologies, applications, competitors, and market segments.
  • Support the development and execution of product roadmaps and growth initiatives.
  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity, customer requirements, and emerging technologies.
  • Assist with product positioning, value proposition development, and strategic planning activities.
  • Contribute market insights that support portfolio investment decisions.

Voice of Customer & Market Intelligence

  • Develop relationships with customers, OEMs, distributors, and end users.
  • Participate in customer visits, trade shows, and industry events to gather market insights.
  • Capture and communicate customer needs, application challenges, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support VOC programs and ensure customer feedback is incorporated into product planning.
  • Maintain awareness of industry trends, regulations, and competitive developments.

New Product Development

  • Partner with Engineering to define product requirements and support new product development projects.
  • Assist in developing business cases, market assessments, and launch plans.
  • Participate in stage-gate reviews and product development activities.
  • Help ensure products are delivered on time and aligned with customer and business objectives.
  • Support product testing, validation activities, and customer feedback collection.

Commercial Support & Product Launches

  • Support sales training, product positioning, and application guidance.
  • Help develop pricing recommendations and competitive analyses.
  • Coordinate product launch activities in partnership with Sales and Marketing.
  • Assist in developing product literature, training materials, customer presentations, and competitive comparisons.
  • Support key customer opportunities through product and application expertise.

Portfolio & Lifecycle Management

  • Monitor product performance, customer adoption, and market trends.
  • Support SKU rationalization and portfolio optimization initiatives.
  • Assist in evaluating product lifecycle stages and recommending enhancements or improvements.
  • Analyze product sales, profitability, and market data to identify growth opportunities.
  • Support annual planning and portfolio review activities.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS:

Outcomes

  • Portfolio growth and market share performance
  • New product launch success
  • Product roadmap execution
  • Customer engagement and VOC effectiveness
  • Pricing and competitive positioning support
  • Portfolio simplification and optimization initiatives
  • Product adoption and customer satisfaction

Competencies

  • Customer focus
  • Market awareness
  • Strategic thinking
  • Collaboration and teamwork
  • Business and commercial acumen
  • Analytical problem solving
  • Communication and presentation skills
  • Project and priority management

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or a related discipline.
  • 3-7 years of experience in Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Application Engineering, Business Development, or a related industrial manufacturing role.
  • Experience with engineered products, fluid handling systems, controls, agricultural equipment, industrial equipment, or related technologies preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working cross-functionally in a manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and business analysis tools.

Desired Characteristics

The successful candidate will:

  • Demonstrate curiosity and a passion for understanding customers and markets.
  • Balance technical and commercial considerations when making decisions.
  • Be comfortable working across multiple functions and priorities.
  • Use data and customer insights to drive recommendations.
  • Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrate initiative and ownership while seeking input from key stakeholders.
  • Embrace continuous learning and professional growth.
  • Apply 80/20 principles to improve focus and effectiveness.

Travel

Travel up to 25% to support customer visits, industry events, market research, and product launches.

title: Client Advisor, MTM Specialist
description:
Relevant, masculine and British. Since 1893, Alfred Dunhill has been engineering unique and stylish luxuries for men. We seek people who have commitment and drive with a strong commercial focus, and will thrive in a creative environment that encourages innovative thinking.

At Richemont Americas, we aspire to reflect the ever-changing world around us. We are proud to employ talent from many different backgrounds, experiences, and identities to build a continually evolving, inclusive community where the diversity of our colleagues and clients is rich and celebrated. We believe when inclusion is fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence, advancing the community that is uniquely Richemont Americas.

Client Advisor, MTM Specialist

Dunhill | Madison Avenue

Reports to: Boutique Director

Overview: As a Client Advisor for our new Madison Avenue Flagship, you will be the face of our Maison, embodying our heritage and values as a customer-facing brand ambassador. This pivotal role is dedicated to delivering an exceptional level of care and service, ensuring every client enjoys a VIP experience and a truly memorable visit. You will be instrumental in driving commercial success, upholding the Maison's exacting standards, and contributing to the flagship's reputation as a key global destination. A profound passion for menswear, tailoring, and an affinity for heritage luxury are essential, as you will convert this passion into genuine client interest and successful purchases through expert styling, personalized advice, and dedicated clientelling.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Experience, Service Excellence & Styling:

  • Provide an unparalleled, personalized luxury experience to every client, ensuring each visit is memorable and exceeds expectations.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, anticipating client needs and offering solutions with the highest level of discretion and professionalism.
  • Provide expert wardrobe and lifestyle styling advice, assisting clients in building comprehensive and sophisticated personal collections.
  • Champion a client-centric approach, fostering a welcoming and exclusive atmosphere within the boutique.

Brand Ambassadorship & Product Expertise:

  • Serve as a passionate and knowledgeable brand ambassador, articulating the Maison's rich heritage, craftsmanship, and unique story.
  • Develop and maintain an in-depth understanding of our menswear collections, tailoring techniques, materials, and lifestyle offerings.
  • Translate your passion for luxury menswear into compelling narratives that resonate with discerning clients, driving interest and desire.

Sales & Commercial Performance:

  • Actively engage with clients on the sales floor to drive sales, achieve individual and boutique sales targets, and contribute to overall KPIs and commercial success.
  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling, expertly guiding clients through our diverse product range, including ready-to-wear, accessories, drawing room and specialist services.
  • Process sales transactions accurately and efficiently, adhering to all company and Group policies and procedures.

Clientelling & Relationship Building:

  • Cultivate and nurture long-term relationships with high-value and VIP clients through proactive clientelling activities.
  • Manage and execute client appointments, ensuring a tailored and exclusive experience for each individual.
  • Maintain accurate client profiles and preferences to personalize future interactions and communications.

Boutique Standards & Operations:

  • Ensure the sales floor and personal client areas are impeccably maintained, reflecting the Maison's exacting standards of visual merchandising and cleanliness.
  • Assist with stock management tasks, including receiving, replenishment, and organization, to ensure product availability and presentation.
  • Adhere to all operational guidelines, security protocols, and health & safety standards.

Collaboration & Communication:

  • Work collaboratively with the entire boutique team, including the Assistant Boutique Managers and Boutique Director, to ensure a seamless client journey and operational efficiency.
  • Provide valuable client feedback and market insights to the management team to inform product development and service enhancements.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in a client-facing sales role within luxury retail, preferably menswear, tailoring, or high-end lifestyle.
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets in a high-service environment.
  • Exceptional clientelling skills with a demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong, lasting client relationships.
  • Profound passion for luxury menswear, tailoring, and an understanding of heritage brands.
  • Expertise in styling, wardrobe consultation, and providing personalized fashion advice.
  • Outstanding communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage confidently and articulately with a discerning clientele.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic luxury retail environment.
  • Proficiency in retail POS systems and client relationship management (CRM) tools.
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required by the business.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor's degree in Fashion, Marketing, Business, or a related field is preferred.
