title: Permanent Contract – Merchandising Project Manager -  Export Local Markets & Travel Retail EMEA – CHANEL Europe – January 2027 – M/F/D
description:
About the Role


Join the Export Local Markets & Travel Retail EMEA team as a Merchandising Project Manager on a permanent contract. You will be responsible for shaping and leading the end-to-end merchandising strategy for campaigns across more than 30 Local Markets and Travel Retail EMEA.


Reporting to the Category, Client Experience & Merchandising Manager, you will work closely with Category, Marketing, Sales, and Forecasting teams to ensure consistent, impactful, and market-relevant campaign deployments. The position is based in Paris. The application period will remain open for 2 weeks until 17 november 2026.


What impact you can create at Chanel


  • Oversee the end-to-end merchandising strategy for campaigns, from budget development and forecasting including the delivery of non-catalogued campaign assets and define implementation guidelines to ensure consistent, high-quality execution across all points of sale.

  • Co-develop the permanent assortment strategy with the Product Manager for local markets and EMEA Travel Retail, optimising the offer by point of sale according to its potential, format, available space, channel-specific requirements and business priorities.

  • Define scalable, channel-specific merchandising solutions that address the diverse needs of local markets as well as the specific constraints of the Travel Retail channel.

  • Support markets and partners throughout campaign deployment, ensuring clear communication, brand excellence and consistent implementation across all points of sale.

  • Design and deliver campaign-focused training sessions and workshops, organise and facilitate seminars, and provide operational support to equip market and field teams with the merchandising skills, tools and best practices required to ensure consistent execution.

You are energised by


  • The opportunity to shape how campaigns come to life across two complementary and highly diverse distribution environments, by developing strategies tailored to the specificities of Local Markets and Travel Retail EMEA.

  • Becoming a key contributor in designing and deploying campaigns that combine the high standards of the Brand with the agility required to address the needs of each market and channel.

  • Directly strengthening Brand visibility and desirability across the entire point-of-sale network.

  • Playing a central coordination role between cross-functional teams and markets to continuously elevate executional excellence across the network.

What you will bring


  • A Master’s degree or Business School background, with 3 to 5 years of experience in merchandising, operational marketing, campaign management, or a related field.

  • Strong strategic thinking and project management skills, with the ability to turn campaign ambition into concrete retail execution.

  • The ability to navigate complex, multicultural, and multi-channel environments, adapting solutions without compromising Brand standards.

  • Fluent in French and English, you are comfortable communicating, engaging stakeholders, and building strong relationships in an international environment.

  • Previous experience with the IWD merchandising software would be appreciated.

What Chanel can offer you


  • The opportunity to operate within a uniquely rich and diverse distribution network: more than 30 Local Markets with varying levels of maturity, consumer profiles, and retail environments, alongside the distinctive Travel Retail ecosystem across airports in Europe, Africa, and the Middle East.

  • The chance to shape a high-impact strategy, directly influencing Brand visibility, point-of-sale executional excellence, and commercial performance across both channels.

  • The opportunity to strengthen your business and strategic perspective through the management of merchandising budgets and investment trade-offs across markets with diverse potential, challenges, and constraints.

  • A rewarding management experience, supporting the development and autonomy of an apprentice.

  • Guide markets and partners throughout campaign execution, ensuring clarity, Brand excellence, and consistent implementation across points of sale.

At CHANEL, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL.

FR — Version française

CDI – Merchandising Project Manager - Export Marchés Locaux & Travel Retail EMEA – CHANEL Europe – Janvier 2027 - H/F/X


À propos du poste


Vous rejoignez en CDI l’équipe Export Marchés Locaux & Travel Retail EMEA comme Chef(fe) de Projet Merchandising, en charge de la stratégie merchandising des campagnes de bout en bout sur plus de 30 marchés locaux et le Travel Retail.


Rattaché(e) à la Responsable Category, Expérience Client & Merchandising, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Category, Marketing, Sales et Forecasting afin de garantir des déploiements cohérents, impactants et adaptés aux spécificités de chaque marché et canal. Le poste est basé à Paris. La période de candidature restera ouverte pendant deux semaines, jusqu’au 17 novembre 2026.



L’impact que vous pouvez créer chez CHANEL


  • Superviser la stratégie merchandising de bout en bout pour les campagnes, depuis l’élaboration des budgets et des prévisions jusqu’à la livraison des supports de campagne hors catalogue, et définir les directives de mise en œuvre afin de garantir une exécution cohérente et de haute qualité sur l’ensemble des points de vente.

  • Co-construire avec le Product Manager la stratégie d’assortiment permanent pour les marchés locaux et le Travel Retail EMEA, afin d’optimiser l’offre par point de vente selon son potentiel, son format, l’espace disponible, les spécificités du canal et les priorités business.

  • Définir des solutions de merchandising évolutives et adaptées à chaque canal, répondant à la diversité des besoins des marchés locaux ainsi qu’aux contraintes du Travel Retail.

  • Accompagner les marchés et les partenaires tout au long du déploiement des campagnes, en garantissant une communication claire, l’excellence de la Marque et une mise en œuvre cohérente sur l’ensemble des points de vente.

  • Concevoir et animer des formations et ateliers dédiés aux campagnes, organiser et faciliter des séminaires, et fournir un accompagnement opérationnel afin de doter les équipes marchés et terrain des compétences, outils et bonnes pratiques de merchandising nécessaires à une exécution cohérente.

Ce qui vous motive


  • Une opportunité de façonner la manière dont les campagnes prennent vie au sein de deux environnements de distribution complémentaires et très diversifiés en définissant des stratégies adaptées aux spécificités des marchés locaux et du Travel Retail EMEA.

  • Devenir un acteur clé pour concevoir et déployer des campagnes conciliant l’exigence des standards de la Marque avec l’agilité nécessaire pour répondre aux spécificités de chaque marché et canal.

  • Contribuer directement à renforcer la visibilité et la désirabilité de la Marque sur l’ensemble des points de vente.

  • Jouer un rôle central de coordination entre les équipes et les marchés afin d’élever l’excellence d’exécution sur l’ensemble du réseau.

Ce que vous apporterez


  • Master ou formation en école de commerce, 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en merchandising, marketing opérationnel, gestion de campagnes ou domaine similaire.

  • Solides compétences en stratégie et gestion de projet pour transformer l’ambition campagne en exécution retail concrète.

  • Capacité à naviguer en environnements complexes, multiculturels et multicanaux, en adaptant les solutions sans compromettre les standards de la Marque.

  • Maitrise courante du français et de l’anglais, vous êtes à l’aise pour communiquer, convaincre et créer du lien dans un contexte international.

  • Une première expérience avec le logiciel de merchandising IWD serait appréciée.

Ce que CHANEL peut vous offrir


  • Evoluerez dans un réseau de distribution particulièrement riche et diversifié : plus de 30 marchés locaux, aux niveaux de maturité, profils de consommateurs et environnements retail variés, ainsi que l’écosystème spécifique du Travel Retail dans les aéroports d’Europe, d’Afrique et du Moyen-Orient.

  • Façonner une stratégie à fort impact, influençant directement la visibilité de la Marque, l’excellence d’exécution en point de vente et la performance commerciale sur les deux canaux.

  • Renforcer votre vision business et stratégique à travers le pilotage des budgets merchandising et les arbitrages d’investissement entre des marchés aux potentiels, enjeux et contraintes variés.

  • Développer une expérience managériale enrichissante, en accompagnant la montée en compétences et l’autonomie d’un(e) alternant(e).

  • Accompagner les marchés et les partenaires tout au long du déploiement des campagnes, en garantissant clarté, excellence de la Marque et cohérence de l’implémentation sur l’ensemble des points de vente.

Chez CHANEL, nous nous attachons à promouvoir une culture inclusive qui favorise l’épanouissement personnel et contribue au progrès collectif. Nous sommes convaincus que le caractère unique de chaque individu contribue à la diversité, la complémentarité et l’efficacité de nos équipes. Nous encourageons vivement votre candidature, car nous apprécions la perspective, l’expérience et le potentiel que vous pourriez apporter à CHANEL.

title: Manager, Data Steward
description:
Manager, Data Steward

At Chanel, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity, and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL.

About the role:

CHANEL is seeking a Manager, Data Steward to join our Corporate Data team within the broader Digital and Client Experience organization. This position is based on site in New York City. This role will play a leading part in safeguarding and advancing the health, quality, and growth of CHANEL’s client database across the U.S. region. The Manager will collaborate closely with stakeholders across all Luxury Retail divisions, translating business needs into actionable data priorities and fostering a productive, transparent partnership with CHANEL Tech. The role will be instrumental in driving the resolution of data-quality issues, identifying root causes and opportunities for improvement, as well as developing innovative approaches to strengthen the accuracy, completeness, and long-term health of the client database.


The successful candidate will report to our Client Data Product Owner, supporting the execution of the Client Data roadmap and helping to advance key initiatives from concept through delivery.


Our ideal candidate will have a minimum of 5 years of experience in data management, data stewardship and growth, and a passion for details, investigations, and communication.


What impact you can create at CHANEL:

Define a data quality framework (KPIs, thresholds, naming conventions, harmonization...)

  • Be accountable and responsible for all data quality projects on the business side for the 3 divisions (Fragrance and Beauty, Fashion, Watches & Fine Jewelry)
  • Benchmark our data quality towards industry to ensure CHANEL remains above competition
  • Propose optimization of data flows to drive efficiencies
  • Find new ways of working to maximize our data usage

Constant and proactive monitoring of the database to keep it healthy

  • Constant and proactive monitoring of the database to keep it healthy
  • Proactively detect quality gaps to mitigate business risk, partnering with the Tech team to build automated monitoring that flags data-quality issues before datasets are leveraged for reporting or activation
  • Definition and harmonization of naming conventions across the client database. Ensuring new data entering the ecosystem adheres to the agreed convention, creating a consistent and easily interpretable data foundation across all divisions
  • Drive the ongoing cleansing and hygiene of the database, systematically eliminating inconsistencies, and non-compliant values to sustain long-term database health
  • Act as the subject-matter expert on the business rules governing the client database, educating the Client Intelligence community on how the data behaves and helping stakeholders distinguish between scenarios working as designed and genuine data-quality issues
  • Operate data stewardship activities to consolidate sensitive client profiles in the U.S. on a weekly basis, coordinating with other regions on international clients as the U.S. representative within the Global Data Steward community
  • Perform comprehensive Data Validation on all incremental data sets

Identify, prioritize, and resolve data-quality issues, ensuring the accuracy and usability of client data in partnership with CHANEL Tech

  • Proactively identify practical workarounds and interim solutions that enable divisions to meet business objectives while sustainable resolutions are developed
  • Drive continuous improvement of CHANEL’s client datasets to establish and maintain best-in-class data quality, ensuring data is trusted to enable data analysts and business teams to generate meaningful insights
  • Lead the end-to-end management of data-quality initiatives from issue identification, impact assessment, and root-cause analysis through testing, validation, communication, and resolution
  • Apply strong project-management discipline to plan, coordinate, track, and communicate progress across stakeholders, ensuring timely delivery and clear accountability
  • Bring forward innovative ideas and improvement opportunities that strengthen long-term database health and support the execution of the Client Data roadmap in partnership with the Client Data Product Owner
  • Communication
  • Coordinate with all data analyst teams and provide regular communication updates to all levels of the organization around issue resolutions with a true business lens

You are energized by:

  • Problem-Solving: Ability to take ownership of complex data-quality challenges, identify root causes, and deliver practical, innovative solutions that drive measurable business impact.
  • Detail Orientation: Data points analysis, flow understanding, impact identification, technical logic.
  • Communication excellence: Strong storytelling and interpersonal skills for presenting ideas and leading discussions
  • Collaborative leadership: A hands-on, tactical leader who excels in cross-functional teamwork
  • Adaptability: Working in a highly collaborative matrix organization, analytical, and fast-paced environment

What you will bring to the team:

  • Experience in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce Data Cloud), Analytics (e.g., BigQuery, Looker, PowerBI) and Activations (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud)
  • Ability to contribute to projects for end-to-end delivery with minimal guidance but also influence the business on best practices and solutions
  • Solid written and oral communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with all stakeholders

Position Logistics:

  • This role is hybrid 3 days per week on site in New York City
  • Data engineering or data management background
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in Data Stewardship, Analysis or similar
  • Bachelors’ or Master's degree preferred

*Chanel, Inc. reserves the right to edit, change, or make exceptions on designations where circumstances where deemed appropriate.


Compensation:

  • The anticipated base salary range for this position is $70,000-$135,000. A base salary is one component of the total compensation for this position. Other forms of variable pay [may/will] be offered for this position. Other components [may/will] include bonus potential, benefits, and/or perks.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Wellbeing resources include dedicated paid time off for wellbeing (2-week August Office Closure) and a Wellbeing fund
  • Family and care giving benefits (inclusive of parental leave, fertility support, MilkStork, and Care.com Membership)
  • Generous paid time off policies to include vacation, holiday, sick and volunteer days
  • 401K and other incentives
  • Robust healthcare offerings; medical, dental, vision, MDLIVE (virtual care), One Medical, Flexible Spending Accounts (Health Care & Dependent Care), Health Savings Account and Employee Assistance Program
  • Life insurance, Accidental Death & Dismemberment, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Health Advocate, International Business Travel Accident & Medical, and Commuter Transit & Parking

Additional Information:

Chanel is a private company whose values are grounded in creating conditions for people to perform at their best and feel fulfilled and confident in their work. We offer a unique work environment where individuals are encouraged to better understand the brand, the business, and motivations, so that together we can unlock the possibilities of growth. This is reflected in:

Diversity and Inclusion:

  • At CHANEL, we are intentional in promoting Diversity & Inclusion. We foster respect, empathy, and dignity for all. We believe strongly that the diversity of our people across the full spectrum of human differences is essential to our organisation and the connections we have with each other and our clients.
  • We offer Employee Resource Groups in the US that are voluntary, open to all, employee-led groups formed around a shared identity or lived experience, whose aim is to foster a diverse, inclusive, and equitable community aligned with the values and missions of the communities they support.

Chanel Community:

  • CHANEL Community empowers our employees to channel their passions, talents and sense of purpose to contribute to and learn from our communities.
  • Employees are encouraged to take time off annually to volunteer through the CHANEL Community. CHANEL also matches employee donations to select charitable organizations.

Sustainability:

  • CHANEL Mission 1.5° is our climate action plan. It is focused on transforming the business in line with the ambitions of the Paris Agreement on climate change to limit the average global mean temperature increase to 1.5 degrees Celsius above preindustrial levels.
  • Employees are encouraged to contribute to our US Sustainability efforts at the corporate level and within the divisions, through organized taskforces and initiatives.

Arts and Culture:

  • We are committed to extending our legacy of cultural engagement. Global support includes the CHANEL Culture Fund, which supports a select group of leading art culture institutions across the globe, and the CHANEL Next Prize for the next generation of creative talent. US support currently includes Annual sponsorship of the MoMA film program, Tribeca Film Festival programs and Through Her Lens, Support of the Academy Gold Fellowship for Women and Sponsorship of the BAAND Together Dance Festival at Lincoln Center.

Fondation Chanel:

title: Data Scientist - EMEA
description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.


What We Offer


Salary:

€0.00 - €0.00

Location:

Bernin,FRA, Dublin,IRL, Eindhoven,NLD, England-Berkshire,GBR, Grenoble,FRA, Milan,ITA, Munich,DEU

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Role Overview

As a Data Scientist, you will develop data-driven insights, predictive models, and optimization solutions that improve semiconductor manufacturing operations. You will work closely with customers, domain experts, and engineering teams to transform large-scale manufacturing and simulation data into actionable recommendations and intelligent decision-support capabilities.


The role combines statistical analysis, machine learning, optimization, simulation, and experimentation. You will contribute to both customer projects and internal innovation efforts while helping bridge the gap between business challenges and technical solutions.


While this role is advertised in the Netherlands, we’d love to hear from you if you’re based near any of our Applied Materials hubs across Europe, ideally within commuting distance of an Applied Materials office.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis & Insights

• Collect, process, and analyze manufacturing, simulation, and operational datasets.

• Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, bottlenecks, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.

• Develop statistical models and analytical frameworks to support operational decision making.

• Translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations.


Modeling & Optimization

• Design, develop, and validate predictive models for forecasting, classification, anomaly detection, and optimization use cases.

• Apply operations research, statistical learning, and optimization techniques to solve manufacturing challenges.

• Contribute to hybrid solutions that combine analytics, machine learning, and simulation technologies.

• Design experiments and perform rigorous analysis to validate model effectiveness and business impact.


Simulation & Manufacturing Intelligence

• Work with simulation technologies, including discrete-event simulation (DES), to evaluate manufacturing scenarios and operational strategies.

• Analyze simulation outputs and combine them with historical operational data.

• Develop methodologies that improve planning, scheduling, resource utilization, and factory performance.


Collaboration & Communication

• Work directly with customers, domain experts, and project teams to understand business requirements.

• Present technical findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Document datasets, methodologies, experiments, and analytical conclusions.

• Contribute to customer workshops, solution design sessions, and project reviews.


Research & Innovation

• Stay current with developments in data science, statistics, optimization, and applied machine learning.

• Evaluate emerging methodologies and identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes.

• Support research initiatives focused on manufacturing intelligence and decision-support technologies.


Required Skills


• Strong foundation in statistics, mathematics, and data analysis.

• Experience developing predictive and analytical models.

• Strong Python programming skills.

• Hands-on experience with Pandas, Polars, NumPy, Scikit-learn, and related analytical tooling.

• Experience with feature engineering, exploratory analysis, and model evaluation.

• Understanding of optimization techniques, statistical experimentation, and hypothesis testing.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.

• Ability to communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.


Preferred Skills


• Experience with discrete-event simulation or operations research.

• Experience with manufacturing, scheduling, supply chain, or industrial systems.

• Familiarity with machine learning deployment and MLOps concepts.

• Experience working with high-dimensional or time-series datasets.

• Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing or advanced industrial environments.


About the Team


You will be joining a highly experienced team of data scientists, AI engineers, software developers, and cloud architects, many with over a decade of experience delivering innovative solutions across multiple industries. Our work spans embedded software, renewable energy optimization, advanced scheduling systems, and AI-driven decision support platforms for multi-billion-dollar semiconductor fabrication facilities.

At Applied Materials, your work will directly influence customer outcomes and business success. As a focused and highly collaborative team, every member plays a meaningful role in shaping both technical solutions and company direction.

No two days are the same. You'll face new challenges, learn continuously, and contribute to solving some of the most difficult problems in industrial AI and optimization. Our customers engage us because they need solutions that go beyond conventional approaches, giving our team the opportunity to create truly unique and impactful technology.

Additional Information

• Participate in execution of project deliverables such as blueprint workshops, documentation, specifications, configuration, and testing/training support.
• Represent complex business processes in SAP SD and MM using solution extensions.
• Conduct workshops to gather and document business requirements into blueprints.
• Identify and document all required FRICEW objects (Forms, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Workflows) during project realization.
• Execute configuration of Vistex solutions.
• Support integration testing and provide expertise in defect resolution.
• Participate in post-go-live support including critical care and knowledge transfer.
• Perform quality assurance on configured systems and prepare documentation for customer support.
• Learn and gain expertise in current and emerging Vistex product offerings.

title: Clinical Service Manager - Boise, ID (Field Based)
description:
Job Summary

Make a direct impact on patient lives as a Clinical Services Manager, delivering hands-on training and education that empower adoption of Omnipod® technology. This role combines clinical expertise with relationship-building and strategy, giving you the chance to influence outcomes and advance diabetes care in a meaningful way.



Are you ready to take your career to the next level by joining a global medical device market leader in diabetes care? At Insulet Corporation, we are transforming lives with innovative products that empower people living with diabetes to take control of their health. Over years of technological advances, we developed Omnipod®, a line of tubeless, wearable, Pod-based insulin management systems.

Position Overview

As a Clinical Services Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving our patient-centric mission forward by creating a culture of collaboration aimed at simplifying life for people managing their diabetes.

In this role, you’ll be the clinical expert in the field, conducting training and guiding healthcare providers in integrating Insulet’s products into their patient care strategies. Your work will go beyond training—by understanding the clinical goals of providers and the unique needs of patients, you’ll create customized approaches that truly make a difference. The work environment will be the HCPs offices, clinics, home office and car.

We’re looking for:

  • A dynamic and driven professional who thrives on delivering clinical excellence, educating healthcare providers, and driving exceptional patient outcomes.
  • A natural relationship builder who creates lasting partnerships with key decision-makers and colleagues
  • A clinical expert who uses evidence-based insights to guide providers toward adopting Insulet products
  • A proven educator who empowers patients to take control of their health and improve their quality of life.

Responsibilities

Establish Clinical Partnerships

  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including endocrinologists, primary care providers, and diabetes management teams in hospitals, clinics, and private practices.
  • Share your expertise with healthcare providers about diabetes management, including the latest technologies and best treatment practices to ensure consistent, high-quality care for patients.
  • Expand your network and credibility within the diabetes community by actively participating in local events and initiatives that position you as a leader in diabetes care.


Own Patient Training

  • Schedule and deliver personalized training to patients on the proper use and care of Insulet products, ensuring they feel confident and informed about their treatment.
  • Assess patient needs and customize training programs, tailoring sessions to accommodate varying levels of familiarity with the device.
  • Provide ongoing support and education, offering follow-up consultation to address questions, troubleshoot issues, and ensure successful long-term device usage.
  • Collaborate with healthcare providers to ensure training aligns with clinical treatment plans, fostering seamless integration of the device into the patient’s care routine.
  • Empower patients to manage their condition effectively by explaining device features, functionality, and best practices for optimal results in everyday use.

Oversee Clinical Education

  • Evaluate and recommend Certified Pod Trainers (CPTs) who wish to become consultant CPTs for Insulet
  • Oversee CPTs by providing timely product updates and being a clinical resource.
  • Leverage multiple data sources to inform education strategy and individual/team actions.
  • Maintain and update data systems, such as Salesforce, to capture training metrics.
  • Conduct administrative responsibilities, managing operations while adhering to budgetary guidelines.


Sell Through Clinical Expertise

  • Empower decision-making by promoting the life-changing benefits of insulin pump therapy to healthcare providers and patients.
  • Collaborate closely with territory partners to achieve shared sales goals while contributing your clinical expertise to shape effective strategies.
  • Champion inspiring patient success stories, leveraging real-world examples to demonstrate the impact of Insulet’s solutions and drive product adoption through clinical selling techniques.
  • Execute field sales activities with a strategic, patient-centered approach, ensuring all promotional efforts are aligned with established guidelines while maximizing impact in the field.


Skills and Competencies

  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
  • Strong influencing and collaboration skills with the ability to build and nurture relationships.
  • Demonstrated skill educating in a clinical setting (both providers and patients)
  • Team-oriented with proven ability to work in a collaborative setting.
  • Ability to solve complex problems and take appropriate action.
  • Ability to execute territory business strategy.
  • Proficiency with technology (both large data systems as well as personal devices, such as insulin pumps and continuous glucose monitors).


Education and Experience

Minimum Qualifications

  • Associate degree
  • 2+ years of related clinical experience
  • Professional, up-to-date credentials and/or certifications (Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist (CDCES), Registered Dietitian (RD), or Registered Nurse (RN), PharmD, or other clinical credentials and/or certifications; state licensure (as required per state)
  • Valid driver’s license

Preferred Qualifications

    • Bachelor’s degree
    • 2+ years’ experience conducting training in a clinical setting and/or managing insulin pump patients
    • Prior experience in a commercial role in the medical device or pharmaceutical industry

Additional Information

    • Must reside within the geographic area of the assigned territory. This position requires regular business travel, mostly by car within a set geographic region.
    • Overnight travel and amount of air travel varies by territory, may be as much as 2 – 5 overnights per month.
    • Ability to lift, carry and transport up to 30 lbs., professional sales samples and literature.


If you’re ready to be a part of a company that’s changing the future of diabetes care, we want to hear from you. Join us at Insulet Corporation, where your talent will make a real difference in people’s lives.


For U.S.-based positions only, the annual base salary for this role is $90,000. This position is eligible for incentive compensation.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • And additional employee wellness programs

Application Details: This job posting will remain open until the position is filled. To apply, please visit the Insulet Careers site and submit your application online.

NOTE: This position requires field-based working arrangements (travel within assigned territory required). #LI-Remote


Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. Insulet’s flagship innovation, the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, integrates with a continuous glucose monitor to manage blood sugar with no multiple daily injections, zero fingersticks, and can be controlled by a compatible personal smartphone in the U.S. or by the Omnipod 5 Controller. Insulet also leverages the unique design of its Pod by tailoring its Omnipod technology platform for the delivery of non-insulin subcutaneous drugs across other therapeutic areas. For more information, please visit insulet.com and omnipod.com.

We are looking for highly motivated, performance-driven individuals to be a part of our expanding team. We do this by hiring amazing people guided by shared values who exceed customer expectations. Our continued success depends on it!

description:
We are looking for a flexibly available (8 hours), enthusiastic Store Colleague for our JD Sports Store in Amsterdam Kalverstraat!

What We Offer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a workplace where every colleague is valued, respected, and empowered. We celebrate the diversity of our teams and strive to ensure that all colleagues, regardless of background, identity, or lived experience, can thrive and contribute meaningfully. As part of our successful and continually evolving business, you'll be encouraged to embrace and uphold our strategic priorities: putting people first, staying at the forefront of digital innovation, remaining deeply attuned to our customers, and pursuing operational excellence. We are always exploring new avenues for growth, and we welcome individuals who are passionate about making a positive impact every day.

READY TO JOIN TEAM JD?

Don’t wait any longer—apply now! We’d love to meet you!

Established in 1981 with a single store in the North West of England, the JD Group is a leading global omnichannel retailer of Sports Fashion and Outdoor brands. The Group now has 4,850 stores (as at 1 February 2025) across 49 countries (including franchises and joint ventures) with a strong presence in the UK, Europe, North America and Asia Pacific. Role Overview: The Product Manager for Optical drives product strategy, roadmap direction, portfolio performance, and commercial alignment for optical solutions within the Global Semiconductors business. This role connects customer needs, market trends, optical technology capabilities, and business objectives into a disciplined product plan that supports growth, differentiation, and customer adoption.

This position serves as the product owner for assigned optical offerings and applications, partnering closely with Sales, Applications Engineering, Engineering, Operations, and Business Line leadership to prioritize opportunities, define requirements, and support global commercialization. Customer & Commercial Enablement:

• Support Sales and Key Account teams with optical product positioning, application fit, customer presentations, and opportunity strategy.

Market Intelligence & Product Performance:

• Monitor optical market trends, semiconductor customer roadmaps, application requirements, and competitive activity.

• Track product adoption, funnel contribution, win/loss feedback, portfolio health, and customer satisfaction indicators.

• Develop internal product updates, launch materials, and training content to support consistent global execution.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager

The Life Project Manager is responsible for leading and managing complex projects from initiation through completion, ensuring delivery on time, within scope, and within budget. Key responsibilities include overseeing project scope, timelines, resources, budgets, and stakeholder communications. The role also involves coordinating the selection and management of vendors and technologies. The Project Manager will plan and implement major initiatives that may impact the entire enterprise, specific business units, or individual business lines. This includes managing all aspects of vendor contract terms, pricing, approvals, and performance. Additionally, the role will develop and track project metrics, evaluate return on investment, and ensure that all projects meet established quality standards and client expectations.

Job Duties

· Manage all aspects of key initiatives including research, scope, requirements, analysis, costs/benefits, implementation schedule, communication mediums and tracking of results.

· Monitor trends and develop high-level proposals that enhance service delivery systems and strengthen the Club’s competitive position.

· Manage projects of varying size and complexity including development of timetable matrices and project metrics. Apply advanced project management techniques, determine appropriate analytical approaches and develop project plans, outlining current state, defining objectives, deliverables and measures of success.

· Oversee multiple team/committee members, contractors and vendors to ensure effective resource utilization and allocation. Ensure projects are completed on schedule and within budget.

· Build strategic relationships with other business units, contractors and vendors in support of standardized methodologies and integration of supporting tools.

· Develop a formal mechanism for communicating status/progress of key initiatives to all staff levels including executive management.

· Participate with Senior Management in other Club business units, other AAA clubs and AAA National to support programs and achievement of assigned projects for the organization.

· Collaborate and communicate with all levels of employees to identify problems and develop solutions. Conduct meetings, facilitate open discussions and consult subject matter experts within affected area(s).

· Participate with Executive Management on the development of strategic plans for involving the implementation of technology as a critical element.

· The position is fully accountable for the results of assigned projects and is empowered to make decisions within the defined project scope. Decisions are often made in high-pressure situations, when facing critical deadlines.

· Assignments vary in scope and complexity and require balancing priorities and tasks of several concurrent projects and associated project teams. Position frequently deals with introducing new technologies and processes into the organization and must also work through intricate resource scheduling scenarios involving multiple organizations, contractors and outside vendors.

· Problem solving events and decision making involve other business units, requiring high level skills of negotiation and persuasiveness to achieve goals and acquire the necessary accommodation for resolutions to take place.


Qualifications

· Bachelors' Equivalent combination of education and experience.

· 7-9 years Project Management, Financial analysis or related experience.

· Previous experience preparing and analyzing financial reports, developing cost-benefit models and creating detailed written proposals/recommendations required.

· Professional verbal and written communication skills required.

· Ability to multi-task, balance numerous and diverse operations, as well as possess the ability to work well with all levels of employees and management required.

· A proven ability to produce recommendations and proposals, and a demonstrated ability to handle effective negotiations and complaint resolutions desired.

· Prior experience managing multi-location/multi-state projects within a major organization preferred.

· General management, organizational and time management skills required.

· Proficiency in Microsoft Office software, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Microsoft Project, required

· Position requires periodic travel.

· Valid Driver's License, acceptable Department of Motor Vehicles record

· Program Management Professional (PgMP) - Project Management Institute Preferred

· Ability to qualify for Life Insurance License within six months of employment

$99,500.00 - $132,900.00
